	0x5097, // +0x00: MOV.L @(7,R9),R0    ; ISTNRM addr
	0x539A, // +0x02: MOV.L @(10,R9),R3   ; scratch base
	0x6102, // +0x04: MOV.L @R0,R1
	0x5294, // +0x06: MOV.L @(4,R9),R2    ; Maple done bit
	0x2128, // +0x08: TST R2,R1
	0x8904, // +0x0A: BT +4 -> +0x16 (no Maple event)
	0x0009, // +0x0C: NOP (delay slot)
	0x5430, // +0x0E: MOV.L @(0,R3),R4    ; Maple IRQ count
	0x7401, // +0x10: ADD #1,R4
	0x1340, // +0x12: MOV.L R4,@(0,R3)
	0x2022, // +0x14: MOV.L R2,@R0        ; ack ISTNRM bit 12
	0x5098, // +0x16: MOV.L @(8,R9),R0    ; ISTEXT addr
	0x6102, // +0x18: MOV.L @R0,R1
	0xE202, // +0x1A: MOV #2,R2           ; AICA bit
	0x2128, // +0x1C: TST R2,R1
	0x8906, // +0x1E: BT +6 -> +0x2E (no AICA event)
	0x0009, // +0x20: NOP (delay slot)
	0x5431, // +0x22: MOV.L @(1,R3),R4    ; AICA IRQ count
	0x7401, // +0x24: ADD #1,R4
	0x1341, // +0x26: MOV.L R4,@(1,R3)
	0x5099, // +0x28: MOV.L @(9,R9),R0    ; MCIRE addr
	0x529B, // +0x2A: MOV.L @(11,R9),R2   ; timer B source bit
	0x2022, // +0x2C: MOV.L R2,@R0        ; clear AICA pending
	0x002B, // +0x2E: RTE
	0x0009, // +0x30: NOP (delay slot)
}

// dc3DataPage is written by the test at physical 0x0C000800.
var dc3DataPage = []uint32{
	0x40000000, // 0: SR, IMASK 0
	0x8C001000, // 1: VBR
	0x8C010000, // 2: stack top
	0x8C100000, // 3: driver image in main RAM
	0x00800000, // 4: AICA RAM base
	0x00000114, // 5: driver size in bytes
	0xA0702C00, // 6: ARMRST register
	0x8C200000, // 7: Maple table (virtual)
	0x00000001, // 8: entry 0 header: port 0, 2 frame words
	0x0C210000, // 9: entry 0 receive buffer
	0x09200001, // 10: Get Condition frame header, port 0
	0x01000000, // 11: controller function code
	0x80000000, // 12: entry 1 header: last, port 1, 1 frame word
	0x0C220000, // 13: entry 1 receive buffer
	0x01604000, // 14: Device Request frame header, port 1
	0xA05F6C04, // 15: SB_MDSTAR
	0x0C200000, // 16: table physical address
	0xA05F6C14, // 17: SB_MDEN
	0xA05F6C18, // 18: SB_MDST
	0xA05F6910, // 19: SB_IML2NRM
	0x00001000, // 20: Maple DMA done bit (ISTNRM bit 12)
	0xA05F6914, // 21: SB_IML2EXT
	0x00000002, // 22: AICA bit (ISTEXT bit 1)
	0xA05F6900, // 23: SB_ISTNRM
	0xA05F6904, // 24: SB_ISTEXT
	0xA07028BC, // 25: AICA MCIRE
	0x8C002000, // 26: scratch base
	0x00000080, // 27: timer B source bit (MCIRE value)
}

const (
	dc3ScratchPhys = 0x0C002000
	dc3Recv0Phys   = 0x0C210000
	dc3Recv1Phys   = 0x0C220000
)

// dc3PCM is the 64 sample loop the ARM driver plays.
func dc3PCM(i int) int16 { return int16((i - 32) * 256) }

// setupDC3Fog submits the fog gate scene through the bus.
func setupDC3Fog(t *testing.T, m *Machine) {
	t.Helper()
	pvrReg(m, 0x48, 0x3)       // FB_W_CTRL: enable, 565
	pvrReg(m, 0x60, 0)         // FB_W_SOF1 = VRAM 0
	pvrReg(m, 0x44, 0x800003)  // FB_R_CTRL: enable, 565, vclk_div
	pvrReg(m, 0x50, 0)         // FB_R_SOF1 = VRAM 0
	pvrReg(m, 0x5C, 15|31<<10) // FB_R_SIZE: 32 wide, 32 lines
	pvrReg(m, 0x68, 31<<16)    // FB_X_CLIP max 31
	pvrReg(m, 0x6C, 31<<16)    // FB_Y_CLIP max 31
	pvrReg(m, 0x98, 0xFF000000)
	pvrReg(m, 0x9C, 0)
	pvrReg(m, 0x128, 0x10000) // TA_ISP_BASE
	// Fog: entries 8 and 9 carry low bytes 100 and 156 (the
	// high bytes are junk on purpose), density 4.25, white.
	for i := 0; i < 128; i += 2 {
		var v uint32
		if i == 8 {
			v = 0xAB64 | 0xCD9C<<16
		}
		m.Bus.Write32(0x005F8000+0x200+uint32(i*2), v)
	}
	pvrReg(m, 0xB0, 0x00FFFFFF) // FOG_COL_RAM white
	pvrReg(m, 0xB8, 0x8802)     // FOG_DENSITY 4.25
	pvrReg(m, 0x140, 0)         // TA_LIST_INIT
	// Polygon header: opaque, ISP depth always with fog mode
	// 0 (table), TSP untextured one-zero blend, base black.
	taPacket(m,
		4<<29,      // polygon header, opaque list
		7,          // ISP/TSP: depth always, fog table mode
		0x6C080000, // TSP: src one, dst zero, 8 by 8 size codes
		0,          // TCW (untextured)
		0xFF000000, // base color black
		0, 0, 0,
	)
	f32 := math.Float32bits
	vtx := func(x, y float32, eos bool) {
		pcw := uint32(7 << 29)
		if eos {
			pcw |= 1 << 28
		}
		taPacket(m, pcw, f32(x), f32(y), f32(0.5), f32(0), f32(0), 0xFF000000, 0)
	}
	vtx(0, 0, false)
	vtx(32, 0, false)
	vtx(0, 32, false)
	vtx(32, 32, true)
	taPacket(m, 0)     // end of list
	pvrReg(m, 0x14, 0) // STARTRENDER
}

func loadDC3Machine(t *testing.T) *Machine {
	t.Helper()
	img := make([]byte, 0x1700)
	put := func(off int, words []uint16) {
		for i, w := range words {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[off+2*i:], w)
		}
	}
	put(0, dc3ProgramWords)
	put(0x1600, dc3HandlerWords)
	m := New()
	m.LoadProgram(0x0C000000, img)
	for i, v := range dc3DataPage {
		m.Bus.Write32(0x0C000800+uint32(4*i), v)
	}
	// The ARM driver image waits in main RAM for the SH-4
	// program to copy it into AICA RAM.
	for i, w := range armDriverWords {
		m.Bus.Write32(0x0C100000+uint32(4*i), w)
	}
	// The PCM loop data sits at wave RAM 0x1000.
	for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
		m.Bus.Write16(0x00801000+uint32(2*i), uint16(dc3PCM(i)))
	}
	m.SetButtons(PadState{
		Mask:     BtnA | BtnStart,
		TriggerL: 200,
		JoyX:     30,
		JoyY:     200,
	})
	setupDC3Fog(t, m)
	return m
}

// audioBytes flattens drained stereo samples for comparison.
func audioBytes(a [][2]int16) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, 4*len(a))
	for i, s := range a {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[4*i:], uint16(s[0]))
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[4*i+2:], uint16(s[1]))
	}
	return b
}

func TestDC3WholeMachineDeterminism(t *testing.T) {
	m := loadDC3Machine(t)
	m.RunFrame()

	// The fog scene rendered through the whole machine.
	if got := m.Framebuffer()[16*Width+16]; got != 0xFF848284 {
		t.Errorf("fog center pixel = %#08x, want 0xFF848284", got)
	}

	// The Maple poll landed: port 0 Get Condition and port 1
	// Device Info in the receive buffers.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv0Phys + 0); got != 0x07002003 {
		t.Errorf("condition header = %#08x, want 0x07002003", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv0Phys + 4); got != 0x01000000 {
		t.Errorf("condition function = %#08x, want controller 0x01000000", got)
	}
	// A (wire bit 2) and Start (wire bit 3) pressed, active
	// low; right trigger 0, left trigger 200.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv0Phys + 8); got != 0xFFF300C8 {
		t.Errorf("condition word 1 = %#08x, want 0xFFF300C8", got)
	}
	// Stick at (30, 200), second stick centered.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv0Phys + 12); got != 0x8080C81E {
		t.Errorf("condition word 2 = %#08x, want 0x8080C81E", got)
	}
	// Port 1: recipient is the port 1 host address 0x40, the
	// sender is the port 1 main device 0x60.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv1Phys + 0); got != 0x0540601C {
		t.Errorf("device info header = %#08x, want 0x0540601C", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3Recv1Phys + 4); got != 0x01000000 {
		t.Errorf("device info function = %#08x, want controller 0x01000000", got)
	}

	// Both interrupt paths vectored the SH-4 handler, and the
	// ARM FIQ handler ran (its wave RAM counter advanced).
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3ScratchPhys + 0); got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("Maple IRQ count = %d, want exactly 1", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc3ScratchPhys + 4); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("AICA IRQ count = %d, want at least 1", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(0x00802000); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("ARM timer counter = %d, want at least 1", got)
	}

	// The sound is the PCM loop itself: search the drained
	// stream for one full period and require two exact
	// periods in both channels.
	audio1 := m.AudioBuffer()
	if len(audio1) < 600 || len(audio1) > 900 {
		t.Fatalf("frame 1 audio = %d samples, want about 735", len(audio1))
	}
	found := -1
	for i := 0; i+128 <= len(audio1); i++ {
		if audio1[i][0] == dc3PCM(0) && audio1[i][1] == dc3PCM(0) {
			ok := true
			for j := 0; j < 128; j++ {
				if audio1[i+j][0] != dc3PCM(j%64) || audio1[i+j][1] != dc3PCM(j%64) {
					ok = false
					break
				}
			}
			if ok {
				found = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if found < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("PCM loop period not found verbatim in %d drained samples", len(audio1))
	}
	t.Logf("audio frame 1: %d samples, loop period found at index %d", len(audio1), found)

	// Mid run save, then byte identical continuation on the
	// original and on a restored machine.
	state := m.Serialize()
	t.Logf("state v3 size: %d bytes", len(state))

	m.RunFrame()
	wantAudio := m.AudioBuffer()
	wantFB := append([]uint32(nil), m.Framebuffer()...)
	wantState := m.Serialize()

	m2 := New()
	if !m2.Deserialize(state) {
		t.Fatal("Deserialize of the mid run state failed")
	}
	m2.RunFrame()
	if got := m2.AudioBuffer(); !bytes.Equal(audioBytes(got), audioBytes(wantAudio)) {
		t.Errorf("restored audio differs (%d vs %d samples)", len(got), len(wantAudio))
	}
	if got := m2.Framebuffer(); !bytes.Equal(u32s(got), u32s(wantFB)) {
		t.Error("restored framebuffer differs")
	}
	if got := m2.Serialize(); !bytes.Equal(got, wantState) {
		t.Errorf("restored final state differs (%d vs %d bytes)", len(got), len(wantState))
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-dreamcast/system/dc4_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// DC-4 enginetest gate (the swap-class gate for the core).
//
// A synthetic disc carries an IP.BIN whose program is
// hand-assembled SH-4 (assembled by the small assembler in
// this file; every encoding is the documented one, and most
// are cross-checked against the DC-2 and DC-3 fixture words).
// The machine boots ONLY through BootDisc: the HLE BIOS
// installs the IP at 0x8C008000 and enters it at 0x8C008300,
// and the IP then does what a real IP does: it initializes
// the GD system through the BIOS syscall vectors, asks for
// the TOC, walks the ISO9660 root directory for the boot
// file named in its own header, loads that file sector by
// sector through the BIOS PIOREAD command to 0x8C010000, and
// jumps to it.
//
// The payload (the boot file) then exercises the whole
// machine: it uploads the DC-3 ARM7 sound driver and keys
// the looping PCM tone, polls the Maple controller on port 0
// through a Maple DMA table and records the condition
// words, renders the DC-2 textured quad scene through the
// TA FIFO, arms the vblank-in interrupt, and idles on SLEEP
// while its handler counts vblanks. Milestone words land in
// order at 0x8C300000. The gate asserts the milestones, the
// exact framebuffer probes, the tone period, the recorded
// Maple condition against the host SetButtons state, and a
// mid-run save restoring byte-identical continuation.
//
// The same disc is written under testroms/enginetest for the
// shared harness run through the built desktop .so.

// ----------------------------------------------------------------
// A small two-pass SH-4 assembler for the fixtures. Only the
// instruction forms the fixtures use are provided; encodings
// follow the SH-4 manual.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------

const (
	fixBra = iota
	fixBsr
	fixBf
	fixBt
	fixMovL
)

type sh4Fix struct {
	at    int // word index of the instruction to patch
	kind  int
	label string
}

type sh4Asm struct {
	base   uint32
	words  []uint16
	labels map[string]uint32
	fix    []sh4Fix
}

func newSH4Asm(base uint32) *sh4Asm {
	return &sh4Asm{base: base, labels: map[string]uint32{}}
}

func (a *sh4Asm) pc() uint32 { return a.base + 2*uint32(len(a.words)) }

func (a *sh4Asm) label(name string) { a.labels[name] = a.pc() }

func (a *sh4Asm) emit(ws ...uint16) { a.words = append(a.words, ws...) }

// long emits a 32 bit literal, padding to a 4 byte boundary
// with a NOP first when needed.
func (a *sh4Asm) long(v uint32) {
	if len(a.words)%2 != 0 {
		a.emit(0x0009)
	}
	a.emit(uint16(v), uint16(v>>16))
}

// pool emits a named 32 bit literal: the padding comes
// first, then the label, so the label names the literal
// itself and PC relative loads land exactly on it.
func (a *sh4Asm) pool(name string, v uint32) {
	if len(a.words)%2 != 0 {
		a.emit(0x0009)
	}
	a.label(name)
	a.emit(uint16(v), uint16(v>>16))
}

func (a *sh4Asm) branch(kind int, op uint16, label string) {
	a.fix = append(a.fix, sh4Fix{at: len(a.words), kind: kind, label: label})
	a.emit(op)
}

// bra and bsr also append a NOP delay slot automatically:
// their delay slots always execute, and no fixture wants a
// real instruction there (a result copy in a call's delay
// slot reads the pre-call register, a classic trap).
func (a *sh4Asm) bra(l string) { a.branch(fixBra, 0xA000, l); a.emit(0x0009) }
func (a *sh4Asm) bsr(l string) { a.branch(fixBsr, 0xB000, l); a.emit(0x0009) }

// bf and bt append a NOP delay slot automatically: on SH-4
// the delay slot of a conditional branch executes only when
// the branch is taken, so a real instruction parked there
// would run on exactly the wrong path. Callers that emit
// their own NOP after a bt or bf simply get two.
func (a *sh4Asm) bf(l string) { a.branch(fixBf, 0x8B00, l); a.emit(0x0009) }
func (a *sh4Asm) bt(l string) { a.branch(fixBt, 0x8900, l); a.emit(0x0009) }

// movl emits MOV.L @(label,PC),Rn with the displacement
// patched at assembly time.
func (a *sh4Asm) movl(rn int, label string) {
	a.fix = append(a.fix, sh4Fix{at: len(a.words), kind: fixMovL, label: label})
	a.emit(uint16(0xD000 | rn<<8))
}

// bytes finishes the assembly, resolving every fixup.
func (a *sh4Asm) bytes(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	for _, f := range a.fix {
		target, ok := a.labels[f.label]
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("assembler: undefined label %q", f.label)
		}
		addr := a.base + 2*uint32(f.at)
		disp := int32(target) - int32(addr+4)
		switch f.kind {
		case fixBra, fixBsr:
			if disp%2 != 0 || disp < -4096 || disp > 4094 {
				t.Fatalf("assembler: branch to %q out of range (%d)", f.label, disp)
			}
			a.words[f.at] |= uint16((disp / 2) & 0xFFF)
		case fixBf, fixBt:
			if disp%2 != 0 || disp < -256 || disp > 254 {
				t.Fatalf("assembler: branch to %q out of range (%d)", f.label, disp)
			}
			a.words[f.at] |= uint16((disp / 2) & 0xFF)
		case fixMovL:
			d := int32(target) - int32((addr&^3)+4)
			if d < 0 || d%4 != 0 || d/4 > 255 {
				t.Fatalf("assembler: literal %q out of range (%d)", f.label, d)
			}
			a.words[f.at] |= uint16(d / 4)
		}
	}
	out := make([]byte, 2*len(a.words))
	for i, w := range a.words {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[2*i:], w)
	}
	return out
}

// Instruction encoders. Register operands are plain numbers
// (R0 is 0, R15 is 15). For two-register forms the argument
// order matches the assembly syntax: eMov(dst, src) is
// MOV src,dst; eCmpEq(rn, rm) is CMP/EQ Rm,Rn (equality is
// symmetric, so the order only matters for reading).
func eMovImm(rn, imm int) uint16 { return uint16(0xE000 | rn<<8 | imm&0xFF) }
func eMov(dst, src int) uint16   { return uint16(0x6003 | dst<<8 | src<<4) }
func eAddImm(rn, imm int) uint16 { return uint16(0x7000 | rn<<8 | imm&0xFF) }
func eAdd(dst, src int) uint16   { return uint16(0x300C | dst<<8 | src<<4) }
func eSub(dst, src int) uint16   { return uint16(0x3008 | dst<<8 | src<<4) }
func eCmpEqImm(imm int) uint16   { return uint16(0x8800 | imm&0xFF) }
func eCmpEq(rn, rm int) uint16   { return uint16(0x3000 | rn<<8 | rm<<4) }
func eCmpHS(rn, rm int) uint16   { return uint16(0x3002 | rn<<8 | rm<<4) }
func eCmpGT(rn, rm int) uint16   { return uint16(0x3007 | rn<<8 | rm<<4) }
func eOr(rn, rm int) uint16      { return uint16(0x200B | rn<<8 | rm<<4) }
func eMovLld(d, rn, dst int) uint16 {
	return uint16(0x5000 | dst<<8 | rn<<4 | d&0xF) // MOV.L @(d*4,Rn),dst
}
func eMovLst(d, rn, src int) uint16 {
	return uint16(0x1000 | rn<<8 | src<<4 | d&0xF) // MOV.L src,@(d*4,Rn)
}
func eMovLAt(addr, dst int) uint16 { return uint16(0x6002 | dst<<8 | addr<<4) } // MOV.L @addr,dst
func eMovLSt(addr, src int) uint16 { return uint16(0x2002 | addr<<8 | src<<4) } // MOV.L src,@addr
func eMovLPush(addr, src int) uint16 {
	return uint16(0x2006 | addr<<8 | src<<4) // MOV.L src,@-addr
}
func eMovLPop(addr, dst int) uint16 {
	return uint16(0x6006 | dst<<8 | addr<<4) // MOV.L @addr+,dst
}
func eMovBAt(addr, dst int) uint16    { return uint16(0x6000 | dst<<8 | addr<<4) } // MOV.B @addr,dst
func eMovBAtInc(addr, dst int) uint16 { return uint16(0x6004 | dst<<8 | addr<<4) } // MOV.B @addr+,dst
func eExtUB(rn, rm int) uint16        { return uint16(0x600C | rn<<8 | rm<<4) }    // EXTU.B rm,rn
func eShll(rn int) uint16             { return uint16(0x4000 | rn<<8) }
func eShll2(rn int) uint16            { return uint16(0x4008 | rn<<8) }
func eShll8(rn int) uint16            { return uint16(0x4018 | rn<<8) }
func eShll16(rn int) uint16           { return uint16(0x4028 | rn<<8) }
func eDT(rn int) uint16               { return uint16(0x4010 | rn<<8) }
func eJmp(rn int) uint16              { return uint16(0x402B | rn<<8) }
func eJsr(rn int) uint16              { return uint16(0x400B | rn<<8) }
func eLdcSR(rm int) uint16            { return uint16(0x400E | rm<<8) }
func eLdcVBR(rm int) uint16           { return uint16(0x402E | rm<<8) }
func eStsPR(rn int) uint16            { return uint16(0x002A | rn<<8) }
func eLdsPR(rm int) uint16            { return uint16(0x402A | rm<<8) } // LDS Rm,PR (0x400A is MACH)

const (
	wNOP   = 0x0009
	wRTS   = 0x000B
	wRTE   = 0x002B
	wSLEEP = 0x001B
)

// pushPR saves PR on the stack (through R0 or R1, whichever
// the caller has free at the matching restore).
func pushPR(a *sh4Asm) {
	a.emit(eStsPR(0), eMovLPush(15, 0))
}

func popPR(a *sh4Asm) {
	a.emit(eMovLPop(15, 1), eLdsPR(1))
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------
// The IP program, entered at 0x8C008300 inside the IP.BIN
// image at 0x8C008000. Image data areas: parameter block at
// image +0x2000, GD status block at +0x2010, TOC buffer at
// +0x2100, sector buffer at +0x4000, vector page at +0x5000
// (VBR = image +0x5000). Persistent registers: R12 = data
// area start FAD, R13 = boot filename length, R14 = image
// base. Subroutines clobber R0 to R8 only.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------

func buildIPProgram(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	a := newSH4Asm(IPEntryAddr)

	// ---- main ----
	a.label("main")
	a.movl(0, "cSR")
	a.emit(eLdcSR(0)) // SR = 0x40000000: privileged, IMASK 0, FPU on
	a.movl(15, "cSP") // SP = 0x8C00E000 (inside the IP image)
	a.movl(0, "cVBR") // VBR = image + 0x5000
	a.emit(eLdcVBR(0))
	a.movl(14, "cIB") // R14 = image base 0x8C008000

	// Boot filename length: the header field at image +0x60
	// is space padded; count bytes to the first space or NUL.
	a.emit(eMov(1, 14), eAddImm(1, 0x60))
	a.emit(eMovImm(13, 0))
	a.label("len_loop")
	a.emit(eMovBAt(1, 0), eCmpEqImm(0x20))
	a.bt("len_done")
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(0))
	a.bt("len_done")
	a.emit(eAddImm(13, 1), eAddImm(1, 1))
	a.emit(eMov(0, 13), eCmpEqImm(16))
	a.bt("len_done")
	a.bra("len_loop")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("len_done")

	// GD command INIT (24) with a zeroed parameter block.
	a.movl(1, "cParams")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0))
	for d := 0; d < 4; d++ {
		a.emit(eMovLst(d, 1, 0))
	}
	a.emit(eMovImm(4, 24), eMov(5, 1))
	a.bsr("gd_cmd")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("init_ok")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("init_ok")

	// GD command GETTOC2 (19): params session 0, TOC buffer.
	a.movl(1, "cParams")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(0, 1, 0))
	a.movl(0, "cTOC")
	a.emit(eMovLst(1, 1, 0))
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(2, 1, 0), eMovLst(3, 1, 0))
	a.emit(eMovImm(4, 19), eMov(5, 1))
	a.bsr("gd_cmd")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("toc_ok")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("toc_ok")

	// Data area start FAD: TOC word [2 + 2*(sessions-1)].
	a.movl(1, "cTOC")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(1, 0))  // sessions
	a.emit(eAddImm(0, -1)) // sessions - 1
	a.emit(eShll(0))       // 2*(sessions-1)
	a.emit(eAddImm(0, 2))  // word index
	a.emit(eShll2(0))      // byte offset
	a.emit(eAdd(0, 1))     // address of the session start word
	a.emit(eMovLAt(0, 12)) // R12 = data start FAD

	// Read the PVD (relative sector 16) into the sector buffer.
	a.emit(eMov(4, 12), eAddImm(4, 16), eMovImm(5, 1))
	a.movl(6, "cSector")
	a.bsr("gd_read")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("pvd_ok")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("pvd_ok")

	// Root directory record in the PVD at sector +156: extent
	// is the unaligned word at +158, size at +166.
	a.movl(1, "cRootRec")
	a.emit(eAddImm(1, 2))
	a.bsr("load32u")
	a.emit(eMov(9, 0)) // R9 = root extent (relative sector)
	a.movl(1, "cRootRec")
	a.emit(eAddImm(1, 10))
	a.bsr("load32u")
	a.emit(eMov(10, 0)) // R10 = root size in bytes

	// Walk the root directory sector by sector. Loop state
	// lives in R9 and R11: gd_cmd keeps its request id in
	// R8, so R8 is call-clobbered like R0 to R7.
	a.emit(eAdd(9, 12))  // R9 = current directory FAD
	a.emit(eMov(11, 10)) // R11 = bytes remaining
	a.label("dir_loop")
	a.emit(eMov(4, 9), eMovImm(5, 1))
	a.movl(6, "cSector")
	a.bsr("gd_read")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("dir_read_ok")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("dir_read_ok")
	a.bsr("scan_dir")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("found")
	a.emit(eAddImm(9, 1))
	a.movl(0, "c2048")
	a.emit(eSub(11, 0)) // remaining -= 2048
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eCmpGT(11, 0))
	a.bt("dir_loop")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)

	// Load the boot file: R9 = absolute FAD, R10 = size.
	a.label("found")
	a.emit(eMovImm(11, 0)) // sector index
	a.emit(eMovImm(12, 0)) // bytes loaded
	a.label("load_loop")
	a.emit(eCmpHS(12, 10)) // loaded >= size, unsigned
	a.bt("load_done")
	a.emit(eMov(4, 9), eAdd(4, 11), eMovImm(5, 1))
	a.emit(eMov(6, 11), eShll8(6), eShll2(6), eShll(6)) // dest offset = i * 2048
	a.movl(0, "cBoot")
	a.emit(eAdd(6, 0))
	a.bsr("gd_read")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(1))
	a.bt("load_ok")
	a.bra("fail")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("load_ok")
	a.emit(eAddImm(11, 1))
	a.movl(0, "c2048")
	a.emit(eAdd(12, 0))
	a.bra("load_loop")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("load_done")

	// Milestone 1: the IP loaded the program. Jump to it.
	a.movl(1, "cMile")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 1), eMovLSt(1, 0))
	a.movl(0, "cBoot")
	a.emit(eJmp(0))
	a.emit(wNOP)

	a.label("fail")
	a.movl(1, "cMile")
	a.movl(0, "cDead")
	a.emit(eMovLSt(1, 0))
	a.label("fail_spin")
	a.bra("fail_spin")
	a.emit(wNOP)

	// ---- gd_cmd: R4 = command, R5 = parameter block pointer.
	// Runs REQ_CMD, EXEC_SERVER, then polls GET_CMD_STAT
	// until the request completes or errors. Returns the
	// final status (1 complete, 2 error) in R0. ----
	a.label("gd_cmd")
	pushPR(a)
	// REQ_CMD: R7 = 0, R6 = 0.
	a.movl(1, "cVecBC")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(1, 1))
	a.emit(eMovImm(6, 0), eMovImm(7, 0), eJsr(1), wNOP)
	a.emit(eMov(8, 0)) // R8 = request id
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(0))
	a.bt("gd_fail") // id 0 means the interface stayed busy
	// EXEC_SERVER: R7 = 2, R6 = 0.
	a.movl(1, "cVecBC")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(1, 1))
	a.emit(eMovImm(6, 0), eMovImm(7, 2), eJsr(1), wNOP)
	a.label("gd_poll")
	// GET_CMD_STAT: R4 = id, R5 = status block, R7 = 1.
	a.movl(1, "cVecBC")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(1, 1))
	a.emit(eMov(4, 8))
	a.movl(5, "cStatus")
	a.emit(eMovImm(6, 0), eMovImm(7, 1), eJsr(1), wNOP)
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(0)) // 0 = still busy
	a.bt("gd_poll")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	// R0 already holds the final status.
	popPR(a)
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)
	a.label("gd_fail")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 2))
	popPR(a)
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)

	// ---- gd_read: R4 = FAD, R5 = sector count, R6 = dest.
	// Fills the parameter block and issues PIOREAD (16)
	// through gd_cmd. Returns gd_cmd's status in R0. ----
	a.label("gd_read")
	pushPR(a)
	a.movl(1, "cParams")
	a.emit(eMovLst(0, 1, 4), eMovLst(1, 1, 5), eMovLst(2, 1, 6))
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(3, 1, 0))
	a.emit(eMovImm(4, 16), eMov(5, 1))
	a.bsr("gd_cmd")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	popPR(a)
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)

	// ---- load32u: R1 = unaligned address. Returns the
	// little-endian word there in R0. Clobbers R0, R1, R2. ----
	a.label("load32u")
	a.emit(eMovBAtInc(1, 0), eExtUB(0, 0))
	a.emit(eMovBAtInc(1, 2), eExtUB(2, 2), eShll8(2), eOr(0, 2))
	a.emit(eMovBAtInc(1, 2), eExtUB(2, 2), eShll16(2), eOr(0, 2))
	a.emit(eMovBAtInc(1, 2), eExtUB(2, 2), eShll16(2), eShll8(2), eOr(0, 2))
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)

	// ---- scan_dir: scans the sector in the sector buffer
	// for the boot filename (R13 = its length, the name
	// itself at R14 + 0x60). On a match returns R0 = 1 with
	// R9 = absolute FAD and R10 = size; else R0 = 0. ----
	a.label("scan_dir")
	pushPR(a)
	a.movl(1, "cSector")    // cursor
	a.movl(2, "cSectorEnd") // end of sector
	a.label("sd_loop")
	a.emit(eCmpHS(1, 2)) // cursor >= end
	a.bt("sd_notfound")
	a.emit(eMovBAt(1, 0), eExtUB(0, 0), eCmpEqImm(0))
	a.bt("sd_notfound") // zero record length: padding
	a.emit(eMov(3, 0))  // R3 = record length
	// Name length at cursor + 32.
	a.emit(eMov(4, 1), eAddImm(4, 32), eMovBAt(4, 5), eExtUB(5, 5))
	a.emit(eMov(0, 13), eCmpEq(5, 0)) // nameLen == H
	a.bt("sd_cmp")
	a.emit(eMov(0, 13), eAddImm(0, 2), eCmpEq(5, 0)) // nameLen == H + 2
	a.bt("sd_cmp2")
	a.bra("sd_next")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("sd_cmp2") // the ";1" version suffix must follow
	a.emit(eMov(4, 1), eAddImm(4, 33), eAdd(4, 13))
	a.emit(eMovBAt(4, 0), eExtUB(0, 0), eCmpEqImm(0x3B)) // ';'
	a.bf("sd_next")
	a.emit(eAddImm(4, 1))
	a.emit(eMovBAt(4, 0), eExtUB(0, 0), eCmpEqImm(0x31)) // '1'
	a.bf("sd_next")
	a.bra("sd_cmp")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("sd_cmp")
	a.emit(eMov(4, 1), eAddImm(4, 33)) // record name
	a.emit(eMov(5, 14), eAddImm(5, 0x60))
	a.emit(eMovImm(6, 0)) // index
	a.label("sd_cmp_loop")
	a.emit(eCmpEq(6, 13))
	a.bt("sd_match")
	a.emit(eMovBAt(4, 0), eExtUB(0, 0))
	a.emit(eMovBAt(5, 2), eExtUB(2, 2))
	a.emit(eCmpEq(2, 0))
	a.bf("sd_next")
	a.emit(eAddImm(4, 1), eAddImm(5, 1), eAddImm(6, 1))
	a.bra("sd_cmp_loop")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("sd_next")
	a.emit(eAdd(1, 3))
	a.bra("sd_loop")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.label("sd_match")
	a.emit(eMov(7, 1), eAddImm(1, 2))
	a.bsr("load32u")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eMov(9, 0), eAdd(9, 12)) // absolute FAD
	a.emit(eMov(1, 7), eAddImm(1, 10))
	a.bsr("load32u")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eMov(10, 0))
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 1))
	popPR(a)
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)
	a.label("sd_notfound")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0))
	popPR(a)
	a.emit(wRTS, wNOP)

	// ---- literal pool ----
	a.pool("cSR", 0x40000000)
	a.pool("cSP", 0x8C00E000)
	a.pool("cVBR", 0x8C00D000)
	a.pool("cIB", 0x8C008000)
	a.pool("cVecBC", 0x8C0000BC)
	a.pool("cParams", 0x8C00A000)
	a.pool("cStatus", 0x8C00A010)
	a.pool("cTOC", 0x8C00A100)
	a.pool("cSector", 0x8C00C000)
	a.pool("cSectorEnd", 0x8C00C800)
	a.pool("cRootRec", 0x8C00C09C)
	a.pool("cBoot", 0x8C010000)
	a.pool("cMile", 0x8C300000)
	a.pool("cDead", 0xDEAD0001)
	a.pool("c2048", 2048)

	return a.bytes(t)
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------
// The payload (the boot file), loaded at 0x8C010000. Data:
// ARM driver image at +0x4000, PCM loop at +0x4200, twiddled
// texture at +0x4400, TA packet stream at +0x4600, vector
// page at +0x8000 with the vblank handler at +0x8600.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------

const (
	dc4MilePhys  = 0x0C300000
	dc4MileVA    = 0x8C300000
	dc4PayloadVA = 0x8C010000
)

func buildPayloadProgram(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	a := newSH4Asm(dc4PayloadVA)

	a.label("main")
	a.movl(0, "cSR")
	a.emit(eLdcSR(0))
	a.movl(15, "cSP") // SP = 0x8C200000
	a.movl(0, "cVBR") // VBR = payload + 0x8000
	a.emit(eLdcVBR(0))

	// Sound: copy the ARM driver (69 words) to AICA RAM,
	// then the PCM loop (32 words) to AICA RAM + 0x1000,
	// then release the ARM7 reset.
	a.movl(1, "cAicaRAM")
	a.movl(2, "cDriver")
	a.emit(eMovImm(3, 69))
	a.label("cp1")
	a.emit(eMovLPop(2, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0), eAddImm(1, 4), eDT(3))
	a.bf("cp1")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.movl(1, "cPcmDst")
	a.movl(2, "cPCM")
	a.emit(eMovImm(3, 32))
	a.label("cp2")
	a.emit(eMovLPop(2, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0), eAddImm(1, 4), eDT(3))
	a.bf("cp2")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.movl(1, "cArmRst")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0))
	// Milestone 2: sound started.
	a.movl(1, "cMile")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 2), eMovLst(1, 1, 0))

	// Maple: one table entry, port 0 Get Condition.
	a.movl(1, "cTable")
	a.movl(0, "cE0Hdr")
	a.emit(eMovLst(0, 1, 0))
	a.movl(0, "cRecvPhys")
	a.emit(eMovLst(1, 1, 0))
	a.movl(0, "cFrame0")
	a.emit(eMovLst(2, 1, 0))
	a.movl(0, "cFrame1")
	a.emit(eMovLst(3, 1, 0))
	a.movl(1, "cMDSTAR")
	a.movl(0, "cTablePhys")
	a.emit(eMovLSt(1, 0))
	a.movl(1, "cMDEN")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 1), eMovLSt(1, 0))
	a.movl(1, "cMDST")
	a.emit(eMovLSt(1, 0)) // R0 still holds 1: transfer runs
	// Record the four receive words at milestone +8..+11.
	a.movl(1, "cRecv")
	a.movl(2, "cMile")
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		a.emit(eMovLld(i, 1, 0), eMovLst(8+i, 2, 0))
	}
	// Milestone 3: the Maple poll landed.
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 3), eMovLst(2, 2, 0))

	// PVR texture upload through the 64 bit VRAM window:
	// backing word k of the texture at VRAM 0x1000 goes to
	// window offset 2*(0x1000 + 4k).
	a.movl(1, "cTexWin")
	a.movl(2, "cTexture")
	a.emit(eMovImm(3, 32)) // 32 words = 128 bytes
	a.label("cp3")
	a.emit(eMovLPop(2, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0), eAddImm(1, 8), eDT(3))
	a.bf("cp3")
	a.emit(wNOP)

	// PVR registers. R1 = register base, R2 = base + 0x40,
	// R3 = base + 0x80.
	a.movl(1, "cPvrBase")
	a.emit(eMov(2, 1), eAddImm(2, 64))
	a.emit(eMov(3, 2), eAddImm(3, 64))
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 3), eMovLst(2, 2, 0)) // FB_W_CTRL (0x48): enable, 565
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(8, 2, 0)) // FB_W_SOF1 (0x60) = 0
	a.movl(0, "cFBRctrl")
	a.emit(eMovLst(1, 2, 0))                // FB_R_CTRL (0x44) = 0x800003
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(4, 2, 0)) // FB_R_SOF1 (0x50) = 0
	a.movl(0, "cFBRsize")
	a.emit(eMovLst(7, 2, 0)) // FB_R_SIZE (0x5C) = 63<<10|31
	a.movl(0, "cClip")
	a.emit(eMovLst(10, 2, 0)) // FB_X_CLIP (0x68) = 63<<16
	a.emit(eMovLst(11, 2, 0)) // FB_Y_CLIP (0x6C) = 63<<16
	a.movl(0, "cBG")
	a.emit(eMovLst(6, 3, 0))                // ISP_BACKGND_S (0x98) = opaque black
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLst(7, 3, 0)) // ISP_BACKGND_D (0x9C) = 0
	a.movl(4, "cTAISPB")
	a.movl(0, "cISPBase")
	a.emit(eMovLSt(4, 0)) // TA_ISP_BASE = 0x10000
	a.movl(4, "cTAInit")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLSt(4, 0)) // TA_LIST_INIT
	// TA packet stream: 40 words from payload data to the FIFO.
	a.movl(1, "cTAFIFO")
	a.movl(2, "cTAData")
	a.emit(eMovImm(3, 40))
	a.label("cp4")
	a.emit(eMovLPop(2, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0), eDT(3))
	a.bf("cp4")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	// STARTRENDER.
	a.movl(1, "cStartRender")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 0), eMovLSt(1, 0))
	// Milestone 4: the scene rendered.
	a.movl(1, "cMile")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 4), eMovLst(3, 1, 0))

	// Arm the vblank-in interrupt (Holly mask level 2, bit 3).
	a.movl(1, "cIML2NRM")
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 8), eMovLSt(1, 0))
	// Idle: wait for the handler's vblank count, record
	// milestone 5, then sleep forever between vblanks.
	a.movl(1, "cMile")
	a.movl(2, "cMileCtr") // milestone word 16, past disp range
	a.label("wait_vb")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(2, 0))
	a.emit(eCmpEqImm(0))
	a.bt("wait_vb")
	a.emit(wNOP)
	a.emit(eMovImm(0, 5), eMovLst(4, 1, 0))
	a.label("idle")
	a.emit(wSLEEP)
	a.bra("idle")
	a.emit(wNOP)

	// ---- literal pool ----
	a.pool("cSR", 0x40000000)
	a.pool("cSP", 0x8C200000)
	a.pool("cVBR", 0x8C018000)
	a.pool("cAicaRAM", 0xA0800000)
	a.pool("cDriver", dc4PayloadVA+0x4000)
	a.pool("cPcmDst", 0xA0801000)
	a.pool("cPCM", dc4PayloadVA+0x4200)
	a.pool("cArmRst", 0xA0702C00)
	a.pool("cMile", dc4MileVA)
	a.pool("cTable", 0x8C210000)
	a.pool("cE0Hdr", 0x80000001) // last entry, port 0, 2 frame words
	a.pool("cRecvPhys", 0x0C220000)
	a.pool("cFrame0", 0x09200001) // Get Condition, port 0
	a.pool("cFrame1", 0x01000000) // controller function code
	a.pool("cMDSTAR", 0xA05F6C04)
	a.pool("cTablePhys", 0x0C210000)
	a.pool("cMDEN", 0xA05F6C14)
	a.pool("cMDST", 0xA05F6C18)
	a.pool("cRecv", 0x8C220000)
	a.pool("cTexWin", 0xA5002000) // 64 bit VRAM window at backing 0x1000
	a.pool("cTexture", dc4PayloadVA+0x4400)
	a.pool("cPvrBase", 0xA05F8000)
	a.pool("cFBRctrl", 0x800003)
	a.pool("cFBRsize", 63<<10|31)
	a.pool("cClip", 63<<16)
	a.pool("cBG", 0xFF000000)
	a.pool("cTAISPB", 0xA05F8128)
	a.pool("cISPBase", 0x10000)
	a.pool("cTAInit", 0xA05F8140)
	a.pool("cTAFIFO", 0xA0500000)
	a.pool("cTAData", dc4PayloadVA+0x4600)
	a.pool("cStartRender", 0xA05F8014)
	a.pool("cIML2NRM", 0xA05F6910)
	a.pool("cMileCtr", dc4MileVA+64)

	return a.bytes(t)
}

// buildVblankHandler assembles the payload's interrupt
// handler at VBR + 0x600 = 0x8C018600: count the vblank at
// milestone word 16 and acknowledge ISTNRM bit 3.
func buildVblankHandler(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	a := newSH4Asm(0x8C018600)
	a.emit(eMovLPush(15, 0), eMovLPush(15, 1))
	a.movl(0, "cCtr")
	a.emit(eMovLAt(0, 1), eAddImm(1, 1), eMovLSt(0, 1))
	a.movl(0, "cIstnrm")
	a.emit(eMovImm(1, 8), eMovLSt(0, 1))
	a.emit(eMovLPop(15, 1), eMovLPop(15, 0))
	a.emit(wRTE, wNOP)
	a.pool("cCtr", dc4MileVA+64) // milestone word 16
	a.pool("cIstnrm", 0xA05F6900)
	return a.bytes(t)
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------
// Fixture builders: IP.BIN image, payload image, ISO, .gdi.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------

// padIPField returns s padded with spaces to width bytes.
func padIPField(s string, width int) string {
	for len(s) < width {
		s += " "
	}
	return s[:width]
}

// buildIPImage crafts the 32 KB IP.BIN: the documented
// metadata fields, the IP program at the entry offset 0x300,
// and the two VBR slots the IP's vector page needs (a spin
// at +0x100, an RTE at +0x600; the IP arms no interrupts, so
// both are pure safety nets).
func buildIPImage(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	img := make([]byte, 0x8000)
	put := func(off int, s string, width int) {
		copy(img[off:off+width], padIPField(s, width))
	}
	put(0x00, "SEGA SEGAKATANA", 16)
	put(0x10, "ITAK MAKER", 16)
	put(0x20, "GD-ROM1/1", 16)
	put(0x30, "JUE", 8)
	put(0x38, "E000F10", 16)
	put(0x48, "T-12345", 10)
	put(0x52, "V1.000", 6)
	put(0x58, "20261013", 8)
	put(0x60, "1ST_READ.BIN", 16)
	put(0x70, "ITAK", 16)
	put(0x80, "ITAK GODC ENGINETEST", 128)
	copy(img[0x300:], buildIPProgram(t))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[0x5100:], 0xAFFE) // BRA -2: spin
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[0x5102:], wNOP)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[0x5600:], wRTE)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[0x5602:], wNOP)
	return img
}

// dc4Texture builds the 8x8 RGB565 texture in twiddled
// order, the same texel pattern the DC-2 gate pins: red,
// green, and blue corners over white.
func dc4Texture() []byte {
	texel := func(x, y int) uint16 {
		switch {
		case x == 0 && y == 0:
			return 0xF800
		case x == 1 && y == 0:
			return 0x07E0
		case x == 0 && y == 1:
			return 0x001F
		}
		return 0xFFFF
	}
	img := make([]byte, 8*8*2)
	for y := 0; y < 8; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < 8; x++ {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[twiddle(x, y, 8, 8)*2:], texel(x, y))
		}
	}
	return img
}

// dc4TAStream builds the payload's TA packet stream: the
// DC-2 gate's polygon header and four vertices verbatim,
// plus the end of list packet.
func dc4TAStream() []uint32 {
	f32 := math.Float32bits
	out := []uint32{
		4 << 29,              // polygon header, opaque list
		1<<6 | 7,             // ISP/TSP: textured, depth always
		1 | 1<<24,            // TSP: bilinear, modulate
		1<<27 | (0x1000 / 8), // TCW: 565 texture at VRAM 0x1000
		0xFFFFFFFF, 0, 0, 0,  // base color white
	}
	vtx := func(x, y, u, v float32, eos bool) {
		pcw := uint32(7 << 29)
		if eos {
			pcw |= 1 << 28
		}
		out = append(out, pcw, f32(x), f32(y), f32(1), f32(u), f32(v), 0xFFFFFFFF, 0)
	}
	vtx(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0, false)
	vtx(64.5, 0.5, 1, 0, false)
	vtx(0.5, 64.5, 0, 1, false)
	vtx(64.5, 64.5, 1, 1, true)
	out = append(out, make([]uint32, 8)...) // end of list
	return out
}

// buildPayloadImage assembles the boot file image.
func buildPayloadImage(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	img := make([]byte, 0x8700)
	copy(img[0:], buildPayloadProgram(t))
	for i, w := range armDriverWords {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(img[0x4000+4*i:], w)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(img[0x4200+2*i:], uint16(dc3PCM(i)))
	}
	copy(img[0x4400:], dc4Texture())
	for i, w := range dc4TAStream() {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(img[0x4600+4*i:], w)
	}
	copy(img[0x8600:], buildVblankHandler(t))
	return img
}

// dc4DirRecord builds one ISO9660 directory record, the
// layout the gd fixtures use.
func dc4DirRecord(extent, size uint32, isDir bool, name []byte) []byte {
	recLen := 33 + len(name)
	if len(name)%2 == 0 {
		recLen++
	}
	rec := make([]byte, recLen)
	rec[0] = byte(recLen)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(rec[2:6], extent)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(rec[6:10], extent)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(rec[10:14], size)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(rec[14:18], size)
	copy(rec[18:25], []byte{126, 10, 13, 12, 0, 0, 0})
	if isDir {
		rec[25] = 0x02
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(rec[28:30], 1)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(rec[30:32], 1)
	rec[32] = byte(len(name))
	copy(rec[33:], name)
	return rec
}

// buildDC4ISO builds the data area image: the IP.BIN boot
// area in sectors 0 to 15, the PVD at 16, the root directory
// at 20, and the payload at 22.
func buildDC4ISO(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	payload := buildPayloadImage(t)
	payloadSectors := (len(payload) + 2047) / 2048
	total := 22 + payloadSectors
	img := make([]byte, total*2048)
	copy(img, buildIPImage(t))

	pvd := make([]byte, 2048)
	pvd[0] = 1
	copy(pvd[1:6], "CD001")
	pvd[6] = 1
	for i := 8; i < 72; i++ {
		pvd[i] = ' '
	}
	copy(pvd[8:], "SEGA")
	copy(pvd[40:], "ITAKGODC")
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(pvd[80:84], uint32(total))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(pvd[84:88], uint32(total))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(pvd[112:114], 2048)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(pvd[114:116], 2048)
	copy(pvd[156:], dc4DirRecord(20, 2048, true, []byte{0x00}))
	copy(img[16*2048:], pvd)

	root := make([]byte, 0, 2048)
	root = append(root, dc4DirRecord(20, 2048, true, []byte{0x00})...)
	root = append(root, dc4DirRecord(20, 2048, true, []byte{0x01})...)
	root = append(root, dc4DirRecord(22, uint32(len(payload)), false, []byte("1ST_READ.BIN;1"))...)
	copy(img[20*2048:], root)

	copy(img[22*2048:], payload)
	return img
}

// wrap2352DC4 wraps 2048 byte sectors into raw 2352 byte
// Mode 1 sectors (12 byte sync, 4 byte header, data, 288
// bytes of filler), the gd fixture layout.
func wrap2352DC4(iso []byte) []byte {
	sectors := len(iso) / 2048
	out := make([]byte, 0, sectors*2352)
	sync := []byte{0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00}
	for i := 0; i < sectors; i++ {
		out = append(out, sync...)
		total := i + 150
		out = append(out, byte(total/4500), byte((total/75)%60), byte(total%75), 0x01)
		out = append(out, iso[i*2048:(i+1)*2048]...)
		out = append(out, make([]byte, 288)...)
	}
	return out
}

// writeDC4GDI writes the harness disc set into dir: a
// two-track .gdi (a short audio track at LBA 0 and the data
// track at LBA 45000, the standard GD layout) and returns
// the .gdi path.
func writeDC4GDI(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	iso := buildDC4ISO(t)
	audio := make([]byte, 10*2352)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "track01.bin"), audio, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "track03.bin"), wrap2352DC4(iso), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gdi := "2\n1 0 0 2352 track01.bin 0\n3 45000 4 2352 track03.bin 0\n"
	p := filepath.Join(dir, "game.gdi")
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(gdi), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return p
}

// dc4Pad is the host pad state the gate holds while booting:
// A and Start pressed, left trigger pulled to 200, stick at
// (30, 200). The expected Maple condition words are the ones
// the DC-3 gate pins for exactly this state.
var dc4Pad = PadState{Mask: BtnA | BtnStart, TriggerL: 200, JoyX: 30, JoyY: 200}

var dc4WantCond = [4]uint32{0x07002003, 0x01000000, 0xFFF300C8, 0x8080C81E}

// bootDC4 loads and boots a disc image, then runs frames
// until every milestone stage has been seen or the budget
// runs out. It returns the machine and the frame index at
// which each of the five stages was first observed (-1 when
// a stage never landed).
func bootDC4(t *testing.T, path string, maxFrames int) (*Machine, [5]int) {
	t.Helper()
	m := New()
	m.SetButtons(dc4Pad)
	if err := m.LoadDisc(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadDisc(%s): %v", path, err)
	}
	if err := m.BootDisc(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("BootDisc(%s): %v", path, err)
	}
	if !m.Booted() {
		t.Fatal("Booted() = false after a successful BootDisc")
	}
	var first [5]int
	for i := range first {
		first[i] = -1
	}
	for frame := 0; frame < maxFrames; frame++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		done := true
		for s := 0; s < 5; s++ {
			if first[s] < 0 {
				if m.Bus.Read32(dc4MilePhys+uint32(4*s)) == uint32(s+1) {
					first[s] = frame
				} else {
					done = false
				}
			}
		}
		if done {
			// A few more frames so the vblank counter and
			// the tone both accumulate past their gates.
			for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
				m.RunFrame()
			}
			return m, first
		}
	}
	return m, first
}

// checkDC4Milestones asserts the ordered milestone stages.
func checkDC4Milestones(t *testing.T, m *Machine, first [5]int) {
	t.Helper()
	for s := 0; s < 5; s++ {
		if first[s] < 0 {
			word := m.Bus.Read32(dc4MilePhys + uint32(4*s))
			t.Errorf("milestone stage %d never landed (word = %#08x, PC = %#08x)",
				s+1, word, m.CPU.PC)
		}
	}
	for s := 1; s < 5; s++ {
		if first[s] >= 0 && first[s-1] >= 0 && first[s] < first[s-1] {
			t.Errorf("milestones out of order: stage %d at frame %d, stage %d at frame %d",
				s+1, first[s], s, first[s-1])
		}
	}
	// The recorded Maple condition matches the host pad.
	for i, want := range dc4WantCond {
		if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc4MilePhys + uint32(4*(8+i))); got != want {
			t.Errorf("recorded condition word %d = %#08x, want %#08x", i, got, want)
		}
	}
	// The boot used only implemented BIOS calls.
	if calls := m.UnimplementedBIOSCalls(); len(calls) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("unimplemented BIOS calls during boot: %v", calls)
	}
}

// checkDC4Scene asserts the exact rendered probes.
func checkDC4Scene(t *testing.T, m *Machine) {
	t.Helper()
	if got := m.PVR.RenderCount(); got < 1 {
		t.Errorf("RenderCount = %d, want at least 1", got)
	}
	fb16 := func(x, y int) uint16 {
		return m.Bus.Read16(0x04000000 + uint32((y*64+x)*2))
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		x, y int
		want uint16
		what string
	}{
		{4, 4, 0xF800, "texel (0,0) red"},
		{12, 4, 0x07E0, "texel (1,0) green"},
		{8, 4, 0x8400, "bilinear midpoint red/green"},
		{4, 12, 0x001F, "texel (0,1) blue"},
		{60, 60, 0xFFFF, "texel (7,7) white"},
	} {
		if got := fb16(c.x, c.y); got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("fb(%d,%d) = %#04x, want %#04x (%s)", c.x, c.y, got, c.want, c.what)
		}
	}
	if got := m.Framebuffer()[4*Width+4]; got != 0xFFFF0000 {
		t.Errorf("presented (4,4) = %#08x, want 0xFFFF0000 (red texel)", got)
	}
	if got := m.Framebuffer()[4*Width+8]; got != 0xFF848200 {
		t.Errorf("presented (8,4) = %#08x, want 0xFF848200 (bilinear midpoint)", got)
	}
	if got := m.Framebuffer()[100*Width+100]; got != 0xFF000000 {
		t.Errorf("presented (100,100) = %#08x, want 0xFF000000 (border)", got)
	}
	// The vblank handler kept counting after milestone 5.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(dc4MilePhys + 64); got < 2 {
		t.Errorf("vblank count = %d, want at least 2", got)
	}
}

// checkDC4Tone asserts the looping PCM tone in the drained
// audio: one full period verbatim, and the zero crossing
// spacing measuring the 64 sample period within tolerance.
func checkDC4Tone(t *testing.T, m *Machine) {
	t.Helper()
	audio := m.AudioBuffer()
	if len(audio) < 1200 {
		t.Fatalf("drained audio = %d samples, want several frames of tone", len(audio))
	}
	found := -1
	for i := 0; i+128 <= len(audio); i++ {
		if audio[i][0] == dc3PCM(0) && audio[i][1] == dc3PCM(0) {
			ok := true
			for j := 0; j < 128; j++ {
				if audio[i+j][0] != dc3PCM(j%64) || audio[i+j][1] != dc3PCM(j%64) {
					ok = false
					break
				}
			}
			if ok {
				found = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if found < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("PCM loop period not found verbatim in %d drained samples", len(audio))
	}
	// Measure the period from rising zero crossings of the
	// left channel after the key-on transient.
	var edges []int
	for i := 1; i < len(audio); i++ {
		if audio[i-1][0] < 0 && audio[i][0] >= 0 {
			edges = append(edges, i)
		}
	}
	if len(edges) < 8 {
		t.Fatalf("only %d rising edges in the tone, want at least 8", len(edges))
	}
	total := edges[len(edges)-1] - edges[0]
	period := float64(total) / float64(len(edges)-1)
	if period < 62 || period > 66 {
		t.Errorf("measured tone period = %.2f samples, want 64 +/- 2 (689 Hz at 44100 Hz)", period)
	}
	t.Logf("tone: period found verbatim at %d, measured period %.2f samples over %d edges",
		found, period, len(edges))
}

func TestDC4Enginetest(t *testing.T) {
	// The gate disc, plus the persistent copy the shared
	// harness runs through the built .so.
	gdiPath := writeDC4GDI(t, t.TempDir())
	writeDC4GDI(t, filepath.Join("..", "testroms", "enginetest"))

	m, first := bootDC4(t, gdiPath, 40)
	checkDC4Milestones(t, m, first)
	t.Logf("milestone frames: %v", first)
	checkDC4Scene(t, m)
	checkDC4Tone(t, m)

	// State size: the fresh v4 state is the DC-3 v3 size
	// plus exactly the BIOS block.
	if got, want := New().StateSize(), 28162473+biosStateSize; got != want {
		t.Errorf("fresh state size = %d, want %d (v3 size + BIOS block)", got, want)
	}

	// Mid-run save, byte-identical continuation.
	state := m.Serialize()
	m.RunFrame()
	m.RunFrame()
	wantFB := append([]uint32(nil), m.Framebuffer()...)
	wantAudio := audioBytes(m.AudioBuffer())
	wantState := m.Serialize()

	m2 := New()
	if !m2.Deserialize(state) {
		t.Fatal("Deserialize of the mid-run state failed")
	}
	m2.RunFrame()
	m2.RunFrame()
	if got := m2.Framebuffer(); !bytes.Equal(u32Bytes(wantFB), u32Bytes(got)) {
		t.Error("restored framebuffer differs from the original continuation")
	}
	if got := audioBytes(m2.AudioBuffer()); !bytes.Equal(wantAudio, got) {
		t.Error("restored audio differs from the original continuation")
	}
	if got := m2.Serialize(); !bytes.Equal(wantState, got) {
		t.Error("restored state bytes differ after two more frames")
	}
}

// u32Bytes flattens a framebuffer for byte comparison.
func u32Bytes(fb []uint32) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, 4*len(fb))
	for i, px := range fb {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[4*i:], px)
	}
	return b
}

func TestDC4BootISO(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	p := filepath.Join(dir, "game.iso")
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, buildDC4ISO(t), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m, first := bootDC4(t, p, 40)
	checkDC4Milestones(t, m, first)
	checkDC4Scene(t, m)
}

func TestDC4BootFailures(t *testing.T) {
	// No disc at all.
	m := New()
	if err := m.BootDisc(); err == nil {
		t.Error("BootDisc with no disc returned nil error")
	}
	// A zeroed image: the IP.BIN has no SEGA header.
	dir := t.TempDir()
	zero := filepath.Join(dir, "zero.iso")
	if err := os.WriteFile(zero, make([]byte, 25*2048), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m2 := New()
	if err := m2.LoadDisc(zero); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadDisc(zero.iso): %v", err)
	}
	if err := m2.BootDisc(); err == nil {
		t.Error("BootDisc on a zeroed IP.BIN returned nil error")
	}
	if m2.Booted() {
		t.Error("Booted() = true after a failed BootDisc")
	}
	// A truncated image: the boot area cannot be read.
	short := filepath.Join(dir, "short.iso")
	if err := os.WriteFile(short, make([]byte, 4*2048), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m3 := New()
	if err := m3.LoadDisc(short); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadDisc(short.iso): %v", err)
	}
	if err := m3.BootDisc(); err == nil {
		t.Error("BootDisc on a truncated image returned nil error")
	}
	// A missing file fails at load.
	m4 := New()
	if err := m4.LoadDisc(filepath.Join(dir, "missing.gdi")); err == nil {
		t.Error("LoadDisc on a missing file returned nil error")
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-dreamcast/system/machine.go ====================

// Package system wires the Dreamcast parts into a running machine:
// the SH-4 CPU from chips/sh4, the physical bus, a GD-ROM image
// from the gd package, the Holly interrupt controller, the
// PowerVR2 from the pvr package (DC-2), and, since DC-3, the
// AICA sound block with its ARM7 CPU, the Maple controller bus,
// and the G2 DMA controller.
//
// Timing model: the CPU charges one cycle per instruction and a
// frame is a fixed budget of FrameCycles (200 MHz divided by 60).
// RunFrame advances the CPU in scanline-sized chunks and steps
// the SPG between chunks, so vblank and hblank interrupts are
// delivered at line accuracy inside the frame. The AICA advances
// in the same chunk rhythm from an exact rational accumulator:
// AICA master cycles = SH-4 cycles * 225792 / 2000000 (the
// 22.5792 MHz AICA master against the 200 MHz SH-4 clock). The
// framebuffer is the PVR display output (FB_R_SOF1 presented per
// FB_R_CTRL), composed at the end of each RunFrame. Controller
// state set with SetButtons is delivered to games over the Maple
// bus on port 0.
package system

import (
	"encoding/binary"

	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/aica"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/bus"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/chips/sh4"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/g2dma"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/gd"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/holly"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/maple"
	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-dreamcast/pvr"
)

// Display geometry and the flat frame budget.
const (
	Width       = 640
	Height      = 480
	FrameCycles = 3333333 // 200 MHz / 60, slice 1 flat model
)

// Pad button bits for PadState.Mask, in the order documented at
// the top of this file's pad section: face buttons first, then
// Start, then the digital cross, then the digital triggers.
const (
	BtnA     uint16 = 1 << 0
	BtnB     uint16 = 1 << 1
	BtnX     uint16 = 1 << 2
	BtnY     uint16 = 1 << 3
	BtnStart uint16 = 1 << 4
	BtnUp    uint16 = 1 << 5
	BtnDown  uint16 = 1 << 6
	BtnLeft  uint16 = 1 << 7
	BtnRight uint16 = 1 << 8
	BtnLT    uint16 = 1 << 9  // left trigger, digital bit
	BtnRT    uint16 = 1 << 10 // right trigger, digital bit
)

// PadState is one Dreamcast controller report: a button mask, the
// two analog triggers (0 to 255) and the analog stick, where 128
// is centred on each axis.
type PadState struct {
	Mask     uint16
	TriggerL uint8
	TriggerR uint8
	JoyX     uint8
	JoyY     uint8
}

// stateVersion is byte 0 of a serialized machine state. Version
// 3 (DC-3) appends the AICA state (including the ARM7 CPU), the
// Maple state (including the VMU images), the G2 DMA state, and
// a small machine tail (the AICA clock accumulator remainder
// and the Maple vblank trigger edge state) after the DC-2
// sections. Version 4 (DC-4) appends the BIOS HLE block (the
// boot flag, the GD request queue, and the unimplemented-call
// diagnostics) after the machine tail.
const stateVersion = 0x04

// machineTailSize is the size of the trailing machine block:
// the AICA clock accumulator remainder (u64) and the Maple
// vblank trigger edge flag (u64, 0 or 1). Both steer future
// stepping, so both are part of the state.
const machineTailSize = 16

// aicaHolly adapts the Holly controller to the AICA's external
// interrupt sink (the AICA raises ISTEXT bit 1).
type aicaHolly struct{ h *holly.Controller }

func (s aicaHolly) RaiseExternal(bits uint32) { s.h.Raise(holly.BankExternal, bits) }
func (s aicaHolly) ClearExternal(bits uint32) { s.h.ClearExternal(bits) }

// mapleHolly adapts the Holly controller to the Maple event sink
// (Maple DMA completion raises the ISTNRM Maple DMA done event).
type mapleHolly struct{ h *holly.Controller }

func (s mapleHolly) RaiseNormal(bits uint32) { s.h.Raise(holly.BankNormal, bits) }
func (s mapleHolly) ClearNormal(bits uint32) {
	s.h.Write32(0x005F6900, bits)
}

// g2Holly adapts the Holly controller to the G2 DMA event sink.
type g2Holly struct{ h *holly.Controller }

func (s g2Holly) RaiseNormal(bits uint32) { s.h.Raise(holly.BankNormal, bits) }

// Machine is one powered-on Dreamcast.
type Machine struct {
	CPU   *sh4.CPU
	Bus   *bus.Bus
	Disc  *gd.Image
	PVR   *pvr.PVR
	Holly *holly.Controller
	AICA  *aica.AICA
	Maple *maple.Maple
	G2DMA *g2dma.Controller

	framebuffer []uint32
	pad         PadState
	discPath    string
	bios        biosState

	// aicaAcc is the numerator remainder of the SH-4 to AICA
	// master cycle conversion (denominator 2000000).
	aicaAcc uint64
	// vblankOut tracks the previous Holly vblank-out bit so the
	// Maple hardware trigger fires once per vblank-out edge.
	vblankOut bool
}

// New builds a machine (bus plus CPU) and resets the CPU. The
// Holly controller presents interrupts to the CPU; the PVR owns
// its register window, its two FIFO ports, and the shared VRAM.
// The AICA owns its register window, its RTC window, and the
// shared AICA RAM slice (which stays bus-owned for DMA and state
// serialization). The Maple controller and the G2 DMA controller
// own their register windows.
func New() *Machine {
	b := bus.New()
	cpu := sh4.New(b)
	h := holly.New(cpu)
	p := pvr.New(b.VRAM, h)
	snd := aica.New(b.AICARAM, aicaHolly{h})
	mp := maple.New(b, mapleHolly{h})
	g2 := g2dma.New(b, snd, g2Holly{h})
	// Attach order is priority order: the TA FIFO range spans
	// 0x00500000 to 0x00600000, which contains the Holly, Maple,
	// G2, and PVR register windows, so every register device
	// must attach before the two FIFO ports.
	b.Attach(0x005F6900, 0x005F6940, h, false)
	b.Attach(0x005F8000, 0x005FA000, p, false)
	b.Attach(0x005F6C00, 0x005F6D00, mp, false)
	b.Attach(0x005F7800, 0x005F7900, g2, false)
	b.Attach(0x00700000, 0x00708000, snd, false)
	b.Attach(0x00710000, 0x0071000C, snd, false)
	b.Attach(0x00500000, 0x00600000, p.TAPort(), true)
	b.Attach(0x00600000, 0x00601000, p.YUVPort(), true)
	m := &Machine{
		Bus:         b,
		CPU:         cpu,
		PVR:         p,
		Holly:       h,
		AICA:        snd,
		Maple:       mp,
		G2DMA:       g2,
		framebuffer: make([]uint32, Width*Height),
		pad:         PadState{JoyX: 128, JoyY: 128},
	}
	for port := 0; port < 4; port++ {
		mp.SetPad(port, maple.PadState{JoyX: 128, JoyY: 128})
	}
	m.CPU.Reset()
	return m
}

// LoadDisc opens a GD-ROM image (.gdi, .iso or .bin) and holds it
// as the machine's disc. The open error, if any, propagates to the
// caller and any previously loaded disc stays in place.
func (m *Machine) LoadDisc(path string) error {
	img, err := gd.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if m.Disc != nil {
		_ = m.Disc.Close()
	}
	m.Disc = img
	m.discPath = path
	return nil
}

// DiscPath returns the path the current disc was loaded from, or
// the empty string when no disc is loaded.
func (m *Machine) DiscPath() string { return m.discPath }

// LoadProgram is a test and tooling helper: it writes code bytes
// into the bus at the physical address pa and points the CPU at
// the matching P1 cached alias, so a program placed in main RAM
// (pa 0x0C000000) starts executing at virtual 0x8C000000.
func (m *Machine) LoadProgram(pa uint32, code []byte) {
	for i, c := range code {
		m.Bus.Write8(pa+uint32(i), c)
	}
	m.CPU.PC = 0x80000000 | pa
}

// SetPC sets the CPU program counter to the virtual address va.
func (m *Machine) SetPC(va uint32) { m.CPU.PC = va }

// RunFrame runs one frame of CPU time. The CPU advances in
// scanline-sized chunks with the SPG stepped between chunks, so
// SPG interrupts pend and are accepted inside the frame at line
// accuracy. The AICA advances in the same chunk rhythm by the
// exact clock ratio. A rising edge of the vblank-out event fires
// the Maple hardware trigger for tables programmed with
// SB_MDTSEL = 1. At the end of the frame the PVR display output
// is composed into the framebuffer.
func (m *Machine) RunFrame() {
	remaining := FrameCycles
	for remaining > 0 {
		chunk := m.PVR.CyclesPerLine()
		if chunk <= 0 || chunk > remaining {
			chunk = remaining
		}
		m.stepCycles(chunk)
		m.PVR.Advance(chunk)
		m.advanceAICA(chunk)
		m.pollMapleTrigger()
		remaining -= chunk
	}
	m.PVR.Present(m.framebuffer, Width, Height)
}

// stepCycles executes n flat-model cycles of SH-4 code. Each
// cycle is one instruction step (the DC-1 model charges every
// instruction one cycle), and each step first offers the
// program counter to the BIOS HLE: a PC sitting on a handler
// stub is a syscall, serviced in Go (see bios.go). A serviced
// syscall still costs its one cycle.
func (m *Machine) stepCycles(n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		if m.stepBIOS() {
			continue
		}
		m.CPU.Step()
	}
}

// SystemRAM returns the machine's 16 MB main RAM, the
// RETRO_MEMORY_SYSTEM_RAM block for the shell.
func (m *Machine) SystemRAM() []byte { return m.Bus.RAM }

// VMUImage returns the live 128 KB storage image of port 0's
// VMU, the RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM block for the shell.
func (m *Machine) VMUImage() []byte { return m.Maple.VMUImage(0) }

// advanceAICA converts a span of SH-4 cycles to AICA master
// cycles with the exact ratio 225792/2000000 and steps the sound
// block, carrying the remainder so long runs drift by zero.
func (m *Machine) advanceAICA(sh4Cycles int) {
	m.aicaAcc += uint64(sh4Cycles) * 225792
	master := int(m.aicaAcc / 2000000)
	m.aicaAcc %= 2000000
	if master > 0 {
		m.AICA.AdvanceMaster(master)
	}
}

// pollMapleTrigger fires the Maple vblank-triggered transfer
// once per vblank-out event edge.
func (m *Machine) pollMapleTrigger() {
	out := m.Holly.Status(holly.BankNormal)&(1<<holly.EvtVBlankOut) != 0
	if out && !m.vblankOut {
		m.Maple.OnVblankOut()
	}
	m.vblankOut = out
}

// AudioBuffer drains the stereo samples the AICA produced since
// the last call, at AudioSampleRate.
func (m *Machine) AudioBuffer() [][2]int16 { return m.AICA.AudioBuffer() }

// AudioSampleRate is the AICA output sample rate.
func (m *Machine) AudioSampleRate() int { return aica.AudioSampleRate() }

// Framebuffer returns the 640 by 480 XRGB8888 frame, composed
// from the PVR display framebuffer at the end of RunFrame. Before
// the first RunFrame it is all zero. The returned slice is the
// machine's own buffer.
func (m *Machine) Framebuffer() []uint32 { return m.framebuffer }

// SetButtons records the current controller state and feeds it
// to the Maple controller on port 0.
func (m *Machine) SetButtons(p PadState) {
	m.pad = p
	m.Maple.SetPad(0, maple.PadState{
		Buttons:  p.Mask,
		TriggerL: p.TriggerL,
		TriggerR: p.TriggerR,
		JoyX:     p.JoyX,
		JoyY:     p.JoyY,
	})
}

// Buttons returns the last controller state set with SetButtons.
func (m *Machine) Buttons() PadState { return m.pad }

// fixedStateSize is the byte size of every section of a machine
// state except the PVR section, whose length depends on the TA
// scene it holds. The AICA, Maple, and G2 DMA blocks are fixed
// size and sit after the PVR section.
func (m *Machine) fixedStateSize() int {
	return 1 + sh4.SerializeSize +
		len(m.Bus.RAM) + len(m.Bus.VRAM) + len(m.Bus.Flash) + len(m.Bus.AICARAM) +
		holly.SerializeSize +
		aica.SerializeSize + maple.SerializeSize + g2dma.SerializeSize +
		machineTailSize + biosStateSize
}

// StateSize is the exact byte size of a serialized machine state
// for the machine's current state.
func (m *Machine) StateSize() int {
	return m.fixedStateSize() + m.PVR.SerializeSize()
}

// Serialize captures the whole machine state. Layout:
//
//	byte 0        version (0x04)
//	bytes 1..     CPU state (sh4.SerializeSize bytes)
//	then          main RAM   (len(Bus.RAM) bytes)
//	then          VRAM       (len(Bus.VRAM) bytes)
//	then          flash      (len(Bus.Flash) bytes)
//	then          AICA RAM   (len(Bus.AICARAM) bytes)
//	then          Holly state (holly.SerializeSize bytes)
//	then          PVR state (variable length, see pvr.Serialize)
//	then          AICA state (aica.SerializeSize bytes, with ARM)
//	then          Maple state (maple.SerializeSize bytes)
//	then          G2 DMA state (g2dma.SerializeSize bytes)
//	then          machine tail (machineTailSize bytes)
//	then          BIOS HLE block (biosStateSize bytes, DC-4)
//
// The register stub storage of the remaining stub ranges is not
// part of the state: those registers have no behaviour yet, so
// nothing a game could observe through them is lost.
func (m *Machine) Serialize() []byte {
	out := make([]byte, m.StateSize())
	out[0] = stateVersion
	off := 1
	copy(out[off:], m.CPU.Serialize())
	off += sh4.SerializeSize
	copy(out[off:], m.Bus.RAM)
	off += len(m.Bus.RAM)
	copy(out[off:], m.Bus.VRAM)
	off += len(m.Bus.VRAM)
	copy(out[off:], m.Bus.Flash)
	off += len(m.Bus.Flash)
	copy(out[off:], m.Bus.AICARAM)
	off += len(m.Bus.AICARAM)
	copy(out[off:], m.Holly.Serialize())
	off += holly.SerializeSize
	pvrLen := m.PVR.SerializeSize()
	copy(out[off:], m.PVR.Serialize())
	off += pvrLen
	m.AICA.Serialize(out[off:])
	off += aica.SerializeSize
	m.Maple.Serialize(out[off:])
	off += maple.SerializeSize
	m.G2DMA.Serialize(out[off:])
	off += g2dma.SerializeSize
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(out[off:], m.aicaAcc)
	if m.vblankOut {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(out[off+8:], 1)
	}
	off += machineTailSize
	copy(out[off:], m.serializeBIOS())
	return out
}

// Deserialize restores a state produced by Serialize. It returns
// false, leaving the live machine alone as far as the checks can
// guarantee, when the length does not match the sections the
// state itself describes, the version byte differs, or a section
// rejects its block.
func (m *Machine) Deserialize(b []byte) bool {
	fixed := m.fixedStateSize()
	if len(b) < fixed || b[0] != stateVersion {
		return false
	}
	head := 1 + sh4.SerializeSize +
		len(m.Bus.RAM) + len(m.Bus.VRAM) + len(m.Bus.Flash) + len(m.Bus.AICARAM) +
		holly.SerializeSize
	pvrLen := len(b) - fixed
	if pvr.SerializedSize(b[head:head+pvrLen]) != pvrLen {
		return false
	}
	off := 1
	if !m.CPU.Deserialize(b[off : off+sh4.SerializeSize]) {
		return false
	}
	off += sh4.SerializeSize
	copy(m.Bus.RAM, b[off:])
	off += len(m.Bus.RAM)
	copy(m.Bus.VRAM, b[off:])
	off += len(m.Bus.VRAM)
	copy(m.Bus.Flash, b[off:])
	off += len(m.Bus.Flash)
	copy(m.Bus.AICARAM, b[off:])
	off += len(m.Bus.AICARAM)
	if !m.Holly.Deserialize(b[off : off+holly.SerializeSize]) {
		return false
	}
	off += holly.SerializeSize
	if !m.PVR.Deserialize(b[off : off+pvrLen]) {
		return false
	}
	off += pvrLen
	if !m.AICA.Deserialize(b[off : off+aica.SerializeSize]) {
		return false
	}
	off += aica.SerializeSize
	if !m.Maple.Deserialize(b[off : off+maple.SerializeSize]) {
		return false
	}
	off += maple.SerializeSize
	if !m.G2DMA.Deserialize(b[off : off+g2dma.SerializeSize]) {
		return false
	}
	off += g2dma.SerializeSize
	m.aicaAcc = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(b[off:])
	m.vblankOut = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(b[off+8:]) != 0
	off += machineTailSize
	m.deserializeBIOS(b[off : off+biosStateSize])
	return true
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-dreamcast/system/machine_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// testProgram is a hand assembled SH-4 routine. It loads a data
// pointer and a VRAM pointer from a literal pool, sums 32 bytes
// from the data page into R0 with a counted loop, stores R0 as a
// 32-bit word at the start of VRAM, then spins in place.
//
// Virtual addresses (the machine runs with the MMU off, so a
// virtual address reaches the bus masked to its physical form):
//
//	data page   0x8C010000 (P1 alias of physical 0x0C010000)
//	VRAM store  0xA5000000 (P2 alias of physical 0x05000000)
//
// Instruction map (offsets from the program base):
//
//	0x00  D106  MOV.L @(6,PC),R1   ; R1 = literal at 0x1C
//	0x02  0009  NOP                ; pad so the next MOV.L is 4-aligned
//	0x04  D406  MOV.L @(6,PC),R4   ; R4 = literal at 0x20
//	0x06  E000  MOV #0,R0          ; sum = 0
//	0x08  E220  MOV #32,R2         ; count = 32
//	0x0A  6314  MOV.B @R1+,R3      ; loop: R3 = next byte, sign extended
//	0x0C  303C  ADD R3,R0          ; sum += R3
//	0x0E  4210  DT R2              ; count, T set when it hits 0
//	0x10  8BFB  BF -5              ; back to loop while T is clear
//	0x12  0009  NOP                ; BF delay slot (runs when taken)
//	0x14  2402  MOV.L R0,@R4       ; store the sum to VRAM
//	0x16  AFFE  BRA -2             ; spin here forever
//	0x18  0009  NOP                ; BRA delay slot
//	0x1A  0000                     ; pad so the literals are 4-aligned
//	0x1C  .long 0x8C010000
//	0x20  .long 0xA5000000
//
// The NOP at 0x12 matters: on SH-4 a BF delay slot executes when
// the branch is taken and is skipped when it is not, so any real
// instruction parked there would run once per loop pass and then
// be skipped on the final pass. Both MOV.L instructions sit at
// 4-aligned offsets, so the PC-relative base (this instruction
// plus 4, aligned down to a word) is the same under either
// reading of the manual. The data bytes are all below 128, so
// the sign extension of MOV.B does not change the sum.
var testProgramWords = []uint16{
	0xD106, 0x0009, 0xD406, 0xE000, 0xE220,
	0x6314, 0x303C, 0x4210, 0x8BFB, 0x0009,
	0x2402, 0xAFFE, 0x0009, 0x0000,
	0x0000, 0x8C01, // 0x8C010000, little-endian
	0x0000, 0xA500, // 0xA5000000, little-endian
}

const (
	testDataPhys = 0x0C010000
	testSumWant  = 528 // 1 + 2 + ... + 32
)

func testProgram() []byte {
	out := make([]byte, len(testProgramWords)*2)
	for i, w := range testProgramWords {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[i*2:], w)
	}
	return out
}

// loadTestMachine returns a machine with the test program in main
// RAM at physical 0x0C000000 (entered at 0x8C000000) and the data
// page filled with the bytes 1..32.
func loadTestMachine(t *testing.T) *Machine {
	t.Helper()
	m := New()
	for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
		m.Bus.Write8(testDataPhys+uint32(i), uint8(i+1))
	}
	m.LoadProgram(0x0C000000, testProgram())
	if m.CPU.PC != 0x8C000000 {
		t.Fatalf("PC after LoadProgram = %#08x, want 0x8C000000", m.CPU.PC)
	}
	return m
}

func stepN(m *Machine, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		m.CPU.Step()
	}
}

func TestSyntheticProgramChecksum(t *testing.T) {
	m := loadTestMachine(t)
	stepN(m, 200)
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(0x05000000); got != testSumWant {
		t.Fatalf("VRAM word after 200 steps = %d (%#08x), want %d", got, got, testSumWant)
	}
	// The same word is visible through the other VRAM window.
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(0x04000000); got != testSumWant {
		t.Errorf("VRAM word via 32-bit window = %d, want %d", got, testSumWant)
	}
}

func TestSyntheticProgramDeterminismAcrossRestore(t *testing.T) {
	// Uninterrupted run: 100 steps, snapshot, 100 more.
	m := loadTestMachine(t)
	stepN(m, 100)
	mid := m.Serialize()
	stepN(m, 100)
	wantWord := m.Bus.Read32(0x05000000)
	if wantWord != testSumWant {
		t.Fatalf("uninterrupted VRAM word = %d, want %d", wantWord, testSumWant)
	}
	wantFinal := m.Serialize()

	// Restored run: a fresh machine takes the mid state and runs
	// the same remaining 100 steps.
	m2 := New()
	if !m2.Deserialize(mid) {
		t.Fatal("Deserialize of the mid-run state returned false")
	}
	stepN(m2, 100)
	if got := m2.Bus.Read32(0x05000000); got != wantWord {
		t.Errorf("restored VRAM word = %d, want %d", got, wantWord)
	}
	if got := m2.Serialize(); !bytes.Equal(got, wantFinal) {
		t.Errorf("restored final state differs from the uninterrupted run (%d vs %d bytes)", len(got), len(wantFinal))
	}
}

func TestSerializeRoundTripFreshMachine(t *testing.T) {
	m := New()
	state := m.Serialize()
	if len(state) != m.StateSize() {
		t.Fatalf("len(Serialize) = %d, want StateSize %d", len(state), m.StateSize())
	}
	m2 := New()
	if !m2.Deserialize(state) {
		t.Fatal("Deserialize of a fresh state returned false")
	}
	if got := m2.Serialize(); !bytes.Equal(got, state) {
		t.Error("state after a fresh round trip differs from the original")
	}
	// Bad inputs are rejected.
	if m2.Deserialize(state[:len(state)-1]) {
		t.Error("Deserialize accepted a truncated state")
	}
	bad := append([]byte(nil), state...)
	bad[0] = 0x7F
	if m2.Deserialize(bad) {
		t.Error("Deserialize accepted a state with a wrong version byte")
	}
}

func TestPadStateAndFramebufferShape(t *testing.T) {
	m := New()
	p := PadState{Mask: BtnA | BtnStart | BtnRT, TriggerL: 12, TriggerR: 250, JoyX: 128, JoyY: 30}
	m.SetButtons(p)
	if got := m.Buttons(); got != p {
		t.Errorf("Buttons = %+v, want %+v", got, p)
	}
	fb := m.Framebuffer()
	if len(fb) != Width*Height {
		t.Fatalf("len(Framebuffer) = %d, want %d", len(fb), Width*Height)
	}
	for i, px := range fb {
		if px != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("framebuffer pixel %d = %#08x, want 0 (blank this slice)", i, px)
		}
	}
}

func TestLoadDiscErrors(t *testing.T) {
	m := New()
	missing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "no-such-disc.gdi")
	if err := m.LoadDisc(missing); err == nil {
		t.Errorf("LoadDisc(%q) returned no error, want one", missing)
	}
	if m.Disc != nil {
		t.Error("Disc is set after a failed LoadDisc, want nil")
	}
}

func TestLoadDiscSyntheticGDI(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	trackPath := filepath.Join(dir, "track01.bin")
	if err := os.WriteFile(trackPath, make([]byte, 2352*16), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gdi := "1\n1 0 4 2352 \"track01.bin\" 0\n"
	gdiPath := filepath.Join(dir, "game.gdi")
	if err := os.WriteFile(gdiPath, []byte(gdi), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadDisc(gdiPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadDisc(synthetic .gdi) error: %v", err)
	}
	if m.Disc == nil {
		t.Fatal("Disc is nil after a successful LoadDisc")
	}
	if got := m.DiscPath(); got != gdiPath {
		t.Errorf("DiscPath = %q, want %q", got, gdiPath)
	}
	_ = m.Disc.Close()
}
