package scd

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"testing"

	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-genesis/chips/m68k"
)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SCD-4 part 1 gates: the BIOS jump table and stub layout, an
// end to end 68k call through the jump table and trampoline into
// the Go services, BURAM at the mailbox level, CDBTOCREAD on a
// synthetic disc, the asynchronous drive queue, the CDC read
// family, and the grown save state with legacy acceptance.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// biosCallResult is one mailbox round trip outcome.
type biosCallResult struct {
	d0, d1, a0, a1 uint32
	carry          bool
}

// biosCall performs one mailbox call the way a trampoline
// leaves it: register image written, family byte stored, request
// byte set, one BIOSService pass, then the result block and CCR
// word read back.
func biosCall(u *Unit, family uint8, d0, d1, a0, a1 uint32) biosCallResult {
	img := [15]uint32{}
	img[0] = d0
	img[1] = d1
	img[8] = a0
	img[9] = a1
	for i, v := range img {
		u.Write32(mbImageAddr+uint32(i*4), v)
	}
	u.Write8(mbFamilyAddr, family)
	u.Write8(mbRequestAddr, 1)
	u.BIOSService()
	if u.Read8(mbRequestAddr) != 0 {
		panic("biosCall: request byte not cleared by BIOSService")
	}
	return biosCallResult{
		d0:    u.Read32(mbResultAddr),
		d1:    u.Read32(mbResultAddr + 4),
		a0:    u.Read32(mbResultAddr + 8),
		a1:    u.Read32(mbResultAddr + 12),
		carry: u.Read16(mbCCRAddr)&0x0001 != 0,
	}
}

// biosServiceN runs n bare BIOSService passes.
func biosServiceN(u *Unit, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		u.BIOSService()
	}
}

// putBytes writes data into PRG-RAM through the sub bus at addr.
func putBytes(u *Unit, addr uint32, data []byte) {
	for i, b := range data {
		u.Write8(addr+uint32(i), b)
	}
}

// getBytes reads n bytes from the sub bus at addr.
func getBytes(u *Unit, addr uint32, n int) []byte {
	out := make([]byte, n)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = u.Read8(addr + uint32(i))
	}
	return out
}

func TestBIOSJumpTableAndVectors(t *testing.T) {
	img := BootStubImage()
	if len(img) != 0x6000 {
		t.Fatalf("BootStubImage len = %#x, want 0x6000", len(img))
	}
	if got := string(img[0x100:0x10C]); got != "iTaK CD BIOS" {
		t.Fatalf("ID string at 0x100 = %q, want iTaK CD BIOS", got)
	}
	vec := func(n int) uint32 { return binary.BigEndian.Uint32(img[n*4:]) }
	if vec(0) != 0x000A0000 || vec(1) != 0x00000200 {
		t.Fatalf("reset vectors = %#x/%#x, want SSP 0xA0000 and PC 0x200", vec(0), vec(1))
	}
	levels := [7]uint32{0x5EE0, 0x5EE6, 0x5EEC, 0x5EF2, 0x5EF8, 0x5EFE, 0x5F04}
	for i, want := range levels {
		if got := vec(25 + i); got != want {
			t.Errorf("autovector %d = %#x, want jump table entry %#x", 25+i, got, want)
		}
	}
	// Vector 24 (spurious) targets the RTE stub.
	if tgt := vec(24); img[tgt] != 0x4E || img[tgt+1] != 0x73 {
		t.Errorf("spurious vector target %#x holds %#02x %#02x, want RTE (4E 73)", tgt, img[tgt], img[tgt+1])
	}
	// Vectors 2 and 40 target the fatal stub: MOVE.B #0xEE, abs.
	for _, v := range []int{2, 23, 32, 40, 63} {
		tgt := vec(v)
		if img[tgt] != 0x13 || img[tgt+1] != 0xFC || img[tgt+2] != 0x00 || img[tgt+3] != 0xEE {
			t.Errorf("vector %d target %#x does not start with MOVE.B #0xEE (13 FC 00 EE)", v, tgt)
		}
	}
	// Every jump table entry is a JMP absolute long.
	for i := 0; i < 14; i++ {
		off := JumpTableBase + i*6
		if img[off] != 0x4E || img[off+1] != 0xF9 {
			t.Fatalf("jump table entry %d at %#x = %#02x %#02x, want JMP abs (4E F9)", i, off, img[off], img[off+1])
		}
	}
	entryTarget := func(off int) uint32 { return binary.BigEndian.Uint32(img[off+2:]) }
	// Level entries target an RTE, usercalls target an RTS, and
	// the three family entries target MOVEM trampolines.
	for i := 0; i < 7; i++ {
		tgt := entryTarget(JumpTableBase + i*6)
		if img[tgt] != 0x4E || img[tgt+1] != 0x73 {
			t.Errorf("level entry %d target %#x is not an RTE stub", i+1, tgt)
		}
	}
	for _, idx := range []int{7, 8, 10, 13} {
		tgt := entryTarget(JumpTableBase + idx*6)
		if img[tgt] != 0x4E || img[tgt+1] != 0x75 {
			t.Errorf("usercall entry %d target %#x is not an RTS stub", idx, tgt)
		}
	}
	for _, off := range []int{0x5F16, 0x5F22, 0x5F28} {
		tgt := entryTarget(off)
		if img[tgt] != 0x48 || img[tgt+1] != 0xF9 {
			t.Errorf("family entry at %#x target %#x does not start with MOVEM (48 F9)", off, tgt)
		}
	}

	// The RAM overlay: reads come from the overlay copy, writes
	// patch it, and the stub image itself is untouched.
	u := NewUnit(nil)
	if got := u.Read8(JumpTableBase); got != 0x4E {
		t.Fatalf("overlay read at jump table = %#02x, want 0x4E", got)
	}
	u.Write8(0x5F0A, 0xAA)
	if got := u.Read8(0x5F0A); got != 0xAA {
		t.Fatalf("overlay patched read = %#02x, want 0xAA", got)
	}
	if got := BootStubImage()[0x5F0A]; got != 0x4E {
		t.Fatalf("stub image changed by overlay write: %#02x", got)
	}
	if got := u.Read8(0x0100); got != 'i' {
		t.Fatalf("stub read outside overlay = %#02x, want i", got)
	}
}

// runCaller places a hand assembled caller at 0x26000 in PRG-RAM,
// runs the sub CPU on the unit bus with BIOSService interleaved,
// and returns the CPU once the caller reaches its final BRA.
func runCaller(t *testing.T, u *Unit, caller []byte, braOff int) *m68k.CPU {
	t.Helper()
	putBytes(u, 0x26000, caller)
	cpu := m68k.New(u)
	r := cpu.Registers()
	r.PC = 0x26000
	r.SR = 0x2700
	r.SSP = 0x000A0000
	cpu.SetState(r)
	braAddr := uint32(0x26000 + braOff)
	for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
		cpu.StepCycles(1000)
		u.BIOSService()
		if cpu.Registers().PC == braAddr && !u.BIOSPending() {
			return cpu
		}
		if cpu.Halted() {
			t.Fatal("sub CPU halted during BIOS caller run")
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("caller never reached its idle BRA (PC = %#x)", cpu.Registers().PC)
	return cpu
}

func TestBIOSEndToEndBuramCall(t *testing.T) {
	u := NewUnit(nil)
	// Caller: A0 = scratch, A1 = display buffer, BRMFORMAT via
	// _buram, then BRMSTAT via _buram, then idle.
	caller := []byte{
		0x20, 0x7C, 0x00, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00, // MOVEA.L #0x30000, A0
		0x22, 0x7C, 0x00, 0x03, 0x01, 0x00, // MOVEA.L #0x30100, A1
		0x70, 0x06, // MOVEQ #6, D0 (BRMFORMAT)
		0x4E, 0xB9, 0x00, 0x00, 0x5F, 0x16, // JSR _buram
		0x70, 0x01, // MOVEQ #1, D0 (BRMSTAT)
		0x4E, 0xB9, 0x00, 0x00, 0x5F, 0x16, // JSR _buram
		0x60, 0xFE, // BRA .
	}
	cpu := runCaller(t, u, caller, len(caller)-2)
	regs := cpu.Registers()
	if got := regs.D[0] & 0xFFFF; got != 125 {
		t.Fatalf("D0.w after BRMSTAT = %d, want 125 free blocks", got)
	}
	if got := regs.D[1] & 0xFFFF; got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("D1.w after BRMSTAT = %d, want 0 files", got)
	}
	if regs.SR&0x0001 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("SR carry set after BRMSTAT, want clear (SR = %#06x)", regs.SR)
	}
	if got := u.Read8(mbFamilyAddr); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("mailbox family byte = %d, want 1 (buram trampoline)", got)
	}
	if got := string(getBytes(u, 0x30100, 12)); got != bramDisplayString {
		t.Fatalf("display buffer = %q, want %q", got, bramDisplayString)
	}
}

func TestBIOSEndToEndCdbiosCall(t *testing.T) {
	u := NewUnit(nil)
	// Caller: D0 = CDBCHK (0x80) via _cdbios, then idle. With an
	// empty drive queue the carry result is clear.
	caller := []byte{
		0x20, 0x3C, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, // MOVE.L #0x80, D0
		0x4E, 0xB9, 0x00, 0x00, 0x5F, 0x22, // JSR _cdbios
		0x60, 0xFE, // BRA .
	}
	cpu := runCaller(t, u, caller, len(caller)-2)
	regs := cpu.Registers()
	if got := regs.D[0] & 0xFFFF; got != 0x80 {
		t.Fatalf("D0.w after CDBCHK = %#x, want 0x80 (registers unchanged)", got)
	}
	if regs.SR&0x0001 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("SR carry set after CDBCHK with empty queue, want clear")
	}
	if got := u.Read8(mbFamilyAddr); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("mailbox family byte = %d, want 0 (cdbios trampoline)", got)
	}
}

// bramNameTable writes a BRMWRITE style table {name, flag,
// blockSize word} at addr.
func bramNameTable(u *Unit, addr uint32, name string, flag uint8, size uint16) {
	putBytes(u, addr, []byte(name))
	u.Write8(addr+11, flag)
	u.Write16(addr+12, size)
}

func TestBIOSBuramRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	u := NewUnit(nil)
	const nameTab = 0x31000
	const dispBuf = 0x30100

	// Unformatted: BRMINIT fails with D0.b = 1, BRMSTAT reports
	// the 0xFFFF pair.
	res := biosCall(u, 1, 0, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if !res.carry || res.d0&0xFF != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMINIT unformatted: carry %v D0.b %#02x, want carry set and 1", res.carry, res.d0&0xFF)
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 1, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if res.d0&0xFFFF != 0xFFFF || res.d1&0xFFFF != 0xFFFF {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSTAT unformatted: D0.w %#x D1.w %#x, want FFFF/FFFF", res.d0&0xFFFF, res.d1&0xFFFF)
	}

	// Format and check the footer byte for byte.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 6, 0, 0, 0)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMFORMAT reported carry set")
	}
	fo := BRAMSize - 64
	for i := 0; i < 11; i++ {
		if u.bram[fo+i] != 0x5F {
			t.Fatalf("footer byte %d = %#02x, want 0x5F", i, u.bram[fo+i])
		}
	}
	for i := 11; i < 15; i++ {
		if u.bram[fo+i] != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("footer byte %d = %#02x, want 0", i, u.bram[fo+i])
		}
	}
	if u.bram[fo+15] != 0x40 {
		t.Fatalf("footer byte 15 = %#02x, want 0x40", u.bram[fo+15])
	}
	for k := 0; k < 4; k++ {
		if got := binary.BigEndian.Uint16(u.bram[fo+16+k*2:]); got != 125 {
			t.Fatalf("footer free word %d = %d, want 125", k, got)
		}
		if got := binary.BigEndian.Uint16(u.bram[fo+24+k*2:]); got != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("footer file word %d = %d, want 0", k, got)
		}
	}
	if got := string(u.bram[fo+32 : fo+43]); got != "SEGA_CD_ROM" {
		t.Fatalf("footer ID = %q, want SEGA_CD_ROM", got)
	}
	if u.bram[fo+43] != 0 || u.bram[fo+44] != 0x01 {
		t.Fatalf("footer bytes 43/44 = %#02x/%#02x, want 0/1", u.bram[fo+43], u.bram[fo+44])
	}
	if got := string(u.bram[fo+48 : fo+64]); got != "RAM_CARTRIDGE___" {
		t.Fatalf("footer name = %q, want RAM_CARTRIDGE___", got)
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 0, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if res.carry || string(getBytes(u, dispBuf, 12)) != bramDisplayString {
		t.Fatalf("BRMINIT formatted: carry %v display %q", res.carry, getBytes(u, dispBuf, 12))
	}

	// Write a one block file with known bytes.
	data := make([]byte, 64)
	for i := range data {
		data[i] = byte(i*3 + 1)
	}
	putBytes(u, 0x32000, data)
	bramNameTable(u, nameTab, "TESTFILE___", 0, 1)
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 4, 0, nameTab, 0x32000)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMWRITE reported carry set")
	}
	if res.a0 != 0x600040 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMWRITE A0 = %#x, want 0x600040 (block 1)", res.a0)
	}
	// Search it.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 2, 0, nameTab, 0)
	if res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 1 || res.d1&0xFF != 0 || res.a0 != 0x600040 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSERCH: carry %v D0.w %d D1.b %#02x A0 %#x, want clear/1/0/0x600040",
			res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF, res.d1&0xFF, res.a0)
	}
	// Read it back byte equal.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 3, 0, nameTab, 0x33000)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMREAD reported carry set")
	}
	if got := getBytes(u, 0x33000, 64); !bytes.Equal(got, data) {
		t.Fatal("BRMREAD data does not match what was written")
	}
	// Stat: 125 - 1 data block - 1 directory block = 123.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 1, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if res.d0&0xFFFF != 123 || res.d1&0xFFFF != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSTAT: free %d files %d, want 123/1", res.d0&0xFFFF, res.d1&0xFFFF)
	}
	// Verify: match, mismatch, and missing file outcomes.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 8, 0, nameTab, 0x32000)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMVERIFY with matching data reported carry set")
	}
	u.Write8(0x32000, data[0]^0xFF)
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 8, 0, nameTab, 0x32000)
	if !res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 0xFFFF {
		t.Fatalf("BRMVERIFY mismatch: carry %v D0.w %#x, want set/FFFF", res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
	u.Write8(0x32000, data[0])
	bramNameTable(u, 0x31800, "NOSUCHFILE_", 0, 1)
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 8, 0, 0x31800, 0x32000)
	if !res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMVERIFY missing: carry %v D0.w %#x, want set/0", res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
	// Directory listing with a wildcard template.
	putBytes(u, 0x31900, []byte("TEST*******"))
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 7, 4, 0x31900, 0x33800) // capacity 4 in D1 low word
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMDIR with room for all matches reported carry set")
	}
	dirEnt := getBytes(u, 0x33800, 16)
	if string(dirEnt[:11]) != "TESTFILE___" || binary.BigEndian.Uint16(dirEnt[12:]) != 1 || binary.BigEndian.Uint16(dirEnt[14:]) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMDIR entry = %q start %d units %d, want TESTFILE___/1/1",
			dirEnt[:11], binary.BigEndian.Uint16(dirEnt[12:]), binary.BigEndian.Uint16(dirEnt[14:]))
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 7, 0, 0x31900, 0x33800) // capacity 0: the match does not fit
	if !res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMDIR capacity 0 did not set carry (more entries remain)")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 7, 1, 0x31900, 0x33800) // capacity 1: fits the one match
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMDIR capacity 1 with one match reported carry set")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 7, 0x00010000, 0x31900, 0x33800) // skip 1 in D1 high word: nothing left
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMDIR skip past the only match reported carry set")
	}
	// Delete, search fails, stat returns to 125 free.
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 5, 0, nameTab, 0)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMDEL reported carry set")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 2, 0, nameTab, 0)
	if !res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMSERCH after delete did not set carry")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 1, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if res.d0&0xFFFF != 125 || res.d1&0xFFFF != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSTAT after delete: free %d files %d, want 125/0", res.d0&0xFFFF, res.d1&0xFFFF)
	}

	// Protected file: flag 0xFF, 4 units of 0x20 = 128 bytes.
	pdata := make([]byte, 128)
	for i := range pdata {
		pdata[i] = byte(0xA0 + i)
	}
	putBytes(u, 0x32000, pdata)
	bramNameTable(u, nameTab, "PROT_______", 0xFF, 4)
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 4, 0, nameTab, 0x32000)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMWRITE protected reported carry set")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 2, 0, nameTab, 0)
	if res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 4 || res.d1&0xFF != 0xFF {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSERCH protected: carry %v units %d flag %#02x, want clear/4/FF",
			res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF, res.d1&0xFF)
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 3, 0, nameTab, 0x33000)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMREAD protected reported carry set")
	}
	if got := getBytes(u, 0x33000, 128); !bytes.Equal(got, pdata) {
		t.Fatal("BRMREAD protected data does not match (want 128 bytes)")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 1, 1, 0, 0, dispBuf)
	if res.d0&0xFFFF != 122 {
		t.Fatalf("BRMSTAT with protected file: free %d, want 122 (125 - 2 data - 1 dir)", res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
}

func TestBIOSCDTOCREAD(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	u := NewUnit(disc)
	toc := func(tno uint32) biosCallResult {
		return biosCall(u, 0, 0x83, tno, 0, 0)
	}
	res := toc(1)
	if res.d0 != 0x00028001 || res.d1&0xFF != 0xFF || res.carry {
		t.Fatalf("track 1: D0 %#010x D1.b %#02x carry %v, want 00028001/FF/clear", res.d0, res.d1&0xFF, res.carry)
	}
	res = toc(2)
	if res.d0 != 0x00021002 || res.d1&0xFF != 0x00 {
		t.Fatalf("track 2: D0 %#010x D1.b %#02x, want 00021002/00", res.d0, res.d1&0xFF)
	}
	res = toc(3)
	if res.d0 != 0x00041003 {
		t.Fatalf("track 3: D0 %#010x, want 00041003", res.d0)
	}
	res = toc(0)
	if res.d0 != 0x00061000 {
		t.Fatalf("lead-out: D0 %#010x, want 00061000", res.d0)
	}
	res = toc(9)
	if res.d0 != 0x00028000 {
		t.Fatalf("out of range: D0 %#010x, want 00028000 (disc start, tno 0)", res.d0)
	}
	// A TOC override is consulted first.
	putBytes(u, 0x31000, []byte{0x01, 0x23, 0xC5, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFF})
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x82, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	res = toc(2)
	if res.d0 != 0x0123C502 || res.d1&0xFF != 0xFF {
		t.Fatalf("override track 2: D0 %#010x D1.b %#02x, want 0123C502/FF", res.d0, res.d1&0xFF)
	}
	res = toc(1)
	if res.d0 != 0x00028001 {
		t.Fatalf("track 1 with override present: D0 %#010x, want disc value 00028001", res.d0)
	}
}

func TestBIOSAsyncDriveQueue(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	u := NewUnit(disc)

	// DRVINIT queues and returns at once.
	putBytes(u, 0x31000, []byte{1, 3})
	res := biosCall(u, 0, 0x10, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("DRVINIT call reported carry set")
	}
	if !u.BIOSPending() {
		t.Fatal("drive queue empty right after DRVINIT call")
	}
	if u.bios.driveInit {
		t.Fatal("DRVINIT executed in the call pass, want deferred")
	}
	// CDBCHK reports busy for a while, then clear once the
	// queued command has aged 223 service calls and executed.
	sawBusy := false
	cleared := false
	for i := 0; i < 400; i++ {
		res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x80, 0, 0, 0)
		if res.carry {
			sawBusy = true
		} else {
			cleared = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !sawBusy {
		t.Fatal("CDBCHK never reported the queue busy")
	}
	if !cleared {
		t.Fatal("CDBCHK never cleared after 400 service calls")
	}
	if !u.bios.driveInit {
		t.Fatal("queued DRVINIT never executed")
	}

	// Rejected function numbers never queue.
	res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x0D, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	if res.carry || u.BIOSPending() {
		t.Fatal("rejected fn 0x0D queued or set carry")
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x25, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	if res.carry || u.BIOSPending() {
		t.Fatal("rejected fn 0x25 queued or set carry")
	}

	// MSCPLAY on audio track 2 leaves the CDD playing it.
	u.Write16(0x31000, 2)
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x11, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	if !u.BIOSPending() {
		t.Fatal("MSCPLAY did not queue")
	}
	biosServiceN(u, 300)
	u.AdvanceCycles(200000)
	if u.CDDState() != CDDPlaying {
		t.Fatalf("CDD state after MSCPLAY = %v, want playing", u.CDDState())
	}
	if pos := u.CDDPositionLBA(); pos < 10 {
		t.Fatalf("CDD position = LBA %d, want at or past track 2 start (10)", pos)
	}
}

func TestBIOSCDCReadFlow(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	u := NewUnit(disc)

	// ROMREADN of 2 sectors at LBA 2.
	u.Write32(0x31000, 2)
	u.Write32(0x31004, 2)
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x20, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	biosServiceN(u, 300)
	if !u.bios.readActive || u.bios.readRemaining != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("read state after ROMREADN: active %v remaining %d, want true/2",
			u.bios.readActive, u.bios.readRemaining)
	}

	wantHeaders := [2]uint32{0x00020201, 0x00020301}
	for i, lba := range []int{2, 3} {
		// Wait for the sector to land in the CDC buffer.
		ready := false
		for try := 0; try < 20 && !ready; try++ {
			u.AdvanceCycles(166667)
			res := biosCall(u, 0, 0x8A, 0, 0, 0) // CDCSTAT
			ready = !res.carry
		}
		if !ready {
			t.Fatalf("sector %d never became ready", lba)
		}
		res := biosCall(u, 0, 0x8B, 0, 0, 0) // CDCREAD
		if res.carry || res.d0 != wantHeaders[i] {
			t.Fatalf("CDCREAD sector %d: carry %v D0 %#010x, want clear/%#010x", lba, res.carry, res.d0, wantHeaders[i])
		}
		res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x8C, 0, 0x34000, 0x35000) // CDCTRN
		if res.carry {
			t.Fatalf("CDCTRN sector %d reported carry set", lba)
		}
		if res.a0 != 0x34000+2336 || res.a1 != 0x35004 {
			t.Fatalf("CDCTRN results: A0 %#x A1 %#x, want 34000+2336/35004", res.a0, res.a1)
		}
		want, err := disc.ReadData(lba)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ReadData(%d): %v", lba, err)
		}
		if got := getBytes(u, 0x34000, 2048); !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("CDCTRN sector %d data does not match the disc sector", lba)
		}
		for j, b := range getBytes(u, 0x34000+2048, 288) {
			if b != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("CDCTRN sector %d EDC/ECC byte %d = %#02x, want 0", lba, j, b)
			}
		}
		hdr := getBytes(u, 0x35000, 4)
		if hdr[0] != byte(wantHeaders[i]>>24) || hdr[1] != byte(wantHeaders[i]>>16) ||
			hdr[2] != byte(wantHeaders[i]>>8) || hdr[3] != byte(wantHeaders[i]) {
			t.Fatalf("CDCTRN sector %d header buffer = % x, want header long bytes", lba, hdr)
		}
		res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x8D, 0, 0, 0) // CDCACK
		if res.carry {
			t.Fatalf("CDCACK sector %d reported carry set", lba)
		}
	}
	// The bounded count is exhausted: the BIOS read is inactive.
	// The CDD transport itself is left streaming (CDCSTOP is the
	// call that stops it), matching the full stack fixture.
	if u.bios.readActive {
		t.Fatal("read still active after the bounded count was ACKed out")
	}
	if u.CDDState() != CDDReading {
		t.Fatalf("CDD state after bounded read = %v, want reading (transport left running)", u.CDDState())
	}
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x89, 0, 0, 0) // CDCSTOP
	if u.CDDState() != CDDStopped {
		t.Fatalf("CDD state after CDCSTOP = %v, want stopped", u.CDDState())
	}
	res := biosCall(u, 0, 0x8B, 0, 0, 0)
	if !res.carry {
		t.Fatal("CDCREAD with nothing prepared did not set carry")
	}
}

func TestBIOSSundrySync(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	u := NewUnit(disc)

	// CDBSTAT fills the table and returns its address.
	res := biosCall(u, 0, 0x81, 0, 0, 0)
	if res.a0 != 0x25E80 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT A0 = %#x, want 25E80", res.a0)
	}
	tbl := getBytes(u, 0x25E80, 32)
	if tbl[0] != 0 || tbl[1] != 0 || tbl[2] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT drv/msc/rom = %d/%d/%d, want 0/0/0 (disc in, stopped)", tbl[0], tbl[1], tbl[2])
	}
	if tbl[4] != 0x09 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT BP0 = %#02x, want 09 (stopped display status)", tbl[4])
	}
	if tbl[7] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT BP3 current track = %d, want 1", tbl[7])
	}
	if tbl[16] != 1 || tbl[17] != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT first/last = %d/%d, want 1/3", tbl[16], tbl[17])
	}
	if tbl[19] != 0x04 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT BP15 = %#02x, want 04 (current track is data)", tbl[19])
	}
	if tbl[20] != 0x00 || tbl[21] != 0x06 || tbl[22] != 0x10 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT lead-out MSF = %02x %02x %02x, want 00 06 10 BCD", tbl[20], tbl[21], tbl[22])
	}
	if got := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(tbl[24:28]); got != 0x04000400 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBSTAT volume long = %#010x, want 04000400", got)
	}

	// CDBPAUSE stores the standby time.
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x84, 0x1234, 0, 0)
	if u.bios.standbyPause != 0x1234 {
		t.Fatalf("standby pause = %#x, want 1234", u.bios.standbyPause)
	}
	// FDRSET volume then master.
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x85, 0x0200, 0, 0)
	if u.bios.faderVol != 0x0200 || u.cddEngine().FaderFD() != 512 {
		t.Fatalf("FDRSET volume: bios %d CDD FD %d, want 512/512", u.bios.faderVol, u.cddEngine().FaderFD())
	}
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x85, 0x8000|0x0200, 0, 0) // master = 0x0200
	if u.bios.faderMaster != 0x0200 || u.cddEngine().FaderFD() != 256 {
		t.Fatalf("FDRSET master: bios %d CDD FD %d, want 512/256", u.bios.faderMaster, u.cddEngine().FaderFD())
	}
	// LEDSET mode 2 (access, both) lands in the LED storage.
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x95, 2, 0, 0)
	if u.led != 0x06 || u.bios.ledMode != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("LEDSET: led storage %#02x mode %d, want 06/2", u.led, u.bios.ledMode)
	}
	// CDCSETMODE with a valid DDT value writes reg03 bits 3-4.
	biosCall(u, 0, 0x96, 2, 0, 0)
	if got := u.Read8(0xFF8003) & 0x18; got != 0x10 {
		t.Fatalf("reg03 DDT bits = %#02x, want 10", got)
	}
	if u.bios.cdcDestMode != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("cdcDestMode = %d, want 2", u.bios.cdcDestMode)
	}
	// SCDSTAT succeeds with zeros; SCDREAD fails (no subcode).
	res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x91, 0, 0, 0)
	if res.carry || res.d0 != 0 || res.d1 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("SCDSTAT: carry %v D0 %#x D1 %#x, want clear/0/0", res.carry, res.d0, res.d1)
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x92, 0, 0, 0)
	if !res.carry || res.d0 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("SCDREAD: carry %v D0 %#x, want set/0", res.carry, res.d0)
	}
	// WONDERREQ is a failure stub.
	res = biosCall(u, 0, 0x97, 0, 0, 0)
	if !res.carry || res.d0 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("WONDERREQ: carry %v D0 %#x, want set/0", res.carry, res.d0)
	}
	// Unknown family fails with carry set and D0 = 0.
	res = biosCall(u, 9, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if !res.carry || res.d0 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unknown family: carry %v D0 %#x, want set/0", res.carry, res.d0)
	}
}

func TestBIOSCDBoot(t *testing.T) {
	// The cue fixture is a data disc without the boot signature.
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	u := NewUnit(disc)
	res := biosCall(u, 2, 5, 0, 0, 0) // CBTCHKSTAT
	if res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("CBTCHKSTAT data non-boot: carry %v D0.w %d, want clear/2", res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
	res = biosCall(u, 2, 4, 0, 0x36000, 0) // CBTCHKDISC
	if !res.carry {
		t.Fatal("CBTCHKDISC on a non-boot disc did not set carry")
	}
	want0, err := disc.ReadData(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReadData(0): %v", err)
	}
	if got := getBytes(u, 0x36000, 2048); !bytes.Equal(got, want0) {
		t.Fatal("CBTCHKDISC did not copy sector 0 into the scratch")
	}

	// A boot ISO (sector 0 carries SEGADISCSYSTEM) is type 5 and
	// CBTCHKDISC clears carry.
	boot := openISO(t, []byte{0x4E, 0x71})
	u2 := NewUnit(boot)
	res = biosCall(u2, 2, 5, 0, 0, 0)
	if res.carry || res.d0&0xFFFF != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("CBTCHKSTAT boot disc: carry %v D0.w %d, want clear/5", res.carry, res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
	res = biosCall(u2, 2, 4, 0, 0x36000, 0)
	if res.carry {
		t.Fatal("CBTCHKDISC on a boot disc reported carry set")
	}
	if got := string(getBytes(u2, 0x36000, 14)); got != "SEGADISCSYSTEM" {
		t.Fatalf("CBTCHKDISC scratch starts %q, want SEGADISCSYSTEM", got)
	}
	// CBTINIT and CBTINT are no-op successes.
	for _, fn := range []uint32{0, 1, 3} {
		res = biosCall(u2, 2, fn, 0, 0, 0)
		if res.carry {
			t.Fatalf("CDBOOT fn %d reported carry set", fn)
		}
	}
	// No disc: type -1.
	u3 := NewUnit(nil)
	res = biosCall(u3, 2, 5, 0, 0, 0)
	if res.d0&0xFFFF != 0xFFFF {
		t.Fatalf("CBTCHKSTAT no disc: D0.w %#x, want FFFF", res.d0&0xFFFF)
	}
	res = biosCall(u3, 2, 4, 0, 0x36000, 0)
	if !res.carry {
		t.Fatal("CBTCHKDISC with no disc did not set carry")
	}
	// Unknown cdboot function fails.
	res = biosCall(u3, 2, 9, 0, 0, 0)
	if !res.carry || res.d0 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("CDBOOT unknown fn: carry %v D0 %#x, want set/0", res.carry, res.d0)
	}
}

func TestBIOSStateGrowth(t *testing.T) {
	if BRAMSize != 8192 || BIOSStateSize != 768 {
		t.Fatalf("BRAMSize %d BIOSStateSize %d, want 8192/768", BRAMSize, BIOSStateSize)
	}
	u := NewUnit(nil)
	if got := u.SerializeSize(); got != 863232 {
		t.Fatalf("SerializeSize = %d, want 863232", got)
	}
	// Put a file in BRAM and patch a jump table overlay byte.
	biosCall(u, 1, 6, 0, 0, 0)
	data := []byte("hello bram world, this file survives a save state")
	putBytes(u, 0x32000, data)
	bramNameTable(u, 0x31000, "SAVEFILE___", 0, 1)
	if res := biosCall(u, 1, 4, 0, 0x31000, 0x32000); res.carry {
		t.Fatal("BRMWRITE for state test reported carry set")
	}
	u.Write8(0x5F0B, 0xF8)

	buf := make([]byte, u.SerializeSize())
	if err := u.Serialize(buf); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Serialize: %v", err)
	}
	u2 := NewUnit(nil)
	if err := u2.Deserialize(buf); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	// Re-serialize matches byte for byte (checked before any
	// further mailbox traffic writes into the restored PRG-RAM).
	buf2 := make([]byte, u2.SerializeSize())
	if err := u2.Serialize(buf2); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("re-Serialize: %v", err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(buf, buf2) {
		t.Fatal("state round trip did not reproduce the serialized bytes")
	}
	res := biosCall(u2, 1, 2, 0, 0x31000, 0)
	if res.carry || res.a0 != 0x600040 {
		t.Fatalf("serch after restore: carry %v A0 %#x, want clear/600040", res.carry, res.a0)
	}
	res = biosCall(u2, 1, 3, 0, 0x31000, 0x33000)
	if res.carry || !bytes.Equal(getBytes(u2, 0x33000, len(data)), data) {
		t.Fatal("BRAM file contents did not survive the state round trip")
	}
	if got := u2.Read8(0x5F0B); got != 0xF8 {
		t.Fatalf("overlay byte after restore = %#02x, want F8", got)
	}

	// A legacy 854272 byte state loads with BRAM unformatted and
	// BIOS defaults in place.
	u3 := NewUnit(nil)
	if err := u3.Deserialize(buf[:legacySerializeSize]); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize legacy: %v", err)
	}
	res = biosCall(u3, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0x30100)
	if !res.carry || res.d0&0xFF != 1 {
		t.Fatal("legacy state BRAM is formatted, want unformatted")
	}
	if u3.bios.faderVol != 0x0400 || u3.bios.faderMaster != 0x0400 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy fader = %d/%d, want 1024/1024", u3.bios.faderVol, u3.bios.faderMaster)
	}
	if got := u3.Read8(JumpTableBase); got != 0x4E {
		t.Fatalf("legacy overlay byte = %#02x, want 4E from the stub image", got)
	}
	if err := u3.Deserialize(make([]byte, 100)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Deserialize of a tiny buffer succeeded, want an error")
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-genesis/scd/cdd.go ====================

package scd

import "encoding/binary"

// This file implements the Sega CD CDD host interface and CD-DA
// playback for the scd package, following the reverse engineered
// CDD protocol documentation (CDD_inf.txt) and the behaviour of
// the Sega CD sub BIOS.
//
// Register model summary: the fader word lives at sub offsets
// 0x34 (high byte) and 0x35 (low byte), the HOCK control bit is
// bit2 of the byte written at sub offset 0x37, status nibbles
// RS0 to RS9 live at sub offsets 0x38 to 0x41, and command
// nibbles TC0 to TC9 live at sub offsets 0x42 to 0x4B. The Unit
// wiring that maps those offsets onto this type belongs to the
// coordinator; this type exposes byte and nibble methods only.
//
// Documented simplifications:
//   - Fades apply instantly, so the fader EFDT status bit always
//     reads 1 and the gain is the fader value in effect now.
//   - Commands apply when TC9 is written, but the response packet
//     is built into a pending slot at that moment and only becomes
//     visible in RS0 to RS9 at the next 75 Hz tick, which is also
//     when the interrupt pending flag sets.
//   - Scanning runs at 8x normal speed. The protocol document
//     does not publish a scan rate, so 8x is a model choice.
//   - Unknown commands 0x05, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0E and 0x0F, and any
//     other unlisted code, are treated as a NOP that returns a
//     plain status packet. Command 0x05 is unknown on real
//     hardware as far as the documentation records.
//   - Play and Seek targets with invalid BCD, an invalid MSF, or
//     an LBA outside the disc are rejected with a plain status
//     packet and no state change.

// CDDStateSize is the exact serialized size of a CDD. The layout
// is: state (1), display status (1), flags (1: bit0 status
// pending, bit1 status valid, bit2 interrupt pending), settle
// counter (1), RS nibbles packed (5), TC nibbles packed (5),
// pending packet nibbles packed (5), reserved (1), play LBA
// (4, big endian signed), play sample in sector (2), play sample
// accumulator (4), render LBA (4), render sample in sector (2),
// fader FD (2), fader misc bits (1), fader high byte latch (1),
// 75 Hz tick accumulator (4), data read LBA (4). Total 52 bytes.
const CDDStateSize = 52

// CDDState is the transport state of the CDD.
type CDDState int

const (
	CDDStopped CDDState = iota
	CDDPlaying
	CDDPaused
	CDDScanFF
	CDDScanFR
	CDDReading
	CDDTrayOpen
)

// CDDEvents reports what one AdvanceCycles call delivered.
// DataLBA is -1 and DataCount is 0 when no data sector was
// delivered. Otherwise DataLBA is the first delivered sector and
// DataCount is the number of consecutive sectors delivered.
type CDDEvents struct {
	DataLBA   int
	DataCount int
}

// CDD is the CD drive controller model. It is constructed with a
// disc, which may be nil for an empty drive, and it is driven by
// sub CPU cycle counts through AdvanceCycles.
type CDD struct {
	disc *Disc

	state   CDDState
	display uint8

	statusPending bool
	statusValid   bool
	irqPending    bool
	settle        uint8

	rs      [10]uint8
	tc      [10]uint8
	pending [10]uint8

	playLBA    int
	playSample int
	playAcc    int

	renderLBA    int
	renderSample int

	faderFD    uint16
	faderMisc  uint8
	faderLatch uint8

	tickAcc int
	readLBA int

	cacheValid bool
	cacheLBA   int
	cacheData  []byte
}

// NewCDD builds a CDD with the given disc attached. The disc may
// be nil, which models an empty drive. Power on state is stopped,
// the fader is at unity gain (FD 1024), and RS holds a valid
// checksum status packet reporting stopped (0x09) with a disc or
// no disc (0x0B) without one.
func NewCDD(d *Disc) *CDD {
	c := &CDD{
		disc:       d,
		state:      CDDStopped,
		display:    0x0B,
		faderFD:    1024,
		faderLatch: 0x40,
		cacheLBA:   -1,
	}
	if d != nil {
		c.display = 0x09
	}
	c.rs[0] = c.display
	setPacketChecksum(&c.rs)
	c.statusValid = true
	return c
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fader, control, and packet registers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// WriteFaderByte writes one fader byte. off 0 is the sub offset
// 0x34 high byte, which is only latched, and off 1 is the sub
// offset 0x35 low byte, which commits the full fader word from
// the latch plus the low byte.
func (c *CDD) WriteFaderByte(off uint8, v uint8) {
	switch off {
	case 0:
		c.faderLatch = v
	case 1:
		word := uint16(c.faderLatch&0x7F)<<8 | uint16(v)
		c.faderFD = uint16(word>>4) & 0x7FF
		c.faderMisc = v & 0x0F
	}
}

// ReadFaderByte reads one fader byte, with the EFDT status bit
// (bit15 of the word, bit7 of the high byte) always set because
// fades apply instantly in this model.
func (c *CDD) ReadFaderByte(off uint8) uint8 {
	switch off {
	case 0:
		return 0x80 | uint8((c.faderFD>>4)&0x7F)
	case 1:
		return uint8(c.faderFD&0x0F)<<4 | (c.faderMisc & 0x0F)
	}
	return 0
}

// WriteControl writes the CDD control byte at sub offset 0x37.
// Bit2 is HOCK: writing it set hands the status transfer back and
// clears the status valid flag. Other bits are ignored.
func (c *CDD) WriteControl(v uint8) {
	if v&0x04 != 0 {
		c.statusValid = false
	}
}

// WriteCommandNibble writes command nibble idx (0 to 9), masked
// to four bits. Writing nibble 9, the checksum nibble, triggers
// command execution.
func (c *CDD) WriteCommandNibble(idx int, v uint8) {
	if idx < 0 || idx >= len(c.tc) {
		return
	}
	c.tc[idx] = v & 0x0F
	if idx == 9 {
		c.executeCommand()
	}
}

// StatusNibble returns status nibble idx (0 to 9), or 0 out of
// range.
func (c *CDD) StatusNibble(idx int) uint8 {
	if idx < 0 || idx >= len(c.rs) {
		return 0
	}
	return c.rs[idx]
}

// CommandNibble returns the stored command nibble idx (0 to 9),
// or 0 out of range.
func (c *CDD) CommandNibble(idx int) uint8 {
	if idx < 0 || idx >= len(c.tc) {
		return 0
	}
	return c.tc[idx]
}

// StatusValid reports whether RS0 to RS9 hold a status packet
// that has been delivered and not yet handed back with HOCK.
func (c *CDD) StatusValid() bool { return c.statusValid }

// TakeInterrupt returns and clears the interrupt pending flag.
// The flag sets at the 75 Hz tick that delivers a response
// packet.
func (c *CDD) TakeInterrupt() bool {
	v := c.irqPending
	c.irqPending = false
	return v
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Accessors
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// State returns the current transport state.
func (c *CDD) State() CDDState { return c.state }

// DisplayStatus returns the current display status code, the
// value a Get status command reports in RS0.
func (c *CDD) DisplayStatus() uint8 { return c.display }

// PositionLBA returns the current play position as an LBA. At the
// end of the disc this is the total sector count.
func (c *CDD) PositionLBA() int { return c.playLBA }

// PositionSample returns the current play position within its
// sector, in stereo frames from 0 to 587.
func (c *CDD) PositionSample() int { return c.playSample }

// PositionMSF returns the current play position as MSF.
func (c *CDD) PositionMSF() (m, s, f int) { return LBAToMSF(c.playLBA) }

// FaderFD returns the current fader value, 0 to 2047, where 1024
// is unity gain.
func (c *CDD) FaderFD() int { return int(c.faderFD) }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Disc helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

func (c *CDD) totalSectors() int {
	if c.disc == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return c.disc.NumSectors()
}

func (c *CDD) trackAt(lba int) *Track {
	if c.disc == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return c.disc.trackForLBA(lba)
}

// currentTrack returns the track at the play position. A position
// at the very end of the disc reports the last track.
func (c *CDD) currentTrack() *Track {
	if c.disc == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if tr := c.disc.trackForLBA(c.playLBA); tr != nil {
		return tr
	}
	tracks := c.disc.tracks
	if len(tracks) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if c.playLBA >= c.totalSectors() {
		return &tracks[len(tracks)-1]
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *CDD) playTotalSamples() int {
	return c.playLBA*588 + c.playSample
}

func (c *CDD) renderTotalSamples() int {
	return c.renderLBA*588 + c.renderSample
}

func (c *CDD) setPlayTotalSamples(total int) {
	if total < 0 {
		total = 0
	}
	c.playLBA = total / 588
	c.playSample = total % 588
}

func (c *CDD) snapRenderToPlay() {
	c.renderLBA = c.playLBA
	c.renderSample = c.playSample
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Packet construction
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// setPacketChecksum sets nibble 9 of a packet so that the sum of
// all ten nibbles is congruent to 0xF modulo 16.
func setPacketChecksum(p *[10]uint8) {
	sum := 0
	for i := 0; i < 9; i++ {
		sum += int(p[i])
	}
	p[9] = uint8((^sum) & 0xF)
}

// setPacketMSF writes m, s and f as BCD nibble pairs into packet
// nibbles 2 to 7.
func setPacketMSF(p *[10]uint8, m, s, f int) {
	p[2] = uint8(m / 10 % 10)
	p[3] = uint8(m % 10)
	p[4] = uint8(s / 10 % 10)
	p[5] = uint8(s % 10)
	p[6] = uint8(f / 10 % 10)
	p[7] = uint8(f % 10)
}

func setPacketMSFFromLBA(p *[10]uint8, lba int) {
	m, s, f := LBAToMSF(lba)
	setPacketMSF(p, m, s, f)
}

// statusPacket builds a plain status packet: RS0 is the display
// status, RS1 is 0, RS2 to RS7 are the current absolute position
// MSF, and RS8 is 0. With no disc the position fields are zero.
func (c *CDD) statusPacket() [10]uint8 {
	var p [10]uint8
	p[0] = c.display
	if c.disc != nil {
		setPacketMSFFromLBA(&p, c.playLBA)
	}
	setPacketChecksum(&p)
	return p
}

// queueResponse stores a response packet in the pending slot. It
// becomes visible in RS at the next 75 Hz tick.
func (c *CDD) queueResponse(p [10]uint8) {
	c.pending = p
	c.statusPending = true
	c.statusValid = false
}

// trackPacket builds the Play and Resume response: RS0 0x01, RS1
// 0x02, and the track number in BCD in RS2 and RS3.
func trackPacket(tr *Track) [10]uint8 {
	var p [10]uint8
	p[0] = 0x01
	p[1] = 0x02
	if tr != nil {
		p[2] = uint8(tr.Number / 10 % 10)
		p[3] = uint8(tr.Number % 10)
	}
	setPacketChecksum(&p)
	return p
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Command execution
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// targetLBA decodes and validates the BCD MSF target in TC2 to
// TC7. It reports false for any nibble over 9, seconds at or over
// 60, frames at or over 75, or an LBA outside the disc tracks.
func (c *CDD) targetLBA() (int, bool) {
	for i := 2; i <= 7; i++ {
		if c.tc[i] > 9 {
			return 0, false
		}
	}
	m := int(c.tc[2])*10 + int(c.tc[3])
	s := int(c.tc[4])*10 + int(c.tc[5])
	f := int(c.tc[6])*10 + int(c.tc[7])
	if s >= 60 || f >= 75 {
		return 0, false
	}
	lba := MSFToLBA(m, s, f)
	if lba < 0 || lba >= c.totalSectors() || c.trackAt(lba) == nil {
		return 0, false
	}
	return lba, true
}

// executeCommand runs the command in TC once TC9 has been
// written. A command whose checksum fails is ignored entirely.
func (c *CDD) executeCommand() {
	sum := 0
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		sum += int(c.tc[i])
	}
	if sum&0xF != 0xF {
		return
	}
	code := c.tc[0]<<4 | c.tc[1]

	switch code {
	case 0x00: // Get status.
		c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())

	case 0x01: // Stop.
		if c.state == CDDTrayOpen {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		c.state = CDDStopped
		if c.disc == nil {
			c.display = 0x0B
			c.settle = 0
		} else {
			c.display = 0x00
			c.settle = 1
		}
		c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())

	case 0x02: // TOC info.
		c.queueResponse(c.tocPacket())

	case 0x03: // Read or Play.
		lba, ok := c.targetLBA()
		if c.state == CDDTrayOpen || c.disc == nil || !ok {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		tr := c.trackAt(lba)
		c.playLBA = lba
		c.playSample = 0
		c.playAcc = 0
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		c.settle = 0
		c.display = 0x01
		if tr.Mode == TrackAudio {
			c.state = CDDPlaying
		} else {
			c.state = CDDReading
			c.readLBA = lba
		}
		c.queueResponse(trackPacket(tr))

	case 0x04: // Seek.
		lba, ok := c.targetLBA()
		if c.state == CDDTrayOpen || c.disc == nil || !ok {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		c.playLBA = lba
		c.playSample = 0
		c.playAcc = 0
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		c.settle = 0
		c.state = CDDPaused
		c.display = 0x04
		var p [10]uint8
		p[0] = 0x02
		setPacketMSFFromLBA(&p, lba)
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		c.queueResponse(p)

	case 0x06: // Pause.
		if c.disc == nil {
			var p [10]uint8
			p[0] = 0x00
			setPacketChecksum(&p)
			c.queueResponse(p)
			return
		}
		if c.state == CDDTrayOpen {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		if c.state == CDDPlaying || c.state == CDDScanFF || c.state == CDDScanFR || c.state == CDDReading {
			c.state = CDDPaused
			c.display = 0x04
		}
		p := c.statusPacket()
		p[0] = 0x04
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		c.queueResponse(p)

	case 0x07: // Resume.
		if c.state != CDDPaused || c.disc == nil {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		tr := c.currentTrack()
		if tr == nil {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		c.settle = 0
		c.display = 0x01
		if tr.Mode == TrackAudio {
			c.state = CDDPlaying
		} else {
			c.state = CDDReading
			c.readLBA = c.playLBA
		}
		c.queueResponse(trackPacket(tr))

	case 0x08, 0x09: // Fast forward and fast reverse.
		if c.disc == nil || (c.state != CDDPlaying && c.state != CDDPaused) {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		if code == 0x08 {
			c.state = CDDScanFF
		} else {
			c.state = CDDScanFR
		}
		c.display = 0x03
		p := c.statusPacket()
		p[0] = 0x03
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		c.queueResponse(p)

	case 0x0C: // Close tray.
		if c.state != CDDTrayOpen {
			c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
			return
		}
		c.state = CDDStopped
		c.display = 0x00
		c.settle = 1
		var p [10]uint8
		p[0] = 0x00
		if c.disc != nil {
			setPacketMSFFromLBA(&p, c.playLBA)
		}
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		c.queueResponse(p)

	case 0x0D: // Open tray.
		c.state = CDDTrayOpen
		c.display = 0x05
		c.settle = 0
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		var p [10]uint8
		p[0] = 0x05
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		c.queueResponse(p)

	default:
		// 0x05, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0E, 0x0F and every other unlisted
		// code: NOP returning a plain status packet.
		c.queueResponse(c.statusPacket())
	}
}

// tocPacket builds the response for command 0x02, selected by
// TC3. RS1 echoes TC3 in every TOC response.
func (c *CDD) tocPacket() [10]uint8 {
	sel := c.tc[3]
	var p [10]uint8
	p[1] = sel
	if c.state == CDDTrayOpen || c.disc == nil {
		if c.state == CDDTrayOpen {
			p[0] = 0x05
		} else {
			p[0] = 0x0B
		}
		setPacketChecksum(&p)
		return p
	}
	switch sel {
	case 0x00: // Absolute position.
		p = c.statusPacket()
		p[1] = sel
	case 0x01: // Position relative to the current track.
		p = c.statusPacket()
		p[1] = sel
		rel := 0
		if tr := c.currentTrack(); tr != nil {
			rel = c.playLBA - tr.StartLBA
			if rel < 0 {
				rel = 0
			}
		}
		m := rel / (75 * 60)
		rem := rel % (75 * 60)
		setPacketMSF(&p, m, rem/75, rem%75)
	case 0x02: // Current track number.
		p[0] = c.display
		if tr := c.currentTrack(); tr != nil {
			p[2] = uint8(tr.Number / 10 % 10)
			p[3] = uint8(tr.Number % 10)
		}
	case 0x03: // Total disc length.
		p[0] = 0x04
		setPacketMSFFromLBA(&p, c.totalSectors())
	case 0x04: // First and last track numbers.
		p[0] = 0x04
		tracks := c.disc.tracks
		if len(tracks) > 0 {
			first := tracks[0].Number
			last := tracks[len(tracks)-1].Number
			p[2] = uint8(first / 10 % 10)
			p[3] = uint8(first % 10)
			p[4] = uint8(last / 10 % 10)
			p[5] = uint8(last % 10)
		}
	case 0x05: // Start MSF of a named track.
		req := int(c.tc[4])*10 + int(c.tc[5])
		p[0] = c.display
		p[8] = uint8(req & 0xF)
		for i := range c.disc.tracks {
			tr := &c.disc.tracks[i]
			if tr.Number == req {
				setPacketMSFFromLBA(&p, tr.StartLBA)
				if tr.Mode != TrackAudio {
					p[6] |= 0x08
				}
				break
			}
		}
	default: // 0x06 to 0x0F: status code, zeroed fields.
		p[0] = c.display
	}
	setPacketChecksum(&p)
	return p
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Time: ticks and playback progression
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// AdvanceCycles runs the CDD for the given number of sub CPU
// cycles. It delivers pending response packets and data sectors
// on the 75 Hz tick, and it advances CD-DA playback and scanning
// in absolute sample space using exact accumulators.
func (c *CDD) AdvanceCycles(cycles int) CDDEvents {
	ev := CDDEvents{DataLBA: -1}
	if cycles <= 0 {
		return ev
	}
	remaining := cycles
	for remaining > 0 {
		// Cycles until the next 75 Hz tick. The tick accumulator
		// counts cycles times 3 against a 500000 threshold, which
		// is exactly 12500000 cycles per second divided by 75.
		toTick := (500000 - c.tickAcc + 2) / 3
		if toTick < 1 {
			toTick = 1
		}
		chunk := remaining
		if chunk > toTick {
			chunk = toTick
		}
		c.advanceSamples(chunk)
		c.tickAcc += chunk * 3
		remaining -= chunk
		if c.tickAcc >= 500000 {
			c.tickAcc -= 500000
			c.tick(&ev)
		}
	}
	return ev
}

// advanceSamples advances or retreats the play position for chunk
// sub CPU cycles when playing or scanning. Samples run at 44100
// per 12500000 cycles, accumulated exactly.
func (c *CDD) advanceSamples(chunk int) {
	if c.state != CDDPlaying && c.state != CDDScanFF && c.state != CDDScanFR {
		return
	}
	total := int64(c.playAcc) + int64(chunk)*441
	delta := total / 125000
	c.playAcc = int(total % 125000)
	if delta == 0 {
		return
	}
	cur := int64(c.playTotalSamples())
	var next int64
	switch c.state {
	case CDDScanFF:
		next = cur + delta*8
	case CDDScanFR:
		next = cur - delta*8
	default:
		next = cur + delta
	}
	end := int64(c.totalSectors()) * 588
	if c.state == CDDScanFR && next <= 0 {
		c.setPlayTotalSamples(0)
		c.stopAtBoundary()
		return
	}
	if next >= end {
		c.setPlayTotalSamples(int(end))
		c.stopAtBoundary()
		return
	}
	if next < 0 {
		next = 0
	}
	lba := int(next / 588)
	if tr := c.trackAt(lba); tr != nil && tr.Mode != TrackAudio {
		// Landed in a data track: clamp to its start and stop.
		c.setPlayTotalSamples(tr.StartLBA * 588)
		c.stopAtBoundary()
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		return
	}
	c.setPlayTotalSamples(int(next))
}

// stopAtBoundary settles the transport into the stopped state at
// a playback boundary.
func (c *CDD) stopAtBoundary() {
	c.state = CDDStopped
	c.display = 0x09
	c.settle = 0
}

// tick runs one 75 Hz tick: settle a transient display status,
// deliver any pending response packet, and deliver one data
// sector when reading.
func (c *CDD) tick(ev *CDDEvents) {
	if c.settle > 0 {
		c.settle--
		if c.settle == 0 {
			if c.disc == nil {
				c.display = 0x0B
			} else {
				c.display = 0x09
			}
		}
	}
	if c.statusPending {
		c.rs = c.pending
		c.statusPending = false
		c.statusValid = true
		c.irqPending = true
	}
	if c.state != CDDReading {
		return
	}
	tr := c.trackAt(c.readLBA)
	if tr == nil || tr.Mode == TrackAudio {
		c.state = CDDStopped
		if c.disc == nil {
			c.display = 0x0B
		} else {
			c.display = 0x09
		}
		return
	}
	if ev.DataCount == 0 {
		ev.DataLBA = c.readLBA
	}
	ev.DataCount++
	delivered := c.readLBA
	last := tr.StartLBA + tr.Sectors - 1
	c.readLBA++
	c.playLBA = c.readLBA
	c.playSample = 0
	if delivered >= last {
		c.state = CDDStopped
		c.display = 0x09
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CD-DA rendering
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// RenderCDDA adds fader scaled CD-DA audio into a stereo int32
// accumulator holding len(acc)/2 frames. Rendering runs from a
// render position that trails the play position: it outputs the
// samples strictly behind the play position and then stays
// silent once caught up. In scanning states it outputs nothing
// and snaps the render position to the play position. Sectors
// that are not audio, or that fail to read, render as silence
// while the render position still advances.
func (c *CDD) RenderCDDA(acc []int32) {
	frames := len(acc) / 2
	if frames <= 0 {
		return
	}
	if c.state == CDDScanFF || c.state == CDDScanFR {
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		return
	}
	if c.renderTotalSamples() > c.playTotalSamples() {
		c.snapRenderToPlay()
		return
	}
	out := 0
	for out < frames {
		behind := c.playTotalSamples() - c.renderTotalSamples()
		if behind <= 0 {
			return
		}
		take := behind
		if avail := 588 - c.renderSample; take > avail {
			take = avail
		}
		if rem := frames - out; take > rem {
			take = rem
		}
		data := c.audioSector(c.renderLBA)
		if data != nil {
			fd := int32(c.faderFD)
			for i := 0; i < take; i++ {
				src := (c.renderSample + i) * 4
				left := int32(int16(uint16(data[src]) | uint16(data[src+1])<<8))
				right := int32(int16(uint16(data[src+2]) | uint16(data[src+3])<<8))
				acc[out*2] += left * fd / 1024
				acc[out*2+1] += right * fd / 1024
				out++
			}
		} else {
			out += take
		}
		c.renderSample += take
		if c.renderSample >= 588 {
			c.renderSample = 0
			c.renderLBA++
		}
	}
}

// audioSector returns the raw sector bytes for an audio track
// LBA, or nil for silence. The last fetched sector is cached; the
// cache is not serialized.
func (c *CDD) audioSector(lba int) []byte {
	if c.cacheValid && c.cacheLBA == lba {
		return c.cacheData
	}
	var data []byte
	if tr := c.trackAt(lba); tr != nil && tr.Mode == TrackAudio && c.disc != nil {
		if raw, err := c.disc.ReadAudio(lba); err == nil {
			data = raw
		}
	}
	c.cacheValid = true
	c.cacheLBA = lba
	c.cacheData = data
	return data
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Save states
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

func packNibbles(dst []byte, nib *[10]uint8) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		dst[i] = (nib[i*2] & 0x0F) | (nib[i*2+1]&0x0F)<<4
	}
}

func unpackNibbles(src []byte, nib *[10]uint8) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		nib[i*2] = src[i] & 0x0F
		nib[i*2+1] = src[i] >> 4 & 0x0F
	}
}

// SerializeState writes exactly CDDStateSize bytes into buf. A
// buffer smaller than CDDStateSize is left untouched.
func (c *CDD) SerializeState(buf []byte) {
	if len(buf) < CDDStateSize {
		return
	}
	buf = buf[:CDDStateSize]
	for i := range buf {
		buf[i] = 0
	}
	buf[0] = byte(c.state)
	buf[1] = c.display
	var flags uint8
	if c.statusPending {
		flags |= 1 << 0
	}
	if c.statusValid {
		flags |= 1 << 1
	}
	if c.irqPending {
		flags |= 1 << 2
	}
	buf[2] = flags
	buf[3] = c.settle
	packNibbles(buf[4:9], &c.rs)
	packNibbles(buf[9:14], &c.tc)
	packNibbles(buf[14:19], &c.pending)
	// buf[19] is reserved.
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[20:24], uint32(int32(c.playLBA)))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(buf[24:26], uint16(c.playSample))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[26:30], uint32(c.playAcc))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[30:34], uint32(int32(c.renderLBA)))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(buf[34:36], uint16(c.renderSample))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(buf[36:38], c.faderFD)
	buf[38] = c.faderMisc
	buf[39] = c.faderLatch
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[40:44], uint32(c.tickAcc))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(buf[44:48], uint32(int32(c.readLBA)))
}

// DeserializeState restores state written by SerializeState. The
// disc pointer is not part of the state and is kept. The audio
// sector cache is invalidated, since disc reads are pure and a
// refetch is deterministic.
func (c *CDD) DeserializeState(buf []byte) {
	if len(buf) < CDDStateSize {
		return
	}
	buf = buf[:CDDStateSize]
	c.state = CDDState(buf[0])
	c.display = buf[1]
	flags := buf[2]
	c.statusPending = flags&(1<<0) != 0
	c.statusValid = flags&(1<<1) != 0
	c.irqPending = flags&(1<<2) != 0
	c.settle = buf[3]
	unpackNibbles(buf[4:9], &c.rs)
	unpackNibbles(buf[9:14], &c.tc)
	unpackNibbles(buf[14:19], &c.pending)
	c.playLBA = int(int32(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(buf[20:24])))
	c.playSample = int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(buf[24:26]))
	c.playAcc = int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(buf[26:30]))
	c.renderLBA = int(int32(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(buf[30:34])))
	c.renderSample = int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(buf[34:36]))
	c.faderFD = binary.BigEndian.Uint16(buf[36:38])
	c.faderMisc = buf[38]
	c.faderLatch = buf[39]
	c.tickAcc = int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(buf[40:44]))
	c.readLBA = int(int32(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(buf[44:48])))
	c.cacheValid = false
	c.cacheLBA = -1
	c.cacheData = nil
}

package scd

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"testing"
)

// buildCDDFixture builds a synthetic cue and bin disc in a temp
// dir: track 1 is MODE1/2352 data with 10 sectors, track 2 is
// audio with 150 sectors of a 440 Hz stereo sine, and track 3 is
// audio with 150 sectors of an 880 Hz sine. It returns the disc
// and the raw bin image bytes.
func buildCDDFixture(t *testing.T) (*Disc, []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	const total = 310
	bin := make([]byte, total*2352)
	for lba := 0; lba < total; lba++ {
		sector := bin[lba*2352 : (lba+1)*2352]
		for i := range sector {
			sector[i] = byte(lba + i)
		}
	}
	writeSine := func(startLBA, sectors int, freq float64) {
		for s := 0; s < sectors; s++ {
			sector := bin[(startLBA+s)*2352 : (startLBA+s+1)*2352]
			for frame := 0; frame < 588; frame++ {
				n := s*588 + frame
				v := int16(math.Round(math.Sin(2*math.Pi*freq*float64(n)/44100) * 12000))
				u := uint16(v)
				off := frame * 4
				sector[off] = byte(u)
				sector[off+1] = byte(u >> 8)
				sector[off+2] = byte(u)
				sector[off+3] = byte(u >> 8)
			}
		}
	}
	writeSine(10, 150, 440)
	writeSine(160, 150, 880)
	writeTestFile(t, dir, "test.bin", bin)
	msf := func(lba int) string {
		m, s, f := LBAToMSF(lba)
		return fmt.Sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", m, s, f)
	}
	cue := "FILE \"test.bin\" BINARY\n" +
		"  TRACK 1 MODE1/2352\n" +
		"    INDEX 01 " + msf(0) + "\n" +
		"  TRACK 2 AUDIO\n" +
		"    INDEX 01 " + msf(10) + "\n" +
		"  TRACK 3 AUDIO\n" +
		"    INDEX 01 " + msf(160) + "\n"
	cuePath := writeTestFile(t, dir, "test.cue", []byte(cue))
	return openAndClose(t, cuePath), bin
}

// cddWriteRaw writes nine command nibbles plus an explicit
// checksum nibble.
func cddWriteRaw(c *CDD, nib [9]uint8, checksum uint8) {
	for i := 0; i < 9; i++ {
		c.WriteCommandNibble(i, nib[i])
	}
	c.WriteCommandNibble(9, checksum)
}

// cddChecksum computes the correct checksum nibble for nine
// command nibbles.
func cddChecksum(nib [9]uint8) uint8 {
	sum := 0
	for _, n := range nib {
		sum += int(n)
	}
	return uint8((^sum) & 0xF)
}

// cddPacket snapshots the current RS packet.
func cddPacket(c *CDD) [10]uint8 {
	var p [10]uint8
	for i := range p {
		p[i] = c.StatusNibble(i)
	}
	return p
}

// cddCheckPacket asserts that a packet carries a valid checksum.
func cddCheckPacket(t *testing.T, p [10]uint8) {
	t.Helper()
	sum := 0
	for _, n := range p {
		sum += int(n)
	}
	if sum%16 != 0xF {
		t.Errorf("packet %v sums to %#x mod 16, want 0xF", p, sum%16)
	}
}

// cddDeliver writes a command with a correct checksum, advances
// one 75 Hz tick to deliver the response, and returns the RS
// packet. The packet checksum is verified.
func cddDeliver(t *testing.T, c *CDD, nib [9]uint8) [10]uint8 {
	t.Helper()
	cddWriteRaw(c, nib, cddChecksum(nib))
	c.AdvanceCycles(166667)
	p := cddPacket(c)
	cddCheckPacket(t, p)
	return p
}

// cddMSFCommand builds the nine nibbles for a command with an MSF
// target taken from an LBA.
func cddMSFCommand(code uint8, lba int) [9]uint8 {
	m, s, f := LBAToMSF(lba)
	return [9]uint8{code >> 4, code & 0xF,
		uint8(m / 10), uint8(m % 10),
		uint8(s / 10), uint8(s % 10),
		uint8(f / 10), uint8(f % 10), 0}
}

// cddSimpleCommand builds the nine nibbles for a command with no
// parameters.
func cddSimpleCommand(code uint8) [9]uint8 {
	return [9]uint8{code >> 4, code & 0xF, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
}

// cddTOCCommand builds the nine nibbles for a TOC query.
func cddTOCCommand(sel uint8, track int) [9]uint8 {
	return [9]uint8{0, 2, 0, sel, uint8(track / 10), uint8(track % 10), 0, 0, 0}
}

// cddPacketMSF decodes the BCD MSF in packet nibbles 2 to 7.
func cddPacketMSF(p [10]uint8) (m, s, f int) {
	m = int(p[2])*10 + int(p[3])
	s = int(p[4])*10 + int(p[5])
	f = int(p[6]&0x7)*10 + int(p[7])
	return m, s, f
}

// cddPosTotal returns the play position in absolute samples.
func cddPosTotal(c *CDD) int {
	return c.PositionLBA()*588 + c.PositionSample()
}

func TestCDDTOC(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	c := NewCDD(disc)

	p := cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x03, 0))
	m, s, f := cddPacketMSF(p)
	wm, ws, wf := LBAToMSF(310)
	if m != wm || s != ws || f != wf {
		t.Errorf("total length MSF = %02d:%02d:%02d, want %02d:%02d:%02d", m, s, f, wm, ws, wf)
	}
	if p[0] != 0x04 || p[1] != 0x03 {
		t.Errorf("total length packet RS0/RS1 = %#x/%#x, want 0x04/0x03", p[0], p[1])
	}

	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x04, 0))
	if p[2] != 0 || p[3] != 1 || p[4] != 0 || p[5] != 3 {
		t.Errorf("first/last tracks nibbles = %v, want first 1 and last 3", p[2:6])
	}

	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x05, 2))
	m, s, f = cddPacketMSF(p)
	wm, ws, wf = LBAToMSF(10)
	if m != wm || s != ws || f != wf {
		t.Errorf("track 2 start MSF = %02d:%02d:%02d, want %02d:%02d:%02d", m, s, f, wm, ws, wf)
	}
	if p[8] != 2 {
		t.Errorf("track 2 start query RS8 = %#x, want 2", p[8])
	}
	if p[6]&0x08 != 0 {
		t.Errorf("track 2 start query RS6 = %#x, has the data flag, want clear", p[6])
	}

	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x05, 1))
	if p[6]&0x08 == 0 {
		t.Errorf("track 1 start query RS6 = %#x, data flag clear, want set", p[6])
	}

	cddDeliver(t, c, cddMSFCommand(0x03, 10))
	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x02, 0))
	if p[2] != 0 || p[3] != 2 {
		t.Errorf("current track nibbles = %#x/%#x, want 0/2", p[2], p[3])
	}

	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddTOCCommand(0x05, 9))
	for i := 2; i <= 7; i++ {
		if p[i] != 0 {
			t.Errorf("nonexistent track 9 query RS%d = %#x, want 0", i, p[i])
		}
	}
	if p[8] != 9 {
		t.Errorf("nonexistent track 9 query RS8 = %#x, want 9", p[8])
	}
}

func TestCDDChecksum(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	c := NewCDD(disc)
	beforeRS := cddPacket(c)
	cddCheckPacket(t, beforeRS)
	beforeState := c.State()

	nib := cddMSFCommand(0x03, 10)
	cddWriteRaw(c, nib, cddChecksum(nib)^0x01)
	if c.State() != beforeState {
		t.Errorf("broken checksum changed state to %v", c.State())
	}
	if got := cddPacket(c); got != beforeRS {
		t.Errorf("broken checksum changed RS to %v, want %v", got, beforeRS)
	}
	c.AdvanceCycles(166667)
	if got := cddPacket(c); got != beforeRS {
		t.Errorf("broken checksum packet appeared after a tick: %v", got)
	}
	// cddDeliver verifies the checksum of every packet it returns,
	// and the other tests exercise it on every command.
	cddDeliver(t, c, cddSimpleCommand(0x00))
}

func TestCDDPlayTimingAndPosition(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	c := NewCDD(disc)
	nib := cddMSFCommand(0x03, 10)
	cddWriteRaw(c, nib, cddChecksum(nib))
	if c.TakeInterrupt() {
		t.Fatal("interrupt fired before the delivery tick")
	}
	start := cddPosTotal(c)
	c.AdvanceCycles(12500000)
	if !c.TakeInterrupt() {
		t.Fatal("interrupt did not fire on the delivery tick")
	}
	if got := c.StatusNibble(0); got != 0x01 {
		t.Errorf("RS0 after play = %#x, want 0x01", got)
	}
	delta := cddPosTotal(c) - start
	t.Logf("play position delta after 1 s: %d samples (LBA %d, sample %d)", delta, c.PositionLBA(), c.PositionSample())
	if c.PositionLBA()-10 < 74 || c.PositionLBA()-10 > 76 {
		t.Errorf("LBA delta = %d, want within [74, 76]", c.PositionLBA()-10)
	}
	if delta < 44100-588 || delta > 44100+588 {
		t.Errorf("sample delta = %d, want 44100 within 588", delta)
	}
}

func TestCDDPauseResume(t *testing.T) {
	disc, _ := buildCDDFixture(t)
	c := NewCDD(disc)
	cddDeliver(t, c, cddMSFCommand(0x03, 10))
	c.AdvanceCycles(3125000)
	p := cddDeliver(t, c, cddSimpleCommand(0x06))
	if p[0] != 0x04 {
		t.Errorf("pause RS0 = %#x, want 0x04", p[0])
	}
	frozen := cddPosTotal(c)
	c.AdvanceCycles(12500000)
	if got := cddPosTotal(c); got != frozen {
		t.Errorf("paused position moved from %d to %d", frozen, got)
	}
	p = cddDeliver(t, c, cddSimpleCommand(0x07))
	if p[0] != 0x01 || p[1] != 0x02 || p[3] != 2 {
		t.Errorf("resume packet = %v, want RS0 0x01, RS1 0x02, track 2", p)
	}
	c.AdvanceCycles(3125000)
	if got := cddPosTotal(c); got <= frozen {
		t.Errorf("resumed position %d did not advance past frozen %d", got, frozen)
	}
}
