// needDiscCmd lists the commands marked E in the
// doc's summary: they answer INT5 with code 80h
// when no disc is inserted.
func needDiscCmd(cmd uint8) bool {
	switch cmd {
	case 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07, 0x08, 0x09,
		0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x10, 0x11, 0x13, 0x14, 0x15,
		0x16, 0x1A, 0x1B, 0x1D:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (c *Controller) command(cmd uint8) {
	if cmd != 0x01 && c.pendingCompletion() {
		// Busy rule: hold the command until the
		// pending completion fires in Advance.
		if !c.hasQueued {
			c.hasQueued = true
			c.queuedCmd = cmd
			c.queuedParams = append([]byte(nil), c.params...)
			c.params = nil
		}
		return
	}
	c.execCommand(cmd)
}

func (c *Controller) execCommand(cmd uint8) {
	params := c.params
	c.params = nil
	if c.disc == nil && needDiscCmd(cmd) {
		// GetID has its own documented no-disc
		// sequence, below.
		if cmd != 0x1A {
			c.errorResp(0x80)
			return
		}
	}
	switch cmd {
	case 0x01: // Getstat
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x02: // Setloc
		if len(params) < 3 {
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		if !bcdValid(params[0]) || !bcdValid(params[1]) || !bcdValid(params[2]) ||
			bcdVal(params[1]) > 59 || bcdVal(params[2]) > 74 {
			c.errorResp(0x10)
			return
		}
		lba := MSFToSector(bcdVal(params[0]), bcdVal(params[1]), bcdVal(params[2])) - 150
		if lba < 0 {
			lba = 0
		}
		c.pendingLBA = lba
		c.setlocPending = true
		c.statError = false
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x03: // Play
		c.cmdPlay(params)
	case 0x04, 0x05: // Forward / Backward
		if !c.playing {
			c.errorResp(0x80)
			return
		}
		if cmd == 0x04 {
			c.scanDir = 1
		} else {
			c.scanDir = -1
		}
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x06, 0x1B: // ReadN / ReadS
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
		c.startRead()
	case 0x07: // MotorOn
		if c.motorOn {
			// The doc: this code normally means wrong
			// parameter count, here it means the
			// motor is already on.
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
		c.schedule(c.now+spinUpSettleCycles, cdEvent{kind: evMotorSecond})
	case 0x08: // Stop
		snap := c.statusByte() &^ 0xE0 // doc: first response already has the read/play/seek bits cleared
		wasSpinning := c.motorOn || c.streaming || c.playing
		c.stopActivities()
		c.ackResp(snap)
		delay := int64(stopSecondStopped)
		if wasSpinning {
			delay = stopSecondSpinning
		}
		c.schedule(c.now+delay, cdEvent{kind: evStopSecond})
	case 0x09: // Pause
		snap := c.statusByte() // doc: first response still shows the old read/play bit
		active := c.streaming || c.playing
		c.stopActivities()
		c.ackResp(snap)
		delay := int64(pauseSecondIdle)
		if active {
			delay = int64(5 * sectorPeriodCycles(c.mode))
		}
		c.schedule(c.now+delay, cdEvent{kind: evPauseSecond})
	case 0x0A: // Init
		snap := c.statusByte()
		c.stopActivities()
		c.mode = 0x20
		c.motorOn = true
		c.stopped = true
		c.statError = false
		c.seekError = false
		c.ackResp(snap)
		c.schedule(c.now+initSecondDelay, cdEvent{kind: evInitSecond})
	case 0x0B: // Mute
		c.muted = true
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x0C: // Demute
		c.muted = false
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x0D: // Setfilter
		if len(params) < 2 {
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		c.filterFile, c.filterChannel = params[0], params[1]
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x0E: // Setmode
		if len(params) < 1 {
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		c.mode = params[0]
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	case 0x0F: // Getparam
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte(), c.mode, 0, c.filterFile, c.filterChannel)
	case 0x10: // GetlocL
		if c.seeking {
			c.errorResp(0x80)
			return
		}
		if tr, ok := c.trackAt(c.curLBA); ok && tr.Mode == TrackAudio {
			c.errorResp(0x80)
			return
		}
		c.ackResp(c.lastHdr[:]...)
	case 0x11: // GetlocP
		c.ackResp(c.positionBytes()...)
	case 0x12: // SetSession
		if len(params) < 1 {
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		if params[0] == 0 {
			c.errorResp(0x10)
			return
		}
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
		delay := int64(seekDelayCycles(c.curLBA, c.stopped))
		if params[0] == 1 {
			c.schedule(c.now+delay, cdEvent{kind: evSessionSecond})
		} else {
			// Single-session model: session 2 and up
			// seek-error, per the doc's
			// non-multisession case (simplified to
			// one INT5 second response).
			c.schedule(c.now+delay, cdEvent{kind: evSessionError})
		}
	case 0x13: // GetTN
		trs := c.tracks()
		if len(trs) == 0 {
			c.errorResp(0x80)
			return
		}
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte(), toBCD(trs[0].Number), toBCD(trs[len(trs)-1].Number))
	case 0x14: // GetTD
		if len(params) < 1 {
			c.errorResp(0x20)
			return
		}
		if !bcdValid(params[0]) {
			c.errorResp(0x10)
			return
		}
		n := bcdVal(params[0])
		var lba int
		if n == 0 {
			lba = c.totalSectors() // doc: track 0 is the end of the last track
		} else {
			found := false
			for _, t := range c.tracks() {
				if t.Number == n {
					lba, found = t.DataLBA, true
				}
			}
			if !found {
				c.errorResp(0x10)
				return
			}
		}
		m, s, _ := LBAToMSF(lba)
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte(), toBCD(m), toBCD(s))
	case 0x15, 0x16: // SeekL / SeekP
		snap := c.statusByte()
		target := c.pendingLBA
		c.setlocPending = false
		c.stopActivities()
		c.ackResp(snap)
		delay := seekDelayCycles(target-c.curLBA, c.stopped)
		c.motorOn = true
		c.stopped = false
		c.seeking = true
		c.seekError = false
		flag := uint8(0)
		if cmd == 0x16 {
			flag = 1
		}
		c.schedule(c.now+int64(delay), cdEvent{kind: evSeek, target: target, flag: flag})
	case 0x19: // Test
		c.cmdTest(params)
	case 0x1A: // GetID
		c.cmdGetID()
	case 0x1C: // Reset
		c.stopActivities()
		c.statError = false
		c.seekError = false
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
		c.schedule(c.now+resetDoneDelay, cdEvent{kind: evResetDone})
	case 0x1D: // GetQ
		c.cmdGetQ(params)
	case 0x1E: // ReadTOC
		c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
		c.schedule(c.now+readTOCSecondDelay, cdEvent{kind: evTOCSecond})
	default:
		// Includes 00h, 17h, 18h, 1Fh (VideoCD is a
		// SCPH-5903 variant, not this controller),
		// the secret unlock family while locked, and
		// every unused opcode: the doc's answer is
		// INT5 with code 40h, invalid command.
		c.noteUnknownCmd(cmd)
		c.errorResp(0x40)
	}
}

func (c *Controller) cmdPlay(params []byte) {
	target := c.curLBA
	if c.playing {
		target = c.playLBA
	}
	switch {
	case len(params) >= 1 && params[0] != 0:
		if !bcdValid(params[0]) {
			c.errorResp(0x10)
			return
		}
		n := bcdVal(params[0])
		found := false
		for _, t := range c.tracks() {
			if t.Number == n {
				target, found = t.DataLBA, true
			}
		}
		if !found {
			// Doc: parameters past the last track
			// restart the begin of the current track.
			if tr, ok := c.trackAt(target); ok {
				target = tr.DataLBA
			}
		}
	case c.setlocPending:
		target = c.pendingLBA
		c.setlocPending = false
	}
	snap := c.statusByte()
	c.stopActivities()
	c.ackResp(snap)
	delay := seekDelayCycles(target-c.curLBA, c.stopped)
	c.motorOn = true
	c.stopped = false
	c.seeking = true
	c.playLBA = target
	c.playOff = 0
	c.playBufValid = false
	c.schedule(c.now+int64(delay), cdEvent{kind: evPlayStart, target: target})
}

// startRead begins or continues a ReadN/ReadS
// stream, per the doc's Setloc/Read rules.
func (c *Controller) startRead() {
	if c.streaming && !c.setlocPending {
		return // already reading: just continues
	}
	target := c.resumeLBA
	if c.setlocPending {
		target = c.pendingLBA
		c.setlocPending = false
	} else if !c.streaming && c.curLBA != 0 {
		target = c.resumeLBA
	}
	c.playing = false
	c.scanDir = 0
	c.xaActive = false
	c.cancelEvents(evPlayStart)
	c.nextLBA = target
	c.streaming = true
	c.seekError = false
	delay := seekDelayCycles(target-c.curLBA, c.stopped) + sectorPeriodCycles(c.mode)
	c.motorOn = true
	c.stopped = false
	c.seeking = true
	c.cancelEvents(evSector)
	c.schedule(c.now+int64(delay), cdEvent{kind: evSector})
}

func (c *Controller) scheduleNextSector() {
	if c.streaming {
		c.schedule(c.now+int64(sectorPeriodCycles(c.mode)), cdEvent{kind: evSector})
	}
}

// deliverSector runs on an evSector event: one
// sector period of a ReadN/ReadS stream.
func (c *Controller) deliverSector() {
	if !c.streaming || c.disc == nil {
		return
	}
	if c.nextLBA >= c.totalSectors() {
		c.streaming = false
		c.seeking = false
		return
	}
	lba := c.nextLBA
	if c.tryXAOrFilter(lba) {
		// Consumed as XA audio, or skipped by the
		// filter: no data delivery, no INT1.
		c.curLBA = lba
		c.resumeLBA = lba
		c.nextLBA = lba + 1
		c.seeking = false
		c.scheduleNextSector()
		return
	}
	user, err := c.disc.ReadSector(lba, false)
	if err != nil {
		c.streaming = false
		c.seeking = false
		c.pushResp(c.statusByte()|0x01, 0x04)
		c.statError = true
		c.raiseIRQ(irqError)
		return
	}
	data := user
	if c.mode&0x20 != 0 {
		// Setmode sector size bit: whole sector
		// except the sync bytes.
		if raw, rerr := c.disc.ReadSector(lba, true); rerr == nil && len(raw) >= 2352 {
			data = raw[12:]
		}
	}
	if len(c.data)+len(data) <= dataCap {
		c.data = append(c.data, data...)
	}
	c.curLBA = lba
	c.resumeLBA = lba
	c.nextLBA = lba + 1
	c.seeking = false
	c.pushResp(c.statusByte())
	c.raiseIRQ(irqDataReady)
	c.scheduleNextSector()
}

// popDataByte removes one byte from the data FIFO.
// Refills are timing driven (Advance), not drain
// driven, in this model.
func (c *Controller) popDataByte() uint8 {
	if len(c.data) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	v := c.data[0]
	c.data = c.data[1:]
	return v
}

// ReadWord removes one little-endian word from the
// data FIFO for the CDROM DMA channel. ok is false
// when fewer than 4 bytes are available.
func (c *Controller) ReadWord() (uint32, bool) {
	if len(c.data) < 4 {
		return 0, false
	}
	var v uint32
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		v |= uint32(c.popDataByte()) << (8 * i)
	}
	return v, true
}

func (c *Controller) cmdGetID() {
	c.ackResp(c.statusByte())
	if c.disc == nil {
		// Doc's no-disc second response.
		resp := []byte{0x08, 0x40, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
		c.schedule(c.now+getIDSecondDelay, cdEvent{kind: evSecondResp, resp: resp, irq: irqError})
		c.idError = true
		return
	}
	allAudio := len(c.tracks()) > 0
	for _, t := range c.tracks() {
		if t.Mode != TrackAudio {
			allAudio = false
		}
	}
	if allAudio {
		resp := []byte{0x0A, 0x90, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
		c.schedule(c.now+getIDSecondDelay, cdEvent{kind: evSecondResp, resp: resp, irq: irqError})
		c.idError = true
		return
	}
	// Licensed Mode2 data disc model: INT2 with the
	// SCEA region string, matching the Test 22h
	// region reported by this controller.
	resp := []byte{0x02, 0x00, 0x20, 0x00, 'S', 'C', 'E', 'A'}
	c.schedule(c.now+getIDSecondDelay, cdEvent{kind: evSecondResp, resp: resp, irq: irqComplete})
	c.idError = false
}

// positionBytes builds the GetlocP response: track,
// index, track-relative MSF, absolute MSF, all BCD.
func (c *Controller) positionBytes() []byte {
	pos := c.headPos()
	trackNum, index := 0xAA, 1
	rel := pos
	if tr, ok := c.trackAt(pos); ok {
		trackNum = tr.Number
		if pos >= tr.DataLBA {
			rel = pos - tr.DataLBA
			index = 1
		} else {
			rel = pos - tr.StartLBA
			index = 0
		}
	}
	rm, rs, rf := SectorToMSF(rel)
	am, as, af := LBAToMSF(pos)
	return []byte{
		toBCD(trackNum), toBCD(index),
		toBCD(rm), toBCD(rs), toBCD(rf),
		toBCD(am), toBCD(as), toBCD(af),
	}
}

// Serialize layout: a 256-byte header, then bounded
// sections for the parameter FIFO, the response
// FIFO, the data FIFO, the play sector buffer, the
// XA sample queue, and the pending events.
const (
	serHdrSize   = 256
	serParamsCap = 16
	serRespCap   = 512
	dataCap      = 32768
	serPlayCap   = 2352
	xaQueueCap   = 8192 // sample frames
	serEventSize = 80
	serEventCap  = 8

	serParamsOff = serHdrSize
	serRespOff   = serParamsOff + serParamsCap
	serDataOff   = serRespOff + serRespCap
	serPlayOff   = serDataOff + dataCap
	serXAOff     = serPlayOff + serPlayCap
	serEventsOff = serXAOff + xaQueueCap*4
)

// CtrlStateSize is the serialized controller size.
const CtrlStateSize = serEventsOff + serEventCap*serEventSize

func boolByte(b bool) uint8 {
	if b {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// Serialize writes the controller state (the disc
// itself is not part of it; the system re-attaches
// the same Reader after a restore).
func (c *Controller) Serialize() []byte {
	out := make([]byte, CtrlStateSize)
	out[0] = uint8(c.index)
	out[1] = c.irqEnable
	out[2] = c.irqFlag
	out[3] = c.mode
	out[4] = boolByte(c.irqHot)
	out[5] = boolByte(c.statError)
	out[6] = boolByte(c.streaming)
	out[7] = boolByte(c.seeking)
	out[8] = boolByte(c.playing)
	out[9] = boolByte(c.motorOn)
	out[10] = boolByte(c.muted)
	out[11] = boolByte(c.idError)
	out[12] = boolByte(c.seekError)
	out[13] = boolByte(c.setlocPending)
	out[14] = boolByte(c.xaActive)
	out[15] = boolByte(c.xaHoldValid)
	out[16] = c.filterFile
	out[17] = c.filterChannel
	out[18] = uint8(int8(c.scanDir) + 1)
	out[19] = boolByte(c.hasQueued)
	out[20] = c.queuedCmd
	out[21] = uint8(len(c.queuedParams))
	out[22] = boolByte(c.playBufValid)
	out[23] = boolByte(c.xaNeedNext)
	out[24] = boolByte(c.xaStereo)
	out[25] = boolByte(c.xaBits8)
	out[26] = c.session
	out[27] = c.scexTotal
	out[28] = c.scexSuccess
	out[29] = boolByte(c.stopped)
	copy(out[160:176], c.queuedParams)
	copy(out[144:152], c.lastHdr[:])
	put32(out[32:], uint32(int32(c.pendingLBA)))
	put32(out[36:], uint32(int32(c.nextLBA)))
	put32(out[40:], uint32(int32(c.curLBA)))
	put32(out[44:], uint32(int32(c.resumeLBA)))
	put32(out[48:], uint32(int32(c.playLBA)))
	put32(out[52:], uint32(int32(c.playOff)))
	put32(out[56:], uint32(int32(c.playBufLBA)))
	put32(out[60:], uint32(int32(c.xaAcc)))
	put32(out[64:], uint32(int32(c.xaRate)))
	put32(out[68:], uint32(c.now))
	put32(out[72:], uint32(c.now>>32))
	put32(out[76:], uint32(int32(c.scanAcc)))
	put32(out[80:], uint32(int32(c.xaOldL)))
	put32(out[84:], uint32(int32(c.xaOlderL)))
	put32(out[88:], uint32(int32(c.xaOldR)))
	put32(out[92:], uint32(int32(c.xaOlderR)))
	put32(out[96:], uint32(int32(c.xaOldM)))
	put32(out[100:], uint32(int32(c.xaOlderM)))
	put32(out[104:], uint32(int32(c.xaHoldL)))
	put32(out[108:], uint32(int32(c.xaHoldR)))
	put32(out[112:], uint32(len(c.params)))
	put32(out[116:], uint32(len(c.response)))
	put32(out[120:], uint32(len(c.data)))
	put32(out[124:], uint32(len(c.xaQueue)))
	put32(out[128:], uint32(len(c.playBuf)))
	put32(out[132:], uint32(len(c.events)))
	copy(out[serParamsOff:], c.params)
	copy(out[serRespOff:], c.response)
	copy(out[serDataOff:], c.data)
	copy(out[serPlayOff:], c.playBuf)
	for i, fr := range c.xaQueue {
		put32(out[serXAOff+i*4:], uint32(uint16(fr[0]))|uint32(uint16(fr[1]))<<16)
	}
	for i, ev := range c.events {
		if i >= serEventCap {
			break
		}
		b := out[serEventsOff+i*serEventSize:]
		b[0] = ev.kind
		b[1] = ev.irq
		b[2] = ev.flag
		b[3] = uint8(len(ev.resp))
		put32(b[4:], uint32(int32(ev.target)))
		put32(b[8:], uint32(ev.at-c.now))
		copy(b[16:64], ev.resp)
	}
	return out
}

// Deserialize restores a state produced by Serialize.
func (c *Controller) Deserialize(in []byte) error {
	if len(in) != CtrlStateSize {
		return fmt.Errorf("cd: controller state size %d, want %d", len(in), CtrlStateSize)
	}
	np := int(get32(in[112:]))
	nr := int(get32(in[116:]))
	nd := int(get32(in[120:]))
	nq := int(get32(in[124:]))
	nb := int(get32(in[128:]))
	ne := int(get32(in[132:]))
	if np > serParamsCap || nr > serRespCap || nd > dataCap || nq > xaQueueCap || nb > serPlayCap || ne > serEventCap {
		return fmt.Errorf("cd: controller state has bad lengths %d/%d/%d/%d/%d/%d", np, nr, nd, nq, nb, ne)
	}
	c.index = int(in[0])
	c.irqEnable = in[1]
	c.irqFlag = in[2]
	c.mode = in[3]
	c.irqHot = in[4] != 0
	c.statError = in[5] != 0
	c.streaming = in[6] != 0
	c.seeking = in[7] != 0
	c.playing = in[8] != 0
	c.motorOn = in[9] != 0
	c.muted = in[10] != 0
	c.idError = in[11] != 0
	c.seekError = in[12] != 0
	c.setlocPending = in[13] != 0
	c.xaActive = in[14] != 0
	c.xaHoldValid = in[15] != 0
	c.filterFile = in[16]
	c.filterChannel = in[17]
	c.scanDir = int(int8(in[18])) - 1
	c.hasQueued = in[19] != 0
	c.queuedCmd = in[20]
	qn := int(in[21])
	if qn > serParamsCap {
		return fmt.Errorf("cd: controller state has bad queued param length %d", qn)
	}
	c.queuedParams = append([]byte(nil), in[160:160+qn]...)
	c.playBufValid = in[22] != 0
	c.xaNeedNext = in[23] != 0
	c.xaStereo = in[24] != 0
	c.xaBits8 = in[25] != 0
	c.session = in[26]
	c.scexTotal = in[27]
	c.scexSuccess = in[28]
	c.stopped = in[29] != 0
	copy(c.lastHdr[:], in[144:152])
	c.pendingLBA = int(int32(get32(in[32:])))
	c.nextLBA = int(int32(get32(in[36:])))
	c.curLBA = int(int32(get32(in[40:])))
	c.resumeLBA = int(int32(get32(in[44:])))
	c.playLBA = int(int32(get32(in[48:])))
	c.playOff = int(int32(get32(in[52:])))
	c.playBufLBA = int(int32(get32(in[56:])))
	c.xaAcc = int(int32(get32(in[60:])))
	c.xaRate = int(int32(get32(in[64:])))
	c.now = int64(uint64(get32(in[68:])) | uint64(get32(in[72:]))<<32)
	c.scanAcc = int(int32(get32(in[76:])))
	c.xaOldL = int(int32(get32(in[80:])))
	c.xaOlderL = int(int32(get32(in[84:])))
	c.xaOldR = int(int32(get32(in[88:])))
	c.xaOlderR = int(int32(get32(in[92:])))
	c.xaOldM = int(int32(get32(in[96:])))
	c.xaOlderM = int(int32(get32(in[100:])))
	c.xaHoldL = int16(int32(get32(in[104:])))
	c.xaHoldR = int16(int32(get32(in[108:])))
	c.params = append([]byte(nil), in[serParamsOff:serParamsOff+np]...)
	c.response = append([]byte(nil), in[serRespOff:serRespOff+nr]...)
	c.data = append([]byte(nil), in[serDataOff:serDataOff+nd]...)
	c.playBuf = append([]byte(nil), in[serPlayOff:serPlayOff+nb]...)
	c.xaQueue = nil
	for i := 0; i < nq; i++ {
		v := get32(in[serXAOff+i*4:])
		c.xaQueue = append(c.xaQueue, [2]int16{int16(v), int16(v >> 16)})
	}
	c.events = nil
	for i := 0; i < ne; i++ {
		b := in[serEventsOff+i*serEventSize:]
		rl := int(b[3])
		if rl > 48 {
			return fmt.Errorf("cd: controller state has bad event response length %d", rl)
		}
		c.events = append(c.events, cdEvent{
			kind:   b[0],
			irq:    b[1],
			flag:   b[2],
			target: int(int32(get32(b[4:]))),
			at:     c.now + int64(get32(b[8:])),
			resp:   append([]byte(nil), b[16:16+rl]...),
		})
	}
	return nil
}

func put32(b []byte, v uint32) {
	b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3] = byte(v), byte(v>>8), byte(v>>16), byte(v>>24)
}
func get32(b []byte) uint32 {
	return uint32(b[0]) | uint32(b[1])<<8 | uint32(b[2])<<16 | uint32(b[3])<<24
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-ps1/cd/ctrl_test.go ====================

package cd

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

// memDisc is a synthetic Reader: sector LBA n holds
// 2048 bytes all equal to byte(n+1).
type memDisc struct{ sectors int }

func (d memDisc) Tracks() []Track {
	return []Track{{Number: 1, Mode: TrackData, SectorSize: 2048, UserSize: 2048, Length: d.sectors}}
}
func (d memDisc) ReadSector(lba int, raw bool) ([]byte, error) {
	if lba < 0 || lba >= d.sectors {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lba %d out of range", lba)
	}
	out := make([]byte, 2048)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = byte(lba + 1)
	}
	return out, nil
}
func (d memDisc) Close() error { return nil }

// fakeDisc is a synthetic 3-track disc: two Mode 2
// data tracks of 750 sectors each, then one audio
// track of 750 sectors. Total 2250 sectors.
// Audio sector frames are a known pattern: frame g
// (counted from the audio track start) is
// (int16(g), int16(-g)).
type fakeDisc struct{}

func (fakeDisc) Tracks() []Track {
	return []Track{
		{Number: 1, Mode: TrackData, SectorSize: 2352, UserOffset: 24, UserSize: 2048, StartLBA: 0, DataLBA: 0, Length: 750},
		{Number: 2, Mode: TrackData, SectorSize: 2352, UserOffset: 24, UserSize: 2048, StartLBA: 750, DataLBA: 750, Length: 750},
		{Number: 3, Mode: TrackAudio, SectorSize: 2352, UserOffset: 0, UserSize: 2352, StartLBA: 1500, DataLBA: 1500, Length: 750},
	}
}

func (fakeDisc) ReadSector(lba int, raw bool) ([]byte, error) {
	if lba < 0 || lba >= 2250 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lba %d out of range", lba)
	}
	if lba >= 1500 {
		out := make([]byte, 2352)
		for i := 0; i < 588; i++ {
			g := int16((lba-1500)*588 + i)
			out[i*4] = byte(g)
			out[i*4+1] = byte(g >> 8)
			out[i*4+2] = byte(-g)
			out[i*4+3] = byte((-g) >> 8)
		}
		return out, nil
	}
	if raw {
		return makeMode2Sector(lba, 0, 0, 0x08, 0), nil
	}
	out := make([]byte, 2048)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = byte(lba + 1)
	}
	return out, nil
}
func (fakeDisc) Close() error { return nil }

// makeMode2Sector builds a raw 2352-byte Mode 2
// sector: sync, BCD header, subheader (twice), then
// data bytes filled with byte(lba+1).
func makeMode2Sector(lba int, file, channel, submode, coding uint8) []byte {
	out := make([]byte, 2352)
	copy(out, syncPattern)
	m, s, f := LBAToMSF(lba)
	out[12], out[13], out[14], out[15] = toBCD(m), toBCD(s), toBCD(f), 2
	out[16], out[17], out[18], out[19] = file, channel, submode, coding
	copy(out[20:24], out[16:20])
	for i := 24; i < len(out); i++ {
		out[i] = byte(lba + 1)
	}
	return out
}

// xaDisc is a synthetic disc whose raw sectors are
// Mode 2 Form 2 XA audio sectors (file 1, channel
// 2, submode audio+realtime+form2, mono, 37.8 kHz).
// In 4-bit format, portion 0 block 0 carries the
// nibble pattern (j%7)+1 for sample j; every other
// nibble is 1. In 8-bit format, portion 0 block 0
// carries the byte pattern j+1; other bytes are 0.
// All header bytes are 0 (shift 0, filter 0), so a
// 4-bit sample decodes to nibble<<12 and an 8-bit
// sample to byte<<8.
type xaDisc struct{ bits8 bool }

func (d xaDisc) Tracks() []Track {
	return []Track{{Number: 1, Mode: TrackData, SectorSize: 2352, UserOffset: 24, UserSize: 2048, StartLBA: 0, DataLBA: 0, Length: 300}}
}
func (d xaDisc) ReadSector(lba int, raw bool) ([]byte, error) {
	if lba < 0 || lba >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lba %d out of range", lba)
	}
	if !raw {
		out := make([]byte, 2048)
		for i := range out {
			out[i] = byte(lba + 1)
		}
		return out, nil
	}
	ci := uint8(0)
	if d.bits8 {
		ci = 0x10
	}
	out := makeMode2Sector(lba, 1, 2, 0x64, ci)
	for i := 24; i < 24+0x900; i++ {
		out[i] = 0
	}
	p := out[24 : 24+128] // portion 0
	if d.bits8 {
		for j := 0; j < 28; j++ {
			p[16+j*4] = byte(j + 1)
		}
	} else {
		for i := 16; i < 128; i++ {
			p[i] = 0x11
		}
		for j := 0; j < 28; j++ {
			p[16+j*4] = 0x10 | byte((j%7)+1)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
func (d xaDisc) Close() error { return nil }

// filterDisc has Mode 2 data sectors alternating
// subheader file/channel: even LBAs are file 0
// channel 0, odd LBAs are file 9 channel 9.
type filterDisc struct{}

func (filterDisc) Tracks() []Track {
	return []Track{{Number: 1, Mode: TrackData, SectorSize: 2352, UserOffset: 24, UserSize: 2048, StartLBA: 0, DataLBA: 0, Length: 100}}
}
func (filterDisc) ReadSector(lba int, raw bool) ([]byte, error) {
	if lba < 0 || lba >= 100 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lba %d out of range", lba)
	}
	if raw {
		file, channel := uint8(0), uint8(0)
		if lba%2 == 1 {
			file, channel = 9, 9
		}
		return makeMode2Sector(lba, file, channel, 0x08, 0), nil
	}
	out := make([]byte, 2048)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = byte(lba + 1)
	}
	return out, nil
}
func (filterDisc) Close() error { return nil }

func writeReg(c *Controller, off uint32, v uint8) { c.WriteReg(off, v) }

// sendCmd writes parameters and a command at index
// 0 and returns the drained response FIFO bytes.
func sendCmd(c *Controller, cmd uint8, params ...uint8) []byte {
	c.WriteReg(0, 0)
	for _, p := range params {
		c.WriteReg(2, p)
	}
	c.WriteReg(1, cmd)
	return drainResp(c)
}

func drainResp(c *Controller) []byte {
	out := append([]byte(nil), c.response...)
	for len(c.response) > 0 {
		c.ReadReg(1)
	}
	return out
}

// setloc is a test helper: Setloc to an absolute
// MSF given in BCD bytes, response drained.
func setloc(c *Controller, mm, ss, ff uint8) {
	sendCmd(c, 0x02, mm, ss, ff)
}

func TestGetstatAndIRQ(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(memDisc{sectors: 10})
	irqs := 0
	c.OnIRQ = func() { irqs++ }
	writeReg(c, 3, 0x1F) // enable all IRQ types (index 0)
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x01) // Getstat
	if got := c.ReadReg(0); got&0x20 == 0 {
		t.Errorf("status = 0x%02X, want RSLRRDY set", got)
	}
	if v := c.ReadReg(1); v != 0x02 {
		t.Errorf("Getstat response = 0x%02X, want 0x02 (motor on)", v)
	}
	if irqs != 1 {
		t.Errorf("IRQ callbacks = %d, want 1", irqs)
	}
	if c.irqFlag != irqAck {
		t.Errorf("irqFlag = %d, want %d (ack)", c.irqFlag, irqAck)
	}
	// Acknowledge via the flag register (index 1).
	writeReg(c, 0, 1)
	writeReg(c, 3, irqAck)
	if c.irqFlag != 0 {
		t.Errorf("irqFlag after ack = %d, want 0", c.irqFlag)
	}
}

func TestSetlocReadNAndDMAWords(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(memDisc{sectors: 300})
	// Setloc to MSF 00:02:00 = LBA 0.
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x00)
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x02)
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x00)
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x02) // Setloc command
	c.ReadReg(1)         // drain response
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x06) // ReadN
	// Timing model change from PS1-2: the first
	// sector now arrives only after the seek delay
	// plus one sector period, via Advance.
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("data FIFO = %d bytes, want 2048", c.DataLen())
	}
	// Sector 0 is filled with 0x01.
	w, ok := c.ReadWord()
	if !ok || w != 0x01010101 {
		t.Fatalf("first DMA word = 0x%08X ok=%v, want 0x01010101", w, ok)
	}
	// Drain the remaining 511 words of sector 0. The
	// next sector is timing driven now: it arrives
	// one sector period after the first, via
	// Advance (PS1-2 queued it on drain).
	for i := 0; i < 511; i++ {
		if _, ok := c.ReadWord(); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("word %d of sector 0 unavailable", i+1)
		}
	}
	c.Advance(sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	if !c.Streaming() {
		t.Fatalf("stream stopped after first sector")
	}
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("data FIFO = %d after next period, want 2048", c.DataLen())
	}
	w, ok = c.ReadWord()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("no word available after next period")
	}
	if w != 0x02020202 {
		t.Errorf("second sector word = 0x%08X, want 0x02020202", w)
	}
	// Pause stops the stream: after draining what is
	// queued, nothing new arrives.
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x09)
	for c.DataLen() > 0 {
		before := c.DataLen()
		c.ReadReg(2)
		if c.DataLen() > before {
			t.Fatalf("FIFO refilled after Pause")
		}
	}
	if c.Streaming() {
		t.Errorf("still streaming after Pause")
	}
}

func TestUnknownCommandError(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(memDisc{sectors: 4})
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x7E)
	if c.irqFlag != irqError {
		t.Errorf("irqFlag = %d, want error type %d", c.irqFlag, irqError)
	}
	if v := c.ReadReg(1); v&0x01 == 0 {
		t.Errorf("status response = 0x%02X, want error bit set", v)
	}
}

func TestControllerSerializeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(memDisc{sectors: 50})
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x00)
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x02)
	writeReg(c, 2, 0x25) // MSF 00:02:25 -> LBA 25
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x02)
	c.ReadReg(1)
	writeReg(c, 1, 0x1B) // ReadS
	// Timing model change from PS1-2: Advance past
	// the seek delay (25 sectors of distance) plus
	// one sector period before the sector lands.
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(25, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("data = %d, want 2048", c.DataLen())
	}
	// Read part of the sector, then save.
	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
		c.ReadReg(2)
	}
	s := c.Serialize()
	c2 := NewController()
	c2.SetDisc(memDisc{sectors: 50})
	if err := c2.Deserialize(s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(c2.Serialize(), s) {
		t.Errorf("controller state diverged after round trip")
	}
	// Sector 25 is filled with 26 (0x1A).
	if v := c2.ReadReg(2); v != 0x1A {
		t.Errorf("restored FIFO byte = 0x%02X, want 0x1A", v)
	}
}

// TestCommandCoverage drives every implemented
// command on the synthetic 3-track disc and checks
// the first response bytes and the INT type.
func TestCommandCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	playSetup := func(c *Controller) {
		setloc(c, 0x00, 0x22, 0x00) // audio track start, LBA 1500
		sendCmd(c, 0x03)
		c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(1500, true))
		drainResp(c)
	}
	readSetup := func(c *Controller) {
		setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
		sendCmd(c, 0x06)
		c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
		drainResp(c)
	}
	stopSetup := func(c *Controller) {
		sendCmd(c, 0x08)
		c.Advance(stopSecondSpinning + 1)
		drainResp(c)
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		setup  func(*Controller)
		cmd    uint8
		params []uint8
		want   []byte
	}{
		{"Getstat", nil, 0x01, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Setloc", nil, 0x02, []uint8{0x00, 0x02, 0x00}, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Play", func(c *Controller) { setloc(c, 0x00, 0x22, 0x00) }, 0x03, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Forward", playSetup, 0x04, nil, []byte{0x82}},
		{"Backward", playSetup, 0x05, nil, []byte{0x82}},
		{"ReadN", nil, 0x06, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"MotorOn", stopSetup, 0x07, nil, []byte{0x00}},
		{"Stop", nil, 0x08, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Pause", nil, 0x09, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Init", nil, 0x0A, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Mute", nil, 0x0B, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Demute", nil, 0x0C, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Setfilter", nil, 0x0D, []uint8{1, 2}, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Setmode", nil, 0x0E, []uint8{0x80}, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Getparam", nil, 0x0F, nil, []byte{0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00}},
		{"GetlocL", readSetup, 0x10, nil, []byte{0x00, 0x02, 0x00, 0x02, 0, 0, 0x08, 0}},
		{"GetlocP", nil, 0x11, nil, []byte{0x01, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x02, 0}},
		{"SetSession", nil, 0x12, []uint8{1}, []byte{0x02}},
		{"GetTN", nil, 0x13, nil, []byte{0x02, 0x01, 0x03}},
		{"GetTD", nil, 0x14, []uint8{0x02}, []byte{0x02, 0x00, 0x12}},
		{"SeekL", func(c *Controller) { setloc(c, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00) }, 0x15, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"SeekP", func(c *Controller) { setloc(c, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00) }, 0x16, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		// Test 20h: the version response published in
		// psx-spx for LATE-PU-8 vC1 is 95h,07h,24h,C1h
		// (24 Jul 1995, version C1).
		{"Test20", nil, 0x19, []uint8{0x20}, []byte{0x95, 0x07, 0x24, 0xC1}},
		{"GetID", nil, 0x1A, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"ReadS", nil, 0x1B, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"Reset", nil, 0x1C, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"GetQ", nil, 0x1D, nil, []byte{0x02}},
		{"ReadTOC", nil, 0x1E, nil, []byte{0x02}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			c := NewController()
			c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
			if tc.setup != nil {
				tc.setup(c)
			}
			drainResp(c)
			c.irqFlag = 0
			got := sendCmd(c, tc.cmd, tc.params...)
			if !bytes.Equal(got, tc.want) {
				t.Errorf("cmd %02X first response = % X, want % X", tc.cmd, got, tc.want)
			}
			if c.irqFlag != irqAck {
				t.Errorf("cmd %02X irqFlag = %d, want INT3 (%d)", tc.cmd, c.irqFlag, irqAck)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGetTNGetTDExact(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x13); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x02, 0x01, 0x03}) {
		t.Errorf("GetTN = % X, want [02 01 03]", got)
	}
	// Track starts: t1 LBA0 -> 00:02, t2 LBA750 ->
	// 00:12, t3 LBA1500 -> 00:22, track 0 = end of
	// last track LBA2250 -> 00:32 (mm:ss, BCD).
	for param, want := range map[uint8][]byte{
		0x01: {0x02, 0x00, 0x02},
		0x02: {0x02, 0x00, 0x12},
		0x03: {0x02, 0x00, 0x22},
		0x00: {0x02, 0x00, 0x32},
	} {
		if got := sendCmd(c, 0x14, param); !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("GetTD(%02X) = % X, want % X", param, got, want)
		}
	}
	// Past the last track: documented error 10h.
	c.irqFlag = 0
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x14, 0x04); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x03, 0x10}) {
		t.Errorf("GetTD(04) = % X, want [03 10]", got)
	}
	if c.irqFlag != irqError {
		t.Errorf("GetTD(04) irqFlag = %d, want INT5", c.irqFlag)
	}
}

func TestGetIDSecondResponse(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	sendCmd(c, 0x1A)
	c.Advance(getIDSecondDelay - 1)
	if len(c.response) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("GetID second response arrived early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	got := drainResp(c)
	want := []byte{0x02, 0x00, 0x20, 0x00, 'S', 'C', 'E', 'A'}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("GetID second response = % X, want % X", got, want)
	}
}

// crcSubQ recomputes the subchannel Q CRC in the
// test, bit by bit, from the documented
// CRC-16-CCITT polynomial (x^16+x^12+x^5+1, hex
// 1021h), initial value zero, result inverted,
// transmitted big-endian. It shares no code with
// the controller's nibble routine.
func crcSubQ(data []byte) uint16 {
	crc := uint16(0)
	for _, b := range data {
		crc ^= uint16(b) << 8
		for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
			if crc&0x8000 != 0 {
				crc = crc<<1 ^ 0x1021
			} else {
				crc <<= 1
			}
		}
	}
	return ^crc
}

func TestGetQDuringPlay(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	sendCmd(c, 0x03, 0x03) // Play track 3
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(1500, true))
	drainResp(c)
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x1D); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x82}) {
		t.Fatalf("GetQ first response = % X, want [82] (playing)", got)
	}
	c.Advance(sectorPeriod1x - 1)
	if len(c.response) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("GetQ second response arrived early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	got := drainResp(c)
	if len(got) != 13 {
		t.Fatalf("GetQ second response = % X, want 13 bytes", got)
	}
	// Position: audio track 3, index 1, relative
	// 00:00:00, absolute 00:22:00 (LBA 1500 + the
	// 150-frame lead-in), control/ADR 01h.
	wantData := []byte{0x01, 0x03, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x22, 0x00}
	if !bytes.Equal(got[:10], wantData) {
		t.Errorf("GetQ data = % X, want % X", got[:10], wantData)
	}
	crc := crcSubQ(got[:10])
	if got[10] != uint8(crc>>8) || got[11] != uint8(crc) {
		t.Errorf("GetQ CRC = %02X %02X, recomputed %04X", got[10], got[11], crc)
	}
	if got[12] != 0 {
		t.Errorf("GetQ peak byte = %02X, want 0", got[12])
	}
}

func TestSeekTiming(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00) // LBA 750
	sendCmd(c, 0x15)            // SeekL
	delay := seekDelayCycles(750, true)
	c.Advance(delay - 1)
	if len(c.response) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("seek INT2 arrived before %d cycles", delay)
	}
	if !c.seeking {
		t.Errorf("seeking flag cleared early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	got := drainResp(c)
	if !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x02}) {
		t.Errorf("seek INT2 response = % X, want [02]", got)
	}
	if c.seeking || c.curLBA != 750 {
		t.Errorf("after seek: seeking=%v cur=%d, want false/750", c.seeking, c.curLBA)
	}
}

func TestSectorPacing(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x06) // ReadN
	first := seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0)
	c.Advance(first - 1)
	if c.DataLen() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("sector arrived before seek+period: %d bytes", c.DataLen())
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("after first period: %d bytes, want 2048", c.DataLen())
	}
	c.Advance(sectorPeriodCycles(0) - 1)
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("second sector arrived early: %d bytes", c.DataLen())
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	if c.DataLen() != 4096 {
		t.Fatalf("after second period: %d bytes, want 4096", c.DataLen())
	}
}

func TestDoubleSpeedHalvesPeriod(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	sendCmd(c, 0x0E, 0x80) // Setmode double speed
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x06)
	half := sectorPeriodCycles(0x80)
	first := seekDelayCycles(0, true) + half
	c.Advance(first - 1)
	if c.DataLen() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("double-speed sector arrived early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("double-speed first sector: %d bytes", c.DataLen())
	}
	c.Advance(half - 1)
	if c.DataLen() != 2048 {
		t.Fatalf("double-speed second sector arrived early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	if c.DataLen() != 4096 {
		t.Fatalf("double-speed second sector: %d bytes, want 4096", c.DataLen())
	}
}

func TestGetstatStates(t *testing.T) {
	// Reading bit during ReadN (after first sector).
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x06)
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	drainResp(c)
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x01); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x22}) {
		t.Errorf("Getstat during ReadN = % X, want [22] (read+motor)", got)
	}
	// Playing bit during Play.
	c2 := NewController()
	c2.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	sendCmd(c2, 0x03, 0x03)
	c2.Advance(seekDelayCycles(1500, true))
	drainResp(c2)
	if got := sendCmd(c2, 0x01); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x82}) {
		t.Errorf("Getstat during Play = % X, want [82] (play+motor)", got)
	}
	// Shell open with no disc.
	c3 := NewController()
	if got := sendCmd(c3, 0x01); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x10}) {
		t.Errorf("Getstat with no disc = % X, want [10] (shell open)", got)
	}
}

func TestSetlocBadBCD(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	c.irqFlag = 0
	// 0Ah in the minute nibble is not valid BCD:
	// documented answer is INT5 with error code
	// 10h (invalid parameter value).
	got := sendCmd(c, 0x02, 0x0A, 0x02, 0x00)
	if !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x03, 0x10}) {
		t.Errorf("bad Setloc response = % X, want [03 10]", got)
	}
	if c.irqFlag != irqError {
		t.Errorf("bad Setloc irqFlag = %d, want INT5", c.irqFlag)
	}
	// Commands needing a disc, with no disc:
	// INT5 with code 80h.
	c2 := NewController()
	got = sendCmd(c2, 0x02, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	if !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x11, 0x80}) {
		t.Errorf("no-disc Setloc = % X, want [11 80]", got)
	}
}

func TestPauseSecondResponse(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x06)
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	drainResp(c)
	for c.DataLen() > 0 {
		c.ReadReg(2)
	}
	// Pause during ReadN: first response still
	// shows the reading bit (22h, the doc's own
	// example), the second arrives after the pause
	// delay with the bit cleared (02h).
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x09); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x22}) {
		t.Fatalf("Pause first response = % X, want [22]", got)
	}
	if c.Streaming() {
		t.Fatalf("still streaming after Pause")
	}
	delay := 5 * sectorPeriodCycles(0)
	c.Advance(delay - 1)
	if len(c.response) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("Pause second response arrived early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	if got := drainResp(c); !bytes.Equal(got, []byte{0x02}) {
		t.Errorf("Pause second response = % X, want [02]", got)
	}
	if c.DataLen() != 0 {
		t.Errorf("data arrived after Pause: %d bytes", c.DataLen())
	}
}

func TestBusyQueuedCommand(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x15) // SeekL, completion pending
	// A command issued while the seek completion is
	// pending is held by the busy rule: no response
	// until the completion fires.
	if got := sendCmd(c, 0x13); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("GetTN answered during busy seek: % X", got)
	}
	delay := seekDelayCycles(750, true)
	c.Advance(delay - 1)
	if len(c.response) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("queued command fired early")
	}
	c.Advance(1)
	got := drainResp(c)
	want := []byte{0x02, 0x02, 0x01, 0x03} // seek INT2, then GetTN
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("after busy completion: % X, want % X", got, want)
	}
}

func TestCDDAPlay(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(fakeDisc{})
	sendCmd(c, 0x03, 0x03) // Play track 3
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(1500, true))
	drainResp(c)
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		l, r := c.PullCDSample()
		if l != int16(i) || r != int16(-i) {
			t.Fatalf("CD-DA sample %d = (%d,%d), want (%d,%d)", i, l, r, i, -i)
		}
	}
	// Pull the rest of the sector: the position
	// must advance to the next LBA.
	for i := 4; i < 588; i++ {
		c.PullCDSample()
	}
	if c.playLBA != 1501 {
		t.Errorf("after 588 samples playLBA = %d, want 1501", c.playLBA)
	}
	l, _ := c.PullCDSample()
	if l != 588 {
		t.Errorf("first sample of next sector = %d, want 588", l)
	}
}

func TestCDDADoubleSpeed(t *testing.T) {

	sendCmd(c, 0x03, 0x03)
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(1500, true))
	drainResp(c)
	// At double speed the position advances two
	// frames per output sample.
	for i, want := range []int16{0, 2, 4, 6} {
		l, _ := c.PullCDSample()
		if l != want {
			t.Fatalf("double-speed sample %d = %d, want %d", i, l, want)
		}
	}
}

		t.Fatalf("Forward response = % X, want [82]", got)
	}

		t.Errorf("scan output = %d, want muted 0", l)
	}
	// Scan model: 10 sectors per sector period.

	}
}

func TestXAADPCM4Bit(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewController()
	c.SetDisc(xaDisc{})
	sendCmd(c, 0x0E, 0x40) // Setmode: XA on
	setloc(c, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00)
	sendCmd(c, 0x1B) // ReadS
	c.Advance(seekDelayCycles(0, true) + sectorPeriodCycles(0))
	if c.DataLen() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("XA sector leaked into the data FIFO: %d bytes", c.DataLen())
	}
	// Source pattern (block 0): sample j is
	// ((j%7)+1)<<12. Sample-and-hold at
	// 37.8k -> 44.1k repeats source indices in the
	// pattern 0,0,1,2,3,4,5,6,6,7.
	wantIdx := []int{0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6, 7}
	for i, idx := range wantIdx {
		l, r := c.PullCDSample()
		want := int16(((idx % 7) + 1) << 12)
		if l != want || r != want {
			t.Fatalf("XA sample %d = (%d,%d), want %d (source index %d)", i, l, r, want, idx)
		}
	}
}

func TestSetfilterSkipsSectors(t *testing.T) {

	c.SetDisc(filterDisc{})
