	// in word 0 and a zero delay slot word the kernel will patch.
	if w := mem.Read32(m.Imports[0].StubAddr); w != 0x03E00008 {
		t.Fatalf("stub word 0 = %#x, want JR $ra", w)
	}
	if w := mem.Read32(m.Imports[0].StubAddr + 4); w != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stub word 1 = %#x, want 0 placeholder", w)
	}
}

func TestLoadPRXRelocations(t *testing.T) {
	const base = 0x08900000
	relocs := []reloc{
		{off: modInfoOff + 0x20, typ: r32}, // gp field
		{off: modInfoOff + 0x2C, typ: r32}, // stubTop
		{off: modInfoOff + 0x30, typ: r32}, // stubBtm
		{off: modStubT_off + 0, typ: r32},  // stub table name ptr
		{off: modStubT_off + 12, typ: r32}, // nidTable ptr
		{off: modStubT_off + 16, typ: r32}, // funcTable ptr
		{off: modTextOff + 0, typ: r26},    // jal target
		{off: modTextOff + 4, typ: rHi16},  // lui half of the pair
		{off: modTextOff + 8, typ: rLo16},  // addiu half of the pair
		{off: modDataOff, typ: r32},        // data pointer
	}
	data := buildTestELF(t, elfOpts{typ: etSceExec, link: 0, relocs: relocs})
	size, relocatable, err := Probe(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !relocatable || size != modSegSize {
		t.Fatalf("Probe: size %#x relocatable %v", size, relocatable)
	}
	mem := newMapMem(base, modSegSize)
	m, err := Load(mem, data, base)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if m.Entry != base+0x40 || m.GP != base+0x900 {
		t.Fatalf("module: entry %#x gp %#x, want %#x / %#x", m.Entry, m.GP, base+0x40, base+0x900)
	}
	if len(m.Imports) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("imports: %d, want 2", len(m.Imports))
	}
	if m.Imports[0].StubAddr != base+modStubsOff || m.Imports[1].StubAddr != base+modStubsOff+8 {
		t.Fatalf("stub addrs: %#x %#x", m.Imports[0].StubAddr, m.Imports[1].StubAddr)
	}
	if m.Imports[0].Module != "ThreadManForUser" || m.Imports[0].NID != 0x446D8DE6 {
		t.Fatalf("import 0: %+v", m.Imports[0])
	}
	// R_MIPS_26: jal field becomes (0x400 + base) >> 2.
	if w := mem.Read32(base + modTextOff); w != 0x0C000000|((0x400+base)>>2) {
		t.Fatalf("jal word = %#x, want %#x", w, 0x0C000000|((0x400+base)>>2))
	}
	// R_MIPS_HI16/LO16 pair: AHL = 0x18ABC, so the relocated
	// address is base + 0x18ABC = 0x08918ABC. The low half 0x8ABC
	// has the sign bit set, so the high half must absorb the
	// carry: LUI imm = 0x0892, ADDIU imm stays 0x8ABC.
	if w := mem.Read32(base + modTextOff + 4); w != 0x3C080000|0x0892 {
		t.Fatalf("lui word = %#x, want imm 0x0892", w)
	}
	if w := mem.Read32(base + modTextOff + 8); w != 0x25088ABC {
		t.Fatalf("addiu word = %#x, want imm 0x8ABC", w)
	}
	// R_MIPS_32 data word.
	if w := mem.Read32(base + modDataOff); w != base+0x500 {
		t.Fatalf("data word = %#x, want %#x", w, base+0x500)
	}
}

func TestLoadUnsupportedRelocation(t *testing.T) {
	data := buildTestELF(t, elfOpts{typ: etSceExec, link: 0, relocs: []reloc{{off: 0, typ: 9}}})
	mem := newMapMem(0x08900000, modSegSize)
	_, err := Load(mem, data, 0x08900000)
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "relocation type 9") {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want a relocation type 9 error", err)
	}
}

func TestLoadRejectsBadFiles(t *testing.T) {
	mem := newMapMem(0x08800000, modSegSize)
	if _, err := Load(mem, []byte("not an elf at all, just bytes"), 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("non ELF accepted")
	}
	data := buildTestELF(t, elfOpts{typ: etExec, link: 0x08800000})
	data[18] = 62 // EM_X86_64
	if _, err := Load(mem, data, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("non MIPS ELF accepted")
	}
	data = buildTestELF(t, elfOpts{typ: 0x1234, link: 0x08800000})
	if _, err := Load(mem, data, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown ELF type accepted")
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-psp/system/psp2_gate_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"math"
	"testing"

	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-psp/ge"
)

// PSP-2 gate: a synthetic program runs VFPU math on the CPU and a
// display list through the GE, then a state saved mid-run restores
// into a byte-identical continuation (state bytes and framebuffer
// pixels). All fixtures are synthesized here; nothing is loaded from
// disc.

// vfpuProg is hand-encoded VFPU on top of the integer core, in
// the corpus operand layout (C000 is field 0 at file positions
// {0, 4, 8, 12}, C010 field 1, C100 field 4, C110 field 5; the
// PSP-2 build of this program used the linear layout the
// pspautotests corpus later refuted):
//
//	vadd.q C100 = C000 + C010                 (1,2,3,4) + (10,20,30,40)
//	vdot.q S200 = C100 . C000                 11+44+99+176 = 330
//	vmul.q C110 = C100 * C000                 (11,44,99,176)
//	j self
var vfpuProg = []uint32{
	encGateVV(0x18, 0, 0x04, 0x00, 0x01, 3), // vadd.q (op 0x18, G 0)
	encGateVV(0x19, 1, 0x08, 0x04, 0x00, 3), // vdot.q (op 0x19, G 1)
	encGateVV(0x19, 0, 0x05, 0x04, 0x00, 3), // vmul.q (op 0x19, G 0)
	0x0A000003,                              // j 0x0800000C (self)
}

// encGateVV encodes a VV-format VFPU instruction: VD at bits 6:0, the
// size split across bits 7 and 15, VS at bits 14:8, VT at bits 22:16,
// group at bits 25:23.
func encGateVV(op, g, vd, vs, vt, size uint32) uint32 {
	return op<<26 | g<<23 | vt<<16 | ((size>>1)&1)<<15 | vs<<8 | (size&1)<<7 | vd
}

func geCmd(op, arg uint32) uint32 { return op<<24 | (arg & 0xFFFFFF) }

// gateDisplayList clears the frame to a color and draws one green
// sprite at (8,8)-(16,12). Addresses: list at 0x08001000, vertices at
// 0x08002000, framebuffer at VRAM offset 0 with width 512 in 8888.
var gateDisplayList = []uint32{
	geCmd(0x14, 0x080000),      // ORIGIN: originPtr = 0x08000000
	geCmd(0x9C, 0),             // FRAMEBUFPTR
	geCmd(0x9D, 512),           // FRAMEBUFWIDTH
	geCmd(0xE8, 3),             // PIXELFORMAT = 8888
	geCmd(0x15, 0),             // REGION1 (0,0)
	geCmd(0x16, 479|(271<<10)), // REGION2 (479,271)
	geCmd(0xC9, 0x102030),      // CLEARCOLOR r=0x30 g=0x20 b=0x10
	geCmd(0xCA, 0xFF),          // CLEARALPHA alpha=255
	geCmd(0xCC, 0x7),           // CLEAR enable|color|alpha
	geCmd(0x04, 3<<16|3),       // PRIM (clear)
	geCmd(0xCC, 0),             // CLEAR mode off, or the next PRIM clears too
	geCmd(0x12, 0x800113),      // VTYPE tc float, color 8888, pos s16, through
	geCmd(0x01, 0x2000),        // VADDR -> 0x08002000
	geCmd(0x04, 6<<16|2),       // PRIM sprite, 2 vertices
	geCmd(0x0F, 0),             // FINISH
	geCmd(0x0C, 0),             // END
}

// gateSpriteVerts: two through-mode vertices, stride 18 bytes
// (uv float pair, color word, position x/y/z as 12.4 fixed / raw z).
func gateSpriteVerts() []byte {
	out := make([]byte, 0, 36)
	put := func(v interface{}) {
		switch t := v.(type) {
		case float32:
			var b [4]byte
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[:], math.Float32bits(t))
			out = append(out, b[:]...)
		case uint32:
			var b [4]byte
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[:], t)
			out = append(out, b[:]...)
		case uint16:
			var b [2]byte
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[:], t)
			out = append(out, b[:]...)
		}
	}
	// v0: uv (0,0), opaque green, pos (8,8), z 0
	put(float32(0))
	put(float32(0))
	put(uint32(0xFF00FF00))
	put(uint16(8 << 4))
	put(uint16(8 << 4))
	put(uint16(0))
	// v1: uv (1,1), opaque green, pos (16,12), z 0
	put(float32(1))
	put(float32(1))
	put(uint32(0xFF00FF00))
	put(uint16(16 << 4))
	put(uint16(12 << 4))
	put(uint16(0))
	return out
}

func loadGateMachine(t *testing.T) *Machine {
	t.Helper()
	m := New()
	buf := make([]byte, 4)
	for i, w := range vfpuProg {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf, w)
		m.LoadBytes(0x08000000+uint32(4*i), buf)
	}
	for i, w := range gateDisplayList {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf, w)
		m.LoadBytes(0x08001000+uint32(4*i), buf)
	}
	m.LoadBytes(0x08002000, gateSpriteVerts())
	m.Boot(0x08000000)
	// VFPU inputs in the corpus layout: C000 (positions
	// {0, 4, 8, 12}) = (1,2,3,4), C010 (positions {1, 5, 9, 13})
	// = (10,20,30,40). Set after Boot because Boot resets the
	// CPU and clears the VFPU file.
	for i, v := range []float32{1, 2, 3, 4} {
		m.CPU.SetVSingle(4*i, math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	for i, v := range []float32{10, 20, 30, 40} {
		m.CPU.SetVSingle(4*i+1, math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	return m
}

func TestPSP2VFPUProgramResults(t *testing.T) {
	m := loadGateMachine(t)
	m.RunCycles(100)
	// vadd.q result at C100 (positions {16, 20, 24, 28}).
	for i, want := range []float32{11, 22, 33, 44} {
		if got := math.Float32frombits(m.CPU.VSingle(16 + 4*i)); got != want {
			t.Errorf("vadd lane %d = %v, want %v", i, got, want)
		}
	}
	// vdot.q result at S200 (position 32 under the dot
	// family's scalar decode).
	if got := math.Float32frombits(m.CPU.VSingle(32)); got != 330 {
		t.Errorf("vdot = %v, want 330", got)
	}
	// vmul.q result at C110 (positions {17, 21, 25, 29}).
	for i, want := range []float32{11, 44, 99, 176} {
		if got := math.Float32frombits(m.CPU.VSingle(17 + 4*i)); got != want {
			t.Errorf("vmul lane %d = %v, want %v", i, got, want)
		}
	}
	if got := m.CPU.VFPUFaultCount(); got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("VFPUFaultCount = %d, want 0 (VFPU executes now)", got)
	}
}

func TestPSP2DisplayListThroughSystem(t *testing.T) {
	m := loadGateMachine(t)
	if st := m.SubmitDisplayList(0x08001000); st != ge.StateCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("list state = %v, want StateCompleted", st)
	}
	fb := m.Framebuffer()
	const clearPx = 0xFF302010 // a=FF r=0x30 g=0x20 b=0x10
	const greenPx = 0xFF00FF00
	if got := fb[0]; got != clearPx {
		t.Errorf("pixel (0,0) = %#08x, want clear %#08x", got, clearPx)
	}
	if got := fb[10*Width+10]; got != greenPx {
		t.Errorf("pixel (10,10) = %#08x, want sprite green %#08x", got, greenPx)
	}
	if got := fb[11*Width+15]; got != greenPx {
		t.Errorf("pixel (15,11) = %#08x, want sprite green %#08x", got, greenPx)
	}
	if got := fb[10*Width+16]; got != clearPx {
		t.Errorf("pixel (16,10) = %#08x, want clear %#08x", got, clearPx)
	}
	if got := fb[12*Width+10]; got != clearPx {
		t.Errorf("pixel (10,12) = %#08x, want clear %#08x", got, clearPx)
	}
}

func TestPSP2SaveRestoreDeterministicContinuation(t *testing.T) {
	a := loadGateMachine(t)
	a.RunCycles(100)
	if st := a.SubmitDisplayList(0x08001000); st != ge.StateCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("list state = %v, want StateCompleted", st)
	}
	mid := a.Serialize()
	if len(mid) != a.StateSize() {
		t.Fatalf("serialized %d bytes, StateSize says %d", len(mid), a.StateSize())
	}
	if mid[0] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("state version = %d, want 2", mid[0])
	}
	a.RunCycles(2000)
	finalA := a.Serialize()
	fbA := append([]uint32(nil), a.Framebuffer()...)

	b := New()
	if err := b.Deserialize(mid); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	if b.DisplayListState() != ge.StateCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("restored list state = %v, want StateCompleted", b.DisplayListState())
	}
	if got := math.Float32frombits(b.CPU.VSingle(32)); got != 330 {
		t.Fatalf("restored vdot = %v, want 330", got)
	}
	b.RunCycles(2000)
	finalB := b.Serialize()
	fbB := append([]uint32(nil), b.Framebuffer()...)

	if !bytes.Equal(finalA, finalB) {
		t.Fatal("continuation after restore diverged from the uninterrupted run")
	}
	if len(fbA) != len(fbB) {
		t.Fatalf("framebuffer sizes differ: %d vs %d", len(fbA), len(fbB))
	}
	for i := range fbA {
		if fbA[i] != fbB[i] {
			t.Fatalf("framebuffer pixel %d diverged: %#08x vs %#08x", i, fbA[i], fbB[i])
		}
	}
}

func TestPSP2RejectsVersion1State(t *testing.T) {
	m := loadGateMachine(t)
	state := m.Serialize()
	state[0] = 1
	if err := New().Deserialize(state); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("version 1 state accepted by the version 2 loader")
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-psp/system/psp3_gate_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// PSP-3 synthetic gates: hand assembled MIPS programs packaged as
// ET_EXEC ELFs (and one relocatable PRX) by the builders in this
// file, booted through the HLE kernel via LoadExecutable. The
// builders mirror the segment layout the loader's own tests prove
// (one PT_LOAD, module info located through its section).

// MIPS register numbers used by the gate programs.
const (
	rZero = 0
	rV0   = 2
	rV1   = 3
	rA0   = 4
	rA1   = 5
	rA2   = 6
	rA3   = 7
	rT0   = 8
	rT1   = 9
	rT2   = 10
	rT3   = 11
	rT4   = 12
	rT5   = 13
	rS0   = 16
	rS1   = 17
	rS2   = 18
	rS3   = 19
	rS4   = 20
	rS5   = 21
	rS6   = 22
	rS7   = 23
	rGP   = 28
	rSP   = 29
	rRA   = 31
)

// --- tiny two-pass assembler ------------------------------------

const (
	fxBranch = iota
	fxJump
	fxStub
	fxLaHi
	fxLaLo
	fxLaCodeHi
	fxLaCodeLo
)

type gateFix struct {
	idx  int
	kind int
	base uint32 // instruction word with the variable field zeroed
	lib  int
	fn   int
	lab  string
}

type gateAsm struct {
	words      []uint32
	labels     map[string]int
	fixups     []gateFix
	laPairs    [][2]int // word indexes of laRel lui/addiu pairs, for PRX relocs
	jalRelIdx  []int    // word indexes of jalRel jumps, for PRX relocs
	stubJalIdx []int    // word indexes of jalStub jumps, for PRX relocs
}

func newGateAsm() *gateAsm { return &gateAsm{labels: map[string]int{}} }

func (a *gateAsm) emit(w uint32) int {
	a.words = append(a.words, w)
	return len(a.words) - 1
}

func (a *gateAsm) here(name string) { a.labels[name] = len(a.words) }

func itype(op, rs, rt int, imm int) uint32 {
	return uint32(op)<<26 | uint32(rs)<<21 | uint32(rt)<<16 | uint32(uint16(imm))
}

func rtype(rs, rt, rd, sa, fn int) uint32 {
	return uint32(rs)<<21 | uint32(rt)<<16 | uint32(rd)<<11 | uint32(sa)<<6 | uint32(fn)
}

func (a *gateAsm) nop() { a.emit(0) }
func (a *gateAsm) addiu(rt, rs, imm int) {
	a.emit(itype(0x09, rs, rt, imm))
}
func (a *gateAsm) ori(rt, rs, imm int)  { a.emit(itype(0x0D, rs, rt, imm)) }
func (a *gateAsm) andi(rt, rs, imm int) { a.emit(itype(0x0C, rs, rt, imm)) }
func (a *gateAsm) lui(rt, imm int)      { a.emit(itype(0x0F, 0, rt, imm)) }
func (a *gateAsm) lw(rt, off, rs int)   { a.emit(itype(0x23, rs, rt, off)) }
func (a *gateAsm) sw(rt, off, rs int)   { a.emit(itype(0x2B, rs, rt, off)) }
func (a *gateAsm) lb(rt, off, rs int)   { a.emit(itype(0x20, rs, rt, off)) }
func (a *gateAsm) lbu(rt, off, rs int)  { a.emit(itype(0x24, rs, rt, off)) }
func (a *gateAsm) sb(rt, off, rs int)   { a.emit(itype(0x28, rs, rt, off)) }
func (a *gateAsm) addu(rd, rs, rt int)  { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, rd, 0, 0x21)) }
func (a *gateAsm) subu(rd, rs, rt int)  { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, rd, 0, 0x23)) }
func (a *gateAsm) and(rd, rs, rt int)   { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, rd, 0, 0x24)) }
func (a *gateAsm) or(rd, rs, rt int)    { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, rd, 0, 0x25)) }
func (a *gateAsm) slt(rd, rs, rt int)   { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, rd, 0, 0x2A)) }
func (a *gateAsm) sll(rd, rt, sa int)   { a.emit(rtype(0, rt, rd, sa, 0x00)) }
func (a *gateAsm) srl(rd, rt, sa int)   { a.emit(rtype(0, rt, rd, sa, 0x02)) }
func (a *gateAsm) jr(rs int)            { a.emit(rtype(rs, 0, 0, 0, 0x08)) }
func (a *gateAsm) mflo(rd int)          { a.emit(rtype(0, 0, rd, 0, 0x12)) }
func (a *gateAsm) mult(rs, rt int)      { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, 0, 0, 0x18)) }
func (a *gateAsm) divu(rs, rt int)      { a.emit(rtype(rs, rt, 0, 0, 0x1B)) }
func (a *gateAsm) move(rd, rs int)      { a.addu(rd, rs, rZero) }

// li loads a signed 32 bit constant in one or two words.
func (a *gateAsm) li(rd int, v int32) {
	if v >= -32768 && v <= 32767 {
		a.addiu(rd, rZero, int(v))
		return
	}
	a.lui(rd, int(uint32(v)>>16))
	a.ori(rd, rd, int(uint32(v)&0xFFFF))
}

func (a *gateAsm) branch(op, rs, rt int, label string) {
	idx := a.emit(itype(op, rs, rt, 0))
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: idx, kind: fxBranch, base: itype(op, rs, rt, 0), lab: label})
}

func (a *gateAsm) beq(rs, rt int, label string) { a.branch(0x04, rs, rt, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) bne(rs, rt int, label string) { a.branch(0x05, rs, rt, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) blez(rs int, label string)    { a.branch(0x06, rs, 0, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) bgtz(rs int, label string)    { a.branch(0x07, rs, 0, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) bltz(rs int, label string)    { a.branch(0x01, rs, 0, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) bgez(rs int, label string)    { a.branch(0x01, rs, 1, label) }

func (a *gateAsm) jump(op int, label string) {
	idx := a.emit(uint32(op) << 26)
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: idx, kind: fxJump, base: uint32(op) << 26, lab: label})
}

func (a *gateAsm) j(label string)   { a.jump(0x02, label) }
func (a *gateAsm) jal(label string) { a.jump(0x03, label) }

func (a *gateAsm) jalStub(lib, fn int) {
	idx := a.emit(0x03 << 26)
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: idx, kind: fxStub, base: 0x03 << 26, lib: lib, fn: fn})
	a.stubJalIdx = append(a.stubJalIdx, idx)
}

// la loads a rodata item's address (lui + addiu pair).
func (a *gateAsm) la(rd int, roLabel string) {
	hi := a.emit(itype(0x0F, 0, rd, 0))
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: hi, kind: fxLaHi, base: itype(0x0F, 0, rd, 0), lab: roLabel})
	lo := a.emit(itype(0x09, rd, rd, 0))
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: lo, kind: fxLaLo, base: itype(0x09, rd, rd, 0), lab: roLabel})
}

// laCode loads a code label's address (lui + addiu pair).
func (a *gateAsm) laCode(rd int, codeLabel string) {
	hi := a.emit(itype(0x0F, 0, rd, 0))
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: hi, kind: fxLaCodeHi, base: itype(0x0F, 0, rd, 0), lab: codeLabel})
	lo := a.emit(itype(0x09, rd, rd, 0))
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, gateFix{idx: lo, kind: fxLaCodeLo, base: itype(0x09, rd, rd, 0), lab: codeLabel})
}

// laRel is la for a relocatable image: the pair is also recorded
// so the PRX builder can emit its HI16/LO16 relocations.
func (a *gateAsm) laRel(rd int, roLabel string) {
	hi := len(a.words)
	a.la(rd, roLabel)
	a.laPairs = append(a.laPairs, [2]int{hi, hi + 1})
}

// jalRel jumps to a code label and records the word so the PRX
// builder can emit its R_MIPS_26 relocation.
func (a *gateAsm) jalRel(codeLabel string) {
	a.jalRelIdx = append(a.jalRelIdx, len(a.words))
	a.jal(codeLabel)
}

// VFPU encoders for the gate (a) quad ops, from the documented
// field layout: opcode 0x18 for VV arith with G in bits 23..25,
// the size enum split across bits 7 and 15, operands as 7 bit
// fields. A quad register field is (matrix row index << 2) for
// matrix 0 rows.
func lvq(row, rs, off int) uint32 {
	return 0x36<<26 | uint32(rs)<<21 | uint32(row)<<16 | uint32((off>>2)&0x3FFF)<<2
}

func svq(row, rs, off int) uint32 {
	return 0x3E<<26 | uint32(rs)<<21 | uint32(row)<<16 | uint32((off>>2)&0x3FFF)<<2
}

// vaddq encodes vadd.q with raw 7 bit operand fields (the
// corpus layout: field 0 is C000, field 1 is C010, field 4
// is C100). An earlier form scaled the fields by 4, which
// matched the PSP-2 layout the corpus later refuted.
func vaddq(vd, vs, vt int) uint32 {
	return 0x60000000 | uint32(vt)<<16 | 1<<15 | uint32(vs)<<8 | 1<<7 | uint32(vd)
}

// --- ELF / PRX builder -------------------------------------------

type gateLib struct {
	name string
	nids []uint32
}

type gateBuilder struct {
	name     string
	libs     []gateLib
	code     *gateAsm
	roOrder  []string
	roData   map[string][]byte
	entryLab string // code label of the entry point; "" = first word

	extraRelocs [][2]uint32 // extra (segment offset, r_info) pairs for buildPRX
}

func newGateBuilder(name string, libs []gateLib) *gateBuilder {
	return &gateBuilder{name: name, libs: libs, code: newGateAsm(), roData: map[string][]byte{}}
}

func (b *gateBuilder) ro(label string, data []byte) {
	if _, dup := b.roData[label]; dup {
		panic("duplicate rodata label " + label)
	}
	b.roOrder = append(b.roOrder, label)
	b.roData[label] = data
}

func (b *gateBuilder) roStr(label, s string) { b.ro(label, append([]byte(s), 0)) }

func (b *gateBuilder) roWords(label string, words ...uint32) {
	buf := make([]byte, 4*len(words))
	for i, w := range words {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(buf[i*4:], w)
	}
	b.ro(label, buf)
}

const (
	gateSegBase = 0x08804000 // ET_EXEC link base, inside the user partition
	gateTextOff = 0x40       // segment offset of .text
)

// layout computes every address a build needs, given whether the
// image links at gateSegBase (ET_EXEC) or at 0 (PRX).
func (b *gateBuilder) layout(relocatable bool) (link uint32, stubAddr func(lib, fn int) uint32, roAddr map[string]uint32, infoOff, segSize int) {
	var base uint32
	if !relocatable {
		base = gateSegBase
	}
	textWords := len(b.code.words)
	stubsOff := gateTextOff + 4*textWords
	totalFuncs := 0
	for _, l := range b.libs {
		totalFuncs += len(l.nids)
	}
	roSegOff := (stubsOff + 8*totalFuncs + 15) &^ 15

	// Rodata order: user items, then per lib the name and NID
	// table, then the stub tables, then the module info.
	off := roSegOff
	roAddr = map[string]uint32{}
	for _, label := range b.roOrder {
		roAddr[label] = base + uint32(off)
		off += len(b.roData[label])
		off = (off + 3) &^ 3
	}
	libNameOff := make([]int, len(b.libs))
	libNidOff := make([]int, len(b.libs))
	for i, l := range b.libs {
		libNameOff[i] = off
		off += len(l.name) + 1
		off = (off + 3) &^ 3
		libNidOff[i] = off
		off += 4 * len(l.nids)
	}
	stubTablesOff := off
	off += 20 * len(b.libs)
	infoOff = off
	off += 0x40
	segSize = off

	stubAddr = func(lib, fn int) uint32 {
		n := 0
		for i := 0; i < lib; i++ {
			n += len(b.libs[i].nids)
		}
		return base + uint32(stubsOff) + uint32(8*(n+fn))
	}
	// Stash the table offsets in the map under synthetic keys.
	roAddr["\x00stubTables"] = base + uint32(stubTablesOff)
	for i := range b.libs {
		roAddr["\x00name"+string(rune(i))] = base + uint32(libNameOff[i])
		roAddr["\x00nids"+string(rune(i))] = base + uint32(libNidOff[i])
	}
	return base, stubAddr, roAddr, infoOff, segSize
}

// build renders the module given the link base and an optional
// relocation list (segment offsets and r_info words).
func (b *gateBuilder) build(relocatable bool, relocs [][2]uint32) []byte {
	link, stubAddr, roAddr, infoOff, segSize := b.layout(relocatable)
	textAddr := func(idx int) uint32 { return link + gateTextOff + uint32(4*idx) }

	// Patch code fixups.
	words := append([]uint32{}, b.code.words...)
	for _, fx := range b.code.fixups {
		switch fx.kind {
		case fxBranch:
			target, ok := b.code.labels[fx.lab]
			if !ok {
				panic("unknown code label " + fx.lab)
			}
			off := target - (fx.idx + 1)
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | uint32(uint16(off))
		case fxJump:
			target, ok := b.code.labels[fx.lab]
			if !ok {
				panic("unknown code label " + fx.lab)
			}
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | ((textAddr(target) >> 2) & 0x3FFFFFF)
		case fxStub:
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | ((stubAddr(fx.lib, fx.fn) >> 2) & 0x3FFFFFF)
		case fxLaHi:
			addr, ok := roAddr[fx.lab]
			if !ok {
				panic("unknown rodata label " + fx.lab)
			}
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | (((addr + 0x8000) >> 16) & 0xFFFF)
		case fxLaLo:
			addr := roAddr[fx.lab]
			hi := (addr + 0x8000) >> 16
			lo := addr - (hi << 16)
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | uint32(uint16(int32(lo)))
		case fxLaCodeHi:
			target, ok := b.code.labels[fx.lab]
			if !ok {
				panic("unknown code label " + fx.lab)
			}
			addr := textAddr(target)
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | (((addr + 0x8000) >> 16) & 0xFFFF)
		case fxLaCodeLo:
			addr := textAddr(b.code.labels[fx.lab])
			hi := (addr + 0x8000) >> 16
			lo := addr - (hi << 16)
			words[fx.idx] = fx.base | uint32(uint16(int32(lo)))
		}
	}

	content := make([]byte, segSize)
	put32 := func(off int, v uint32) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(content[off:], v) }
	for i, w := range words {
		put32(gateTextOff+4*i, w)
	}
	stubsOff := gateTextOff + 4*len(words)
	n := 0
	for _, l := range b.libs {
		for range l.nids {
			put32(stubsOff+8*n, 0x03E00008) // JR $ra
			put32(stubsOff+8*n+4, 0)        // delay slot: the kernel patches the SYSCALL here
			n++
		}
	}
	// User rodata items.
	for _, label := range b.roOrder {
		copy(content[int(roAddr[label]-link):], b.roData[label])
	}
	// Lib names, NID tables, stub tables.
	stubTablesAddr := roAddr["\x00stubTables"]
	for i, l := range b.libs {
		nameAddr := roAddr["\x00name"+string(rune(i))]
		nidAddr := roAddr["\x00nids"+string(rune(i))]
		copy(content[int(nameAddr-link):], l.name)
		for j, nid := range l.nids {
			put32(int(nidAddr-link)+4*j, nid)
		}
		tbl := int(stubTablesAddr-link) + 20*i
		put32(tbl+0, nameAddr)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(content[tbl+10:], uint16(len(l.nids)))
		content[tbl+8] = 5 // entrySize in words
		put32(tbl+12, nidAddr)
		put32(tbl+16, stubAddr(i, 0))
	}
	// Module info (SceModuleInfo).
	put32(infoOff+0x00, 0) // attribute: user module
	copy(content[infoOff+4:infoOff+31], b.name)
	put32(infoOff+0x20, link+0x900) // gp in module space
	put32(infoOff+0x2C, stubTablesAddr)
	put32(infoOff+0x30, stubTablesAddr+uint32(20*len(b.libs)))

	entry := textAddr(0)
	if b.entryLab != "" {
		entry = textAddr(b.code.labels[b.entryLab])
	}

	// Sections and string table.
	shstr := "\x00.text\x00.sceStub.text\x00.rodata.sceModuleInfo\x00.rel.text\x00.shstrtab\x00"
	nameText := strings.Index(shstr, ".text")
	nameStubT := strings.Index(shstr, ".sceStub.text")
	nameInfo := strings.Index(shstr, ".rodata.sceModuleInfo")
	nameRel := strings.Index(shstr, ".rel.text")
	nameShstr := strings.Index(shstr, ".shstrtab")

	const segFileOff = 0x1000
	shstrOff := segFileOff + segSize
	relOff := (shstrOff + len(shstr) + 3) &^ 3
	shnum := 5
	if len(relocs) > 0 {
		shnum = 6
	}
	shoff := (relOff + 8*len(relocs) + 3) &^ 3
	out := make([]byte, shoff+shnum*40)
	typ := uint16(2) // ET_EXEC
	if relocatable {
		typ = 0xFFA1 // ET_SCE_REL (PRX)
	}
	out[0], out[1], out[2], out[3] = 0x7F, 'E', 'L', 'F'
	out[4], out[5] = 1, 1
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[16:], typ)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[18:], 8) // EM_MIPS
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[20:], 1)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[24:], entry)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[28:], 52)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[32:], uint32(shoff))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[40:], 52)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[42:], 32)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[44:], 1)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[46:], 40)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[48:], uint16(shnum))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(out[50:], uint16(shnum-1))
	ph := out[52:]
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[0:], 1) // PT_LOAD
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[4:], segFileOff)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[8:], link)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[12:], link)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[16:], uint32(segSize))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[20:], uint32(segSize))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[24:], 7)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ph[28:], 0x1000)
	copy(out[segFileOff:], content)
	copy(out[shstrOff:], shstr)
	for i, r := range relocs {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[relOff+i*8:], r[0])
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[relOff+i*8+4:], r[1])
	}
	sh := func(i int, name, typ, addr, off, size, entsize uint32) {
		bb := out[shoff+i*40:]
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[0:], name)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[4:], typ)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[12:], addr)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[16:], off)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[20:], size)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(bb[36:], entsize)
	}
	sh(1, uint32(nameText), 1, link+gateTextOff, segFileOff+gateTextOff, uint32(4*len(words)), 0)
	sh(2, uint32(nameStubT), 1, link+uint32(stubsOff), uint32(segFileOff+stubsOff), uint32(8*n), 0)
	sh(3, uint32(nameInfo), 1, link+uint32(infoOff), uint32(segFileOff+infoOff), 0x40, 0)
	if len(relocs) > 0 {
		sh(4, uint32(nameRel), 0x700000A0, 0, uint32(relOff), uint32(8*len(relocs)), 8)
		sh(5, uint32(nameShstr), 3, 0, uint32(shstrOff), uint32(len(shstr)), 0)
	} else {
		sh(4, uint32(nameShstr), 3, 0, uint32(shstrOff), uint32(len(shstr)), 0)
	}
	return out
}

// buildPRX renders the module as a relocatable PRX (ET_SCE_REL,
// link base 0), emitting the relocations a toolchain would: the
// module info pointer fields, each stub table's pointer fields,
// every recorded la pair (HI16/LO16) and jal (R_MIPS_26), plus the
// builder's extraRelocs.
func (b *gateBuilder) buildPRX() []byte {
	_, _, roAddr, infoOff, _ := b.layout(true)
	const (
		r32   = 2
		r26   = 4
		rHi16 = 5
		rLo16 = 6
	)
	relocs := [][2]uint32{
		{uint32(infoOff) + 0x20, r32}, // gp
		{uint32(infoOff) + 0x2C, r32}, // stubTop
		{uint32(infoOff) + 0x30, r32}, // stubEnd
	}
	stubTablesOff := int(roAddr["\x00stubTables"])
	for i := range b.libs {
		tbl := uint32(stubTablesOff + 20*i)
		relocs = append(relocs,
			[2]uint32{tbl + 0, r32},  // name pointer
			[2]uint32{tbl + 12, r32}, // NID table pointer
			[2]uint32{tbl + 16, r32}) // func table pointer
	}
	for _, pair := range b.code.laPairs {
		relocs = append(relocs,
			[2]uint32{gateTextOff + uint32(4*pair[0]), rHi16},
			[2]uint32{gateTextOff + uint32(4*pair[1]), rLo16})
	}
	for _, idx := range b.code.jalRelIdx {
		relocs = append(relocs, [2]uint32{gateTextOff + uint32(4*idx), r26})
	}
	for _, idx := range b.code.stubJalIdx {
		relocs = append(relocs, [2]uint32{gateTextOff + uint32(4*idx), r26})
	}
	relocs = append(relocs, b.extraRelocs...)
	return b.build(true, relocs)
}

// roSegOff returns the segment offset of a rodata label in a
// relocatable (link base 0) layout.
func (b *gateBuilder) roSegOff(label string) uint32 {
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(true)
	addr, ok := roAddr[label]
	if !ok {
		panic("unknown rodata label " + label)
	}
	return addr
}

// runGate boots a built image on a fresh machine and runs frames
// until the guest exits, returning the machine and frames used.
func runGate(t *testing.T, img []byte, maxFrames int) (*Machine, int) {
	t.Helper()
	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	for f := 1; f <= maxFrames; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		if m.Exited() {
			return m, f
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("guest did not exit within %d frames; console so far: %q", maxFrames, m.ConsoleOutput())
	return m, maxFrames
}

// Library indexes shared by the gate programs.
var (
	libSysMem   = gateLib{"SysMemUserForUser", []uint32{0x13A5ABEF}}                                                // sceKernelPrintf
	libThread   = gateLib{"ThreadManForUser", nil}                                                                  // filled per gate
	libLoadExec = gateLib{"LoadExecForUser", []uint32{0x05572A5F}}                                                  // sceKernelExitGame
	libIO       = gateLib{"IoFileMgrForUser", []uint32{0x109F50BC, 0x6A638D83, 0x42EC03AC, 0x810C4BC3, 0xACE946E8}} // Open Read Write Close Getstat
	libDisplay  = gateLib{"sceDisplay", []uint32{0xEEDA2E54, 0x9C6EAAD7}}                                           // WaitVblankStart, GetVcount
)

// --- gate (a): hello, printf + IoWrite + a VFPU quad add --------

func TestPSP3GateHello(t *testing.T) {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEA", []gateLib{libSysMem, libIO, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("fmtA", "vfpu=%d,%d,%d,%d\n")
	b.roStr("msgA", "hello io\n")
	// Float bit patterns: A = 1.5, 2.25, -3.0, 4.0; B = 0.5, 0.75, 3.0, -4.0.
	b.roWords("vecA", 0x3FC00000, 0x40100000, 0xC0400000, 0x40800000)
	b.roWords("vecB", 0x3F000000, 0x3F400000, 0x40400000, 0xC0800000)
	b.roWords("vecOut", 0, 0, 0, 0)
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	a.la(rT0, "vecA")
	a.emit(lvq(0, rT0, 0))
	a.la(rT0, "vecB")
	a.emit(lvq(1, rT0, 0))
	a.emit(vaddq(0, 0, 1))
	a.la(rT0, "vecOut")
	a.emit(svq(0, rT0, 0))
	a.lw(rA1, 0, rT0)
	a.lw(rA2, 4, rT0)
	a.lw(rA3, 8, rT0)
	a.lw(rT1, 12, rT0)
	a.sw(rT1, 16, rSP) // fourth printf argument rides the stack
	a.la(rA0, "fmtA")
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	// sceIoWrite(1, msgA, len)
	a.li(rA0, 1)
	a.la(rA1, "msgA")
	a.li(rA2, 9)
	a.jalStub(1, 2)
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()

	m, _ := runGate(t, b.build(false, nil), 10)
	// Sums are 2.0, 3.0, +0.0, +0.0 printed as their integer bit patterns.
	want := "vfpu=1073741824,1077936128,0,0\nhello io\n"
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

// --- gate (b): threads + semaphore interleaving ----------------

func buildGateB() []byte {
	tm := gateLib{"ThreadManForUser", []uint32{
		0xD6DA4BA1, // 0 CreateSema
		0x4E3A1105, // 1 WaitSema
		0x3F53E640, // 2 SignalSema
		0x446D8DE6, // 3 CreateThread
		0xF475845D, // 4 StartThread
		0x278C0DF5, // 5 WaitThreadEnd
	}}
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEB", []gateLib{tm, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("fmtStart", "start\n")
	b.roStr("fmtDone", "count=%d sum=%d len=%d\n")
	b.roStr("semName", "s")
	b.roStr("hiName", "whi")
	b.roStr("loName", "wlo")
	b.roWords("counter", 0)
	b.roWords("traceIdx", 0)
	b.roWords("semaSlot", 0)
	b.roWords("markerHi", 1)
	b.roWords("markerLo", 2)
	b.ro("trace", make([]byte, 40))
	a := b.code
	// main
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtStart")
	a.jalStub(1, 0)
	a.nop()
	// CreateSema("s", 0, 1, 1)
	a.la(rA0, "semName")
	a.li(rA1, 0)
	a.li(rA2, 1)
	a.li(rA3, 1)
	a.jalStub(0, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.la(rT0, "semaSlot")
	a.sw(rV0, 0, rT0)
	// CreateThread("whi", worker, 0x18, 0x4000, attr 0, opt 0)
	a.la(rA0, "hiName")
	a.laCode(rA1, "worker")
	a.li(rA2, 0x18)
	a.li(rA3, 0x4000)
	a.sw(rZero, 16, rSP)
	a.sw(rZero, 20, rSP)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS7, rV0)
	// CreateThread("wlo", worker, 0x28, 0x4000, 0, 0)
	a.la(rA0, "loName")
	a.laCode(rA1, "worker")
	a.li(rA2, 0x28)
	a.li(rA3, 0x4000)
	a.sw(rZero, 16, rSP)
	a.sw(rZero, 20, rSP)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	a.sw(rV0, 40, rSP)
	// StartThread(hi, 4, &markerHi); the higher priority worker
	// preempts main here and runs to completion first (see the
	// gate comment in the test).
	a.move(rA0, rS7)
	a.li(rA1, 4)
	a.la(rA2, "markerHi")
	a.jalStub(0, 4)
	a.nop()
	// StartThread(lo, 4, &markerLo)
	a.lw(rA0, 40, rSP)
	a.li(rA1, 4)
	a.la(rA2, "markerLo")
	a.jalStub(0, 4)
	a.nop()
	// WaitThreadEnd(hi), WaitThreadEnd(lo)
	a.move(rA0, rS7)
	a.li(rA1, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 5)
	a.nop()
	a.lw(rA0, 40, rSP)
	a.li(rA1, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 5)
	a.nop()
	// sum = Sigma trace[i] * (i+1); a1 = counter, a2 = sum, a3 = len.
	a.la(rT0, "counter")
	a.lw(rS0, 0, rT0)
	a.la(rT5, "trace")
	a.la(rT0, "traceIdx")
	a.lw(rS3, 0, rT0)
	a.li(rS1, 0) // sum
	a.li(rS2, 0) // i
	a.here("sumLoop")
	a.slt(rT0, rS2, rS3)
	a.beq(rT0, rZero, "sumDone")
	a.nop()
	a.sll(rT0, rS2, 2)
	a.addu(rT0, rT5, rT0)
	a.lw(rT1, 0, rT0)
	a.addiu(rT2, rS2, 1)
	a.mult(rT1, rT2)
	a.mflo(rT3)
	a.addu(rS1, rS1, rT3)
	a.addiu(rS2, rS2, 1)
	a.j("sumLoop")
	a.nop()
	a.here("sumDone")
	a.move(rA1, rS0)
	a.move(rA2, rS1)
	a.move(rA3, rS3)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtDone")
	a.jalStub(1, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0)
	a.nop()
	// worker: a1 points at the marker word delivered by StartThread.
	a.here("worker")
	a.move(rS2, rRA)  // stub calls clobber $ra; keep the exit address
	a.lw(rS0, 0, rA1) // marker (1 for hi, 2 for lo)
	a.li(rS1, 0)      // chunk counter
	a.here("chunk")
	// WaitSema(sema, 1, NULL)
	a.la(rT0, "semaSlot")
	a.lw(rA0, 0, rT0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	// counter += 200
	a.la(rT0, "counter")
	a.lw(rT1, 0, rT0)
	a.addiu(rT1, rT1, 200)
	a.sw(rT1, 0, rT0)
	// trace[traceIdx++] = marker
	a.la(rT0, "traceIdx")
	a.lw(rT1, 0, rT0)
	a.la(rT2, "trace")
	a.sll(rT3, rT1, 2)
	a.addu(rT2, rT2, rT3)
	a.sw(rS0, 0, rT2)
	a.addiu(rT1, rT1, 1)
	a.sw(rT1, 0, rT0)
	// SignalSema(sema, 1)
	a.la(rT0, "semaSlot")
	a.lw(rA0, 0, rT0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.jalStub(0, 2)
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(rS1, rS1, 1)
	a.li(rT0, 5)
	a.bne(rS1, rT0, "chunk")
	a.nop()
	a.li(rV0, 0)
	a.move(rRA, rS2)
	a.jr(rRA) // return through the $ra = 0 trampoline exits the thread
	a.nop()
	return b.build(false, nil)
}

func TestPSP3GateThreads(t *testing.T) {
	// Scheduler model trace: StartThread(hi, priority 0x18)
	// unblocks a thread that outranks main (0x20), so the
	// post-syscall reschedule runs hi first. Hi never blocks (the
	// semaphore is free at each take) and finishes all 5 chunks,
	// appending 1 five times. Main then starts lo (0x28), blocks in
	// WaitThreadEnd(lo), and lo appends 2 five times.
	// count = 10 chunks * 200 = 2000.
	// sum = 1*(1+2+3+4+5) + 2*(6+7+8+9+10) = 15 + 80 = 95.
	m, _ := runGate(t, buildGateB(), 10)
	want := "start\ncount=2000 sum=95 len=10\n"
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

// --- gate (c): delay + vblank wake order -------------------------

func TestPSP3GateDelayVblank(t *testing.T) {
	tm := gateLib{"ThreadManForUser", []uint32{0xCEADEB47}} // DelayThread
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEC", []gateLib{tm, libDisplay, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("fT0", "t0\n")
	b.roStr("fDelayed", "delayed\n")
	b.roStr("fVblank", "vblank %d\n")
	a := b.code
	a.la(rA0, "fT0")
	a.jalStub(2, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 1000) // 1000 microseconds
	a.jalStub(0, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.la(rA0, "fDelayed")
	a.jalStub(2, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // WaitVblankStart
	a.nop()
	a.jalStub(1, 1) // GetVcount
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA1, rV0)
	a.la(rA0, "fVblank")
	a.jalStub(2, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // WaitVblankStart again
	a.nop()
	a.jalStub(1, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA1, rV0)
	a.la(rA0, "fVblank")
	a.jalStub(2, 0)
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(3, 0)
	a.nop()

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(b.build(false, nil)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m.RunFrame()
	if m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("exited during frame 1")
	}
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != "t0\ndelayed\n" {
		t.Fatalf("after frame 1 console = %q", got)
	}
	m.RunFrame()
	if m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("exited during frame 2")
	}
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != "t0\ndelayed\nvblank 1\n" {
		t.Fatalf("after frame 2 console = %q", got)
	}
	m.RunFrame()
	if !m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("not exited after frame 3")
	}
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != "t0\ndelayed\nvblank 1\nvblank 2\n" {
		t.Fatalf("final console = %q", got)
	}
}

// --- gate (d): UMD file IO through the ISO9660 VFS ---------------

// gateDataByte is the DATA.BIN fixture pattern for gate (d).
func gateDataByte(i int) byte { return byte((i*7 + 3) & 0xFF) }

// buildGateISO writes a minimal ISO9660 image holding one root
// file, DATA.BIN (256 pattern bytes), and returns its path.
func buildGateISO(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	const sec = 2048
	data := make([]byte, 256)
	for i := range data {
		data[i] = gateDataByte(i)
	}
	img := make([]byte, 24*sec)
	pvd := img[16*sec:]
	pvd[0] = 1
	copy(pvd[1:], "CD001")
	pvd[6] = 1
	for i := 40; i < 72; i++ {
		pvd[i] = ' '
	}
	copy(pvd[40:], "PSP_GATE_UMD")
	both32(pvd[80:], 24)
	both16(pvd[120:], 1)
	both16(pvd[124:], 1)
	both16(pvd[128:], sec)
	both32(pvd[132:], 10)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(pvd[140:], 19)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(pvd[148:], 19)
	copy(pvd[156:], dirRecord([]byte{0}, 20, sec, true))
	root := img[20*sec:]
	off := 0
	for _, r := range [][]byte{
		dirRecord([]byte{0}, 20, sec, true),
		dirRecord([]byte{1}, 20, sec, true),
		dirRecord([]byte("DATA.BIN;1"), 23, 256, false),
	} {
		copy(root[off:], r)
		off += len(r)
	}
	copy(img[23*sec:], data)
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "gate.iso")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, img, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return path
}

func TestPSP3GateUMD(t *testing.T) {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATED", []gateLib{libIO, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("pathD", "umd0:/DATA.BIN")
	b.roStr("fmtD", "umd size=%d sum=%d\n")
	b.ro("statD", make([]byte, 96))
	b.ro("bufD", make([]byte, 256))
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	a.la(rA0, "pathD")
	a.li(rA1, 1) // PSP_O_RDONLY
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceIoOpen
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0) // fd
	a.la(rA0, "pathD")
	a.la(rA1, "statD")
	a.jalStub(0, 4) // sceIoGetstat
	a.nop()
	a.la(rT0, "statD")
	a.lw(rS1, 8, rT0) // st_size
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.la(rA1, "bufD")
	a.li(rA2, 256)
	a.jalStub(0, 1) // sceIoRead
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 3) // sceIoClose
	a.nop()
	// sum the bytes the guest read back through the ISO.
	a.li(rS2, 0)
	a.li(rS3, 0)
	a.la(rS4, "bufD")
	a.here("sumLoop")
	a.lbu(rT0, 0, rS4)
	a.addu(rS2, rS2, rT0)
	a.addiu(rS4, rS4, 1)
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.li(rT0, 256)
	a.bne(rS3, rT0, "sumLoop")
	a.nop()
	a.la(rA0, "fmtD")
	a.move(rA1, rS1)
	a.move(rA2, rS2)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadISO(buildGateISO(t)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadISO: %v", err)
	}
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(b.build(false, nil)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	for f := 0; f < 10 && !m.Exited(); f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
	}
	if !m.Exited() {
		t.Fatalf("guest did not exit; console %q", m.ConsoleOutput())
	}
	sum := 0
	for i := 0; i < 256; i++ {
		sum += int(gateDataByte(i))
	}
	want := fmt.Sprintf("umd size=256 sum=%d\n", sum)
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

// --- gate (e): relocatable PRX -----------------------------------

func TestPSP3GatePRX(t *testing.T) {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEE", []gateLib{libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("msgE", "relocated hello")
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	a.jalRel("helper") // v0 = 77, through an R_MIPS_26 relocation
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	a.laRel(rA0, "fmtE")
	a.laRel(rA1, "ptrE")
	a.lw(rA1, 0, rA1) // the message address, via an R_MIPS_32 word
	a.move(rA2, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()
	a.here("helper")
	a.li(rV0, 77)
	a.jr(rRA)
	a.nop()
	// The message offset is fixed once the code above is emitted
	// and msgE is the first rodata item; later items cannot move
	// it. ptrE starts as that link offset and is relocated by an
	// R_MIPS_32 entry the builder adds here.
	msgOff := b.roSegOff("msgE")
	b.roStr("fmtE", "prx says %s and %d\n")
	b.roWords("ptrE", msgOff)
	b.extraRelocs = append(b.extraRelocs, [2]uint32{b.roSegOff("ptrE"), 2})

	m, _ := runGate(t, b.buildPRX(), 10)
	if got, want := m.ConsoleOutput(), "prx says relocated hello and 77\n"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if base := m.Kernel().ModuleBase(); base != 0x08804000 {
		t.Fatalf("ModuleBase = %#x, want 0x08804000 (partition base plus the 16 KB reserve)", base)
	}
	if ptr := m.Bus.Read32(0x08804000 + b.roSegOff("ptrE")); ptr != 0x08804000+msgOff {
		t.Fatalf("relocated pointer = %#x, want %#x", ptr, 0x08804000+msgOff)
	}
}

// --- gate (f): determinism across a mid-run save -----------------

func TestPSP3GateDeterminism(t *testing.T) {
	img := buildGateB()

	mA := New()
	if err := mA.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mA.RunCycles(120)
	if mA.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("gate B finished before the save point; pick a smaller budget")
	}
	saved := mA.Serialize()

	// A second fresh machine at the same cycle count must produce
	// byte-identical state.
	mB := New()
	if err := mB.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mB.RunCycles(120)
	if !bytes.Equal(saved, mB.Serialize()) {
		t.Fatal("two fresh machines disagree on state at cycle 120")
	}

	finish := func(m *Machine) {
		for f := 0; f < 10 && !m.Exited(); f++ {
			m.RunFrame()
		}
		if !m.Exited() {
			t.Fatal("machine did not exit")
		}
	}
	finish(mA)

	mC := New()
	if err := mC.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := mC.Deserialize(saved); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	finish(mC)

	if mC.ConsoleOutput() != mA.ConsoleOutput() {
		t.Fatalf("console after restore = %q, want %q", mC.ConsoleOutput(), mA.ConsoleOutput())
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(mC.Serialize(), mA.Serialize()) {
		t.Fatal("final state after restore differs from the straight run")
	}
}

// --- gate (g): unknown NID ----------------------------------------

func TestPSP3GateUnknownNID(t *testing.T) {
	fake := gateLib{"FakeLib", []uint32{0xDEADBEEF}}
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEG", []gateLib{fake, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("fmtG", "err=%x end\n")
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // the nonsense import
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtG")
	a.move(rA1, rS0)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()

	m, _ := runGate(t, b.build(false, nil), 10)
	if got, want := m.ConsoleOutput(), "err=80020001 end\n"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	uc := m.Kernel().UnknownCalls()
	if len(uc) != 1 || uc[0].Module != "FakeLib" || uc[0].NID != 0xDEADBEEF || uc[0].Count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("UnknownCalls = %+v, want one {FakeLib 0xDEADBEEF 1}", uc)
	}
}

// --- gate (h): mutex + event flag semantics ------------------------

func TestPSP3GateSyncObjects(t *testing.T) {
	tm := gateLib{"ThreadManForUser", []uint32{
		0xB7D098C6, // 0 CreateMutex
		0xB011B11F, // 1 LockMutex
		0x6B30100F, // 2 UnlockMutex
		0x55C20A00, // 3 CreateEventFlag
		0x402FCF22, // 4 WaitEventFlag
		0x1FB15A32, // 5 SetEventFlag
		0x30FD48F0, // 6 PollEventFlag
		0xA66B0120, // 7 ReferEventFlagStatus
	}}
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEH", []gateLib{tm, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.roStr("mxName", "mx")
	b.roStr("evName", "ev")
	b.roStr("fmtMx", "mx %x %x %x\n")
	b.roStr("fmtEv", "ev %x %x %x\n")
	b.roStr("fmtPat", "pat %x res %d\n")
	b.roWords("zeroWord", 0)
	b.roWords("resWord", 0)
	b.ro("evfStat", make([]byte, 52))
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -80)
	// Recursive mutex: lock twice, unlock twice, third unlock errors.
	a.la(rA0, "mxName")
	a.li(rA1, 0x400) // recursive attribute
	a.li(rA2, 0)     // starts unlocked
	a.jalStub(0, 0)  // CreateMutex
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 1) // LockMutex
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS1, rV0)
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 1) // LockMutex again (recursive)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 2) // UnlockMutex
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 2) // UnlockMutex
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS2, rV0)
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 2) // UnlockMutex a third time: not locked
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS3, rV0)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtMx")
	a.move(rA1, rS1)
	a.move(rA2, rS2)
	a.move(rA3, rS3)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // printf
	a.nop()
	// Event flag.
	a.la(rA0, "evName")
	a.li(rA1, 0)
	a.li(rA2, 0)    // initial pattern 0
	a.jalStub(0, 3) // CreateEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	// Wait for bit 0 (AND) with a zero timeout word: polls, times out.
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.li(rA2, 0) // AND, no clear
	a.la(rA3, "resWord")
	a.la(rT0, "zeroWord")
	a.sw(rT0, 16, rSP) // fifth argument: timeout pointer
	a.jalStub(0, 4)    // WaitEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS1, rV0)
	// Set bit 1 only, then poll for bits 0+1 (AND): not satisfied.
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 2)
	a.jalStub(0, 5) // SetEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 3)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.la(rA3, "resWord")
	a.jalStub(0, 6) // PollEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS2, rV0)
	// Set bit 0 too; the AND wait with CLEAR_PAT succeeds.
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 1)
	a.jalStub(0, 5) // SetEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 3)
	a.li(rA2, 0x20) // AND | WAIT_CLEAR_PAT
	a.la(rA3, "resWord")
	a.sw(rZero, 16, rSP) // no timeout
	a.jalStub(0, 4)      // WaitEventFlag
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS3, rV0)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtEv")
	a.move(rA1, rS1)
	a.move(rA2, rS2)
	a.move(rA3, rS3)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // printf
	a.nop()
	// Refer: the pattern field (+44) must read 0 after the clear.
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.la(rA1, "evfStat")
	a.jalStub(0, 7) // ReferEventFlagStatus
	a.nop()
	a.la(rT0, "evfStat")
	a.lw(rA1, 44, rT0)
	a.la(rT0, "resWord")
	a.lw(rA2, 0, rT0)
	a.la(rA0, "fmtPat")
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // printf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()

	m, _ := runGate(t, b.build(false, nil), 10)
	want := "mx 0 0 800201c5\nev 800201a8 800201af 0\npat 0 res 3\n"
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-psp/system/psp4_enginetest_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/davidpatton/itak-gaming/cores/go-psp/enginetest"
)

// PSP-4 enginetest gate: the synthetic UMD image from the
// enginetest fixture package, booted through the same path the
// libretro shell uses (BootUMD: ISO, PSP_GAME/SYSDR/BOOT.BIN,
// kernel). The guest prints, draws, plays a continuous tone,
// polls the pad, and idles on vblank waits; the host asserts
// milestones in order, exact pixels, the tone, the recorded
// buttons, and a byte-identical continuation across a mid-run
// save.

func writeEngineISO(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "psp4_engine.iso")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, enginetest.ISOImage(), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return path
}

func milestoneProgress(m *Machine) uint32 {
	return m.Bus.Read32(enginetest.MilestoneAddr + enginetest.OffProgress)
}

func TestPSP4EngineTestISO(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeEngineISO(t)

	m := New()
	if err := m.BootUMD(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("BootUMD: %v", err)
	}
	if got := m.GameTitle(); got != enginetest.GameTitle {
		t.Fatalf("GameTitle = %q, want %q (PARAM.SFO through the ISO)", got, enginetest.GameTitle)
	}

	// Host input arrives after boot, like the harness's
	// schedule: Start and Down.
	const buttons = uint32(0x0008 | 0x0040) // Start | Down
	var stream []int16
	frames := 0
	run := func(n int) {
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			m.RunFrame()
			frames++
			stream = append(stream, m.AudioBuffer()...)
		}
	}
	run(10)
	if got := milestoneProgress(m); got < enginetest.MilestoneAudio {
		t.Fatalf("after 10 frames progress = %d, want at least %d (console, GE, audio all started)", got, enginetest.MilestoneAudio)
	}
	m.SetButtons(buttons)
	run(90)

	if m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("enginetest guest exited; it must idle forever")
	}
	// Milestones complete, in order: the progress cell only
	// ever holds the count of finished stages.
	if got := milestoneProgress(m); got != enginetest.MilestoneFinal {
		t.Fatalf("progress = %d, want %d (all milestones)", got, enginetest.MilestoneFinal)
	}
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != enginetest.ConsoleText {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, enginetest.ConsoleText)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(enginetest.MilestoneAddr + enginetest.OffButtons); got != buttons {
		t.Fatalf("guest recorded buttons = %#x, want %#x (Start|Down as set by the host)", got, buttons)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(enginetest.MilestoneAddr + enginetest.OffAudioCalls); got < 8 {
		t.Fatalf("guest audio calls = %d, want at least 8", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(enginetest.MilestoneAddr + enginetest.OffVblanks); got < 30 {
		t.Fatalf("guest vblank waits = %d, want at least 30 in 100 frames", got)
	}
	if got := m.Kernel().Vcount(); got != uint32(frames) {
		t.Fatalf("kernel vcount = %d, want %d", got, frames)
	}

	// Exact pixels: clear color everywhere, the sprite green
	// inside its rect.
	fb := m.Framebuffer()
	probe := func(x, y int, want uint32, what string) {
		if got := fb[y*Width+x]; got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s pixel (%d,%d) = %#08x, want %#08x", what, x, y, got, want)
		}
	}
	probe(0, 0, enginetest.ClearPixel, "clear")
	probe(479, 271, enginetest.ClearPixel, "clear")
	probe(100, 100, enginetest.ClearPixel, "clear")
	probe(10, 10, enginetest.SpritePixel, "sprite")
	probe(15, 11, enginetest.SpritePixel, "sprite")
	probe(16, 12, enginetest.ClearPixel, "clear just past the sprite")

	// The tone: continuous from an early start, table exact.
	tab := enginetest.ToneTable()
	start := -1
	for i := 0; i < len(stream)/2; i++ {
		if stream[2*i] != 0 {
			start = i
			break
		}
	}
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("audio stream is entirely silent")
	}
	if start > 735*5 {
		t.Fatalf("tone starts at stream frame %d, want within the first 5 frames of runtime", start)
	}
	// After the start the guest's phase runs continuously
	// (double buffered fills), so every frame is the table.
	for i := start; i < len(stream)/2; i++ {
		want := tab[(i-start)%enginetest.TonePeriod]
		if stream[2*i] != want || stream[2*i+1] != want {
			t.Fatalf("stream frame %d: got (%d, %d), want tone value %d", i, stream[2*i], stream[2*i+1], want)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("enginetest: %d frames run, tone from stream frame %d, %d samples exact", frames, start, len(stream))
}

// TestPSP4EngineTestSaveRestore: a save taken mid-run restores
// a byte-identical continuation: machine state, framebuffer,
// and the audio block produced after the save point.
func TestPSP4EngineTestSaveRestore(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeEngineISO(t)
	const buttons = uint32(0x0008 | 0x0040)

	boot := func() *Machine {
		m := New()
		if err := m.BootUMD(path); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("BootUMD: %v", err)
		}
		return m
	}

	// Reference run: 40 warm-up frames, then 30 more.
	ref := boot()
	ref.SetButtons(buttons)
	for f := 0; f < 40; f++ {
		ref.RunFrame()
		ref.AudioBuffer()
	}
	var refAudio []int16
	for f := 0; f < 30; f++ {
		ref.RunFrame()
		refAudio = append(refAudio, ref.AudioBuffer()...)
	}
	refState := ref.Serialize()
	refFB := append([]uint32{}, ref.Framebuffer()...)

	// Restored run: same 40 frames, save, continue 30, then
	// restore and continue the same 30 again.
	m := boot()
	m.SetButtons(buttons)
	for f := 0; f < 40; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		m.AudioBuffer()
	}
	saved := m.Serialize()
	for f := 0; f < 30; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		m.AudioBuffer()
	}
	if err := m.Deserialize(saved); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	var gotAudio []int16
	for f := 0; f < 30; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		gotAudio = append(gotAudio, m.AudioBuffer()...)
	}
	if got := m.Serialize(); !equalBytes(got, refState) {
		t.Fatal("state after restore + 30 frames differs from the reference run")
	}
	fb := m.Framebuffer()
	for i := range fb {
		if fb[i] != refFB[i] {
			t.Fatalf("framebuffer pixel %d = %#08x, want %#08x", i, fb[i], refFB[i])
		}
	}
	if len(gotAudio) != len(refAudio) {
		t.Fatalf("audio block %d samples, want %d", len(gotAudio), len(refAudio))
	}
	for i := range gotAudio {
		if gotAudio[i] != refAudio[i] {
			t.Fatalf("audio sample %d = %d, want %d", i, gotAudio[i], refAudio[i])
		}
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-psp/system/psp4_gate_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"math"
	"testing"
)

// PSP-4 synthetic gates for sceAudio: hand assembled guests in
// the PSP-3 gate builder style, booted through LoadExecutable,
// with the host measuring the drained 44,100 Hz stereo stream
// sample by sample.
//
// The tone fixture is a 100 frame cosine table (441 Hz at the
// output rate), amplitude 12000, generated here in the test;
// the guests copy it into their play buffers with a running
// phase so the waveform is continuous across buffer joins.

const (
	audioGateBufFrames = 1024
	audioGateTableLen  = 100
	audioGateAmp       = 12000
)

func audioGateTable() []int16 {
	tab := make([]int16, audioGateTableLen)
	for i := range tab {
		tab[i] = int16(math.Round(audioGateAmp * math.Cos(2*math.Pi*float64(i)/audioGateTableLen)))
	}
	return tab
}

func audioGateTableBytes() []byte {
	tab := audioGateTable()
	out := make([]byte, 2*len(tab))
	for i, v := range tab {
		out[2*i] = byte(v)
		out[2*i+1] = byte(v >> 8)
	}
	return out
}

// Extra register numbers the gate assembler leaves out.
const (
	rT6 = 14
	rT7 = 15
)

// Extra assembler forms the audio gates need (the PSP-3
// assembler lives in psp3_gate_test.go, same package).
func (a *gateAsm) mfhi(rd int) { a.emit(rtype(0, 0, rd, 0, 0x10)) }
func (a *gateAsm) xori(rt, rs, imm int) {
	a.emit(itype(0x0E, rs, rt, imm))
}
func (a *gateAsm) lh(rt, off, rs int) {
	a.emit(itype(0x21, rs, rt, off))
}
func (a *gateAsm) sh(rt, off, rs int) {
	a.emit(itype(0x29, rs, rt, off))
}

// sceAudio stubs for the gates, in call order.
var libAudio4 = gateLib{"sceAudio", []uint32{
	0x5EC81C55, // 0 sceAudioChReserve
	0x136CAF51, // 1 sceAudioOutputBlocking
	0xE9D97901, // 2 sceAudioGetChannelRestLen
	0x6FC46853, // 3 sceAudioChRelease
}}

// audioFillAsm emits the loop that fills the stereo play buffer
// at bufLab from the cosine table at tabLab, continuing the
// phase counter in register phaseReg (kept across calls by the
// caller). Clobbers t0..t7 and the phase register advances by
// one buffer.
func audioFillAsm(a *gateAsm, tabLab, bufLab string, phaseReg int, tag string) {
	a.la(rS7, bufLab)
	audioFillRegAsm(a, tabLab, rS7, phaseReg, tag)
}

// audioFillRegAsm is audioFillAsm with the buffer address in a
// register (double buffering guests select the target first).
func audioFillRegAsm(a *gateAsm, tabLab string, bufReg, phaseReg int, tag string) {
	a.la(rS6, tabLab)
	a.li(rT0, 0)
	a.here("fill" + tag)
	a.addu(rT2, phaseReg, rT0)
	a.li(rT3, audioGateTableLen)
	a.divu(rT2, rT3)
	a.mfhi(rT4) // table index
	a.sll(rT5, rT4, 1)
	a.addu(rT5, rS6, rT5)
	a.lh(rT6, 0, rT5)
	a.sll(rT7, rT0, 2)
	a.addu(rT7, bufReg, rT7)
	a.sh(rT6, 0, rT7)
	a.sh(rT6, 2, rT7)
	a.addiu(rT0, rT0, 1)
	a.li(rT1, audioGateBufFrames)
	a.bne(rT0, rT1, "fill"+tag)
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(phaseReg, phaseReg, audioGateBufFrames)
}

// audioWaitDrainAsm emits a poll loop: sceAudioGetChannelRestLen
// on the channel in chReg until it reads 0.
func audioWaitDrainAsm(a *gateAsm, chReg int, tag string) {
	a.here("wait" + tag)
	a.move(rA0, chReg)
	a.jalStub(0, 2) // sceAudioGetChannelRestLen
	a.nop()
	a.bne(rV0, rZero, "wait"+tag)
	a.nop()
}

// runAudioGate boots img and runs until the guest exits,
// draining the audio stream after every frame. It returns the
// machine and the full drained stream.
func runAudioGate(t *testing.T, m *Machine, maxFrames int) []int16 {
	t.Helper()
	var stream []int16
	for f := 0; f < maxFrames; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		stream = append(stream, m.AudioBuffer()...)
		if m.Exited() {
			return stream
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("guest did not exit within %d frames; console %q", maxFrames, m.ConsoleOutput())
	return stream
}

// --- gate (a): one channel, blocking sine, exact stream --------

func buildGateA() *gateBuilder {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEA", []gateLib{libAudio4, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.ro("tabA", audioGateTableBytes())
	// Two play buffers, alternated: the mixer reads samples
	// live from guest memory (the documented model), so the
	// buffer being filled must never be the one playing.
	b.ro("pbufA0", make([]byte, audioGateBufFrames*4))
	b.ro("pbufA1", make([]byte, audioGateBufFrames*4))
	b.roWords("cellChA", 0)
	b.roWords("cellCallsA", 0)
	b.roStr("fmtA", "ch=%d calls=%d\n")
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -32)
	a.addiu(rA0, rZero, -1) // first free channel
	a.li(rA1, audioGateBufFrames)
	a.li(rA2, 0)    // stereo
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceAudioChReserve
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	a.la(rT0, "cellChA")
	a.sw(rS0, 0, rT0)
	a.li(rS3, 0) // calls done
	a.li(rS4, 0) // phase
	a.li(rS5, 0) // buffer parity
	a.here("playA")
	a.la(rS2, "pbufA0")
	a.beq(rS5, rZero, "bufAReady")
	a.nop()
	a.la(rS2, "pbufA1")
	a.here("bufAReady")
	audioFillRegAsm(a, "tabA", rS2, rS4, "A")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000) // unity volume
	a.move(rA2, rS2)
	a.jalStub(0, 1) // sceAudioOutputBlocking
	a.nop()
	a.xori(rS5, rS5, 1)
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.la(rT0, "cellCallsA")
	a.sw(rS3, 0, rT0)
	a.li(rT1, 40)
	a.bne(rS3, rT1, "playA")
	a.nop()
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS0, "A")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.jalStub(0, 3) // sceAudioChRelease
	a.nop()
	a.la(rA0, "fmtA")
	a.move(rA1, rS0)
	a.move(rA2, rS3)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()
	return b
}

// checkToneSpan asserts the stream is silent everywhere except
// a contiguous span of wantFrames frames starting at the first
// nonzero frame, whose samples reproduce the cosine table
// exactly (unity volume), and returns the measured frequency
// from rising zero crossings inside the span.
func checkToneSpan(t *testing.T, stream []int16, wantFrames int) float64 {
	t.Helper()
	tab := audioGateTable()
	frames := len(stream) / 2
	start := -1
	for i := 0; i < frames; i++ {
		if stream[2*i] != 0 || stream[2*i+1] != 0 {
			start = i
			break
		}
	}
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("stream is entirely silent")
	}
	for i := 0; i < frames; i++ {
		l, r := stream[2*i], stream[2*i+1]
		if i >= start && i < start+wantFrames {
			want := tab[(i-start)%audioGateTableLen]
			if l != want || r != want {
				t.Fatalf("frame %d: got (%d, %d), want table value %d", i, l, r, want)
			}
		} else if l != 0 || r != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("frame %d outside the tone span is (%d, %d), want silence", i, l, r)
		}
	}
	crossings := 0
	prev := int16(0)
	for j := 0; j < wantFrames; j++ {
		v := stream[2*(start+j)]
		if prev < 0 && v >= 0 {
			crossings++
		}
		prev = v
	}
	return float64(crossings) * audioGateSampleRate / float64(wantFrames)
}

const audioGateSampleRate = 44100.0

func TestPSP4GateAudioSine(t *testing.T) {
	b := buildGateA()
	img := b.build(false, nil)
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(false)

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	stream := runAudioGate(t, m, 400)

	if got := m.Bus.Read32(roAddr["cellChA"]); got != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("reserved channel = %d, want 7 (free search runs downward)", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(roAddr["cellCallsA"]); got != 40 {
		t.Fatalf("completed output calls = %d, want 40", got)
	}
	if want := "ch=7 calls=40\n"; m.ConsoleOutput() != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", m.ConsoleOutput(), want)
	}
	freq := checkToneSpan(t, stream, 40*audioGateBufFrames)
	if freq < 441*0.98 || freq > 441*1.02 {
		t.Fatalf("measured tone frequency %.2f Hz, want 441 within 2 percent", freq)
	}
	t.Logf("tone: %d frames exact, measured %.2f Hz", 40*audioGateBufFrames, freq)
}

// TestPSP4GateAudioSaveRestore reruns gate (a) with a save
// taken mid-playback (a buffer in flight, the guest parked or
// filling): the continuation must be byte identical to the
// uninterrupted run, stream included.
func TestPSP4GateAudioSaveRestore(t *testing.T) {
	b := buildGateA()
	img := b.build(false, nil)
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(false)
	callsAddr := roAddr["cellCallsA"]

	ref := New()
	if err := ref.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	refStream := runAudioGate(t, ref, 400)
	refState := ref.Serialize()

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	var stream []int16
	var saved []byte
	savedAt := -1
	for f := 0; f < 400 && !m.Exited(); f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		stream = append(stream, m.AudioBuffer()...)
		if saved == nil && m.Bus.Read32(callsAddr) >= 20 {
			saved = m.Serialize()
			savedAt = len(stream)
		}
	}
	if saved == nil {
		t.Fatal("guest never reached 20 calls; no mid-playback save taken")
	}
	if err := m.Deserialize(saved); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Deserialize: %v", err)
	}
	stream = stream[:savedAt]
	for f := 0; f < 400 && !m.Exited(); f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		stream = append(stream, m.AudioBuffer()...)
	}
	if !m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("restored guest did not exit")
	}
	if len(stream) != len(refStream) {
		t.Fatalf("stream length %d, want %d", len(stream), len(refStream))
	}
	for i := range stream {
		if stream[i] != refStream[i] {
			t.Fatalf("stream sample %d = %d, want %d (reference run)", i, stream[i], refStream[i])
		}
	}
	if got := m.Serialize(); !equalBytes(got, refState) {
		t.Fatal("final state differs from the uninterrupted run")
	}
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != ref.ConsoleOutput() {
		t.Fatalf("console %q, want %q", got, ref.ConsoleOutput())
	}
}

func equalBytes(a, b []byte) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range a {
		if a[i] != b[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// --- gate (b): two channels mixed, exact sums and clamping -----

func buildMixGate() *gateBuilder {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEB", []gateLib{libAudio4, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	b.ro("tabB", audioGateTableBytes())
	b.ro("bufBA", make([]byte, audioGateBufFrames*4))
	b.ro("bufBB", make([]byte, audioGateBufFrames*4))
	b.roWords("cellChBA", 0)
	b.roWords("cellChBB", 0)
	b.roStr("fmtB", "mix a=%d b=%d\n")
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -32)
	// Reserve two channels.
	for _, cell := range []string{"cellChBA", "cellChBB"} {
		a.addiu(rA0, rZero, -1)
		a.li(rA1, audioGateBufFrames)
		a.li(rA2, 0)
		a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceAudioChReserve
		a.nop()
		a.la(rT0, cell)
		a.sw(rV0, 0, rT0)
	}
	a.la(rT0, "cellChBA")
	a.lw(rS0, 0, rT0)
	a.la(rT0, "cellChBB")
	a.lw(rS1, 0, rT0)
	// Fill both buffers with the same sine phase.
	a.li(rS4, 0)
	audioFillAsm(a, "tabB", "bufBA", rS4, "BA")
	a.li(rS4, 0)
	audioFillAsm(a, "tabB", "bufBB", rS4, "BB")
	// 10 buffer pairs at unity volume.
	a.li(rS3, 0)
	a.here("pairB")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBA")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS1)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBB")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.li(rT1, 10)
	a.bne(rS3, rT1, "pairB")
	a.nop()
	// The mixer reads the buffers live, so a phase change must
	// wait for the drain before refilling them.
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS0, "BX")
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS1, "BY")
	// Fill both buffers with a +30000 constant, 2 pairs (the
	// sum 60000 clamps to 32767).
	audioFillConstAsm(a, "bufBA", 30000, "P")
	audioFillConstAsm(a, "bufBB", 30000, "Q")
	a.li(rS3, 0)
	a.here("pairBP")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBA")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS1)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBB")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.li(rT1, 2)
	a.bne(rS3, rT1, "pairBP")
	a.nop()
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS0, "BZ")
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS1, "BW")
	// Fill both with -30000, 2 pairs (the sum clamps to -32768).
	audioFillConstAsm(a, "bufBA", -30000, "R")
	audioFillConstAsm(a, "bufBB", -30000, "S")
	a.li(rS3, 0)
	a.here("pairBN")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBA")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.move(rA0, rS1)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "bufBB")
	a.jalStub(0, 1)
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.li(rT1, 2)
	a.bne(rS3, rT1, "pairBN")
	a.nop()
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS0, "BA")
	audioWaitDrainAsm(a, rS1, "BB")
	a.la(rA0, "fmtB")
	a.move(rA1, rS0)
	a.move(rA2, rS1)
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()
	return b
}

// audioFillConstAsm fills a stereo buffer with a constant
// halfword value.
func audioFillConstAsm(a *gateAsm, bufLab string, val int32, tag string) {
	a.la(rS7, bufLab)
	a.li(rT6, val)
	a.li(rT0, 0)
	a.here("const" + tag)
	a.sll(rT7, rT0, 2)
	a.addu(rT7, rS7, rT7)
	a.sh(rT6, 0, rT7)
	a.sh(rT6, 2, rT7)
	a.addiu(rT0, rT0, 1)
	a.li(rT1, audioGateBufFrames)
	a.bne(rT0, rT1, "const"+tag)
	a.nop()
}

func TestPSP4GateAudioMix(t *testing.T) {
	b := buildMixGate()
	img := b.build(false, nil)
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(false)

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	stream := runAudioGate(t, m, 400)

	if got := m.Bus.Read32(roAddr["cellChBA"]); got != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("first reserved channel = %d, want 7", got)
	}
	if got := m.Bus.Read32(roAddr["cellChBB"]); got != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("second reserved channel = %d, want 6", got)
	}
	if want := "mix a=7 b=6\n"; m.ConsoleOutput() != want {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", m.ConsoleOutput(), want)
	}

	tab := audioGateTable()
	frames := len(stream) / 2
	start := -1
	for i := 0; i < frames; i++ {
		if stream[2*i] != 0 {
			start = i
			break
		}
	}
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("stream is entirely silent")
	}
	// Both channels must start on the same output frame: the
	// first span frame is the sum at table index 0 on both.
	if got := stream[2*start]; got != 2*tab[0] {
		t.Fatalf("first mixed frame = %d, want %d (channels did not start in lockstep)", got, 2*tab[0])
	}
	// The three phases are separated by silence while the
	// guest waits for the drain and refills (its fill time is
	// guest behavior, not core behavior), so each segment is
	// located by scanning and checked exactly.
	const (
		sineFrames = 10 * audioGateBufFrames
		posFrames  = 2 * audioGateBufFrames
		negFrames  = 2 * audioGateBufFrames
	)
	nextNonzero := func(from int) int {
		for i := from; i < frames; i++ {
			if stream[2*i] != 0 || stream[2*i+1] != 0 {
				return i
			}
		}
		return -1
	}
	seg := start
	for j := 0; j < sineFrames; j++ {
		// The guest replays one static buffer per channel, so
		// the stream phase restarts every buffer.
		want := 2 * tab[(j%audioGateBufFrames)%audioGateTableLen]
		if stream[2*(seg+j)] != want || stream[2*(seg+j)+1] != want {
			t.Fatalf("sine segment frame %d: got (%d, %d), want %d", j, stream[2*(seg+j)], stream[2*(seg+j)+1], want)
		}
	}
	seg = nextNonzero(seg + sineFrames)
	if seg < 0 {
		t.Fatal("no positive clamp segment after the sine segment")
	}
	for j := 0; j < posFrames; j++ {
		if stream[2*(seg+j)] != 32767 || stream[2*(seg+j)+1] != 32767 {
			t.Fatalf("positive clamp frame %d: got (%d, %d), want 32767", j, stream[2*(seg+j)], stream[2*(seg+j)+1])
		}
	}
	seg = nextNonzero(seg + posFrames)
	if seg < 0 {
		t.Fatal("no negative clamp segment after the positive segment")
	}
	for j := 0; j < negFrames; j++ {
		if stream[2*(seg+j)] != -32768 || stream[2*(seg+j)+1] != -32768 {
			t.Fatalf("negative clamp frame %d: got (%d, %d), want -32768", j, stream[2*(seg+j)], stream[2*(seg+j)+1])
		}
	}
	if tail := nextNonzero(seg + negFrames); tail >= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("frame %d after the last segment is (%d, %d), want silence to the end", tail, stream[2*tail], stream[2*tail+1])
	}
	t.Logf("mix: %d frames exact (sine sums, +clamp, -clamp)", sineFrames+posFrames+negFrames)
}

// --- gate (d): documented edge semantics -----------------------
//
// One straight-line guest walks the documented validation
// orders and error codes and stores every return value into a
// results vector the host compares exactly, including the
// RestLen/RestLength disagreement after a null-pointer output
// and the Output2/SRC families staying on the unknown path.

var libAudioSem = gateLib{"sceAudio", []uint32{
	0x80F1F7E0, // 0 sceAudioInit
	0x5EC81C55, // 1 sceAudioChReserve
	0x6FC46853, // 2 sceAudioChRelease
	0x8C1009B2, // 3 sceAudioOutput
	0x136CAF51, // 4 sceAudioOutputBlocking
	0xE9D97901, // 5 sceAudioGetChannelRestLen
	0xB011922F, // 6 sceAudioGetChannelRestLength
	0xCB2E439E, // 7 sceAudioSetChannelDataLen
	0xB7E1D8E7, // 8 sceAudioChangeChannelVolume
	0xA2BEAA6C, // 9 sceAudioSetFrequency
	0x6D4BEC68, // 10 sceAudioInput
	0x7DE61688, // 11 sceAudioInputInit
	0xA708C6A6, // 12 sceAudioGetInputLength
	0x01562BA3, // 13 sceAudioOutput2Reserve (not implemented)
	0x38553111, // 14 sceAudioSRCChReserve (not implemented)
	0x39240E7D, // 15 sceAudioRoutingGetMode
	0x36FD8AA9, // 16 sceAudioRoutingSetMode
	0x41EFADE7, // 17 sceAudioOneshotOutput
}}

func TestPSP4GateAudioSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATESEM", []gateLib{libAudioSem, libSysMem, libLoadExec})
	bufPat := make([]byte, 4096)
	for i := range bufPat {
		bufPat[i] = 0xAA
	}
	b.ro("bufS", bufPat)
	b.ro("resS", make([]byte, 34*4))
	b.roStr("fmtS", "sem done\n")
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -64)
	rec := func(idx int) { // store v0 into resS[idx]
		a.la(rT9(), "resS")
		a.sw(rV0, 4*idx, rT9())
	}
	call := func(fn int, args ...int32) {
		regs := []int{rA0, rA1, rA2, rA3}
		for i, v := range args {
			a.li(regs[i], v)
		}
		a.jalStub(0, fn)
		a.nop()
	}
	bufAddr := func(reg int) { a.la(reg, "bufS") }

	a.jalStub(0, 0) // Init
	a.nop()
	rec(0)
	call(1, 8, 1024, 0) // ChReserve chan 8
	rec(1)
	call(1, -1, 100, 0) // ChReserve bad count
	rec(2)
	call(1, -1, 1024, 7) // ChReserve bad format
	rec(3)
	call(1, -1, 1024, 0) // ChReserve -> 7
	rec(4)
	call(1, 7, 1024, 0) // ChReserve again
	rec(5)
	// Output on channel 9: invalid channel.
	a.li(rA0, 9)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(6)
	// Output with an oversize volume on a good channel.
	a.li(rA0, 7)
	a.li(rA1, 0x10000)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(7)
	// Output on unreserved channel 5.
	a.li(rA0, 5)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(8)
	// Null pointer output on channel 7.
	a.li(rA0, 7)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(9)
	call(5, 7) // GetChannelRestLen
	rec(10)
	call(6, 7) // GetChannelRestLength
	rec(11)
	// Real output right after the null one: not busy.
	a.li(rA0, 7)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(12)
	// And again while it plays: busy.
	a.li(rA0, 7)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 3)
	a.nop()
	rec(13)
	call(7, 7, 100) // SetChannelDataLen bad length
	rec(14)
	call(7, 5, 2048) // SetChannelDataLen unreserved
	rec(15)
	call(7, 7, 2048) // SetChannelDataLen ok
	rec(16)
	call(8, 7, 0x10000, 0) // ChangeChannelVolume oversize
	rec(17)
	call(8, 7, 0x4000, -1) // ChangeChannelVolume ok
	rec(18)
	call(9, 22050) // SetFrequency bad
	rec(19)
	call(9, 44100) // SetFrequency ok
	rec(20)
	call(11, 0, 0) // InputInit
	rec(21)
	// Input(64, 44100, buf): silence written, count returned.
	a.li(rA0, 64)
	a.li(rA1, 44100)
	bufAddr(rA2)
	a.jalStub(0, 10)
	a.nop()
	rec(22)
	// Input with a null buffer.
	a.li(rA0, 64)
	a.li(rA1, 44100)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 10)
	a.nop()
	rec(23)
	call(12) // GetInputLength
	rec(24)
	call(15) // RoutingGetMode
	rec(25)
	call(16, 0) // RoutingSetMode(0) returns the previous
	rec(26)
	call(15) // RoutingGetMode
	rec(27)
	call(13, 1024) // Output2Reserve: unknown
	rec(28)
	call(14, 1024, 44100, 2) // SRCChReserve: unknown
	rec(29)
	call(2, 5) // ChRelease unreserved
	rec(30)
	call(2, 7) // ChRelease with a buffer in flight
	rec(31)
	// Oneshot on the next free channel: 7 is still playing
	// out its released buffer, so the search lands on 6.
	a.li(rA0, -1)
	a.li(rA1, 512)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.li(rA3, 0x8000)
	a.li(rT0, 0x8000)
	a.sw(rT0, 16, rSP) // rightvol (stack arg 4)
	bufAddr(rT0)
	a.sw(rT0, 20, rSP) // buf (stack arg 5)
	a.jalStub(0, 17)
	a.nop()
	rec(32)
	call(5, 6) // GetChannelRestLen on the oneshot channel
	rec(33)

	a.la(rA0, "fmtS")
	a.jalStub(1, 0) // sceKernelPrintf
	a.nop()
	a.li(rA0, 0)
	a.jalStub(2, 0) // sceKernelExitGame
	a.nop()

	img := b.build(false, nil)
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(false)
	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	runAudioGate(t, m, 60)
	if got := m.ConsoleOutput(); got != "sem done\n" {
		t.Fatalf("console = %q, want %q", got, "sem done\n")
	}
	want := []uint32{
		0,          // Init
		0x80260003, // reserve chan 8: invalid channel
		0x80260006, // reserve count 100: not aligned
		0x80260007, // reserve format 7: invalid format
		7,          // reserve: first free from the top
		0x80260003, // reserve 7 again: invalid channel
		0x80260003, // output chan 9
		0x8026000B, // output volume 0x10000
		0x80260001, // output unreserved 5: not init
		1024,       // null output accepted
		1024,       // RestLen counts the null buffer
		0,          // RestLength does not
		1024,       // real output after null: not busy
		0x80260002, // output while playing: busy
		0x80260006, // SetChannelDataLen 100
		0x80260001, // SetChannelDataLen unreserved
		0,          // SetChannelDataLen 2048
		0x8026000B, // ChangeChannelVolume oversize
		0,          // ChangeChannelVolume
		0x8026000A, // SetFrequency 22050
		0,          // SetFrequency 44100
		0,          // InputInit
		64,         // Input delivers 64 silent samples
		0xFFFFFFFF, // Input null buffer
		0,          // GetInputLength
		1,          // RoutingGetMode default
		1,          // RoutingSetMode returns previous
		0,          // RoutingGetMode after set
		0x80020001, // Output2Reserve: unknown NID
		0x80020001, // SRCChReserve: unknown NID
		0x80260008, // ChRelease unreserved
		0,          // ChRelease in flight
		6,          // Oneshot lands on channel 6
		512,        // oneshot rest length
	}
	resAddr := roAddr["resS"]
	for i, w := range want {
		if got := m.Bus.Read32(resAddr + uint32(4*i)); got != w {
			t.Fatalf("result %d = %#08x, want %#08x", i, got, w)
		}
	}
	// The input call zeroed the first 128 bytes of the buffer.
	buf := roAddr["bufS"]
	for i := 0; i < 128; i++ {
		if got := m.Bus.Read8(buf + uint32(i)); got != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("input buffer byte %d = %#x, want 0 (silence)", i, got)
		}
	}
	// Exactly the two unimplemented families were logged.
	unknown := m.Kernel().UnknownCalls()
	if len(unknown) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("UnknownCalls = %v, want exactly the Output2 and SRC reserves", unknown)
	}
	seen := map[uint32]bool{}
	for _, u := range unknown {
		if u.Module != "sceAudio" {
			t.Fatalf("unknown call module = %q, want sceAudio", u.Module)
		}
		seen[u.NID] = true
	}
	if !seen[0x01562BA3] || !seen[0x38553111] {
		t.Fatalf("UnknownCalls NIDs = %v, want 0x01562BA3 and 0x38553111", seen)
	}
}

// rT9 is $t9 (25), used by the semantics gate as a scratch
// base register.
func rT9() int { return 25 }

// --- gate (c): a pure audio guest cannot deadlock --------------

func TestPSP4GateAudioOnlyGuest(t *testing.T) {
	b := newGateBuilder("GATEC", []gateLib{libAudio4})
	b.ro("tabC", audioGateTableBytes())
	b.ro("pbufC", make([]byte, audioGateBufFrames*4))
	b.roWords("cellCallsC", 0)
	a := b.code
	a.addiu(rSP, rSP, -32)
	a.addiu(rA0, rZero, -1)
	a.li(rA1, audioGateBufFrames)
	a.li(rA2, 0)
	a.jalStub(0, 0) // sceAudioChReserve
	a.nop()
	a.move(rS0, rV0)
	a.li(rS4, 0)
	audioFillAsm(a, "tabC", "pbufC", rS4, "C")
	a.li(rS3, 0)
	a.here("loopC")
	a.move(rA0, rS0)
	a.li(rA1, 0x8000)
	a.la(rA2, "pbufC")
	a.jalStub(0, 1) // sceAudioOutputBlocking, forever
	a.nop()
	a.addiu(rS3, rS3, 1)
	a.la(rT0, "cellCallsC")
	a.sw(rS3, 0, rT0)
	a.j("loopC")
	a.nop()
	img := b.build(false, nil)
	_, _, roAddr, _, _ := b.layout(false)

	m := New()
	if err := m.LoadExecutable(img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadExecutable: %v", err)
	}
	const frames = 30
	var stream []int16
	for f := 0; f < frames; f++ {
		m.RunFrame()
		stream = append(stream, m.AudioBuffer()...)
	}
	if m.Exited() {
		t.Fatal("pure audio guest exited; it should loop on output forever")
	}
	if got := m.Kernel().Vcount(); got != frames {
		t.Fatalf("vcount = %d, want %d (frames must keep advancing)", got, frames)
	}
	if want := frames * 735 * 2; len(stream) != want {
		t.Fatalf("drained %d samples, want %d (735 stereo frames per frame)", len(stream), want)
	}
	nonSilent := 0
	for _, s := range stream {
		if s != 0 {
			nonSilent++
		}
	}
	if nonSilent < 20000 {
		t.Fatalf("only %d non-silent samples in %d; the tone must be playing", nonSilent, len(stream))
	}
	if calls := m.Bus.Read32(roAddr["cellCallsC"]); calls < 15 {
		t.Fatalf("guest completed %d blocking calls in 30 frames, want at least 15", calls)
	} else {
		t.Logf("pure audio guest: %d blocking calls in 30 frames, %d samples drained", calls, len(stream))
	}
	// The guest replays one static buffer forever, so after
	// the leading silence every frame is the buffer pattern
	// exactly: buffer frame j holds table[j mod 100].
	tab := audioGateTable()
	start := -1
	for i := 0; i < len(stream)/2; i++ {
		if stream[2*i] != 0 {
			start = i
			break
		}
	}
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("stream is entirely silent")
	}
	for i := start; i < len(stream)/2; i++ {
		want := tab[((i-start)%audioGateBufFrames)%audioGateTableLen]
		if stream[2*i] != want || stream[2*i+1] != want {
			t.Fatalf("frame %d: got (%d, %d), want replay value %d", i, stream[2*i], stream[2*i+1], want)
		}
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-psp/system/pspautotests_test.go ====================

package system

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// pspautotests harness: runs the open source pspautotests PRXs
// from the local corpus (testroms/pspautotests, gitignored, never
// committed) through the HLE kernel and compares each test's
// result file against its .expected file, byte exact after line
// ending normalization. The corpus framework writes its output
// to host0:/__testoutput.txt (the psplink host channel), which
// the kernel routes into the file store; that file's content is
// the test result. cpu/cpu_alu is the gating set: every one of
// its tests must pass. The other cpu groups run report only:
// their outcomes are logged (and visible with go test -v)
// without failing the suite, which is what closes or keeps
// flagged the PSP-2 VFPU cross-check items. The whole file skips
// when the corpus is absent.

func corpusDir(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	dir := filepath.Join("..", "testroms", "pspautotests")
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "cpu")); err != nil {
