		t.Fatalf("SP=%08X", c.A(7))
	}
	want := []byte{
		0x27, 0x00, // SR
		0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x06, // PC: next instruction
		0x30, 0x39, // IR
		0x00, 0x00, 0x10, 0x01, // fault address
		0x00, 0x35, // SSW: FC 5, data, read
	}
	if got := bus.b[0x7FF2 : 0x7FF2+14]; !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("frame: got % X want % X", got, want)
	}
}

func TestInterruptAfterMaskLowered(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	bus.w32(27*4, 0x4000)
	load(bus, 0x1000, 0x46FC, 0x2000) // MOVE.W #$2000, SR
	c.Interrupt(3)
	c.Step() // mask is 7, so the MOVE runs first
	if c.SR() != 0x2000 {
		t.Fatalf("SR=%04X", c.SR())
	}
	if c.PC() != 0x1004 {
		t.Fatalf("PC=%08X", c.PC())
	}
	c.Step() // now the latched level 3 is accepted
	if c.PC() != 0x4000 {
		t.Fatalf("PC=%08X", c.PC())
	}
	if c.A(7) != 0x7FFA {
		t.Fatalf("SP=%08X", c.A(7))
	}
	if bus.r16(0x7FFA) != 0x2000 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked SR=%04X", bus.r16(0x7FFA))
	}
	if bus.r32(0x7FFC) != 0x1004 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked PC=%08X", bus.r32(0x7FFC))
	}
	if c.SR() != 0x2300 {
		t.Fatalf("SR in handler=%04X", c.SR())
	}
}

func TestStopWakesOnInterrupt(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	bus.w32(26*4, 0x4000)
	load(bus, 0x1000, 0x4E72, 0x2000) // STOP #$2000
	c.Step()
	if !c.Halted() {
		t.Fatal("not halted after STOP")
	}
	c.Step()
	if !c.Halted() || c.PC() != 0x1004 {
		t.Fatalf("halted step moved: halted=%v PC=%08X", c.Halted(), c.PC())
	}
	c.Interrupt(2)
	c.Step()
	if c.Halted() {
		t.Fatal("still halted after interrupt")
	}
	if c.PC() != 0x4000 {
		t.Fatalf("PC=%08X", c.PC())
	}
	if bus.r32(c.A(7)+2) != 0x1004 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked PC=%08X", bus.r32(c.A(7)+2))
	}
}

func TestTas(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		in   uint8
		out  uint8
		n, z bool
	}{
		{0x7F, 0xFF, false, false},
		{0x80, 0x80, true, false},
		{0x00, 0x80, false, true},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		c, bus := newCPU()
		bus.Write8(0x2000, tc.in)
		exec1(c, bus, 0x4AF9, 0x0000, 0x2000) // TAS $2000.L
		if got := bus.Read8(0x2000); got != tc.out {
			t.Fatalf("TAS %02X: memory=%02X want %02X", tc.in, got, tc.out)
		}
		flag(t, c, srN, tc.n, "N")
		flag(t, c, srZ, tc.z, "Z")
	}
}

func TestMovepRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	c.d[0] = 0xAABBCCDD
	c.a[0] = 0x2000
	bus.Write8(0x2001, 0xEE)
	exec1(c, bus, 0x0188, 0x0000) // MOVEP.L D0, (0,A0)
	for i, want := range []uint8{0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC, 0xDD} {
		if got := bus.Read8(0x2000 + uint32(2*i)); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("byte %d: got %02X want %02X", i, got, want)
		}
	}
	if bus.Read8(0x2001) != 0xEE {
		t.Fatal("MOVEP touched an odd byte")
	}
	c.d[0] = 0
	exec1(c, bus, 0x01C8, 0x0000) // MOVEP.L (0,A0), D0
	if c.D(0) != 0xAABBCCDD {
		t.Fatalf("D0=%08X", c.D(0))
	}
}

func TestScc(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	c.sr = 0x2700 | srZ
	c.d[0] = 0x12345600
	exec1(c, bus, 0x57C0) // SEQ D0 with Z set
	if c.D(0) != 0x123456FF {
		t.Fatalf("SEQ: D0=%08X", c.D(0))
	}
	c2, bus2 := newCPU()
	c2.sr = 0x2700 | srZ
	c2.d[0] = 0x123456AA
	exec1(c2, bus2, 0x56C0) // SNE D0 with Z set: false
	if c2.D(0) != 0x12345600 {
		t.Fatalf("SNE: D0=%08X", c2.D(0))
	}
	c3, bus3 := newCPU()
	c3.d[0] = 0
	exec1(c3, bus3, 0x56C0) // SNE D0 with Z clear: true
	if c3.D(0) != 0xFF {
		t.Fatalf("SNE true: D0=%08X", c3.D(0))
	}
}

func TestBranchDisplacements(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	load(bus, 0x1000,
		0x6000, 0x0004, // BRA +4 (word displacement)
		0x7001, // MOVEQ #1, D0 (skipped)
		0x7007) // MOVEQ #7, D0
	c.Step()
	if c.PC() != 0x1006 {
		t.Fatalf("PC=%08X", c.PC())
	}
	c.Step()
	if c.D(0) != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("D0=%d", c.D(0))
	}

	// A byte displacement of 0xFF is -1 on the base
	// 68000: BNE at 0x1000 targets 0x1001, and the odd
	// fetch there takes the address error vector with
	// the faulting fetch address stacked.
	c2, bus2 := newCPU()
	bus2.w32(3*4, 0x2000)
	load(bus2, 0x1000, 0x66FF) // BNE -1, Z clear after reset
	c2.Step()
	if c2.PC() != 0x1001 {
		t.Fatalf("BNE -1 target PC=%08X", c2.PC())
	}
	c2.Step()
	if c2.PC() != 0x2000 {
		t.Fatalf("odd fetch PC=%08X", c2.PC())
	}
	if bus2.r32(c2.A(7)+2) != 0x1001 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked fetch PC=%08X", bus2.r32(c2.A(7)+2))
	}
	if bus2.r16(c2.A(7)+12) != 0x0026 {
		t.Fatalf("SSW=%04X", bus2.r16(c2.A(7)+12))
	}
}

func TestPrivilegeViolationStackedPC(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := newCPU()
	bus.w32(8*4, 0x3000)
	c.otherSP = 0x7000                // USP value while in supervisor
	c.setSR(0x0000)                   // enter user mode: A7 becomes USP
	load(bus, 0x1000, 0x46FC, 0x2700) // MOVE.W #$2700, SR
	c.Step()
	if c.PC() != 0x3000 {
		t.Fatalf("PC=%08X", c.PC())
	}
	if c.A(7) != 0x8000-6 {
		t.Fatalf("SSP=%08X", c.A(7))
	}
	if bus.r32(0x8000-4) != 0x1002 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked PC=%08X, want past the opcode", bus.r32(0x8000-4))
	}
	if bus.r16(0x8000-6) != 0x0000 {
		t.Fatalf("stacked SR=%04X", bus.r16(0x8000-6))
	}
}

func TestLineAAndFAndIllegal(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		op   uint16
		vec  int
		name string
	}{
		{0xA000, 10, "line A"},
		{0xF000, 11, "line F"},
		{0x4AFC, 4, "illegal"},
	} {
		c, bus := newCPU()
		bus.w32(uint32(tc.vec)*4, 0x3000)
		exec1(c, bus, tc.op)
		if c.PC() != 0x3000 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: PC=%08X", tc.name, c.PC())
		}
		if bus.r32(c.A(7)+2) != 0x1002 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: stacked PC=%08X", tc.name, bus.r32(c.A(7)+2))
		}
	}
}

func summationCPU(t *testing.T) (*CPU, *memBus) {
	t.Helper()
	c, bus := newCPU()
	load(bus, 0x1000,
		0x41F9, 0x0000, 0x2000, // LEA $2000.L, A0
		0x7000,         // MOVEQ #0, D0
		0x7203,         // MOVEQ #3, D1
		0xD098,         // loop: ADD.L (A0)+, D0
		0x51C9, 0xFFFC, // DBRA D1, loop
		0x60FE) // BRA *
	for i, v := range []uint32{10, 20, 30, 40} {
		bus.w32(0x2000+uint32(4*i), v)
	}
	return c, bus
}

func TestSummationProgramDeterministicCycles(t *testing.T) {
	var cycles []uint64
	for run := 0; run < 2; run++ {
		c, _ := summationCPU(t)
		for i := 0; i < 11; i++ {
			c.Step()
		}
		if c.D(0) != 100 {
			t.Fatalf("run %d: sum=%d", run, c.D(0))
		}
		if c.PC() != 0x1010 {
			t.Fatalf("run %d: PC=%08X", run, c.PC())
		}
		cycles = append(cycles, c.Cycles)
	}
	if cycles[0] != cycles[1] {
		t.Fatalf("cycles differ across runs: %d vs %d", cycles[0], cycles[1])
	}
}

func TestSerializeRoundTripMidProgram(t *testing.T) {
	c, bus := summationCPU(t)
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		c.Step()
	}
	blob := c.Serialize()
	if len(blob) != SerializeSize {
		t.Fatalf("blob size %d", len(blob))
	}
	c2 := New(bus)
	if err := c2.Deserialize(blob); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c2.D(0) != c.D(0) || c2.D(1) != c.D(1) || c2.PC() != c.PC() ||
		c2.SR() != c.SR() || c2.Cycles != c.Cycles || c2.A(0) != c.A(0) {
		t.Fatalf("restored state differs: D0=%d PC=%08X Cycles=%d",
			c2.D(0), c2.PC(), c2.Cycles)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(c2.Serialize(), blob) {
		t.Fatal("re-serialized blob differs")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		c2.Step()
	}
	if c2.D(0) != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("resumed sum=%d", c2.D(0))
	}
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/chips/sh2/exec.go ====================

package sh2

// isDelayedBranch reports whether op is any delayed
// branch form or RTE, for the delay slot legality check.
func isDelayedBranch(op uint16) bool {
	top := op >> 12
	switch top {
	case 0x0A, 0x0B:
		return true
	case 0x08:
		sub := (op >> 8) & 0x0F
		return sub == 0x0D || sub == 0x0F
	case 0x00:
		if op == 0x000B || op == 0x002B {
			return true
		}
		low := op & 0x0F
		mid := (op >> 4) & 0x0F
		return low == 3 && (mid == 0 || mid == 2)
	case 0x04:
		lowByte := op & 0xFF
		return lowByte == 0x0B || lowByte == 0x2B
	}
	return false
}

// execSlot fetches and executes the delay slot of the
// branch instruction at addr. A slot that is itself a
// delayed branch or RTE raises the slot illegal
// instruction exception, vector 6, with the saved PC at
// the slot address, and the outer branch is abandoned.
func (c *CPU) execSlot(addr uint32) (int, bool) {
	slotAddr := addr + 2
	c.cur = slotAddr
	op := c.fetch(slotAddr)
	if isDelayedBranch(op) {
		c.enterException(6, slotAddr)
		return 2, true
	}
	return c.exec(op, slotAddr)
}

// delayed runs the delay slot, then jumps to target.
func (c *CPU) delayed(addr uint32, target uint32, cost int) (int, bool) {
	if _, bad := c.execSlot(addr); bad {
		return cost, true
	}
	c.PC = target
	return cost, false
}

// div1 performs one DIV1 step, Rm into Rn, following
// the operation table in the SH programming manual,
// stated here in words: the old Q is saved; Q takes the
// top bit of Rn; Rn shifts left by one with T entering
// at the bottom; when old Q equals M the divisor is
// subtracted, otherwise it is added; the new Q is the
// exclusive or of the borrow or carry flag from that
// addition or subtraction, that top bit, the old Q,
// and 1 when the operation was an addition; finally
// T is set when the new Q equals M.
func (c *CPU) div1(m, n int) {
	oldQ := c.getQ()
	mv := c.getM()
	qSign := 0
	if c.Reg[n]>>31 != 0 {
		qSign = 1
	}
	c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[n]<<1 | uint32(c.getT())
	before := c.Reg[n]
	sub := oldQ == mv
	var flag int
	if sub {
		c.Reg[n] = before - c.Reg[m]
		if c.Reg[n] > before {
			flag = 1
		}
	} else {
		c.Reg[n] = before + c.Reg[m]
		if c.Reg[n] < before {
			flag = 1
		}
	}
	add := 0
	if !sub {
		add = 1
	}
	newQ := flag ^ qSign ^ oldQ ^ add
	c.setQ(newQ)
	if newQ == mv {
		c.setT(1)
	} else {
		c.setT(0)
	}
}

// macAdd adds product to the MACH:MACL accumulator.
//
// Saturation rule used here, stated plainly: when the
// S bit is set, the incoming accumulator is read as a
// signed 48 bit value (the low 16 bits of MACH together
// with MACL, sign extended), the product is added, and
// the result is clamped to the signed 48 bit range,
// whose ends are the 64 bit patterns 0x00007FFFFFFFFFFF
// (high) and 0xFFFF800000000000 (low). A clamped high
// result therefore leaves MACH as 0x00007FFF and MACL
// as 0xFFFFFFFF; a clamped low result leaves MACH as
// 0xFFFF8000 and MACL as 0. When S is clear, the full
// 64 bit accumulator wraps normally.
func (c *CPU) macAdd(product int64) {
	if c.getS() == 1 {
		acc := int64(uint64(c.MACH&0x0000FFFF)<<32 | uint64(c.MACL))
		if acc&0x0000800000000000 != 0 {
			acc -= 0x0001000000000000
		}
		result := acc + product
		hi := int64(0x00007FFFFFFFFFFF)
		lo := int64(-1) << 47
		if result > hi {
			result = hi
		}
		if result < lo {
			result = lo
		}
		c.MACH = uint32(uint64(result) >> 32)
		c.MACL = uint32(result)
		return
	}
	acc := uint64(c.MACH)<<32 | uint64(c.MACL)
	acc += uint64(product)
	c.MACH = uint32(acc >> 32)
	c.MACL = uint32(acc)
}

// sysRead returns the STS and STC source value for a
// selector: for STS, 0 MACH, 1 MACL, 2 PR; for STC the
// caller passes a flag and the selector means 0 SR,
// 1 GBR, 2 VBR.
func (c *CPU) stsValue(sel uint32) uint32 {
	switch sel {
	case 0:
		return c.MACH
	case 1:
		return c.MACL
	default:
		return c.PR
	}
}

func (c *CPU) stcValue(sel uint32) uint32 {
	switch sel {
	case 0:
		return c.SR
	case 1:
		return c.GBR
	default:
		return c.VBR
	}
}

func (c *CPU) ldsValue(sel uint32, v uint32) {
	switch sel {
	case 0:
		c.MACH = v
	case 1:
		c.MACL = v
	default:
		c.PR = v
	}
}

func (c *CPU) ldcValue(sel uint32, v uint32) {
	switch sel {
	case 0:
		c.SR = v
	case 1:
		c.GBR = v
	default:
		c.VBR = v
	}
}

// exec runs one fetched instruction at address addr and
// returns its nominal cycle count plus a flag telling
// whether an exception was taken (so a caller executing
// a delay slot can abandon the outer branch).
func (c *CPU) exec(op uint16, addr uint32) (int, bool) {
	c.cur = addr
	c.PC = addr + 2
	n := int((op >> 8) & 0x0F)
	m := int((op >> 4) & 0x0F)
	low := uint32(op & 0x0F)
	top := op >> 12

	switch top {
	case 0x00:
		return c.exec0(op, addr, n, m, low)
	case 0x01:
		// MOV.L Rm, @(disp 4, Rn)
		disp := uint32(op & 0x0F)
		dst := c.Reg[n] + disp*4
		c.store(dst, c.Reg[m], 4)
		return 2, false
	case 0x02:
		return c.exec2(addr, n, m, low)
	case 0x03:
		return c.exec3(addr, n, m, low)
	case 0x04:
		return c.exec4(op, addr, n, m)
	case 0x05:
		// MOV.L @(disp 4, Rm), Rn
		disp := uint32(op & 0x0F)
		src := c.Reg[m] + disp*4
		c.Reg[n] = c.rd32(src)
		return 2, false
	case 0x06:
		return c.exec6(addr, n, m, low)
	case 0x07:
		// ADD #imm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] += sext8(uint32(op & 0xFF))
		return 1, false
	case 0x08:
		return c.exec8(op, addr)
	case 0x09:
		// MOV.W @(disp, PC), Rn
		base := addr + 4
		src := base + uint32(op&0xFF)*2
		c.Reg[n] = sext16(uint32(c.rd16(src)))
		return 2, false
	case 0x0A:
		target := uint32(int32(addr+4) + sext12(uint32(op&0x0FFF))*2)
		return c.delayed(addr, target, 2)
	case 0x0B:
		c.PR = addr + 4
		target := uint32(int32(addr+4) + sext12(uint32(op&0x0FFF))*2)
		return c.delayed(addr, target, 2)
	case 0x0C:
		return c.execC(op, addr)
	case 0x0D:
		// MOV.L @(disp, PC), Rn
		base := (addr + 4) &^ 3
		src := base + uint32(op&0xFF)*4
		c.Reg[n] = c.rd32(src)
		return 2, false
	case 0x0E:
		// MOV #imm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = sext8(uint32(op & 0xFF))
		return 1, false
	}
	// Top nibble 0x0F is the floating point and SH-4 only
	// space: every encoding there is illegal on SH-2.
	return c.illegal(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) exec0(op uint16, addr uint32, n, m int, low uint32) (int, bool) {
	mid := uint32((op >> 4) & 0x0F)
	switch {
	case op == 0x0008:
		c.setT(0)
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x0018:
		c.setT(1)
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x0028:
		c.MACH = 0
		c.MACL = 0
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x0019:
		// DIV0U
		c.setQM(0, 0)
		c.setT(0)
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x000B:
		// RTS
		return c.delayed(addr, c.PR, 2)
	case op == 0x001B:
		// SLEEP
		c.Sleeping = true
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x002B:
		// RTE: pop the saved PC and SR, run the delay
		// slot, then restore PC and SR from the stack.
		savedPC := c.bus.Read32(c.Reg[15])
		savedSR := c.bus.Read32(c.Reg[15] + 4)
		c.Reg[15] += 8
		if _, bad := c.execSlot(addr); bad {
			return 2, true
		}
		c.PC = savedPC
		c.SR = savedSR
		return 2, false
	case low == 9 && mid == 2:
		// MOVT Rn: R0's encoding 0x0029 carries the
		// constant 2 in the middle nibble. The all zero
		// middle nibble form 0x0009 is NOP and changes no
		// register; an earlier slice treated it as MOVT
		// R0, which corrupts R0 across every NOP delay
		// slot and breaks real code, so SAT-4 corrects it
		// to the manual.
		c.Reg[n] = uint32(c.getT())
		return 1, false
	case op == 0x0009:
		// NOP
		return 1, false
	case low == 3 && mid == 0:
		// BSRF Rn
		target := c.Reg[n]
		c.PR = addr + 4
		return c.delayed(addr, target, 2)
	case low == 3 && mid == 2:
		// BRAF Rn
		return c.delayed(addr, c.Reg[n], 2)
	case low == 7:
		// MUL.L Rm, Rn
		c.MACL = uint32(int32(c.Reg[n]) * int32(c.Reg[m]))
		return 2, false
	case low == 15:
		// MAC.L @Rm+, @Rn+: both pointers advance by
		// 4; when m equals n the same register advances
		// twice and the second operand comes from the
		// advanced address. Both operands are read, with
		// their alignment checked, before either pointer
		// moves, so a bad access aborts cleanly.
		addrM := c.Reg[m]
		a := int32(c.rd32(addrM))
		addrN := c.Reg[n]
		if n == m {
			addrN = addrM + 4
		}
		b := int32(c.rd32(addrN))
		c.Reg[m] += 4
		c.Reg[n] += 4
		c.macAdd(int64(a) * int64(b))
		return 3, false
	case low == 4 || low == 5 || low == 6:
		// MOV Rm, @(R0, Rn), byte word long by low.
		size := sizeOf(low)
		dst := c.Reg[n] + c.Reg[0]
		c.store(dst, c.Reg[m], size)
		return 2, false
	case low == 12 || low == 13 || low == 14:
		// MOV @(R0, Rm), Rn, byte word long by low.
		size := sizeOf(low)
		src := c.Reg[m] + c.Reg[0]
		c.Reg[n] = c.loadSigned(src, size)
		return 2, false
	case low == 2 && mid <= 2:
		// STC: selector in mid, 0 SR, 1 GBR, 2 VBR.
		c.Reg[n] = c.stcValue(mid)
		return 1, false
	case low == 10 && mid <= 2:
		// STS: selector in mid, 0 MACH, 1 MACL, 2 PR.
		c.Reg[n] = c.stsValue(mid)
		return 1, false
	}
	return c.illegal(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) exec2(addr uint32, n, m int, low uint32) (int, bool) {
	switch low {
	case 0, 1, 2:
		// MOV Rm, @Rn
		size := sizeOf(low)
		c.store(c.Reg[n], c.Reg[m], size)
		return 2, false
	case 4, 5, 6:
		// MOV Rm, @-Rn: the address register moves
		// first, the store follows, and the alignment
		// of the new address is checked before either
		// change so a bad access aborts cleanly.
		size := sizeOf(low)
		dst := c.Reg[n] - uint32(size)
		c.checkAlign(dst, size)
		c.Reg[n] = dst
		c.store(dst, c.Reg[m], size)
		return 2, false
	case 7:
		// DIV0S Rm, Rn
		q := 0
		if c.Reg[n]>>31 != 0 {
			q = 1
		}
		mv := 0
		if c.Reg[m]>>31 != 0 {
			mv = 1
		}
		c.setQM(q, mv)
		c.setT(q ^ mv)
		return 1, false
	case 8:
		c.setT(b2u(c.Reg[n]&c.Reg[m] == 0))
		return 1, false
	case 9:
		c.Reg[n] &= c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 10:
		c.Reg[n] ^= c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 11:
		c.Reg[n] |= c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 12:
		// CMP/STR: T set when any byte pair matches.
		a := c.Reg[n]
		b := c.Reg[m]
		hit := false
		for i := 0; i < 4; i += 1 {
			if (a>>(uint(i)*8))&0xFF == (b>>(uint(i)*8))&0xFF {
				hit = true
			}
		}
		c.setT(b2u(hit))
		return 1, false
	case 13:
		// XTRCT Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = (c.Reg[m]&0x0000FFFF)<<16 | (c.Reg[n] >> 16)
		return 1, false
	case 14:
		// MULU.W Rm, Rn
		c.MACL = uint32(c.Reg[n]&0x0000FFFF) * uint32(c.Reg[m]&0x0000FFFF)
		return 1, false
	case 15:
		// MULS.W Rm, Rn
		c.MACL = uint32(int32(int16(c.Reg[n])) * int32(int16(c.Reg[m])))
		return 1, false
	}
	return c.illegal(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) exec3(addr uint32, n, m int, low uint32) (int, bool) {
	a := c.Reg[n]
	b := c.Reg[m]
	switch low {
	case 0:
		c.setT(b2u(a == b))
	case 2:
		c.setT(b2u(a >= b))
	case 3:
		c.setT(b2u(int32(a) >= int32(b)))
	case 4:
		c.div1(m, n)
	case 5:
		p := uint64(a) * uint64(b)
		c.MACH = uint32(p >> 32)
		c.MACL = uint32(p)
		return 2, false
	case 6:
		c.setT(b2u(a > b))
	case 7:
		c.setT(b2u(int32(a) > int32(b)))
	case 8:
		c.Reg[n] = a - b
	case 10:
		t := uint32(c.getT())
		res := a - b - t
		var borrow uint32
		if uint64(a) < uint64(b)+uint64(t) {
			borrow = 1
		}
		c.Reg[n] = res
		c.setT(int(borrow))
	case 11:
		res := a - b
		over := false
		if (a^b)&0x80000000 != 0 && (res^a)&0x80000000 != 0 {
			over = true
		}
		c.Reg[n] = res
		c.setT(b2u(over))
	case 12:
		c.Reg[n] = a + b
	case 13:
		p := int64(int32(a)) * int64(int32(b))
		c.MACH = uint32(uint64(p) >> 32)
		c.MACL = uint32(p)
		return 2, false
	case 14:
		t := uint32(c.getT())
		sum := uint64(a) + uint64(b) + uint64(t)
		c.Reg[n] = uint32(sum)
		c.setT(int(uint32(sum >> 32)))
	case 15:
		res := a + b
		over := false
		if (a^b)&0x80000000 == 0 && (res^a)&0x80000000 != 0 {
			over = true
		}
		c.Reg[n] = res
		c.setT(b2u(over))
	default:
		// Low nibbles 1 and 9 are not SH-2 instructions.
		return c.illegal(addr)
	}
	return 1, false
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/chips/sh2/exec2.go ====================

package sh2

func (c *CPU) exec4(op uint16, addr uint32, n, m int) (int, bool) {
	lowByte := uint32(op & 0xFF)
	if lowByte&0x0F == 0x0F {
		// MAC.W @Rm+, @Rn+: both pointers advance by
		// 2; when m equals n the same register advances
		// twice and the second operand comes from the
		// advanced address.
		addrM := c.Reg[m]
		a := int32(int16(c.rd16(addrM)))
		addrN := c.Reg[n]
		if n == m {
			addrN = addrM + 2
			c.checkAlign(addrN, 2)
		}
		b := int32(int16(c.rd16(addrN)))
		c.Reg[m] += 2
		c.Reg[n] += 2
		c.macAdd(int64(a) * int64(b))
		return 3, false
	}
	switch lowByte {
	case 0x00:
		// SHLL Rn
		c.setT(int(c.Reg[n] >> 31))
		c.Reg[n] <<= 1
	case 0x10:
		// DT Rn
		c.Reg[n] -= 1
		c.setT(b2u(c.Reg[n] == 0))
	case 0x20:
		// SHAL Rn, same operation as SHLL.
		c.setT(int(c.Reg[n] >> 31))
		c.Reg[n] <<= 1
	case 0x01:
		// SHLR Rn
		c.setT(int(c.Reg[n] & 1))
		c.Reg[n] >>= 1
	case 0x11:
		// CMP/PZ Rn
		c.setT(b2u(int32(c.Reg[n]) >= 0))
	case 0x21:
		// SHAR Rn
		c.setT(int(c.Reg[n] & 1))
		c.Reg[n] = uint32(int32(c.Reg[n]) >> 1)
	case 0x04:
		// ROTL Rn
		bit := c.Reg[n] >> 31
		c.setT(int(bit))
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[n]<<1 | bit
	case 0x24:
		// ROTCL Rn
		bit := c.Reg[n] >> 31
		old := uint32(c.getT())
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[n]<<1 | old
		c.setT(int(bit))
	case 0x05:
		// ROTR Rn
		bit := c.Reg[n] & 1
		c.setT(int(bit))
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[n]>>1 | bit<<31
	case 0x15:
		// CMP/PL Rn
		c.setT(b2u(int32(c.Reg[n]) > 0))
	case 0x25:
		// ROTCR Rn
		bit := c.Reg[n] & 1
		old := uint32(c.getT())
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[n]>>1 | old<<31
		c.setT(int(bit))
	case 0x08:
		c.Reg[n] <<= 2
	case 0x18:
		c.Reg[n] <<= 8
	case 0x28:
		c.Reg[n] <<= 16
	case 0x09:
		c.Reg[n] >>= 2
	case 0x19:
		c.Reg[n] >>= 8
	case 0x29:
		c.Reg[n] >>= 16
	case 0x0B:
		// JSR @Rn
		target := c.Reg[n]
		c.PR = addr + 4
		return c.delayed(addr, target, 2)
	case 0x2B:
		// JMP @Rn
		return c.delayed(addr, c.Reg[n], 2)
	case 0x1B:
		// TAS.B @Rn
		dst := c.Reg[n]
		v := c.rd8(dst)
		c.setT(b2u(v == 0))
		c.wr8(dst, v|0x80)
		return 2, false
	case 0x02, 0x12, 0x22:
		// STS.L sys, @-Rn
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		dst := c.Reg[n] - 4
		c.checkAlign(dst, 4)
		c.wr32(dst, c.stsValue(sel))
		c.Reg[n] = dst
		return 2, false
	case 0x03, 0x13, 0x23:
		// STC.L sys, @-Rn
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		dst := c.Reg[n] - 4
		c.checkAlign(dst, 4)
		c.wr32(dst, c.stcValue(sel))
		c.Reg[n] = dst
		return 2, false
	case 0x06, 0x16, 0x26:
		// LDS.L @Rn+, sys
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		v := c.rd32(c.Reg[n])
		c.Reg[n] += 4
		c.ldsValue(sel, v)
		return 2, false
	case 0x07, 0x17, 0x27:
		// LDC.L @Rn+, sys; an SR load applies at once.
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		v := c.rd32(c.Reg[n])
		c.Reg[n] += 4
		c.ldcValue(sel, v)
		return 2, false
	case 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x2A:
		// LDS Rn, sys
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		c.ldsValue(sel, c.Reg[n])
		return 1, false
	case 0x0E, 0x1E, 0x2E:
		// LDC Rn, sys; an SR load applies at once.
		sel := lowByte >> 4
		c.ldcValue(sel, c.Reg[n])
		return 1, false
	default:
		return c.illegal(addr)
	}
	return 1, false
}

func (c *CPU) exec6(addr uint32, n, m int, low uint32) (int, bool) {
	switch low {
	case 0, 1, 2:
		// MOV @Rm, Rn
		size := sizeOf(low)
		c.Reg[n] = c.loadSigned(c.Reg[m], size)
		return 2, false
	case 3:
		// MOV Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 4, 5, 6:
		// MOV @Rm+, Rn: destination is loaded first,
		// then the source pointer advances, matching
		// the manual operation order.
		size := sizeOf(low)
		v := c.loadSigned(c.Reg[m], size)
		c.Reg[n] = v
		c.Reg[m] += uint32(size)
		return 2, false
	case 8:
		// SWAP.B Rm, Rn
		v := c.Reg[m]
		c.Reg[n] = v&0xFFFF0000 | (v&0x000000FF)<<8 | (v>>8)&0x000000FF
		return 1, false
	case 9:
		// SWAP.W Rm, Rn
		v := c.Reg[m]
		c.Reg[n] = v<<16 | v>>16
		return 1, false
	case 7:
		// NOT Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = ^c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 0x0A:
		// NEGC Rm, Rn: Rn = 0 - Rm - T, and T takes
		// the borrow, set unless Rm and T are both 0.
		tbit := uint32(c.getT())
		borrow := uint64(c.Reg[m]) + uint64(tbit)
		c.Reg[n] = 0 - c.Reg[m] - tbit
		c.setT(b2u(borrow != 0))
		return 1, false
	case 0x0B:
		// NEG Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = 0 - c.Reg[m]
		return 1, false
	case 0x0C:
		// EXTU.B Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[m] & 0xFF
		return 1, false
	case 0x0D:
		// EXTU.W Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = c.Reg[m] & 0xFFFF
		return 1, false
	case 0x0E:
		// EXTS.B Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = uint32(int32(int8(c.Reg[m])))
		return 1, false
	case 0x0F:
		// EXTS.W Rm, Rn
		c.Reg[n] = uint32(int32(int16(c.Reg[m])))
		return 1, false
	}
	return c.illegal(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) exec8(op uint16, addr uint32) (int, bool) {
	sub := (op >> 8) & 0x0F
	reg := int((op >> 4) & 0x0F)
	disp := uint32(op & 0x0F)
	imm := uint32(op & 0xFF)
	switch sub {
	case 0x00:
		// MOV.B R0, @(disp, Rn)
		c.store(c.Reg[reg]+disp, c.Reg[0], 1)
		return 2, false
	case 0x01:
		// MOV.W R0, @(disp, Rn)
		c.store(c.Reg[reg]+disp*2, c.Reg[0], 2)
		return 2, false
	case 0x04:
		// MOV.B @(disp, Rn), R0
		c.Reg[0] = c.loadSigned(c.Reg[reg]+disp, 1)
		return 2, false
	case 0x05:
		// MOV.W @(disp, Rn), R0
		c.Reg[0] = c.loadSigned(c.Reg[reg]+disp*2, 2)
		return 2, false
	case 0x08:
		// CMP/EQ #imm, R0
		c.setT(b2u(c.Reg[0] == sext8(imm)))
		return 1, false
	case 0x09, 0x0B:
		// BT, BF: non delayed conditional branches.
		target := uint32(int32(addr+4) + int32(int8(imm))*2)
		taken := (sub == 0x09 && c.getT() == 1) || (sub == 0x0B && c.getT() == 0)
		if taken {
			c.PC = target
			return 3, false
		}
		return 1, false
	case 0x0D, 0x0F:
		// BT/S, BF/S: delayed conditional branches. A
		// not taken form skips its delay slot entirely.
		target := uint32(int32(addr+4) + int32(int8(imm))*2)
		taken := (sub == 0x0D && c.getT() == 1) || (sub == 0x0F && c.getT() == 0)
		if taken {
			return c.delayed(addr, target, 2)
		}
		c.PC = addr + 4
		return 1, false
	}
	return c.illegal(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) execC(op uint16, addr uint32) (int, bool) {
	sub := (op >> 8) & 0x0F
	disp := uint32(op & 0xFF)
	imm := uint32(op & 0xFF)
	switch sub {
	case 0x00:
		c.store(c.GBR+disp, c.Reg[0], 1)
		return 2, false
	case 0x01:
		c.store(c.GBR+disp*2, c.Reg[0], 2)
		return 2, false
	case 0x02:
		c.store(c.GBR+disp*4, c.Reg[0], 4)
		return 2, false
	case 0x03:
		// TRAPA #imm. Rule used here: the trap number
		// is the immediate bits 7 to 2, and the vector
		// is 32 plus that number, so the handler pointer
		// is read at VBR plus vector times 4. TRAPA
		// with immediate 0x40 uses vector 48.
		vector := 32 + int((imm>>2)&0x3F)
		c.enterException(vector, addr+2)
		return 4, true
	case 0x04:
		c.Reg[0] = c.loadSigned(c.GBR+disp, 1)
		return 2, false
	case 0x05:
		c.Reg[0] = c.loadSigned(c.GBR+disp*2, 2)
		return 2, false
	case 0x06:
		c.Reg[0] = c.rd32(c.GBR + disp*4)
		return 2, false
	case 0x07:
		// MOVA @(disp, PC), R0
		base := (addr + 4) &^ 3
		c.Reg[0] = base + disp*4
		return 1, false
	case 0x08:
		// TST #imm, R0
		c.setT(b2u(c.Reg[0]&imm == 0))
		return 1, false
	case 0x09:
		c.Reg[0] &= imm
		return 1, false
	case 0x0A:
		c.Reg[0] ^= imm
		return 1, false
	case 0x0B:
		c.Reg[0] |= imm
		return 1, false
	case 0x0C:
		// TST.B #imm, @(R0, GBR)
		v := c.rd8(c.GBR + c.Reg[0])
		c.setT(b2u(uint32(v)&imm == 0))
		return 3, false
	case 0x0D:
		dst := c.GBR + c.Reg[0]
		c.wr8(dst, c.rd8(dst)&uint8(imm))
		return 3, false
	case 0x0E:
		dst := c.GBR + c.Reg[0]
		c.wr8(dst, c.rd8(dst)^uint8(imm))
		return 3, false
	case 0x0F:
		dst := c.GBR + c.Reg[0]
		c.wr8(dst, c.rd8(dst)|uint8(imm))
		return 3, false
	}
	return c.illegal(addr)
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/chips/sh2/extended_ops_test.go ====================

package sh2

import "testing"

// The 0x6 group register ops beyond MOV and SWAP: NOT,
// NEG, NEGC, EXTU.B, EXTU.W, EXTS.B, EXTS.W. Encodings
// are group 6, low nibble 7, A, B, C, D, E, F.

func TestGroup6Extensions(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("NOT", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 7)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x0F0FF0F0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "not", c.Reg[2], 0xF0F00F0F)
	})
	t.Run("NEG", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0B)})
		c.Reg[1] = 5
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "neg", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFFFB)
	})
	t.Run("NEGC with borrow set", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0A)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		c.SR |= 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "value", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFFFF)
		eq(t, "T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("NEGC no borrow", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0A)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		c.SR &^= 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "value", c.Reg[2], 0)
		eq(t, "T", c.SR&1, 0)
	})
	t.Run("NEGC value with T clear", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0A)})
		c.Reg[1] = 10
		c.SR &^= 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "value", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFFF6)
		eq(t, "T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("EXTU.B clears high bytes", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0C)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xDEADBEEF
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "extu.b", c.Reg[2], 0x000000EF)
	})
	t.Run("EXTU.W clears high word", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0D)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xDEADBEEF
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "extu.w", c.Reg[2], 0x0000BEEF)
	})
	t.Run("EXTS.B sign extends", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0E)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x00000080
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "exts.b", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFF80)
	})
	t.Run("EXTS.W sign extends", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0x0F)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x00008001
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "exts.w", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFF8001)
	})
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/chips/sh2/sh2.go ====================

// Package sh2 implements the SH-2 CPU, the SH-2 subset of
// SuperH, as used in the Sega Saturn main processors.
//
// The core is a plain interpreter. One Step call executes
// one instruction; a delayed branch also executes its
// delay slot inside the same Step call. Cycle counts are
// the nominal counts from the programming manual states
// column, simplified as documented on Step.
//
// Serialized layout, SerializeSize bytes, big endian:
// bytes 0 to 63: Reg 0 to 15, four bytes each
// bytes 64 to 67: PC
// bytes 68 to 71: PR
// bytes 72 to 75: SR
// bytes 76 to 79: GBR
// bytes 80 to 83: VBR
// bytes 84 to 87: MACH
// bytes 88 to 91: MACL
// bytes 92 to 99: Cycles, eight bytes
// byte 100: Sleeping flag, 0 or 1
// byte 101: pending NMI flag, 0 or 1
// byte 102: pending interrupt: high bit set when valid,
// plus the level in the low four bits
// byte 103: pending interrupt vector
package sh2

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
)

// SerializeSize is the exact size of a serialized CPU.
const SerializeSize = 104

// Bus is the memory and device space the CPU talks to.
// Read16 and Read32 return big endian assembled values:
// the bus, not the CPU, owns byte order assembly.
type Bus interface {
	Read8(addr uint32) uint8
	Read16(addr uint32) uint16
	Read32(addr uint32) uint32
	Write8(addr uint32, v uint8)
	Write16(addr uint32, v uint16)
	Write32(addr uint32, v uint32)
}

// CPU is one SH-2 processor. The exported fields are the
// architecturally visible state.
type CPU struct {
	Reg  [16]uint32
	PC   uint32
	PR   uint32
	SR   uint32
	GBR  uint32
	VBR  uint32
	MACH uint32
	MACL uint32

	Cycles   uint64
	Sleeping bool

	bus        Bus
	pendNMI    bool
	pendValid  bool
	pendLevel  int
	pendVector int
	cur        uint32
}

// New returns a CPU attached to b, in the Go zero state.
// Call Reset to place it at a known execution point.
func New(b Bus) *CPU {
	c := &CPU{}
	c.bus = b
	return c
}

// Attach swaps the bus the CPU talks to.
func (c *CPU) Attach(b Bus) {
	c.bus = b
}

// Reset clears all CPU state, sets SR to 0x400000F0 (the
// MD bit plus interrupt mask 15), VBR to 0, PC to pc, and
// the stack pointer register Reg 15 to sp.
func (c *CPU) Reset(pc, sp uint32) {
	c.Reg = [16]uint32{}
	c.PR = 0
	c.GBR = 0
	c.MACH = 0
	c.MACL = 0
	c.Cycles = 0
	c.Sleeping = false
	c.pendNMI = false
	c.pendValid = false
	c.pendLevel = 0
	c.pendVector = 0
	c.SR = 0x400000F0
	c.VBR = 0
	c.PC = pc
	c.Reg[15] = sp
}

// RaiseNMI latches a pending non maskable interrupt. It
// is accepted at the next Step boundary regardless of
// the SR interrupt mask, with vector 11.
func (c *CPU) RaiseNMI() {
	c.pendNMI = true
}

// Interrupt latches a maskable interrupt request. It is
// accepted at a Step boundary when level is greater
// than the SR I field. Only the highest level pending
// request is kept. The return value reports whether
// this request is the one now latched.
func (c *CPU) Interrupt(level, vector int) bool {
	if level < 1 || level > 15 {
		return false
	}
	if vector < 0 || vector > 127 {
		return false
	}
	if c.pendValid && c.pendLevel >= level {
		return false
	}
	c.pendValid = true
	c.pendLevel = level
	c.pendVector = vector
	return true
}

// Serialize returns the CPU state in the layout given
// in the package comment, exactly SerializeSize bytes.
func (c *CPU) Serialize() []byte {
	out := make([]byte, SerializeSize)
	for i := 0; i < 16; i += 1 {
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[i*4:i*4+4], c.Reg[i])
	}
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[64:68], c.PC)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[68:72], c.PR)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[72:76], c.SR)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[76:80], c.GBR)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[80:84], c.VBR)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[84:88], c.MACH)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[88:92], c.MACL)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(out[92:100], c.Cycles)
	if c.Sleeping {
		out[100] = 1
	}
	if c.pendNMI {
		out[101] = 1
	}
	if c.pendValid {
		out[102] = 0x80 | byte(c.pendLevel&0x0F)
	}
	out[103] = byte(c.pendVector & 0x7F)
	return out
}

// Deserialize restores a state produced by Serialize.
// It returns an error unless the length matches exactly.
func (c *CPU) Deserialize(data []byte) error {
	if len(data) != SerializeSize {
		return errors.New("sh2: state size mismatch")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 16; i += 1 {
		c.Reg[i] = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[i*4 : i*4+4])
	}
	c.PC = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[64:68])
	c.PR = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[68:72])
	c.SR = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[72:76])
	c.GBR = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[76:80])
	c.VBR = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[80:84])
	c.MACH = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[84:88])
	c.MACL = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[88:92])
	c.Cycles = binary.BigEndian.Uint64(data[92:100])
	c.Sleeping = data[100] != 0
	c.pendNMI = data[101] != 0
	c.pendValid = data[102]&0x80 != 0
	c.pendLevel = int(data[102] & 0x0F)
	c.pendVector = int(data[103] & 0x7F)
	return nil
}

// SR bit accessors. T is bit 0, S is bit 1, the I field
// is bits 4 to 7, Q is bit 8, M is bit 9, MD is bit 30.
// Writes to SR elsewhere in this file change only the
// bits named; an LDC to SR stores the value as given.

func (c *CPU) getT() int {
	if c.SR&0x00000001 != 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func (c *CPU) setT(v int) {
	if v != 0 {
		c.SR |= 0x00000001
	} else {
		c.SR &^= 0x00000001
	}
}

func (c *CPU) getS() int {
	if c.SR&0x00000002 != 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func (c *CPU) getQ() int {
	if c.SR&0x00000100 != 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func (c *CPU) setQ(v int) {
	if v != 0 {
		c.SR |= 0x00000100
	} else {
		c.SR &^= 0x00000100
	}
}

func (c *CPU) getM() int {
	if c.SR&0x00000200 != 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func (c *CPU) setQM(q, m int) {
	c.setQ(q)
	if m != 0 {
		c.SR |= 0x00000200
	} else {
		c.SR &^= 0x00000200
	}
}

func (c *CPU) getI() int {
	return int((c.SR >> 4) & 0x0F)
}

func (c *CPU) setI(level int) {
	c.SR &^= 0x000000F0
	c.SR |= uint32(level&0x0F) << 4
}

func b2u(b bool) int {
	if b {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func sext8(v uint32) uint32 {
	return uint32(int32(int8(v)))
}

func sext16(v uint32) uint32 {
	return uint32(int32(int16(v)))
}

func sext12(v uint32) int32 {
	x := int32(v & 0x0FFF)
	if x&0x0800 != 0 {
		x -= 0x1000
	}
	return x
}

// addrError is panicked by the memory helpers when an
// access breaks the alignment rules. Step recovers it
// and raises the CPU address error exception, vector 7,
// with the saved PC set to instr, the address of the
// instruction that made the bad access.
type addrError struct {
	instr uint32
}

func (c *CPU) checkAlign(addr uint32, size int) {
	if size == 2 && addr&1 != 0 {
		panic(addrError{instr: c.cur})
	}
	if size == 4 && addr&3 != 0 {
		panic(addrError{instr: c.cur})
	}
}

func (c *CPU) rd8(addr uint32) uint8 {
	return c.bus.Read8(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) rd16(addr uint32) uint16 {
	c.checkAlign(addr, 2)
	return c.bus.Read16(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) rd32(addr uint32) uint32 {
	c.checkAlign(addr, 4)
	return c.bus.Read32(addr)
}

func (c *CPU) wr8(addr uint32, v uint8) {
	c.bus.Write8(addr, v)
}

func (c *CPU) wr16(addr uint32, v uint16) {
	c.checkAlign(addr, 2)
	c.bus.Write16(addr, v)
}

func (c *CPU) wr32(addr uint32, v uint32) {
	c.checkAlign(addr, 4)
	c.bus.Write32(addr, v)
}

func (c *CPU) fetch(addr uint32) uint16 {
	if addr&1 != 0 {
		panic(addrError{instr: addr})
	}
	return c.bus.Read16(addr)
}

// loadSigned reads a byte, word, or long from memory and
// sign extends byte and word results into a register
// value. size is 1, 2, or 4.
func (c *CPU) loadSigned(addr uint32, size int) uint32 {
	switch size {
	case 1:
		return sext8(uint32(c.rd8(addr)))
	case 2:
		return sext16(uint32(c.rd16(addr)))
	default:
		return c.rd32(addr)
	}
}

// store writes the low byte, word, or long of v using
// the matching bus width. size is 1, 2, or 4.
func (c *CPU) store(addr uint32, v uint32, size int) {
	switch size {
	case 1:
		c.wr8(addr, uint8(v))
	case 2:
		c.wr16(addr, uint16(v))
	default:
		c.wr32(addr, v)
	}
}

func sizeOf(low uint32) int {
	switch low {
	case 0, 4, 12:
		return 1
	case 1, 5, 13:
		return 2
	default:
		return 4
	}
}

// enterException pushes SR then the saved PC onto the
// stack (so the saved PC sits at Reg 15 and the saved SR
// at Reg 15 plus 4, matching RTE), then loads the PC
// from the vector slot at VBR plus vector times 4. The
// saved SR is the SR value from before any later change.
func (c *CPU) enterException(vector int, savedPC uint32) {
	sp := c.Reg[15]
	sp -= 4
	c.Reg[15] = sp
	c.bus.Write32(sp, c.SR)
	sp -= 4
	c.Reg[15] = sp
	c.bus.Write32(sp, savedPC)
	c.PC = c.bus.Read32(c.VBR + uint32(vector)*4)
}

// enterInterrupt is enterException plus the rule that
// an accepted interrupt sets the SR I field to the
// accepted level; the stack still holds the old SR.
func (c *CPU) enterInterrupt(vector int, savedPC uint32, level int) {
	c.enterException(vector, savedPC)
	c.setI(level)
}

// illegal raises the general illegal instruction
// exception, vector 4, saved PC at the instruction.
func (c *CPU) illegal(addr uint32) (int, bool) {
	c.enterException(4, addr)
	return 1, true
}

// Step executes one instruction and returns its nominal
// cycle count, which is also added to Cycles.
//
// Nominal counts used here: most register and immediate
// ops 1; loads and stores 2; the byte forms at GBR for
// the immediate logic group 3; MULU.W and MULS.W 1;
// MUL.L 2; DMULS.L and DMULU.L 2; MAC.W and MAC.L 3;
// DIV steps 1; BF and BT cost 3 taken and 1 not taken;
// BF/S and BT/S cost 2 taken and 1 not taken (a not
// taken form skips its delay slot); other delayed
// branches cost 2, including their delay slot in this
// simple model; TRAPA 4. An interrupt accepted at the
// Step boundary costs 4 and the handler instruction
// itself runs on a later Step. While Sleeping, Step
// returns 1 without fetching until a wakeup is accepted.
func (c *CPU) Step() int {
	n := c.stepInner()
	c.Cycles += uint64(n)
	return n
}

func (c *CPU) stepInner() (cycles int) {
	cycles = 1
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			if ae, ok := r.(addrError); ok {
				c.Sleeping = false
				c.enterException(7, ae.instr)
				cycles = 1
				return
			}
			panic(r)
		}
	}()
	if c.pendNMI {
		c.pendNMI = false
		c.Sleeping = false
		c.enterInterrupt(11, c.PC, 15)
		return 4
	}
	if c.pendValid && c.pendLevel > c.getI() {
		level := c.pendLevel
		vector := c.pendVector
		c.pendValid = false
		c.Sleeping = false
		c.enterInterrupt(vector, c.PC, level)
		return 4
	}
	if c.Sleeping {
		return 1
	}
	addr := c.PC
	c.cur = addr
	op := c.fetch(addr)
	n, _ := c.exec(op, addr)
	return n
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/chips/sh2/sh2_test.go ====================

package sh2

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"testing"
)

// ram is a flat big endian memory mock, 64 KiB.
type ram struct {
	b []byte
}

func newRAM() *ram {
	return &ram{b: make([]byte, 0x10000)}
}

func (r *ram) Read8(addr uint32) uint8 {
	return r.b[addr&0xFFFF]
}

func (r *ram) Read16(addr uint32) uint16 {
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint16(r.b[addr&0xFFFF:])
}

func (r *ram) Read32(addr uint32) uint32 {
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint32(r.b[addr&0xFFFF:])
}

func (r *ram) Write8(addr uint32, v uint8) {
	r.b[addr&0xFFFF] = v
}

func (r *ram) Write16(addr uint32, v uint16) {
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(r.b[addr&0xFFFF:], v)
}

func (r *ram) Write32(addr uint32, v uint32) {
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(r.b[addr&0xFFFF:], v)
}

func (r *ram) put16(addr uint32, v uint16) { r.Write16(addr, v) }
func (r *ram) put32(addr uint32, v uint32) { r.Write32(addr, v) }
func (r *ram) get32(addr uint32) uint32    { return r.Read32(addr) }

// prog loads instruction words at base and returns a
// CPU reset to base with a stack at 0x8000.
func prog(words []uint16) (*CPU, *ram) {
	r := newRAM()
	base := uint32(0x1000)
	for i, w := range words {
		r.put16(base+uint32(i*2), w)
	}
	c := New(r)
	c.Reset(base, 0x8000)
	return c, r
}

func eq(t *testing.T, what string, got, want uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	if got != want {
		t.Errorf("%s: got 0x%08X, want 0x%08X", what, got, want)
	}
}

func eqB(t *testing.T, what string, got, want bool) {
	t.Helper()
	if got != want {
		t.Errorf("%s: got %v, want %v", what, got, want)
	}
}

func stepN(c *CPU, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i += 1 {
		c.Step()
	}
}

// Opcode builders, in the manual field order Rn, Rm.
func op0(n, m, low int) uint16 { return uint16(0x0000 | n<<8 | m<<4 | low) }
func op2(n, m, low int) uint16 { return uint16(0x2000 | n<<8 | m<<4 | low) }
func op3(n, m, low int) uint16 { return uint16(0x3000 | n<<8 | m<<4 | low) }
func op4(n, lowByte int) uint16 {
	return uint16(0x4000 | n<<8 | lowByte)
}
func op6(n, m, low int) uint16 { return uint16(0x6000 | n<<8 | m<<4 | low) }
func movImm(n, imm int) uint16 { return uint16(0xE000 | n<<8 | imm&0xFF) }

func TestReset(t *testing.T) {
	c, _ := prog(nil)
	eq(t, "reset SR", c.SR, 0x400000F0)
	eq(t, "reset VBR", c.VBR, 0)
	eq(t, "reset PC", c.PC, 0x1000)
	eq(t, "reset SP", c.Reg[15], 0x8000)
	eq(t, "serialize size", uint32(len(c.Serialize())), SerializeSize)
	if err := c.Deserialize(make([]byte, 10)); err == nil {
		t.Errorf("short deserialize: got nil error, want an error")
	}
}

func TestMOVAddressing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("post increment load", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 6)})
		r.put32(0x2000, 0x11223344)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "loaded", c.Reg[2], 0x11223344)
		eq(t, "pointer", c.Reg[1], 0x2004)
	})
	t.Run("pre decrement store", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op2(1, 2, 6)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2004
		c.Reg[2] = 0xAABBCCDD
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "stored", r.get32(0x2000), 0xAABBCCDD)
		eq(t, "pointer", c.Reg[1], 0x2000)
	})
	t.Run("indexed load and store", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op0(3, 1, 14), op0(5, 4, 4)})
		r.put32(0x2004, 0x55667788)
		c.Reg[0] = 4
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "indexed loaded", c.Reg[3], 0x55667788)
		c.Reg[0] = 3
		c.Reg[5] = 0x2000
		c.Reg[4] = 0xAB
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "indexed stored byte", uint32(r.Read8(0x2003)), 0xAB)
	})
	t.Run("disp4 load and store", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x5611, 0x1162})
		r.put32(0x2004, 0x0BADF00D)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "disp4 loaded", c.Reg[6], 0x0BADF00D)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "disp4 stored", r.get32(0x2008), 0x0BADF00D)
	})
	t.Run("gbr disp store and load", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xC202, 0xE000, 0xC602})
		c.GBR = 0x2000
		c.Reg[0] = 0x12345678
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "gbr stored", r.get32(0x2008), 0x12345678)
		stepN(c, 2)
		eq(t, "gbr loaded", c.Reg[0], 0x12345678)
	})
	t.Run("pc relative word load sign extends", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x9706})
		r.put16(0x1010, 0x8001)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "pc word", c.Reg[7], 0xFFFF8001)
	})
	t.Run("pc relative long load", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xD804})
		r.put32(0x1014, 0xCAFEBABE)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "pc long", c.Reg[8], 0xCAFEBABE)
	})
	t.Run("mova", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0xC703})
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mova", c.Reg[0], 0x1010)
	})
	t.Run("mov immediate sign extends", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{movImm(3, -1)})
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mov imm", c.Reg[3], 0xFFFFFFFF)
	})
	t.Run("movt real encoding, and 0009 is nop", func(t *testing.T) {
		// The SH-2 manual gives MOVT the 0x0n29 encoding
		// and 0x0009 is NOP, changing no register. The
		// zero form was treated as MOVT R0 in SAT-1 by
		// direction; SAT-4 corrects it to the manual
		// (NOP delay slots must not corrupt R0).
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x0018, 0x0529, 0x0009})
		stepN(c, 1)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "movt with T set", c.Reg[5], 1)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "opcode 0009 is nop, r0 untouched", c.Reg[0], 0)
	})
	t.Run("swap byte and word", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 8), op6(3, 1, 9)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x11223344
		stepN(c, 2)
		eq(t, "swap.b", c.Reg[2], 0x11224433)
		eq(t, "swap.w", c.Reg[3], 0x33441122)
	})
	t.Run("xtrct", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op2(2, 1, 13)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xAABBCCDD
		c.Reg[2] = 0x11223344
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "xtrct", c.Reg[2], 0xCCDD1122)
	})
	t.Run("byte and word loads sign extend", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 0), op6(3, 1, 1)})
		r.Write8(0x2000, 0x80)
		r.put16(0x2002, 0x8000)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "byte load", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFF80)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2002
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "word load", c.Reg[3], 0xFFFF8000)
	})
	t.Run("disp4 byte and word with r0 in group 8", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x8013, 0x8112, 0xE000, 0x8413, 0x8512})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		c.Reg[0] = 0x7F01
		stepN(c, 2)
		eq(t, "disp byte stored", uint32(r.Read8(0x2003)), 0x01)
		eq(t, "disp word stored", uint32(r.Read16(0x2004)), 0x7F01)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "r0 cleared", c.Reg[0], 0)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "disp byte loaded", c.Reg[0], 1)
	})
}

func TestArithmetic(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("add and sub", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op3(1, 2, 12), op3(1, 2, 8)})
		c.Reg[1] = 30
		c.Reg[2] = 12
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "add", c.Reg[1], 42)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sub", c.Reg[1], 30)
	})
	t.Run("addc chain", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x0018, op3(1, 2, 14), op3(3, 2, 14)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		c.Reg[3] = 0
		stepN(c, 3)
		eq(t, "addc low", c.Reg[1], 1)
		eq(t, "addc high", c.Reg[3], 2)
		eq(t, "addc final T", c.SR&1, 0)
	})
	t.Run("subc chain", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x0018, op3(1, 2, 10), op3(3, 2, 10)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		c.Reg[2] = 0
		c.Reg[3] = 5
		stepN(c, 3)
		eq(t, "subc low", c.Reg[1], 0xFFFFFFFF)
		eq(t, "subc high", c.Reg[3], 4)
		eq(t, "subc final T", c.SR&1, 0)
	})
	t.Run("addv overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op3(1, 2, 15)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x7FFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "addv result", c.Reg[1], 0x80000000)
		eq(t, "addv T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("subv overflow", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op3(1, 2, 11)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x80000000
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "subv result", c.Reg[1], 0x7FFFFFFF)
		eq(t, "subv T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("cmp family", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{
			op3(1, 2, 0), op3(1, 2, 2), op3(1, 2, 3),
			op3(1, 2, 6), op3(1, 2, 7), op2(1, 2, 12),
		})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp eq true", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp hs true", c.SR&1, 1)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp ge false for minus one vs one", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.Reg[1] = 2
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp hi true", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp gt false signed", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x11223344
		c.Reg[2] = 0x99003399
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp str byte match", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("logic register ops", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op2(1, 2, 9), op2(1, 2, 10), op2(1, 2, 11), op2(1, 2, 8)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFF0F
		c.Reg[2] = 0x0FF0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "and", c.Reg[1], 0x0F00)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFF00
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "xor", c.Reg[1], 0xF0F0)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xF000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "or", c.Reg[1], 0xFFF0)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xF0F0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "tst nonzero clears T", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		c.Reg[2] = 0xFFFF
		c.PC = 0x1006
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "tst zero sets T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("add immediate negative", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x71FB})
		c.Reg[1] = 10
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "add imm", c.Reg[1], 5)
	})
}

func TestImmediateLogicAndGBRByte(t *testing.T) {
	c, r := prog([]uint16{0xC8F0, 0xC93C, 0xCAFF, 0xCB01, 0xCD3C, 0xCF01, 0xCEFF, 0xCC0F})
	c.Reg[0] = 0x0F
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "tst imm sets T", c.SR&1, 1)
	c.Reg[0] = 0xFF
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "and imm", c.Reg[0], 0x3C)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "xor imm", c.Reg[0], 0xC3)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "or imm", c.Reg[0], 0xC3)
	c.GBR = 0x2000
	c.Reg[0] = 0x10
	r.Write8(0x2010, 0x0F)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "and.b at gbr", uint32(r.Read8(0x2010)), 0x0C)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "or.b at gbr", uint32(r.Read8(0x2010)), 0x0D)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "xor.b at gbr", uint32(r.Read8(0x2010)), 0xF2)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "tst.b at gbr T", c.SR&1, 0)
	c2, _ := prog([]uint16{0x8805})
	c2.Reg[0] = 5
	stepN(c2, 1)
	eq(t, "cmp eq imm", c2.SR&1, 1)
}

// divProgram builds the manual style division sequence.
// Signed: example sequence for a 32 bit signed dividend
// in R2 by R0, quotient ending in R2, with the original
// dividend saved in R4 so the remainder can be formed
// as dividend minus divisor times quotient in R6.
// Unsigned: DIV0U form with the high word R1 zeroed,
// quotient ending in R2, original saved in R4, and the
// remainder likewise formed in R6.
func divProgram(signed bool) []uint16 {
	w := []uint16{op6(4, 2, 3)}
	if signed {
		w = append(w, op6(3, 2, 3), op4(3, 0x24), op3(1, 1, 10),
			op2(3, 3, 10), op3(2, 3, 10), op2(1, 0, 7))
	} else {
		w = append(w, 0x0019)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 32; i += 1 {
		w = append(w, op4(2, 0x24), op3(1, 0, 4))
	}
	w = append(w, op4(2, 0x24))
	if signed {
		w = append(w, op3(2, 3, 14))
	}
	w = append(w, op0(2, 0, 7), 0x051A, op6(6, 4, 3), op3(6, 5, 8))
	return w
}

func TestDivision(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("div0s and div0u flags", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op2(1, 0, 7), 0x0019})
		c.Reg[0] = 0x80000000
		c.Reg[1] = 5
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "div0s M", (c.SR>>9)&1, 1)
		eq(t, "div0s Q", (c.SR>>8)&1, 0)
		eq(t, "div0s T", c.SR&1, 1)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "div0u MQT clear", c.SR&0x0301, 0)
	})
	t.Run("unsigned 100 by 7", func(t *testing.T) {
		w := divProgram(false)
		c, _ := prog(w)
		c.Reg[0] = 7
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		c.Reg[2] = 100
		stepN(c, len(w))
		wantQ := uint32(100 / 7)
		wantR := uint32(100 % 7)
		eq(t, "unsigned quotient", c.Reg[2], wantQ)
		eq(t, "unsigned remainder", c.Reg[6], wantR)
	})
	t.Run("signed minus 100 by 7", func(t *testing.T) {
		w := divProgram(true)
		c, _ := prog(w)
		c.Reg[0] = 7
		c.Reg[2] = 0xFFFFFF9C
		stepN(c, len(w))
		wantQ := int64(-100) / 7
		wantR := int64(-100) % 7
		eq(t, "signed quotient", c.Reg[2], uint32(int32(wantQ)))
		eq(t, "signed remainder", c.Reg[6], uint32(int32(wantR)))
	})
	t.Run("signed 100 by minus 7", func(t *testing.T) {
		w := divProgram(true)
		c, _ := prog(w)
		c.Reg[0] = 0xFFFFFFF9
		c.Reg[2] = 100
		stepN(c, len(w))
		eq(t, "signed quotient neg divisor", c.Reg[2], 0xFFFFFFF2)
		eq(t, "signed remainder neg divisor", c.Reg[6], uint32(int32(2)))
	})
}

func TestMultiplyAndMAC(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("mul.l and word multiplies", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op0(2, 1, 7), op2(3, 1, 14), op2(4, 1, 15)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFD
		c.Reg[2] = 7
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mul.l macl", c.MACL, 0xFFFFFFEB)
		c.Reg[3] = 0x0000FFFF
		c.Reg[1] = 3
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mulu.w macl", c.MACL, 0x0002FFFD)
		c.Reg[4] = 0x0000FFFF
		c.Reg[1] = 3
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "muls.w macl", c.MACL, 0xFFFFFFFD)
	})
	t.Run("dmuls and dmulu", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op3(2, 1, 13), op3(2, 1, 5)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFD
		c.Reg[2] = 7
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "dmuls mach", c.MACH, 0xFFFFFFFF)
		eq(t, "dmuls macl", c.MACL, 0xFFFFFFEB)
		c.Reg[1] = 0xFFFFFFFF
		c.Reg[2] = 2
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "dmulu mach", c.MACH, 1)
		eq(t, "dmulu macl", c.MACL, 0xFFFFFFFE)
	})
	t.Run("mac.w accumulates and advances", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x421F, 0x421F})
		r.put16(0x2000, 5)
		r.put16(0x2002, 2)
		r.put16(0x2100, 0xFFFA)
		r.put16(0x2102, 10)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		c.Reg[2] = 0x2100
		c.MACL = 100
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mac.w first sum", c.MACL, 70)
		eq(t, "mac.w ptr m", c.Reg[1], 0x2002)
		eq(t, "mac.w ptr n", c.Reg[2], 0x2102)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mac.w second sum", c.MACL, 90)
	})
	t.Run("mac.l accumulates and advances", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op0(2, 1, 15)})
		r.put32(0x2000, 0xFFFFFFFD)
		r.put32(0x2100, 7)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		c.Reg[2] = 0x2100
		c.MACL = 100
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mac.l sum", c.MACL, 79)
		eq(t, "mac.l ptr m", c.Reg[1], 0x2004)
		eq(t, "mac.l ptr n", c.Reg[2], 0x2104)
	})
	t.Run("mac.l same register advances twice", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op0(1, 1, 15)})
		r.put32(0x2000, 3)
		r.put32(0x2004, 4)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mac.l same reg sum", c.MACL, 12)
		eq(t, "mac.l same reg ptr", c.Reg[1], 0x2008)
	})
	t.Run("mac.w saturation clamps high", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x421F})
		r.put16(0x2000, 16)
		r.put16(0x2100, 2)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
		c.Reg[2] = 0x2100
		c.SR |= 0x00000002
		c.MACH = 0x00007FFF
		c.MACL = 0xFFFFFFF0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "mac.w sat mach", c.MACH, 0x00007FFF)
		eq(t, "mac.w sat macl", c.MACL, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	})
	t.Run("clrmac", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x0028})
		c.MACH = 9
		c.MACL = 9
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "clrmac mach", c.MACH, 0)
		eq(t, "clrmac macl", c.MACL, 0)
	})
}

func TestShiftsAndRotates(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("one bit shifts", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x00), op4(1, 0x01), op4(1, 0x21)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x80000001
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shll result", c.Reg[1], 2)
		eq(t, "shll T", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 3
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shlr result", c.Reg[1], 1)
		eq(t, "shlr T", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x80000003
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shar result", c.Reg[1], 0xC0000001)
		eq(t, "shar T", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("rotates", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x04), op4(1, 0x05), op4(1, 0x24), op4(1, 0x25)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x80000000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rotl result", c.Reg[1], 1)
		eq(t, "rotl T", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rotr result", c.Reg[1], 0x80000000)
		eq(t, "rotr T", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.SR |= 1
		c.Reg[1] = 0x40000000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rotcl result", c.Reg[1], 0x80000001)
		eq(t, "rotcl T", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.SR &^= 1
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rotcr result", c.Reg[1], 0)
		eq(t, "rotcr T", c.SR&1, 0)
	})
	t.Run("multi bit shifts keep T", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x08), op4(1, 0x29), op4(1, 0x28), op4(1, 0x19)})
		c.SR |= 1
		c.Reg[1] = 0x12345678
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shll2", c.Reg[1], 0x48D159E0)
		eq(t, "shll2 T kept", c.SR&1, 1)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x12345678
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shlr16", c.Reg[1], 0x00001234)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x00001234
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shll16", c.Reg[1], 0x12340000)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x12345678
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "shlr8", c.Reg[1], 0x00123456)
	})
	t.Run("cmp pz and pl", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x11), op4(1, 0x15), op4(1, 0x11), op4(1, 0x15)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp pz zero", c.SR&1, 1)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp pl zero", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x80000000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp pz negative", c.SR&1, 0)
		c.Reg[1] = 7
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "cmp pl positive", c.SR&1, 1)
	})
	t.Run("dt loop counts down", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(5, 0x10), 0x8BFD})
		c.Reg[5] = 4
		steps := 0
		for c.PC != 0x1004 && steps < 40 {
			c.Step()
			steps += 1
		}
		eq(t, "dt final value", c.Reg[5], 0)
		eq(t, "dt loop steps", uint32(steps), 8)
	})
}

func TestTAS(t *testing.T) {
	c, r := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x1B), op4(1, 0x1B)})
	r.Write8(0x2000, 0)
	c.Reg[1] = 0x2000
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "tas zero T", c.SR&1, 1)
	eq(t, "tas zero byte", uint32(r.Read8(0x2000)), 0x80)
	r.Write8(0x2000, 0x05)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eq(t, "tas nonzero T", c.SR&1, 0)
	eq(t, "tas nonzero byte", uint32(r.Read8(0x2000)), 0x85)
}

func TestBranches(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("bra executes delay slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0xA001, movImm(1, 7), movImm(2, 9), movImm(3, 3)})
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "bra slot ran", c.Reg[1], 7)
		eq(t, "bra target pc", c.PC, 0x1006)
		eq(t, "bra skipped word", c.Reg[2], 0)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "bra landed", c.Reg[3], 3)
	})
	t.Run("bsr sets pr and runs slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0xB001, movImm(1, 7), movImm(2, 9), movImm(3, 3)})
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "bsr pr", c.PR, 0x1004)
		eq(t, "bsr slot ran", c.Reg[1], 7)
		eq(t, "bsr pc", c.PC, 0x1006)
	})
	t.Run("jmp and jsr register forms", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x2B), movImm(5, 5), movImm(6, 6), movImm(7, 7)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x1008
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "jmp slot ran", c.Reg[5], 5)
		eq(t, "jmp pc", c.PC, 0x1008)
		c2, _ := prog([]uint16{op4(1, 0x0B), movImm(5, 5), movImm(6, 6), movImm(7, 7)})
		c2.Reg[1] = 0x1008
		stepN(c2, 1)
		eq(t, "jsr pr", c2.PR, 0x1004)
		eq(t, "jsr pc", c2.PC, 0x1008)
	})
	t.Run("braf form", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{op0(1, 0, 3) | 0x0020, movImm(5, 5), movImm(6, 6), movImm(7, 7)})
		c.Reg[1] = 0x1008
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "braf pc", c.PC, 0x1008)
		eq(t, "braf slot ran", c.Reg[5], 5)
	})
	t.Run("rts uses pr and runs slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x000B, movImm(5, 5), movImm(6, 6)})
		c.PR = 0x1006
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rts pc", c.PC, 0x1006)
		eq(t, "rts slot ran", c.Reg[5], 5)
	})
	t.Run("bt s not taken skips delay slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x8D02, movImm(1, 7), movImm(2, 5)})
		n := c.Step()
		eq(t, "bt s not taken cost", uint32(n), 1)
		eq(t, "bt s slot skipped", c.Reg[1], 0)
		eq(t, "bt s fallthrough pc", c.PC, 0x1004)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "bt s next ran", c.Reg[2], 5)
	})
	t.Run("bt s taken runs delay slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x8D01, movImm(1, 7), movImm(2, 9), movImm(3, 3)})
		c.SR |= 1
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "bt s taken slot ran", c.Reg[1], 7)
		eq(t, "bt s taken pc", c.PC, 0x1006)
	})
	t.Run("bf non delayed", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x8B01, movImm(1, 7), movImm(2, 9), movImm(3, 3)})
		n := c.Step()
		eq(t, "bf taken cost", uint32(n), 3)
		eq(t, "bf taken pc", c.PC, 0x1006)
		eq(t, "bf has no delay slot", c.Reg[1], 0)
	})
	t.Run("slot illegal lands at vector 6", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xA001, 0xA000, movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(6*4, 0x3000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "slot illegal pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "slot illegal sp", c.Reg[15], 0x8000-8)
		eq(t, "slot illegal saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1002)
		eq(t, "slot illegal saved sr", r.get32(0x8000-4), 0x400000F0)
		eq(t, "slot illegal slot not run", c.Reg[1], 0)
	})
	t.Run("rte restores and runs slot", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x002B, movImm(9, 9)})
		r.put32(0x8000, 0x5000)
		r.put32(0x8004, 0x00000001)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rte pc", c.PC, 0x5000)
		eq(t, "rte sr", c.SR, 1)
		eq(t, "rte sp", c.Reg[15], 0x8008)
		eq(t, "rte slot ran", c.Reg[9], 9)
	})
}

func TestExceptionsAndInterrupts(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("trapa frame and vector", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xC340})
		r.put32(48*4, 0x3000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "trapa pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "trapa sp", c.Reg[15], 0x8000-8)
		eq(t, "trapa saved pc is next", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1002)
		eq(t, "trapa saved sr", r.get32(0x8000-4), 0x400000F0)
	})
	t.Run("illegal opcode ffff vector 4", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xFFFF})
		r.put32(4*4, 0x3000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "illegal pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "illegal saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1000)
	})
	t.Run("illegal 3 group low 1", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op3(1, 0, 1)})
		r.put32(4*4, 0x3000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "illegal low1 pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
	})
	t.Run("illegal top f forms", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0xF000})
		r.put32(4*4, 0x3000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "illegal f pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
	})
	t.Run("misaligned word load vector 7", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op6(2, 1, 1)})
		r.put32(7*4, 0x3000)
		c.Reg[1] = 0x2001
		c.Reg[2] = 0xDEADBEEF
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "addr error pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "addr error saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1000)
		eq(t, "addr error dest unchanged", c.Reg[2], 0xDEADBEEF)
	})
	t.Run("misaligned fetch vector 7", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(7*4, 0x3000)
		c.PC = 0x1001
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "fetch addr error pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "fetch addr error saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1001)
	})
	t.Run("interrupt accepted above mask", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(64*4, 0x3000)
		r.put16(0x3000, 0x002B)
		r.put16(0x3002, movImm(2, 2))
		c.SR = 0x40000030
		eqB(t, "interrupt latched", c.Interrupt(5, 64), true)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "interrupt pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "interrupt saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1000)
		eq(t, "interrupt saved sr", r.get32(0x8000-4), 0x40000030)
		eq(t, "interrupt new I field", (c.SR>>4)&0x0F, 5)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "rte returns pc", c.PC, 0x1000)
		eq(t, "rte returns sr", c.SR, 0x40000030)
		eq(t, "rte sp restored", c.Reg[15], 0x8000)
		eq(t, "rte slot ran", c.Reg[2], 2)
	})
	t.Run("interrupt masked at or below I field stays pending", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{movImm(1, 1), movImm(3, 3)})
		r.put32(64*4, 0x3000)
		c.SR = 0x40000030
		eqB(t, "masked latched", c.Interrupt(3, 64), true)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "masked not taken, instr ran", c.Reg[1], 1)
		eq(t, "masked not taken pc", c.PC, 0x1002)
		c.SR = 0x40000010
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "later accepted pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "later accepted saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1002)
	})
	t.Run("interrupt argument checks and highest kept", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(20*4, 0x3000)
		eqB(t, "level zero rejected", c.Interrupt(0, 10), false)
		eqB(t, "vector too big rejected", c.Interrupt(5, 200), false)
		eqB(t, "level five latched", c.Interrupt(5, 10), true)
		eqB(t, "level nine takes the slot", c.Interrupt(9, 20), true)
		eqB(t, "level seven not kept", c.Interrupt(7, 30), false)
		c.SR = 0x40000000
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "highest vector used", c.PC, 0x3000)
	})
	t.Run("nmi taken with mask 15", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(11*4, 0x3000)
		c.RaiseNMI()
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "nmi pc", c.PC, 0x3000)
		eq(t, "nmi I field 15", (c.SR>>4)&0x0F, 15)
		eq(t, "nmi saved pc", r.get32(0x8000-8), 0x1000)
		eq(t, "nmi instr not run", c.Reg[1], 0)
	})
}

func TestSystemTransfers(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("stc and ldc round trip", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x0102, 0x0212, 0x0322, op4(3, 0x0E), 0x0102})
		c.GBR = 0x6000
		c.VBR = 0x200
		stepN(c, 3)
		eq(t, "stc sr", c.Reg[1], 0x400000F0)
		eq(t, "stc gbr", c.Reg[2], 0x6000)
		eq(t, "stc vbr", c.Reg[3], 0x200)
		c.Reg[3] = 0x00000123
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "ldc sr stored as given", c.SR, 0x123)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "stc sr again", c.Reg[1], 0x123)
	})
	t.Run("sts and lds round trip", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, _ := prog([]uint16{0x040A, 0x041A, 0x042A, op4(5, 0x0A), op4(5, 0x2A), 0x042A})
		c.MACH = 0x11111111
		c.MACL = 0x22222222
		c.PR = 0x33333333
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sts mach", c.Reg[4], 0x11111111)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sts macl", c.Reg[4], 0x22222222)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sts pr", c.Reg[4], 0x33333333)
		c.Reg[5] = 0x44444444
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "lds mach", c.MACH, 0x44444444)
		c.Reg[5] = 0x55555555
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "lds pr", c.PR, 0x55555555)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sts pr after lds", c.Reg[4], 0x55555555)
	})
	t.Run("sts.l and lds.l through the stack", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x4F22, 0x4F26})
		c.PR = 0x77777777
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "sts.l stored", r.get32(0x7FFC), 0x77777777)
		eq(t, "sts.l sp", c.Reg[15], 0x7FFC)
		c.PR = 0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "lds.l loaded pr", c.PR, 0x77777777)
		eq(t, "lds.l sp", c.Reg[15], 0x8000)
	})
	t.Run("stc.l and ldc.l round trip sr", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{0x4F03, 0x4F07})
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "stc.l stored sr", r.get32(0x7FFC), 0x400000F0)
		c.SR = 0
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "ldc.l restored sr", c.SR, 0x400000F0)
		eq(t, "ldc.l sp", c.Reg[15], 0x8000)
	})
	t.Run("ldc to sr lowers mask and pending interrupt lands", func(t *testing.T) {
		c, r := prog([]uint16{op4(3, 0x0E), movImm(1, 1)})
		r.put32(40*4, 0x3000)
		c.Reg[3] = 0x40000000
		eqB(t, "pending while masked", c.Interrupt(4, 40), true)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "ldc ran not interrupt", c.SR, 0x40000000)
		stepN(c, 1)
		eq(t, "interrupt after ldc", c.PC, 0x3000)
	})
}

func TestSleep(t *testing.T) {
	c, r := prog([]uint16{0x001B, movImm(1, 1)})
	r.put32(33*4, 0x3000)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eqB(t, "sleeping set", c.Sleeping, true)
	eq(t, "sleep pc advanced", c.PC, 0x1002)
	n := c.Step()
	eq(t, "sleep step returns 1", uint32(n), 1)
	eq(t, "sleep pc held", c.PC, 0x1002)
	eq(t, "sleep instr not run", c.Reg[1], 0)
	c.SR = 0x40000000
	eqB(t, "wake latched", c.Interrupt(2, 33), true)
	stepN(c, 1)
	eqB(t, "sleeping cleared", c.Sleeping, false)
	eq(t, "wake lands at handler", c.PC, 0x3000)
}

func TestSerializeRoundTripMidProgram(t *testing.T) {
	words := []uint16{
		movImm(1, 10), movImm(2, 3), op3(1, 2, 12),
		op3(1, 2, 12), movImm(4, 7), op6(5, 1, 3),
	}
	a, _ := prog(words)
	b, _ := prog(words)
	stepN(a, 3)
	eqB(t, "a pending latched", a.Interrupt(4, 40), true)
	mid := a.Serialize()
	eq(t, "mid size", uint32(len(mid)), SerializeSize)
	stepN(b, 3)
	if err := b.Deserialize(mid); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("deserialize mid: %v", err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(mid, b.Serialize()) {
		t.Errorf("restored state differs from saved state")
	}
	stepN(a, 3)
	stepN(b, 3)
	fa := a.Serialize()
	fb := b.Serialize()
	eq(t, "a reached r5", a.Reg[5], 16)
	if !bytes.Equal(fa, fb) {
		t.Errorf("final states differ after restore")
	}
	eq(t, "step smoke returns at least 1", uint32(a.Step()), 1)
}


==================== FILE: cores/go-saturn/enginetest/asm.go ====================

package enginetest

// A tiny two pass SH-2 assembler, just large enough for
// the enginetest IP. Encodings follow the SH-2 hardware
// manual and were cross checked against the chips/sh2
// implementation in this module (in particular the load
// and store groups: MOV.L Rm,@Rn is 2nm2, the pre
// decrement store is 2nm6, MOV.L @Rm+,Rn is 6nm6).
//
// Branch and BSR displacements and PC relative literal
// loads are fixups resolved by Build. Literal loads bind
// to the next Pool flush after the load, so callers place
// Pool calls at dead fallthrough points (after an
// unconditional branch or an RTS) often enough that every
// literal stays within the 1020 byte forward reach of
// MOV.L @(disp,PC); Build reports any that do not.
//
// Delay slots are the caller's job: every branch, BSR,
// JMP and RTS emitted here must be followed by the
// instruction that belongs in its delay slot (a Nop in
// most of this program).

import "fmt"

type fixupKind int

const (
	fixBranch8 fixupKind = iota
	fixBranch12
	fixLiteral
)

type fixup struct {
	at    int // word index of the instruction
	kind  fixupKind
	label string
	lit   int // pending literal request index
}

type litRequest struct {
	value uint32
	addr  uint32 // resolved pool address, set at flush or Build
}

// Asm accumulates one SH-2 program at a fixed base
// address.
type Asm struct {
	base    uint32
	words   []uint16
	labels  map[string]uint32
	fixups  []fixup
	pending []litRequest
	poolSeq int
}

// NewAsm starts a program whose first word lands at base.
func NewAsm(base uint32) *Asm {
	return &Asm{
		base:   base,
		labels: make(map[string]uint32),
	}
}

func (a *Asm) pc() uint32 { return a.base + uint32(2*len(a.words)) }

// Emit appends one raw word.
func (a *Asm) Emit(w uint16) { a.words = append(a.words, w) }

// Label marks the current position with a name.
func (a *Asm) Label(name string) { a.labels[name] = a.pc() }

// Here returns the absolute address of the current
// position.
func (a *Asm) Here() uint32 { return a.pc() }

// Pool flushes the pending literal batch: every request
// not yet flushed is emitted at the next 4 byte boundary,
// deduplicated by value within the batch. The batch is
// preceded by a BRA over the data, so flushing is safe at
// fallthrough points as well as at dead points (after an
// unconditional branch or an RTS, where the BRA is simply
// unreachable). Calling Pool with nothing pending is a
// no-op.
func (a *Asm) Pool() {
	need := false
	for i := range a.pending {
		if a.pending[i].addr == 0 {
			need = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !need {
		return
	}
	if len(a.words)%2 != 0 {
		a.Emit(0x0009)
	}
	end := fmt.Sprintf("poolend%d", a.poolSeq)
	a.poolSeq++
	a.Bra(end)
	a.Nop()
	done := make(map[uint32]uint32)
	for i := range a.pending {
		if a.pending[i].addr != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if addr, ok := done[a.pending[i].value]; ok {
			a.pending[i].addr = addr
			continue
		}
		addr := a.pc()
		done[a.pending[i].value] = addr
		a.Emit(uint16(a.pending[i].value >> 16))
		a.Emit(uint16(a.pending[i].value))
		a.pending[i].addr = addr
	}
	a.Label(end)
}

// Words returns the assembled program so far (without
// resolving fixups); data builders use it for layout.
func (a *Asm) Words() []uint16 { return a.words }

// Build resolves every fixup and returns the finished
// program words. Any literal still pending is flushed at
// the end.
func (a *Asm) Build() ([]uint16, error) {
	a.Pool()
	// Requests made after the last manual Pool flush were
	// flushed by the Pool call above; their addresses are
	// recorded in the requests themselves.
	out := append([]uint16(nil), a.words...)
	for _, f := range a.fixups {
		insnAddr := a.base + uint32(2*f.at)
		switch f.kind {
		case fixBranch8, fixBranch12:
			target, ok := a.labels[f.label]
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: undefined label %q", f.label)
			}
			diff := int32(target) - int32(insnAddr+4)
			if diff%2 != 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: branch to %q is not word aligned", f.label)
			}
			d := diff / 2
			if f.kind == fixBranch8 {
				if d < -128 || d > 127 {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: short branch to %q out of range (%d words)", f.label, d)
				}
				out[f.at] |= uint16(byte(d))
			} else {
				if d < -2048 || d > 2047 {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: branch to %q out of range (%d words)", f.label, d)
				}
				out[f.at] |= uint16(d) & 0x0FFF
			}
		case fixLiteral:
			req := a.pending[f.lit]
			if req.addr == 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: literal %#x was never pooled", req.value)
			}
			base := (insnAddr + 4) &^ 3
			diff := int32(req.addr) - int32(base)
			if diff < 0 || diff%4 != 0 || diff/4 > 255 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("asm: literal %#x out of reach of its load (distance %d)", req.value, diff)
			}
			out[f.at] |= uint16(diff / 4)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func reg(r int) uint16 {
	if r < 0 || r > 15 {
		panic("asm: register out of range")
	}
	return uint16(r)
}

// Nop emits NOP (also the standard delay slot filler).
func (a *Asm) Nop() { a.Emit(0x0009) }

// Rts emits RTS; the caller supplies the delay slot.
func (a *Asm) Rts() { a.Emit(0x000B) }

// MovImm emits MOV #imm,Rn. The immediate is sign
// extended from 8 bits.
func (a *Asm) MovImm(rn int, imm int) {
	if imm < -128 || imm > 127 {
		panic("asm: MOV immediate out of range")
	}
	a.Emit(0xE000 | reg(rn)<<8 | uint16(byte(imm)))
}

// MovReg emits MOV Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) MovReg(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6003 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadL emits MOV.L @Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) LoadL(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6002 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadW emits MOV.W @Rm,Rn (sign extended).
func (a *Asm) LoadW(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6001 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadB emits MOV.B @Rm,Rn (sign extended).
func (a *Asm) LoadB(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6000 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadLInc emits MOV.L @Rm+,Rn.
func (a *Asm) LoadLInc(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6006 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadWInc emits MOV.W @Rm+,Rn.
func (a *Asm) LoadWInc(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6005 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// LoadBInc emits MOV.B @Rm+,Rn.
func (a *Asm) LoadBInc(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x6004 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// StoreL emits MOV.L Rm,@Rn (Rn is the address register).
func (a *Asm) StoreL(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x2002 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// StoreW emits MOV.W Rm,@Rn.
func (a *Asm) StoreW(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x2001 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// StoreB emits MOV.B Rm,@Rn.
func (a *Asm) StoreB(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x2000 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// StoreLDisp emits MOV.L Rm,@(disp,Rn); disp is a byte
// offset, a multiple of 4 in 0..60.
func (a *Asm) StoreLDisp(rn, rm int, disp int) {
	if disp < 0 || disp > 60 || disp%4 != 0 {
		panic("asm: bad long store displacement")
	}
	a.Emit(0x1000 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4 | uint16(disp/4))
}

// LoadLDisp emits MOV.L @(disp,Rm),Rn.
func (a *Asm) LoadLDisp(rn, rm int, disp int) {
	if disp < 0 || disp > 60 || disp%4 != 0 {
		panic("asm: bad long load displacement")
	}
	a.Emit(0x5000 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4 | uint16(disp/4))
}

// LoadLit emits MOV.L @(disp,PC),Rn for the constant v,
// resolved against the next Pool flush.
func (a *Asm) LoadLit(rn int, v uint32) {
	idx := -1
	for i := range a.pending {
		if a.pending[i].value == v && a.pending[i].addr == 0 {
			idx = i
			break
		}
	}
	if idx < 0 {
		a.pending = append(a.pending, litRequest{value: v})
		idx = len(a.pending) - 1
	}
	a.fixups = append(a.fixups, fixup{at: len(a.words), kind: fixLiteral, lit: idx})
	a.Emit(0xD000 | reg(rn)<<8)
}

// AddImm emits ADD #imm,Rn (sign extended 8 bit).
func (a *Asm) AddImm(rn int, imm int) {
	if imm < -128 || imm > 127 {
		panic("asm: ADD immediate out of range")
	}
	a.Emit(0x7000 | reg(rn)<<8 | uint16(byte(imm)))
}

// AddReg emits ADD Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) AddReg(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x300C | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// SubReg emits SUB Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) SubReg(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x3008 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// CmpEqImm emits CMP/EQ #imm,R0.
func (a *Asm) CmpEqImm(imm int) {
	if imm < -128 || imm > 127 {
		panic("asm: CMP immediate out of range")
	}
	a.Emit(0x8800 | uint16(byte(imm)))
}

// CmpEq emits CMP/EQ Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) CmpEq(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x3000 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// CmpHS emits CMP/HS Rm,Rn (unsigned Rn >= Rm).
func (a *Asm) CmpHS(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x3002 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// CmpGE emits CMP/GE Rm,Rn (signed Rn >= Rm).
func (a *Asm) CmpGE(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x3003 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// TstImm emits TST #imm,R0: T is set when R0 AND imm is
// zero.
func (a *Asm) TstImm(imm int) { a.Emit(0xC800 | uint16(byte(imm))) }

// TstReg emits TST Rm,Rn: T is set when Rn AND Rm is zero.
func (a *Asm) TstReg(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x2008 | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }

// AndImm emits AND #imm,R0.

// OrReg emits OR Rm,Rn.
func (a *Asm) OrReg(rn, rm int) { a.Emit(0x200B | reg(rn)<<8 | reg(rm)<<4) }
