// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Online play: browse, create, and join lobbies on the iTaK lobby
// server. One box hosts, the other joins; the server introduces the
// two and relays for them. Game sessions run over the same link.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const String kServerBase = 'https://arcade.itak.live';

/// One game installed on this box, found by scanning the ROM
/// folders. Used by the Online screen to host or join a session:
/// both players must own the identical ROM file.
class LocalGame {
  final SystemInfo system;
  final File file;
  const LocalGame(this.system, this.file);

  String get fileName => file.path.split('/').last;

  String get display {
    final dot = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
    return dot > 0 ? fileName.substring(0, dot) : fileName;
  }
}

Future<List<LocalGame>> scanLocalGames() async {
  final out = <LocalGame>[];
  for (final sys in kSystems) {
    if (sys.requires64 && !gIs64Bit) continue;
    final dir = Directory('/sdcard/ROMs/${sys.dir}');
    if (await dir.exists()) {
      await for (final e in dir.list()) {
        if (e is File &&
            sys.exts.any((x) => e.path.toLowerCase().endsWith(x))) {
          out.add(LocalGame(sys, e));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => a.display.compareTo(b.display));
  return out;
}

class OnlineScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnlineScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<OnlineScreen> createState() => _OnlineScreenState();
}

class _OnlineScreenState extends State<OnlineScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  final FocusNode _focusNode = FocusNode();
  List<dynamic> _lobbies = [];
  List<dynamic> _friends = [];
  String _status = 'Connecting to the lobby server...';
  bool _online = false;
  // Focus rows: 0 = Create, 1 = Refresh, then one row per friend,
  // then two stops per lobby (Join, then Watch on the same card),
  // last = Back. The Friends and Open lobbies section labels sit
  // between the rows in the list but are not selectable, so they
  // own no focus index.
  int _sel = 0;
  Timer? _ticker;
  final ScrollController _listScroll = ScrollController();
  final Map<int, GlobalKey> _rowKeys = {};

  int get _itemCount => _lobbies.length * 2 + _friends.length + 3;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _refresh();
    _ticker =
        Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 5), (_) => _refresh());
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _focusNode.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ticker?.cancel();
    _listScroll.dispose();
    _focusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // Keep the remote-selected lobby row on screen as selection moves.
  void _scrollToSel() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final ctx = _rowKeys[_sel]?.currentContext;
      if (ctx != null) {
        Scrollable.ensureVisible(
          ctx,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<dynamic> _api(String method, String path,
      [Map<String, dynamic>? body]) async {
    final client = HttpClient();
    client.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 6);
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$kServerBase$path');
      final req = method == 'POST'
          ? await client.postUrl(uri)
          : await client.getUrl(uri);
      if (body != null) {
        req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
        req.write(jsonEncode(body));
      }
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      final text = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      if (resp.statusCode >= 400) {
        throw Exception(text.isEmpty ? 'Error ${resp.statusCode}' : text);
      }
      return text.isEmpty ? null : jsonDecode(text);
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    // Friends ride the same cadence as the lobby list: loaded on
    // open (initState calls _refresh) and on every timed refresh.
    _loadFriends();
    try {
      final data = await _api('GET', '/lobbies');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _online = true;
        _lobbies = (data['lobbies'] as List?) ?? [];
        _status = _lobbies.isEmpty
            ? 'Server online. No open lobbies right now: create one and tell a friend to join.'
            : 'Server online. Pick a lobby to join, or create your own.';
        if (_sel >= _itemCount) _sel = _itemCount - 1;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _online = false;
        _status = 'Cannot reach the lobby server. It may be offline.';
      });
    }
  }

  // Friends of the current player, from the same server the
  // leaderboard uses. A failed load just leaves the section as it
  // was (empty on first open): no error noise over the lobby list.
  Future<void> _loadFriends() async {
    try {
      final player = await _playerName();
      final data = await _api(
          'GET', '/friends?player=${Uri.encodeQueryComponent(player)}');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _friends = (data['friends'] as List?) ?? [];
        if (_sel >= _itemCount) _sel = _itemCount - 1;
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // OK on a friend row. Someone in a lobby joins that lobby through
  // the normal join flow when the open lobby list has it (matched
  // by host or guest name); anything else just notes it in the
  // status line and stays on this screen.
  void _tapFriend(Map<String, dynamic> f) {
    final name = (f['name'] ?? '').toString();
    if (f['status'] != 'in_lobby') {
      setState(() => _status = '$name is not in a lobby right now');
      return;
    }
    Map<String, dynamic>? found;
    for (final l in _lobbies) {
      final m = l as Map<String, dynamic>;
      if (m['hostPlayer']?.toString() == name ||
          m['guestPlayer']?.toString() == name ||
          m['guest']?.toString() == name) {
        found = m;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (found == null) {
      // The friend is in a lobby the open list cannot offer (full,
      // already started, or private): say so and stay here.
      setState(() => _status = 'That lobby is not joinable right now');
      return;
    }
    _joinLobby(found);
  }

  Future<String> _playerName() async {
    final p = await Prefs.get('current_player');
    return (p == null || p.isEmpty) ? 'Player 1' : p;
  }

  Future<LocalGame?> _pickGame(List<LocalGame> games) {
    return showDialog<LocalGame>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: const Text('Pick the game to host'),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 560,
          height: 380,
          child: ListView.builder(
            itemCount: games.length,
            itemBuilder: (_, i) {
              final g = games[i];
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
                child: ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  child: Material(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
                    child: InkWell(
                      autofocus: i == 0,
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, g),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(g.display,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 19,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ),
                            Text(g.system.name,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white60)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ).then((v) {
      _focusNode.requestFocus();
      return v;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _launchOnline(LocalGame game,
      {required String role,
      required String lobbyId,
      required String token,
      String password = '',
      String tournament = ''}) async {
    await PlayStats.record(game.file.path);
    await _channel.invokeMethod('launch', {
      'core': game.system.core,
      'rom': game.file.path,
      'npRole': role,
      'npLobby': lobbyId,
      'npToken': token,
      'npServer': kServerBase,
      // The game screen keeps the password so a seat rotation
      // can re-enter the room (watch or join) on its own.
      'npPassword': password,
      // Only meaningful for the host: the game screen reports
      // the room's results to the tournament board under this
      // name. Guests launch with it blank and learn the name
      // from the host inside the room.
      'npTournament': tournament,
    });
  }

  Future<void> _createLobby() async {
    final player = await _playerName();
    if (!mounted) return;
    final games = await scanLocalGames();
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (games.isEmpty) {
      _showMessage('No games on this box',
          'There are no games to host. Add games first, then come back.');
      return;
    }
    final game = await _pickGame(games);
    if (game == null || !mounted) return;
    final password = await showTvKeyboard(context,
        title: 'Password (blank = open to anyone)', initial: '');
    if (password == null || !mounted) return;
    final tournament = await showTvKeyboard(context,
        title: 'Tournament name (blank = casual game)', initial: '');
    if (tournament == null || !mounted) return;
    try {
      final data = await _api('POST', '/lobbies', {
        'name': "$player's lobby",
        'game': game.fileName,
        'hostPlayer': player,
        'password': password,
      });
      if (!mounted) return;
      final lobbyId = (data['id'] ?? data['lobby']?['id'] ?? '').toString();
      final token = (data['hostToken'] ?? '').toString();
      if (lobbyId.isEmpty || token.isEmpty) {
        _showMessage('Could not create the lobby',
            'The server did not send a lobby id. Try again.');
        return;
      }
      appLog('lobby created: $lobbyId for ${game.fileName} by $player');
      await _launchOnline(game,
          role: 'host',
          lobbyId: lobbyId,
          token: token,
          password: password,
          tournament: tournament.trim());
    } catch (e) {
      appLog('create lobby failed: $e');
      _showMessage('Could not create the lobby', '$e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _joinLobby(Map<String, dynamic> lobby) async {
    final player = await _playerName();
    if (!mounted) return;
    var password = '';
    if (lobby['locked'] == true) {
      final pw = await showTvKeyboard(context,
          title: 'Lobby password', initial: '');
      if (pw == null || !mounted) return;
      password = pw;
    }
    try {
      final data = await _api('POST', '/lobbies/${lobby['id']}/join', {
        'player': player,
        'password': password,
      });
      if (!mounted) return;
      final token = (data['guestToken'] ?? '').toString();
      if (token.isEmpty) {
        _showMessage('Could not join', 'The server did not send a token.');
        return;
      }
      final games = await scanLocalGames();
      LocalGame? match;
      for (final g in games) {
        if (g.fileName == lobby['game']) {
          match = g;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (match == null) {
        _showMessage('You do not have this game',
            '"${lobby['game']}" is not on this box. Both players need '
                'the same game file to play together.');
        return;
      }
      appLog(
          'lobby joined: ${lobby['id']} for ${match.fileName} by $player');
      await _launchOnline(match,
          role: 'guest',
          lobbyId: lobby['id'].toString(),
          token: token,
          password: password);
    } catch (e) {
      appLog('join lobby failed: $e');
      _showMessage('Could not join', '$e');
    }
  }

  // Watch a lobby without taking a seat: the server hands back a
  // spectator token, and the game screen reconstructs the match
  // locally from both players' inputs. Watching runs the same
  // game on this box, so the game file has to be in the library,
  // exactly like joining.
  Future<void> _watchLobby(Map<String, dynamic> lobby) async {
    final player = await _playerName();
    if (!mounted) return;
    var password = '';
    if (lobby['locked'] == true) {
      final pw = await showTvKeyboard(context,
          title: 'Lobby password', initial: '');
      if (pw == null || !mounted) return;
      password = pw;
    }
    try {
      final data = await _api('POST', '/lobbies/${lobby['id']}/watch', {
        'player': player,
        'password': password,
      });
      if (!mounted) return;
      final token = (data['spectatorToken'] ?? '').toString();
      if (token.isEmpty) {
        setState(() =>
            _status = 'The server did not send a spectator token.');
        return;
      }
      final games = await scanLocalGames();
      LocalGame? match;
      for (final g in games) {
        if (g.fileName == lobby['game']) {
          match = g;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (match == null) {
        setState(() =>
            _status = 'You need this game in your library to watch');
        return;
      }
      appLog(
          'watch joined: ${lobby['id']} for ${match.fileName} by $player');
      await _channel.invokeMethod('launch', {
        'core': match.system.core,
        'rom': match.file.path,
        'mode': 'watch',
        'serverBase': kServerBase,
        'lobbyId': lobby['id'].toString(),
        'token': token,
        'playerName': player,
        'npPassword': password,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      appLog('watch lobby failed: $e');
      if (!mounted) return;
      // The server's own words (bad password, room full of
      // watchers) belong on the status line, like a failed join.
      setState(() =>
          _status = e.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', ''));
    }
  }

  void _showMessage(String title, String body) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: Text(title),
        content: Text(body, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ).then((_) => _focusNode.requestFocus());
  }

  void _activate() {
    if (_sel == 0) {
      _createLobby();
    } else if (_sel == 1) {
      _refresh();
    } else if (_sel == _itemCount - 1) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    } else if (_sel < 2 + _friends.length) {
      _tapFriend(_friends[_sel - 2] as Map<String, dynamic>);
    } else {
      // Lobby stops come in pairs on one card: even offset is the
      // Join stop, odd offset is the Watch stop.
      final off = _sel - 2 - _friends.length;
      final lobby = _lobbies[off ~/ 2] as Map<String, dynamic>;
      if (off % 2 == 0) {
        _joinLobby(lobby);
      } else {
        _watchLobby(lobby);
      }
    }
  }

  void _onKey(KeyEvent event) {
    // Repeats count too, so holding UP or DOWN runs through the
    // lobby list instead of crawling one row per press.
    if (event is! KeyDownEvent && event is! KeyRepeatEvent) return;
    if (ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == false) return;
    final key = event.logicalKey;
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp) {
      setState(() => _sel = (_sel - 1 + _itemCount) % _itemCount);
      _scrollToSel();
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown) {
      setState(() => _sel = (_sel + 1) % _itemCount);
      _scrollToSel();
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA) {
      _activate();
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.escape ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonB ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.browserBack) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  Widget _actionButton(int index, IconData icon, String label,
      {bool primary = false}) {
    final focused = _sel == index;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _sel = index);
        _activate();
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 13),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: primary
              ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
              : const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused
                ? Colors.white
                : (primary ? Colors.white54 : Colors.white24),
            width: focused ? 3 : 1.5,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(icon,
                size: 20, color: primary ? Colors.black : Colors.white),
            const SizedBox(width: 9),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: primary ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // One small pill on a lobby card (Join / Watch). Each pill is
  // its own focus stop in the flat index walk; tapping it selects
  // the stop and fires its action at once.
  Widget _lobbyAction(
      int index, String label, VoidCallback action,
      {bool primary = false}) {
    final focused = _sel == index;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _sel = index);
        action();
      },
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: primary
              ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
              : const Color(0xFF23233A),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused
                ? Colors.white
                : (primary ? Colors.white54 : Colors.white24),
            width: focused ? 2.5 : 1.2,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 15.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: primary ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _lobbyRow(int lobbyIndex, Map<String, dynamic> lobby) {
    // The card owns two consecutive focus stops: Join, then Watch.
    final joinIndex = 2 + _friends.length + 2 * lobbyIndex;
    final watchIndex = joinIndex + 1;
    final focused = _sel == joinIndex || _sel == watchIndex;
    final locked = lobby['locked'] == true;
    final host = (lobby['hostPlayer'] ?? 'Player').toString();
    final spectators = (lobby['spectators'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    // Both stops scroll to this card, so they share its key.
    final cardKey = _rowKeys.putIfAbsent(joinIndex, () => GlobalKey());
    _rowKeys[watchIndex] = cardKey;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _sel = joinIndex);
        _joinLobby(lobby);
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        key: cardKey,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: focused
              ? const Color(0xFF23233A)
              : const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white12,
            width: focused ? 3 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            // Game tile.
            Container(
              width: 52,
              height: 52,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF2A2A4A),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.sports_esports,
                  size: 27, color: Color(0xFF00E676)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text('${lobby['name']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text('${lobby['game']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white70),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      PlayerAvatar(name: host, size: 20),
                      const SizedBox(width: 7),
                      Text('Host: $host',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white54)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 14),
            Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                // Open / Locked chip.
                Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: locked
                        ? Colors.amber.withOpacity(0.16)
                        : const Color(0xFF00E676).withOpacity(0.14),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: locked
                          ? Colors.amber.withOpacity(0.6)
                          : const Color(0xFF00E676).withOpacity(0.55),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(locked ? Icons.lock : Icons.lock_open,
                          size: 14,
                          color: locked
                              ? Colors.amber
                              : const Color(0xFF00E676)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 5),
                      Text(
                        locked ? 'Locked' : 'Open',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: locked
                              ? Colors.amber
                              : const Color(0xFF00E676),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.people, size: 16, color: Colors.white54),
                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                    Text(
                      '${lobby['players']}/${lobby['maxPlayers']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14.5, color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                if (spectators > 0) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.visibility,
                          size: 15, color: Colors.white54),
                      const SizedBox(width: 5),
                      Text(
                        '$spectators watching',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13.5, color: Colors.white54),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    _lobbyAction(
                        joinIndex, 'Join', () => _joinLobby(lobby),
                        primary: true),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    _lobbyAction(
                        watchIndex, 'Watch', () => _watchLobby(lobby)),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Section label over a group of rows in the list, with a count
  // chip. Labels are visual only: they own no focus index.
  Widget _sectionHeader(String label, int count) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 2),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white10,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
          ),
          child: Text(
            '$count',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: Colors.white70),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _friendRow(int index, Map<String, dynamic> f) {
    final focused = _sel == index;
    final name = (f['name'] ?? 'Player').toString();
    final display = (f['display'] ?? '').toString();
    final region = (f['region'] ?? '').toString();
    final inLobby = f['status'] == 'in_lobby';
    final game = (f['game'] ?? '').toString();
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _sel = index);
        _tapFriend(f);
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        key: _rowKeys.putIfAbsent(index, () => GlobalKey()),
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: focused
              ? const Color(0xFF23233A)
              : const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white12,
            width: focused ? 3 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            PlayerAvatar(name: name, size: 46),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          display.isNotEmpty ? display : name,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (region.isNotEmpty) ...[
                        const SizedBox(width: 9),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white10,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            region,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: Colors.white70),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.circle,
                          size: 11,
                          color: inLobby
                              ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
                              : Colors.white38),
                      const SizedBox(width: 7),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          inLobby
                              ? (game.isNotEmpty
                                  ? 'In lobby: $game'
                                  : 'In a lobby')
                              : 'Offline',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              color: inLobby
                                  ? Colors.white70
                                  : Colors.white54),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (inLobby)
              const Icon(Icons.play_circle_outline,
                  size: 26, color: Color(0xFF00E676)),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The lobby empty state, sized to live inside the shared list
  // under the Open lobbies label.

      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 72,
            height: 72,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.05),
              border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
            ),
            child: const Icon(Icons.sports_esports,
                size: 34, color: Colors.white38),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          const Text('No open lobbies right now',
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 19,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Colors.white70)),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          const Text(
            'Create one above and tell a friend to join. '
            'Both of you need the same game file.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white54),

          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: KeyboardListener(
        focusNode: _focusNode,
        onKeyEvent: _onKey,
        child: Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
              colors: [Color(0xFF2A1152), Color(0xFF140B2E), Color(0xFF0A1A33)],
            ),
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(58, 30, 58, 26),
            child: Column(

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Self-update: the server publishes /app/version.json plus the APK.
// The app compares version codes; the native side downloads the APK,
// verifies its SHA-256, and opens the system installer (Android
// always shows its own Install prompt; that press is the user's).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AppUpdateInfo {
  final int versionCode;
  final String versionName;
  final String sha256;
  final String notes;
  final int size; // APK bytes from version.json; 0 when unpublished
  const AppUpdateInfo(
      this.versionCode, this.versionName, this.sha256, this.notes, this.size);
}

class UpdateCheck {
  final int currentCode;
  final String currentName;
  final AppUpdateInfo? available;
  const UpdateCheck(this.currentCode, this.currentName, this.available);
}

class AppUpdate {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  static const _progressChannel =
      EventChannel('net.itak/emu/update_progress');

  /// Byte progress from the native downloader while install()
  /// runs: maps with int 'downloaded' and 'total' (total 0 means
  /// the size is unknown and the bar should stay indeterminate).
  static Stream<Map<String, int>> progress() {
    return _progressChannel.receiveBroadcastStream().map((e) {
      final m = (e as Map).map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v));
      return {
        'downloaded': (m['downloaded'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        'total': (m['total'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      };
    });
  }

  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> installed() async {
    try {
      final m = await _channel.invokeMethod<Map>('appInfo');
      return m?.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v));
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Null when the check itself failed (offline, server down).
  static Future<UpdateCheck?> check() async {
    final info = await installed();
    final code = (info?['versionCode'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    final name = info?['versionName']?.toString() ?? '';
    final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 6);
    try {
      final req =
          await client.getUrl(Uri.parse('$kServerBase/app/version.json'));
      req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.userAgentHeader, 'iTaK-Gaming/1.0');
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      if (resp.statusCode != 200) return UpdateCheck(code, name, null);
      final body = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      final j = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final latest = (j['versionCode'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      AppUpdateInfo? avail;
      if (latest > code) {
        avail = AppUpdateInfo(
          latest,
          j['versionName']?.toString() ?? '',
          j['sha256']?.toString() ?? '',
          j['notes']?.toString() ?? '',
          (j['size'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        );
      }
      return UpdateCheck(code, name, avail);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  /// "" = installer opened; "needs-permission"; else an error line.
  /// Always downloads the server's current latest.apk, so a box
  /// many builds behind jumps straight to the newest build in this
  /// one step; there is no version-by-version chain.
  static Future<String> install(AppUpdateInfo u) async {
    try {
      final r = await _channel.invokeMethod<String>('installUpdate', {
        'url': '$kServerBase/app/latest.apk',
        'sha256': u.sha256,
        'size': u.size,
      });
      return r ?? '';
    } catch (e) {
      return 'Update failed: $e';
    }
  }
}

/// One button of the update offer dialog. The focused button is
/// impossible to miss: it grows and turns white with black
/// text, while the others stay dark with light text. David
/// asked for this on 2026-10-15 after nearly hitting the wrong
/// choice on the TV: the old dialog's focus highlight was dim
/// and focus started on a live button, so one stray OK press
/// could install or dismiss by accident.
class _UpdateChoiceButton extends StatefulWidget {
  final String label;
  final VoidCallback onPressed;
  final bool autofocus;
  final bool small;

  const _UpdateChoiceButton({
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.autofocus = false,
    this.small = false,
  });

  @override
  State<_UpdateChoiceButton> createState() => _UpdateChoiceButtonState();
}

class _UpdateChoiceButtonState extends State<_UpdateChoiceButton> {
  final FocusNode _node = FocusNode();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _node.addListener(() => setState(() {}));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _node.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final focused = _node.hasFocus;
    return Transform.scale(
      scale: focused ? 1.12 : 1.0,
      child: TextButton(
        focusNode: _node,
        autofocus: widget.autofocus,
        onPressed: widget.onPressed,
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: focused ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF17172A),
          foregroundColor: focused ? Colors.black : Colors.white70,
          shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: widget.small ? 16 : 26, vertical: 12),
          textStyle: TextStyle(
              fontSize: widget.small ? 15 : 17,
              fontWeight: focused ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal),
        ),
        child: Text(widget.label),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The update offer (and retry) dialog. Three buttons, and
/// focus starts on the small middle one, which does nothing
/// but show a hint line. Installing or dismissing takes a
/// deliberate move left or right first.
class _UpdateOfferDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final String leftLabel;
  final String rightLabel;
  // Old version on the left, new version on the right (David,
  // 2026-10-15): people should see the change they are making.
  final String fromVersion;
  final String toVersion;

  const _UpdateOfferDialog({
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    required this.leftLabel,
    required this.rightLabel,
    this.fromVersion = '',
    this.toVersion = '',
  });

  @override
  State<_UpdateOfferDialog> createState() => _UpdateOfferDialogState();
}

class _UpdateOfferDialogState extends State<_UpdateOfferDialog> {
  bool _showHint = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
      title: Text(widget.title),
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (widget.fromVersion.isNotEmpty && widget.toVersion.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(widget.fromVersion,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 22, color: Colors.white70)),
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                    child: Icon(Icons.arrow_forward,
                        color: Color(0xFF00E676), size: 26),
                  ),
                  Text(widget.toVersion,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 22,
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          Text(widget.body),
          if (_showHint)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
              child: Text(
                'Use the left and right buttons on your remote to move to your choice, then press OK.',
                style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFFD54F)),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
      actionsAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      actions: [
        _UpdateChoiceButton(
          label: widget.leftLabel,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
        ),
        _UpdateChoiceButton(
          label: '?',
          small: true,
          autofocus: true,
          onPressed: () => setState(() => _showHint = true),
        ),
        _UpdateChoiceButton(
          label: widget.rightLabel,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

Future<void> showAppUpdateDialog(BuildContext context, UpdateCheck check,
    {required bool manual}) async {
  const bg = Color(0xFF262640);
  final avail = check.available;
  if (avail == null) {
    if (!manual) return;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: bg,
        title: const Text('App updates'),
        content: Text('You are up to date.\n\niTaK Gaming ${check.currentName} is the newest build.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return;
  }
  final go = await showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
    builder: (ctx) => _UpdateOfferDialog(
      title: 'Update available',
      body:
          'iTaK Gaming ${avail.versionName} is ready to install.${avail.notes.isEmpty ? '' : '\n\n${avail.notes}'}',
      leftLabel: 'Later',
      rightLabel: 'Update now',
      fromVersion: check.currentName,
      toVersion: avail.versionName,
    ),
  );
  if (go != true || !context.mounted) return;
  var result =
      await _downloadWithProgress(context, avail, fromVersion: check.currentName);
  while (true) {
    if (result.isEmpty) return; // the system installer is on screen
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    if (result == 'needs-permission') {
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: bg,
          title: const Text('One more step'),
          content: const Text(
              'The TV opened a Settings page. Turn ON "Allow" for iTaK Gaming, press BACK, then choose Update again.'),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child:
                  const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    // A failed download is never a dead end: try again or later.
    final retry = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => _UpdateOfferDialog(
        title: 'Update failed',
        body: result,
        leftLabel: 'Later',
        rightLabel: 'Try again',
        fromVersion: check.currentName,
        toVersion: avail.versionName,
      ),
    );
    if (retry != true || !context.mounted) return;
    result = await _downloadWithProgress(context, avail,
        fromVersion: check.currentName);
  }
}

/// Shows the live download progress dialog while the native side
/// fetches the APK, then returns install()'s result string.
Future<String> _downloadWithProgress(
    BuildContext context, AppUpdateInfo avail,
    {String fromVersion = ''}) async {
  showDialog<void>(
    context: context,
    barrierDismissible: false,
    barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
    builder: (_) => _UpdateProgressDialog(
        expectedSize: avail.size,
        fromVersion: fromVersion,
        toVersion: avail.versionName),
  );
  final result = await AppUpdate.install(avail);
  if (context.mounted) {
    Navigator.of(context).pop(); // progress dialog
  }
  return result;
}

/// The update download dialog: a real progress bar with percent
/// and MB counts, driven by the native downloader's byte stream.
/// Falls back to an indeterminate bar (with MB downloaded) when
/// the size is unknown.
class _UpdateProgressDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final int expectedSize;
  final String fromVersion;
  final String toVersion;
  const _UpdateProgressDialog(
      {required this.expectedSize,
      this.fromVersion = '',
      this.toVersion = ''});

  @override
  State<_UpdateProgressDialog> createState() => _UpdateProgressDialogState();
}

class _UpdateProgressDialogState extends State<_UpdateProgressDialog> {
  StreamSubscription<Map<String, int>>? _sub;
  int _downloaded = 0;
  int _total = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _total = widget.expectedSize;
    _sub = AppUpdate.progress().listen((p) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _downloaded = p['downloaded'] ?? 0;
        if ((p['total'] ?? 0) > 0) _total = p['total']!;
      });
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _sub?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  static String _mb(int bytes) =>
      (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final hasTotal = _total > 0;
    final frac =
        hasTotal ? (_downloaded / _total).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble() : null;
    final pct = frac == null ? '' : ' · ${(frac * 100).floor()}%';
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
      title: const Text('Downloading update...'),
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          if (widget.fromVersion.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
              child: Text(
                'iTaK Gaming ${widget.fromVersion}  to  ${widget.toVersion}',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Colors.white),
              ),
            ),
          LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: frac,
            minHeight: 10,
            color: const Color(0xFF00E676),
            backgroundColor: Colors.white12,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Text(
            hasTotal
                ? '${_mb(_downloaded)} MB of ${_mb(_total)} MB$pct'
                : '${_mb(_downloaded)} MB downloaded',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white70),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  int _row = 0;
  bool _swapAB = false;
  bool _autoArt = true;
  bool _autoSave = true;
  bool _friendAlerts = true;
  bool _spaceBg = true;
  bool _introVideo = true;
  bool _debugChute = true;
  String _installCodeShort = '';
  String _installCode = '';
  bool _sendingReport = false;
  String _versionName = '';
  bool _checkingUpdate = false;
  int _logSize = 0;
  final FocusNode _focusNode = FocusNode();
  final ScrollController _settingsScroll = ScrollController();

  static const int _rowCount = 13;
  // Swap, Auto art, Auto-save, Friend alerts,
  // Sound test, App updates, Logs, Space background, Intro video,
  // Debug reports, Send debug report now, Install code, Back

  // One real focus node per row (the app's per-row focus pattern,
  // as in Manage players): D-pad traversal moves between these
  // nodes, and _row follows the focus via onFocusChange, so the
  // highlight and the actual focus can never split apart. Before
  // this, the rows were plain GestureDetectors under a single
  // KeyboardListener node spanning the whole body, and an UP press
  // let framework traversal throw focus to the AppBar back button.
  // See SETTINGS_FOCUS_FIX.md.
  final List<FocusNode> _rowFocus = List<FocusNode>.generate(
    _rowCount,
    (i) => FocusNode(debugLabel: 'settings-row-$i'),
  );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    // The KeyboardListener node must never be a traversal target:
    // it wraps the whole body, so if traversal lands on it, the
    // next UP throws focus out of the list to the AppBar back
    // button (the 2026-11-04 bug). It still receives key events as
    // an ancestor of whichever row holds focus. Focus starts on
    // row 0's own node instead.
    _focusNode.skipTraversal = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _rowFocus[0].requestFocus();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final sw = await Prefs.getInt('swap_ab');
    final a = await Prefs.get('art_autofetch');
    final asv = await Prefs.get('autosave');
    final fa = await Prefs.get('friend_alerts');
    final sb = await Prefs.get('space_bg');
    final iv = await Prefs.get('intro_video');
    final dc = await Prefs.get('debug_chute');
    final code = await DebugChute.installCode();
    final ai = await AppUpdate.installed();
    try {
      final info = await _logChannel
          .invokeMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('logInfo');
      _logSize = (info?['size'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _swapAB = (sw ?? 0) != 0;
      _autoArt = a != '0';
      _autoSave = asv != '0';
      _friendAlerts = fa != '0';
      _spaceBg = sb != '0';
      _introVideo = iv != '0';
      _debugChute = dc != '0';
      _installCode = code;
      _installCodeShort = code.length >= 8 ? code.substring(0, 8) : code;
      _versionName = ai?['versionName']?.toString() ?? '';
    });
  }

  Future<void> _openUpdates() async {
    if (_checkingUpdate) return;
    setState(() => _checkingUpdate = true);
    final check = await AppUpdate.check();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _checkingUpdate = false);
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (check == null) {
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
          title: const Text('App updates'),
          content: const Text(
              'Cannot reach the update server. Check the internet connection and try again.'),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child:
                  const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    showAppUpdateDialog(context, check, manual: true);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _focusNode.dispose();
    for (final node in _rowFocus) {
      node.dispose();
    }
    _settingsScroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // Nine rows no longer fit on one TV screen: keep the focused
  // row in view as the remote walks the list.
  void _ensureRowVisible() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!_settingsScroll.hasClients) return;
      final target = (_row * 99.0 - 150)
          .clamp(0.0, _settingsScroll.position.maxScrollExtent);
      _settingsScroll.animateTo(
        target,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
      );
    });
  }

  // Toggle rows: their popup titles, current values, and how a
  // picked value is applied (state + pref, exactly what the old
  // inline _adjust wrote). There is no inline cycling any more:
  // activation opens the row's popup (2026-11-04 popup rework).
  String _toggleLabel(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        return 'Swap A and B buttons';
      case 1:
        return 'Download box art';
      case 2:
        return 'Auto-save';
      case 3:
        return 'Friend alerts';
      case 7:
        return 'Space background';
      case 8:
        return 'Intro video';
      case 9:
        return 'Debug reports';
      default:
        return 'Setting';
    }
  }

  bool _rowValue(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        return _swapAB;
      case 1:
        return _autoArt;
      case 2:
        return _autoSave;
      case 3:
        return _friendAlerts;
      case 7:
        return _spaceBg;
      case 8:
        return _introVideo;
      case 9:
        return _debugChute;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  void _setRowValue(int index, bool value) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        setState(() => _swapAB = value);
        Prefs.setInt('swap_ab', value ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      case 1:
        setState(() => _autoArt = value);
        Prefs.set('art_autofetch', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
      case 2:
        setState(() => _autoSave = value);
        Prefs.set('autosave', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
      case 3:
        setState(() => _friendAlerts = value);
        Prefs.set('friend_alerts', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
      case 7:
        setState(() => _spaceBg = value);
        Prefs.set('space_bg', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
      case 8:
        setState(() => _introVideo = value);
        Prefs.set('intro_video', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
      case 9:
        setState(() => _debugChute = value);
        Prefs.set('debug_chute', value ? '1' : '0');
        break;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _reportDialog(String title, String body) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: Text(title),
        content: Text(body),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            autofocus: true,
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child:
                const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // Row activation: every row opens a popup box in the app's dialog
  // style (dark card, green affirmative, BACK closes), opened with
  // a default choice focused; closing returns focus to the row
  // that opened it. Owner, 2026-11-04: make the settings like the
  // rest, rows that pop up like a box when you click them.
  // ----------------------------------------------------------------

  void _restoreRowFocus() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) _rowFocus[_row].requestFocus();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _activateRow(int index) async {
    switch (index) {
      case 12:
        Navigator.pop(context);
        return;
      case 0:
      case 1:
      case 2:
      case 3:
      case 7:
      case 8:
      case 9:
        await _openTogglePopup(index);
        break;
      case 4:
        await _openSoundPopup();
        break;
      case 5:
        await _openUpdatesPopup();
        break;
      case 6:
        await _openLogsPopup();
        break;
      case 10:
        await _openSendReportPopup();
        break;
      case 11:
        await _reportDialog(
          'Install code',
          'This stick\'s own code for debug reports:\n\n'
              '${_installCode.isEmpty ? _installCodeShort : _installCode}',
        );
        break;
    }
    _restoreRowFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _openTogglePopup(int index) async {
    final current = _rowValue(index);
    final picked = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: Text(_toggleLabel(index)),
        content: Text('Now: ${current ? 'On' : 'Off'}',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            autofocus: !current,
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: Text('Off',
                style: TextStyle(
                    color:
                        !current ? const Color(0xFF00E676) : Colors.white70,
                    fontWeight:
                        !current ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
          ),
          TextButton(
            autofocus: current,
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: Text('On',
                style: TextStyle(
                    color:
                        current ? const Color(0xFF00E676) : Colors.white70,
                    fontWeight:
                        current ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != current) {
      _setRowValue(index, picked);
    }
  }

  // The Sound test popup carries the DEBUG card from the old
  // native sound test screen: measure the sound delay on this box
  // (one channel call running the same measurement the native
  // screen runs) and send a debug report on the spot. The speaker
  // and microphone level-bar tests stay on the native screen,
  // which this popup no longer opens.
  Future<void> _openSoundPopup() async {
    appLog('opened the Sound test popup');
    var measuring = false;
    var sending = false;
    var delayText = 'Plays a soft tone through the game sound path and '
        'measures how far the sound trails behind, in milliseconds.';
    var reportText = 'Sends the full report, the latest game '
        'session\'s sound measurements included, to the debug server.';
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setLocal) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
          title: const Text('Sound test'),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(delayText, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Text(reportText, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              autofocus: true,
              onPressed: measuring
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      setLocal(() {
                        measuring = true;
                        delayText = 'Measuring...';
                      });
                      String result;
                      try {
                        result = await _logChannel
                                .invokeMethod<String>('measureSoundDelay') ??
                            'The delay measurement failed on this box.';
                      } catch (_) {
                        result = 'The delay measurement failed on this box.';
                      }
                      if (ctx.mounted) {
                        setLocal(() {
                          measuring = false;
                          delayText = result;
                        });
                      }
                    },
              child: Text(measuring ? 'Measuring...' : 'Measure sound delay',
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: sending
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      setLocal(() {
                        sending = true;
                        reportText = 'Sending...';
                      });
                      final ok = await DebugChute.sendReport('manual');
                      if (ctx.mounted) {
                        setLocal(() {
                          sending = false;
                          reportText = ok
                              ? 'Debug report sent, with the latest game '
                                  'session\'s sound measurements inside.'
                              : 'The report did not reach the server. '
                                  'Check the internet connection and try again.';
                        });
                      }
                    },
              child: const Text('Send debug report now',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Close',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The App updates popup shows the installed build and offers the
  // check; the check itself runs the exact flow the row always ran
  // (_openUpdates and its own result dialogs, unchanged).
  Future<void> _openUpdatesPopup() async {
    final go = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: const Text('App updates'),
        content: Text(
            'Installed: iTaK Gaming '
            '${_versionName.isEmpty ? '(unknown)' : _versionName}\n\n'
            'Check the iTaK server for a newer build.',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child:
                const Text('Close', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          ),
          TextButton(
            autofocus: true,
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Check for updates',
                style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
          ),
        ],

  }

  Future<void> _openLogsPopup() async {
    appLog('opened the Logs popup');
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => const _LogsPopup(),
    );
  }

  // Settings -> Send debug report now, as a popup: confirm, show
  // the send running, then show its real result in the same box.
  // The Debug reports toggle gates it exactly as before.
  Future<void> _openSendReportPopup() async {
    if (!_debugChute) {
      await _reportDialog('Debug reports are off',
          'Turn Debug reports on above if you want this stick to send its app log and game speeds to our server.');
      return;
    }
    var phase = 0; // 0 ask, 1 sending, 2 sent, 3 failed
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setLocal) {
          var title = 'Send debug report now';
          var body = 'Upload the app log and game speeds to our server '
              'right now?';
          List<Widget> actions = [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child:
                  const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
            ),
            TextButton(
              autofocus: true,
              onPressed: () async {
                setLocal(() => phase = 1);
                setState(() => _sendingReport = true);
                final ok = await DebugChute.sendReport('manual');
                if (mounted) setState(() => _sendingReport = false);
                if (ctx.mounted) setLocal(() => phase = ok ? 2 : 3);
              },
              child: const Text('Send',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
            ),
          ];
          if (phase == 1) {
            body = 'Sending...';
            actions = const [];
          } else if (phase == 2) {
            title = 'Report sent';
            body = 'The app log and game speeds from this stick are '
                'on our server now.';
            actions = [
              TextButton(
                autofocus: true,
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('OK',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
              ),
            ];
          } else if (phase == 3) {
            title = 'Report failed';
            body = 'The report did not reach the server. Check the '
                'internet connection and try again.';
            actions = [
              TextButton(
                autofocus: true,
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('OK',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
              ),
            ];
          }
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
            title: Text(title),
            content: Text(body, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
            actions: actions,
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // Wraps one settings row in its own focus node. When focus lands
  // on the row (D-pad traversal, a tap, or the initial request),
  // _row follows it and the list scrolls the row into view, so the
  // white highlight ring and the framework's focus are always the
  // same row.
  Widget _focusableRow(int index, Widget child) {
    return Focus(
      focusNode: _rowFocus[index],
      onFocusChange: (focused) {
        if (focused && _row != index) {
          setState(() => _row = index);
          _ensureRowVisible();
        }
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  void _onKey(KeyEvent event) {
    if (event is! KeyDownEvent) return;
    // Dialogs above this screen own the remote while they are up.
    if (ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != true) return;
    final key = event.logicalKey;
    // UP/DOWN belong to focus traversal now: the rows are real
    // focus nodes and _row follows the focus (see _focusableRow).
    // LEFT/RIGHT no longer cycle a value inline; activation opens
    // the row's popup instead (2026-11-04 popup rework).
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.space) {
      _activateRow(_row);
    }
  }

  Widget _settingRow({
    required int index,
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required String hint,
  }) {
    final focused = _row == index;
    return _focusableRow(
      index,
      GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _row = index);
        _activateRow(index);
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white12,
            width: focused ? 3 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(label,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  Text(hint,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white54)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_left, color: Colors.white54),
            SizedBox(
              width: 190,
              child: Text(
                value,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 21, color: Color(0xFF00E676)),
              ),
            ),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, color: Colors.white54),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      ),
    );
  }
