// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings -> Logs popup: the app log inside a scrollable popup
// box (owner, 2026-11-04) instead of opening the full LogScreen.
// Same source (the readLog channel) and the same page step as the
// LogScreen; its buttons are real buttons, so the D-pad walks
// them and BACK closes the box back to the Logs row.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _LogsPopup extends StatefulWidget {
  const _LogsPopup();

  @override
  State<_LogsPopup> createState() => _LogsPopupState();
}

class _LogsPopupState extends State<_LogsPopup> {
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  String _text = 'Loading...';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _refresh();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    try {
      final data =
          await _logChannel.invokeMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('readLog');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _text = (data?['text'] ?? '').toString();
        if (_text.isEmpty) _text = '(The log is empty.)';
      });
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (_scroll.hasClients) {
          _scroll.jumpTo(_scroll.position.maxScrollExtent);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _text = 'Could not read the log: $e');
    }
  }

  void _page(int dir) {
    if (!_scroll.hasClients) return;
    final pos = _scroll.position;
    _scroll.jumpTo((pos.pixels + dir * 320).clamp(0.0, pos.maxScrollExtent));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
      title: const Text('Logs'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 780,
        height: 420,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          controller: _scroll,
          child: Text(
            _text,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.35),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => _page(-1),
          child:
              const Text('Page up', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => _page(1),
          child:
              const Text('Page down', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _refresh,
          child:
              const Text('Refresh', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
        ),
        TextButton(
          autofocus: true,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child:
              const Text('Close', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Debug log viewer (Settings -> Logs). The native side streams the
// app's whole logcat into a file; this screen reads the tail of it.
// Remote model (David, 2026-10-12): a top row he can always reach
// (Back, Refresh, Save a copy to /sdcard/iTaK, Clear with a confirm)
// and dedicated scroll buttons beside the log; DOWN moves from the
// top row to the scroll buttons, OK on a scroll button pages the
// log, and holding OK keeps scrolling.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class LogScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LogScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LogScreen> createState() => _LogScreenState();
}

class _LogScreenState extends State<LogScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  String _text = '';
  int _size = 0;
  bool _loading = true;
  // Remote zones: 0 = top row (0 Back, 1 Refresh, 2 Save a copy,
  // 3 Clear), 1 = the log's scroll buttons (0 page up, 1 page down).
  int _zone = 0;
  int _topIndex = 0;
  int _logBtn = 1;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _refresh();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      final data =
          await _channel.invokeMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('readLog');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _text = (data?['text'] ?? '').toString();
        _size = (data?['size'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        _loading = false;
      });
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (_scroll.hasClients) {
          _scroll.jumpTo(_scroll.position.maxScrollExtent);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _text = 'Could not read the log: $e';
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _export() async {
    try {
      final path = await _channel.invokeMethod<String>('exportLog');
      if (!mounted) return;
      _showInfo('Log saved',
          'A copy is at ${path ?? 'unknown'} on this box. Grab it with a file manager or USB.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _showInfo('Save failed', '$e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clear() async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: const Text('Clear the log?'),
        content: const Text(
            'The saved copy file is not touched. New lines keep being written.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Keep', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70)),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Clear',
                style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('clearLog');
      appLog('log cleared from the Logs screen');
      _refresh();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _showInfo(String title, String body) {
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.8),
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
        title: Text(title),
        content: Text(body, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child:
                const Text('OK', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF00E676))),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _scrollPage(int dir) {
    if (!_scroll.hasClients) return;
    final pos = _scroll.position;
    _scroll.jumpTo((pos.pixels + dir * 320).clamp(0.0, pos.maxScrollExtent));
  }

  void _activateTop() {
    switch (_topIndex) {
      case 0:
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
        break;
      case 1:
        _refresh();
        break;
      case 2:
        _export();
        break;
      case 3:
        _clear();
        break;
    }
  }

  Widget _logPill(int index, String label) {
    final focused = _zone == 0 && _topIndex == index;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _zone = 0;
          _topIndex = index;
        });
        _activateTop();
      },
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 9),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white24,
            width: focused ? 2.5 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16.5,
            fontWeight: focused ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            color: Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _logScrollButton(int btn, IconData icon) {
    final focused = _zone == 1 && _logBtn == btn;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _zone = 1;
          _logBtn = btn;
        });
        _scrollPage(btn == 0 ? -1 : 1);
      },
      child: Container(
        width: 54,
        height: 54,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white24,
            width: focused ? 2.5 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Icon(icon, size: 30, color: Colors.white),
      ),
    );
  }

  KeyEventResult _onKey(FocusNode node, KeyEvent event) {
    if (event is! KeyDownEvent && event is! KeyRepeatEvent) {
      return KeyEventResult.ignored;
    }
    if (ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != true) {
      return KeyEventResult.ignored;
    }
    final key = event.logicalKey;
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.escape ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonB ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.browserBack) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 0) {
          _topIndex = (_topIndex - 1).clamp(0, 3);
        } else {
          _zone = 0;
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 0) {
          _topIndex = (_topIndex + 1).clamp(0, 3);
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 0) {
          _zone = 1;
          _logBtn = 1;
        } else if (_logBtn == 0) {
          _logBtn = 1;
        } else {
          _scrollPage(1);
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 1) {
          if (_logBtn == 1) {
            _logBtn = 0;
          } else {
            _zone = 0;
          }
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA) {
      if (_zone == 0) {
        _activateTop();
      } else {
        _scrollPage(_logBtn == 0 ? -1 : 1);
      }
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        leadingWidth: 76,
        leading: Center(
          child: GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 44,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                border: Border.all(
                  color: (_zone == 0 && _topIndex == 0)
                      ? Colors.white
                      : Colors.white24,
                  width: (_zone == 0 && _topIndex == 0) ? 3 : 1,
                ),
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, size: 20),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        title: const Text('Logs'),
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFF2A1152), Color(0xFF140B2E), Color(0xFF0A1A33)],
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 4),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    _loading
                        ? 'Loading...'
                        : '${(_size / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB logged · newest at the bottom',
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white70),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  _logPill(1, 'Refresh'),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _logPill(2, 'Save a copy'),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _logPill(3, 'Clear'),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 8),
                child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Focus(
                        autofocus: true,
                        onKeyEvent: _onKey,
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.45),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border:
                                Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
                          ),
                          child: SingleChildScrollView(
                            controller: _scroll,
                            child: SizedBox(
                              width: double.infinity,
                              child: Text(
                                _text.isEmpty
                                    ? '(the log is empty)'
                                    : _text,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  height: 1.35,
                                  color: Color(0xFFD8F3DC),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Column(
                      children: [
                        _logScrollButton(0, Icons.keyboard_arrow_up),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        _logScrollButton(
                            1, Icons.keyboard_arrow_down),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 12),
              child: Text(
                'LEFT / RIGHT pick an action · OK runs it · DOWN reaches the scroll buttons · hold OK to scroll · BACK done',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white54),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LiveState {
  bool live = false;
  bool upcoming = false;
  bool checked = false;
  String? videoId;
  String? title;
  String? get thumb =>
      videoId == null ? null : 'https://i.ytimg.com/vi/$videoId/hqdefault.jpg';
}

String _htmlUnescape(String s) {
  return s
      .replaceAll('&amp;', '&')
      .replaceAll('&quot;', '"')
      .replaceAll('&#39;', "'")
      .replaceAll('&apos;', "'")
      .replaceAll('&lt;', '<')
      .replaceAll('&gt;', '>');
}

// One channel's live page, classified. While a stream is live
// the page redirects to the watch page (that hop names the
// video) and its player data carries isLive markers; a
// scheduled stream carries isUpcoming instead and is reported
// as upcoming, never live. Any failure just means "no info",
// never an error on screen.
Future<_LiveState> _fetchLiveState(PatriotChannel ch) async {
  final info = _LiveState();
  final client = HttpClient();
  client.userAgent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) '
      'AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) '
      'Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';
  try {
    final req = await client
        .getUrl(Uri.parse('https://www.youtube.com/channel/${ch.channelId}/live'))
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
    req.followRedirects = true;
    req.maxRedirects = 5;
    final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
    String? videoId;
    for (final r in resp.redirects) {
      final m = RegExp(r'[?&]v=([\w-]{11})').firstMatch(r.location.toString());
      if (m != null) videoId = m.group(1);
    }
    // Read a capped slice of the page: the title tag and the
    // player response sit near the front.
    final buf = StringBuffer();
    await for (final chunk in resp.transform(utf8.decoder)) {
      buf.write(chunk);
      if (buf.length > 1000000) break;
    }
    final html = buf.toString();
    info.checked = true;
    info.upcoming = html.contains('"isUpcoming":true');
    info.live = !info.upcoming &&
        (html.contains('"isLiveNow":true') || html.contains('"isLive":true'));
    if (videoId == null) {
      final m = RegExp(r'"videoId":"([\w-]{11})"').firstMatch(html);
      if (m != null) videoId = m.group(1);
    }
    // og:title ships in both attribute orders depending on the
    // page variant; the player JSON title is the last fallback.
    var title = '';
    var t = RegExp(r'<meta property="og:title" content="([^"]*)"')
        .firstMatch(html);
    t ??= RegExp(r'<meta content="([^"]*)" property="og:title"')
        .firstMatch(html);
    if (t != null) {
      title = _htmlUnescape(t.group(1)!);
    } else {
      final vd =
          RegExp(r'"videoDetails":\{[^}]*?"title":"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"')
              .firstMatch(html);
      if (vd != null) title = _htmlUnescape(vd.group(1)!.replaceAll(r'\"', '"'));
    }
    if (title.isNotEmpty) info.title = title;
    if (info.live || info.upcoming) info.videoId = videoId;
    return info;
  } catch (_) {
    // A failed check is still a check: screens settle on the
    // "not live" wording instead of spinning forever.
    info.checked = true;
    return info;
  } finally {
    client.close(force: true);
  }
}

class _RssVideo {
  final String videoId;
  final String title;
  final DateTime? published;
  const _RssVideo(this.videoId, this.title, this.published);
  String get thumb => 'https://i.ytimg.com/vi/$videoId/hqdefault.jpg';
}

String _fmtDate(DateTime? d) {
  if (d == null) return '';
  const months = [
    'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
    'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec',
  ];
  return '${months[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';
}

// A channel's newest videos from its public RSS feed: no key,
// no account, most recent first by construction.
Future<List<_RssVideo>> _fetchVideos(String channelId) async {
  final client = HttpClient();
  client.userAgent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) '
      'AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) '
      'Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';
  try {
    final req = await client
        .getUrl(Uri.parse(
            'https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=$channelId'))
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
    final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
    final buf = StringBuffer();
    await for (final chunk in resp.transform(utf8.decoder)) {
      buf.write(chunk);
      if (buf.length > 400000) break;
    }
    final out = <_RssVideo>[];
    for (final block in buf.toString().split('<entry>').skip(1)) {
      final id = RegExp(r'<yt:videoId>([^<]+)</yt:videoId>').firstMatch(block);
      final title = RegExp(r'<title>([^<]*)</title>').firstMatch(block);
      if (id == null || title == null) continue;
      final pub = RegExp(r'<published>([^<]*)</published>').firstMatch(block);
      out.add(_RssVideo(
        id.group(1)!,
        _htmlUnescape(title.group(1)!),
        pub == null ? null : DateTime.tryParse(pub.group(1)!),
      ));
      if (out.length >= 12) break;
    }
    return out;
  } catch (_) {
    return const [];
  } finally {
    client.close(force: true);
  }
}

// Drawn flag motif for the banner (code-drawn on purpose: no
// emoji anywhere in this app, and no flag image to license).
class _FlagPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final double opacity;
  const _FlagPainter({this.opacity = 1});
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final stripeH = size.height / 7;
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      final paint = Paint()
        ..color = (i.isEven ? const Color(0xFFB22234) : Colors.white)
            .withOpacity(opacity);
      canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTWH(0, i * stripeH, size.width, stripeH + 1), paint);
    }
    final cantonW = size.width * 0.42;
    final cantonH = stripeH * 4;
    canvas.drawRect(Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, cantonW, cantonH),
        Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF3C3B6E).withOpacity(opacity));
    final dot = Paint()..color = Colors.white.withOpacity(opacity);
    for (var r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
      for (var c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
        canvas.drawCircle(
          Offset(cantonW * (c + 0.5) / 6, cantonH * (r + 0.5) / 4),
          size.height * 0.016 + 1,
          dot,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_FlagPainter old) => old.opacity != opacity;
}

// One focusable PATRIOTS tile in the game grid's own language:
// dark card, white focus border, glow in the show's color.
class _PatriotTile extends StatefulWidget {
  final PatriotChannel ch;
  final _LiveState? state;
  final String? artUrl;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final bool autofocus;
  final String? tag;
  const _PatriotTile({
    required this.ch,
    required this.state,
    required this.artUrl,
    required this.onTap,
    this.autofocus = false,
    this.tag,
  });

  @override
  State<_PatriotTile> createState() => _PatriotTileState();
}

class _PatriotTileState extends State<_PatriotTile> {
  bool _focused = false;

  Widget _fallback() {
    final ch = widget.ch;
    return Container(
      color: ch.color.withOpacity(0.25),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.live_tv, size: 54, color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.9)),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
            child: Text(
              ch.name,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _badge() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFC62828),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 8,
            height: 8,
            decoration:
                const BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, shape: BoxShape.circle),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          const Text(
            'LIVE',
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.white),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ch = widget.ch;
    final state = widget.state;
    final live = state?.live == true;
    final art = state?.thumb ?? widget.artUrl;
    final line1 = live && (state?.title?.isNotEmpty ?? false)
        ? state!.title!
        : ch.name;
    final line2 = live
        ? ch.name
        : state?.upcoming == true
            ? 'Stream scheduled'
            : state?.checked == true
                ? 'Not live right now'
                : 'Checking...';
    return Focus(
      autofocus: widget.autofocus,
      onFocusChange: (f) => setState(() => _focused = f),
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
            (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA)) {
          widget.onTap();
          return KeyEventResult.handled;
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        child: AnimatedScale(
          scale: _focused ? 1.06 : 1.0,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(
                color: _focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white10,
                width: _focused ? 3.5 : 1,
              ),
              boxShadow: _focused
                  ? [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: ch.color.withOpacity(0.6),
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        spreadRadius: 3,
                      ),
                    ]
                  : null,
            ),
            clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                if (widget.tag != null)
                  Container(
                    color: const Color(0xFF14141E),
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                    child: Text(
                      widget.tag!,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          letterSpacing: 1.2,
                          color: Color(0xFF29D3EE)),
                    ),
                  ),
                Expanded(
                  child: Stack(
                    fit: StackFit.expand,
                    children: [
                      if (art != null)
                        Image.network(
                          art,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _fallback(),
                        )
                      else
                        _fallback(),
                      if (live)
                        Positioned(top: 8, left: 8, child: _badge()),
                      if (ch.rank != null)
                        Positioned(
                          top: 8,
                          right: 8,
                          child: Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.72),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              '#${ch.rank}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: Colors.white),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  color: const Color(0xFF14141E),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        line1,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight:
                              _focused ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        line2,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white54),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class PatriotsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PatriotsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PatriotsScreen> createState() => _PatriotsScreenState();
}

class _PatriotsScreenState extends State<PatriotsScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  final Map<String, _LiveState> _live = {};
  final Map<String, String> _art = {};
  bool _checking = true;

  List<PatriotChannel> get _all => [...kPatriotNetworks, ...kPatriotPodcasts];
  List<PatriotChannel> get _liveNow =>
      _all.where((s) => _live[s.channelId]?.live == true).toList();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  /// Live checks land in waves (heroes and networks first, then
  /// the podcasts), then a cover art wave fills the tiles of the
  /// shows that are not live with their newest episode art.
  Future<void> _load() async {
    final waves = <List<PatriotChannel>>[
      kPatriotNetworks,
      kPatriotPodcasts.take(15).toList(),
      kPatriotPodcasts.skip(15).toList(),
    ];
    for (final wave in waves) {
      await Future.wait(wave.map((s) async {
        final info = await _fetchLiveState(s);
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() => _live[s.channelId] = info);
      }));
      if (!mounted) return;
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _checking = false);
    final need = _all.where((s) => _live[s.channelId]?.live != true).toList();
    for (var i = 0; i < need.length; i += 6) {
      await Future.wait(need.skip(i).take(6).map((s) async {
        final videos = await _fetchVideos(s.channelId);
        if (!mounted || videos.isEmpty) return;
        setState(() => _art[s.channelId] = videos.first.thumb);
      }));
      if (!mounted) return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _play(PatriotChannel ch, {String? videoId}) async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('playStream', {
        'channelId': ch.channelId,
        'videoId': videoId ?? _live[ch.channelId]?.videoId,
        'name': ch.name,
      });
    } catch (_) {
      // The player could not open; the screen stays where it was.
    }
    // What is live may have changed while they watched.
    if (mounted) _load();
  }

  void _activate(PatriotChannel ch) {
    // Podcasts always open their window (David's layout call);
    // a network that is live plays in one tap, the way it has
    // worked for Terry since 1.87. Everything else opens the
    // show's window.
    if (ch.network && _live[ch.channelId]?.live == true) {
      _play(ch);
      return;
    }
    Navigator.of(context)
        .push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => PatriotShowScreen(show: ch)))
        .then((_) {
      if (mounted) _load();
    });
  }

  Widget _section(String text) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(40, 20, 40, 10),
      child: Align(
        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
        child: Text(
          text,
          style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 1.1),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _banner() {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(40, 14, 40, 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white10),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: const Stack(
        children: [
          Positioned.fill(
            child: CustomPaint(painter: _FlagPainter(opacity: 0.15)),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
            child: Text(
              'Livestreams and shows from YouTube. Live ones play; '
              'the rest open to their newest videos. BACK returns here.',
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 17,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final heroA = kPatriotNetworks.first;
    final heroB = kPatriotPodcasts.first;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('PATRIOTS'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFF22103F), Color(0xFF120826), Color(0xFF081426)],
          ),
        ),
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 28),
          children: [
            _banner(),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40),
              child: Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 252,
                      child: _PatriotTile(
                        ch: heroA,
                        state: _live[heroA.channelId],
                        artUrl: _art[heroA.channelId],
                        autofocus: true,
                        tag: 'FEATURED NETWORK',
                        onTap: () => _activate(heroA),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 22),
                  Expanded(
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 252,
                      child: _PatriotTile(
                        ch: heroB,
                        state: _live[heroB.channelId],
                        artUrl: _art[heroB.channelId],
                        tag: 'NUMBER ONE PODCAST',
                        onTap: () => _activate(heroB),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            _section('RECOMMENDED LIVE'),
            if (_liveNow.isEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40),
                child: Text(
                  _checking
                      ? 'Checking who is live right now...'
                      : 'No live streams right now. When a show in the lineup goes live, it shows up here first.',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white54),
                ),
              )
            else
              SizedBox(
                height: 196,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40),
                  itemCount: _liveNow.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(width: 22),
                  itemBuilder: (_, i) => SizedBox(
                    width: 300,
                    child: _PatriotTile(
                      ch: _liveNow[i],
                      state: _live[_liveNow[i].channelId],
                      artUrl: _art[_liveNow[i].channelId],
                      onTap: () => _activate(_liveNow[i]),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            _section('NEWS NETWORKS'),
            SizedBox(
              height: 196,
              child: ListView.separated(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40),
                itemCount: kPatriotNetworks.length,
                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(width: 22),
                itemBuilder: (_, i) => SizedBox(
                  width: 300,
                  child: _PatriotTile(
                    ch: kPatriotNetworks[i],
                    state: _live[kPatriotNetworks[i].channelId],
                    artUrl: _art[kPatriotNetworks[i].channelId],
                    onTap: () => _activate(kPatriotNetworks[i]),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            _section('TOP PODCASTS'),
            GridView.builder(
              shrinkWrap: true,
              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(40, 4, 40, 8),
              gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                crossAxisCount: 4,
                crossAxisSpacing: 22,
                mainAxisSpacing: 22,
                childAspectRatio: 1.15,
              ),
              itemCount: kPatriotPodcasts.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final ch = kPatriotPodcasts[index];
                return _PatriotTile(
                  ch: ch,
                  state: _live[ch.channelId],
                  artUrl: _art[ch.channelId],
                  onTap: () => _activate(ch),
                );
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One show's window: live status and a watch button up top,
// then the newest videos, most recent first.

class PatriotShowScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final PatriotChannel show;
  const PatriotShowScreen({super.key, required this.show});

  @override
  State<PatriotShowScreen> createState() => _PatriotShowScreenState();
}

class _PatriotShowScreenState extends State<PatriotShowScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  _LiveState? _live;
  List<_RssVideo> _videos = const [];
  bool _videosLoaded = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final liveFuture = _fetchLiveState(widget.show);
    final videosFuture = _fetchVideos(widget.show.channelId);
    final live = await liveFuture;
    if (mounted) setState(() => _live = live);
    final videos = await videosFuture;
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _videos = videos;
        _videosLoaded = true;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _playVideo(String? videoId) async {
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod('playStream', {
        'channelId': widget.show.channelId,
        'videoId': videoId,
        'name': widget.show.name,
      });
    } catch (_) {
      // The player could not open; the window stays where it was.
    }
  }

  Widget _playButton(String label, VoidCallback onTap, {bool red = false}) {
    return Focus(
      autofocus: red,
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
            (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA)) {
          onTap();
          return KeyEventResult.handled;
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: onTap,
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 13),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: red ? const Color(0xFFC62828) : const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.play_arrow, color: Colors.white, size: 22),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    letterSpacing: 1.0,
                    color: Colors.white),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final show = widget.show;
    final live = _live;
    final isLive = live?.live == true;
    final art = live?.thumb ??
        (_videos.isNotEmpty ? _videos.first.thumb : null);
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(show.name),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFF22103F), Color(0xFF120826), Color(0xFF081426)],
          ),
        ),
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(40, 14, 40, 30),
          children: [
            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.white10),
              ),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  SizedBox(
                    height: 300,
                    child: Stack(
                      fit: StackFit.expand,
                      children: [
                        if (art != null)
                          Image.network(
                            art,
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) =>
                                Container(color: show.color.withOpacity(0.25)),
                          )
                        else
                          Container(color: show.color.withOpacity(0.25)),
                        if (isLive)
                          Positioned(
                            top: 12,
                            left: 12,
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFFC62828),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                              ),
                              child: const Text(
                                'LIVE',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 14,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    color: Colors.white),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 18),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          live == null
                              ? 'Checking live status...'
                              : isLive
                                  ? (live.title ?? 'Live now')
                                  : live.upcoming
                                      ? 'A live stream is scheduled, but it has not started yet.'
                                      : 'No live stream right now.',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        if (isLive)
                          _playButton(
                            'WATCH LIVE',
                            () => _playVideo(live!.videoId),
                            red: true,
                          )
                        else if (_videos.isNotEmpty)
                          _playButton(
                            'PLAY NEWEST VIDEO',
                            () => _playVideo(_videos.first.videoId),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 22),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'VIDEOS',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 19,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      letterSpacing: 1.1),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),
                Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
                  ),
                  child: const Text(
                    'Most recent',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!_videosLoaded)
              const Text('Pulling the newest videos...',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white54))
            else if (_videos.isEmpty)
              const Text('No videos came back for this channel.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white54))
            else
              ..._videos.map((v) => Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    child: _videoRow(v),
                  )),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _videoRow(_RssVideo v) {
    return _VideoRow(
      video: v,
      onTap: () => _playVideo(v.videoId),
    );
  }
}

class _VideoRow extends StatefulWidget {
  final _RssVideo video;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  const _VideoRow({required this.video, required this.onTap});

  @override
  State<_VideoRow> createState() => _VideoRowState();
}

class _VideoRowState extends State<_VideoRow> {
  bool _focused = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final v = widget.video;
    return Focus(
      onFocusChange: (f) => setState(() => _focused = f),
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
            (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA)) {
          widget.onTap();
          return KeyEventResult.handled;
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        child: Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: _focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white10,
              width: _focused ? 3 : 1,
            ),
          ),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Image.network(
                v.thumb,
                width: 168,
                height: 96,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Container(
                  width: 168,
                  height: 96,
                  color: const Color(0xFF3C3B6E),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow,
                      color: Colors.white, size: 32),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        v.title,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 5),
                      Text(
                        _fmtDate(v.published),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white54),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: 16),
                child: Icon(Icons.play_circle_fill,
                    color: Color(0xFFC62828), size: 30),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class GameGridScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final SystemInfo system;

  const GameGridScreen({super.key, required this.system});

  @override
  State<GameGridScreen> createState() => _GameGridScreenState();
}

class _GameGridScreenState extends State<GameGridScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  List<File> _games = [];
  final Map<String, File?> _art = {};
  bool _loading = true;
  String _status = '';
  int _focused = 0;
  String _query = '';
  int _sort = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _openSearch() async {
    final text = await showTvKeyboard(
      context,
      title: 'Search games',
      initial: _query,
    );
    if (text == null || !mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _query = text.trim();
      _focused = 0;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    await PlayStats.load();
    final s = await Prefs.get('sort_mode');
    if (s != null) _sort = (int.tryParse(s) ?? 0).clamp(0, kSortNames.length - 1);
    await _scan();
  }

  Future<void> _scan() async {
    final sys = widget.system;
    final dir = Directory('/sdcard/ROMs/${sys.dir}');
    final found = <File>[];
    try {
      if (await dir.exists()) {
        await for (final e in dir.list()) {
          if (e is File) {
            final lower = e.path.toLowerCase();
            if (sys.exts.any((x) => lower.endsWith(x))) found.add(e);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _status =
            'Cannot read games folder. Grant "All files access" to iTaK Gaming in Settings.';
      });
      return;
    }
    found.sort((a, b) => a.path.compareTo(b.path));
    // Cached art first so the grid paints instantly.
    for (final f in found) {
      final art = File('${dir.path}/boxart/${_displayName(f)}.png');
      _art[f.path] = art.existsSync() ? art : null;
    }
    setState(() {
      _games = found;
      _loading = false;
      _status = found.isEmpty ? 'No games found in ${dir.path}' : '';
    });
    // Then fetch anything missing in the background.
    final autoArt = (await Prefs.get('art_autofetch')) != '0';
    if (!autoArt) return;
    for (final f in found) {
      if (_art[f.path] == null) {
        final fetched =
            await Artwork.boxart(sys, _displayName(f), dir.path);
        if (fetched != null && mounted) {
          setState(() => _art[f.path] = fetched);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  String _displayName(File f) {
    var name = f.uri.pathSegments.last;
    final dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0) name = name.substring(0, dot);
    return name;
  }

  List<File> get _visible {
    var list = _games.where((f) {
      return _query.isEmpty ||
          _displayName(f).toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase());
    }).toList();
    switch (_sort) {
      case 1:
        list.sort((a, b) => _displayName(b).compareTo(_displayName(a)));
        break;
      case 2:
        list.sort((a, b) {
          final c = PlayStats.count(b.path).compareTo(PlayStats.count(a.path));
          return c != 0 ? c : _displayName(a).compareTo(_displayName(b));
        });
        break;
      case 3:
        list.sort((a, b) {
          final c = PlayStats.lastPlayed(b.path)
              .compareTo(PlayStats.lastPlayed(a.path));
          return c != 0 ? c : _displayName(a).compareTo(_displayName(b));
        });
        break;
      default:
        list.sort((a, b) => _displayName(a).compareTo(_displayName(b)));
    }
    return list;
  }

  Future<void> _launch(File f) async {
    await PlayStats.record(f.path);
    appLog('launch game: ${f.path} on ${widget.system.core}');
    await _channel.invokeMethod('launch', {
      'core': widget.system.core,
      'rom': f.path,
    });
  }

  void _cycleSort(int delta) {
    setState(() {
      _sort = (_sort + delta + kSortNames.length) % kSortNames.length;
      _focused = 0;
    });
    Prefs.set('sort_mode', _sort.toString());
  }

  Widget _tile(int index, List<File> visible) {
    final game = visible[index];
    final art = _art[game.path];
    final focused = _focused == index;
    final sys = widget.system;
    return Focus(
      autofocus: index == 0,
      onFocusChange: (hasFocus) {
        if (hasFocus) setState(() => _focused = index);
      },
      onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
        if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
            (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
                event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA)) {
          _launch(game);
          return KeyEventResult.handled;
        }
        return KeyEventResult.ignored;
      },
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => _launch(game),
        child: AnimatedScale(
          scale: focused ? 1.09 : 1.0,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2A),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(
                color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white10,
                width: focused ? 3.5 : 1,
              ),
              boxShadow: focused
                  ? [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: sys.color.withOpacity(0.6),
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        spreadRadius: 3,
                      ),
                    ]
                  : null,
            ),
            clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: art != null
                      ? Image.file(
                          art,
                          // Whole cover visible; covers differ per
                          // system (SNES landscape, NES portrait).
                          fit: BoxFit.contain,
                          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _artFallback(),
                        )
                      : _artFallback(),
                ),
                Container(
                  color: const Color(0xFF14141E),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                  child: Text(
                    _displayName(game),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: focused ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _artFallback() {
    return Container(
      color: widget.system.color.withOpacity(0.22),
      child: Icon(
        Icons.sports_esports,
        size: 56,
        color: widget.system.color.withOpacity(0.85),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final visible = _visible;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(widget.system.name),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFF22103F), Color(0xFF120826), Color(0xFF081426)],
          ),
        ),
        child: _loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            : Column(
                children: [
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 6, 24, 4),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: Focus(
                            onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
                              if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
                                  (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                                      event.logicalKey ==
                                          LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                                      event.logicalKey ==
                                          LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA)) {
                                _openSearch();
                                return KeyEventResult.handled;
                              }
                              return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                            },
                            child: Builder(builder: (ctx) {
                              final barFocused = Focus.of(ctx).hasFocus;
                              return GestureDetector(
                                onTap: _openSearch,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                      horizontal: 16, vertical: 13),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: barFocused
                                          ? Colors.white
                                          : Colors.white12,
                                      width: barFocused ? 3 : 1,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    children: [
                                      const Icon(Icons.search, size: 21),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: Text(
                                          _query.isEmpty
                                              ? 'Search games...'
                                              : _query,
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 19,
                                            color: _query.isEmpty
                                                ? Colors.white38
                                                : Colors.white,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      if (_query.isNotEmpty)
                                        GestureDetector(
                                          onTap: () => setState(() {
                                            _query = '';
                                            _focused = 0;
                                          }),
                                          child: const Icon(Icons.clear,
                                              size: 21),
                                        ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            }),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 16),
                        Focus(
                          onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
                            if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
                              if (event.logicalKey ==
                                  LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight) {
                                _cycleSort(1);
                                return KeyEventResult.handled;
                              }
                              if (event.logicalKey ==
                                  LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft) {
                                _cycleSort(-1);
                                return KeyEventResult.handled;
                              }
                              if (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                                  event.logicalKey ==
                                      LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
                                  event.logicalKey ==
                                      LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA) {
                                _cycleSort(1);
                                return KeyEventResult.handled;
                              }
                            }
                            return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                          },
                          child: Builder(builder: (ctx) {
                            final chipFocused = Focus.of(ctx).hasFocus;
                            return GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => _cycleSort(1),
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                    color: chipFocused
                                        ? Colors.white
                                        : Colors.white12,
                                    width: chipFocused ? 3 : 1,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(Icons.sort, size: 20),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                    Text('Sort: ${kSortNames[_sort]}',
                                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            );
                          }),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  // Breathing room so the focused tile (which scales
                  // up) never runs into the search bar above it.
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  Expanded(
                    child: _games.isEmpty
                        ? Center(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
                              child: Text(
                                _status,
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 22, color: Colors.grey),
                              ),
                            ),
                          )
                        : visible.isEmpty
                            ? const Center(
                                child: Text(
                                  'No games match your search',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 22, color: Colors.grey),
                                ),
                              )
                            : LayoutBuilder(
                                builder: (context, constraints) {
                                  // Whole rows only: pick the largest
                                  // row count whose tiles stay near
                                  // their natural shape, then size the
                                  // tiles so exactly that many rows
                                  // fill the screen. Combined with zero
                                  // vertical grid padding, the focus
                                  // auto-scroll always settles on a row
                                  // boundary, so no tile is ever cut.
                                  final tileW = (constraints.maxWidth -
                                          28 -
                                          28 -
                                          3 * 20) /
                                      4;
                                  var rows = 1;
                                  for (var r = 6; r >= 1; r--) {
                                    final th = (constraints.maxHeight -
                                            (r - 1) * 22) /
                                        r;
                                    if (th >= tileW / 1.30) {
                                      rows = r;
                                      break;
                                    }
                                  }
                                  final tileH = (constraints.maxHeight -
                                          (rows - 1) * 22) /
                                      rows;
                                  final aspect =
                                      tileH > 40 ? tileW / tileH : 0.92;
                                  return GridView.builder(
                                    // Same glow rule as the home grid:
                                    // a focused tile's glow fades past
                                    // the grid edge, never slices.
                                    clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                                    cacheExtent: 0,
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                                        28, 10, 28, 10),
                                    gridDelegate:
                                        SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                                      crossAxisCount: 4,
                                      crossAxisSpacing: 20,
                                      mainAxisSpacing: 22,
                                      childAspectRatio: aspect,
                                    ),
                                    itemCount: visible.length,
                                    itemBuilder: (context, index) =>
                                        _tile(index, visible),
                                  );
                                },
                              ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ],
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Leaderboard: per-player play stats written by EmulatorActivity into
// files/stats/<player>.json and read back through the channel.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _GameStat {
  final String rom;
  final int plays;
  final int seconds;
  final int last;
  const _GameStat(this.rom, this.plays, this.seconds, this.last);
  String get name {
    var n = rom.split('/').last;
    final dot = n.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0) n = n.substring(0, dot);
    return n;
  }
}

class _PlayerStat {
  final String name;
  final List<_GameStat> games;

  /// Set for global-board rows, where the server sends totals only
  /// (no per-game breakdown).
  final int? gamesCountOverride;
  final int? secondsOverride;
  final int? playsOverride;

  /// Global rows only: the identity the player's own box reported
  /// (display name with initials, home region). Empty when the
  /// player's app has not sent them; the raw name is shown instead.
  final String display;
  final String region;
  const _PlayerStat(this.name, this.games,
      {this.gamesCountOverride,
      this.secondsOverride,
      this.playsOverride,
      this.display = '',
      this.region = ''});
  int get totalSeconds =>
      secondsOverride ?? games.fold(0, (a, g) => a + g.seconds);
  int get totalPlays =>
      playsOverride ?? games.fold(0, (a, g) => a + g.plays);
  int get gamesCount => gamesCountOverride ?? games.length;
  _GameStat? get favorite => games.isEmpty
      ? null
      : games.reduce((a, b) => a.seconds >= b.seconds ? a : b);
  _GameStat? get mostRecent => games.isEmpty
      ? null
      : games.reduce((a, b) => a.last >= b.last ? a : b);
}

/// One row of the tournament board (PROTOCOL.md 8): a player's
/// reported record from the server's tournament store, ranked
/// there by titles, then wins. Nothing here counts play time;
/// a row exists because matches were reported.
class _TPlayer {
  final String name;
  final String display;
  final String region;
  final int wins;
  final int losses;
  final int matches;
  final int tournamentsWon;
  final String lastTournament;
  final String lastGame;
  final String lastTitle;
  const _TPlayer({
    required this.name,
    this.display = '',
    this.region = '',
    this.wins = 0,
    this.losses = 0,
    this.matches = 0,
    this.tournamentsWon = 0,
    this.lastTournament = '',
    this.lastGame = '',
    this.lastTitle = '',
  });
}

/// One reported tournament match from the recent feed.
class _TResult {
  final String tournament;
  final String game;
  final String winner;
  final String loser;
  final int at;
  const _TResult({
    required this.tournament,
    required this.game,
    required this.winner,
    required this.loser,
    required this.at,
  });
}

String _fmtDuration(int seconds) {
  if (seconds >= 3600) {
    final h = seconds ~/ 3600;
    final m = (seconds % 3600) ~/ 60;
    return '${h}h ${m}m';
  }
  if (seconds >= 60) return '${seconds ~/ 60}m';
  return '${seconds}s';
}

String _fmtWhen(int millis) {
  if (millis <= 0) return '';
  const months = [
    'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
    'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec',
  ];
  final d = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(millis);
  var h = d.hour % 12;
  if (h == 0) h = 12;
  final ampm = d.hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM';
  final mm = d.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
  return '${months[d.month - 1]} ${d.day} · $h:$mm $ampm';
}

class LeaderboardScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LeaderboardScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LeaderboardScreen> createState() => _LeaderboardScreenState();
}

class _LeaderboardScreenState extends State<LeaderboardScreen> {
  static const _channel = MethodChannel('net.itak/emu');
  static const _modes = ['Players', 'Top Games', 'Most Played', 'Last Played'];
  List<_PlayerStat> _players = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  int _mode = 0;
  final FocusNode _focusNode = FocusNode();

  // Board scope: 0 = this box (Local), 1 = everyone (Global),
  // 2 = the tournament board. The switch lives in the top bar
  // now (David, 2026-10-12), next to the back button. Remote
  // focus moves through three zones: 0 = top bar (Back and the
  // board pills), 1 = filter chips, 2 = the rows. UP/DOWN
  // travel between zones and through the rows, so the back
  // button is reachable and the board itself can be browsed.
  // The tournament board has no filter chips: its zone 1 is
  // skipped in both directions.
  int _scope = 0;
  int _zone = 1;
  int _barIndex = 0; // 0 = Back, 1 = Local, 2 = Global, 3 = Tournament
  int _selIndex = 0;
  int _rowCount = 0;
  // Hold-to-scroll: holding UP or DOWN on the remote sends repeat
  // events; the streak counts them so the rows move faster the
  // longer the button is held (David, 2026-10-12).
  int _streak = 0;
  LogicalKeyboardKey? _streakKey;

  int get _rowStep => _streak < 6 ? 1 : (_streak < 16 ? 3 : 5);
  final ScrollController _listScroll = ScrollController();
  final Map<int, GlobalKey> _rowKeys = {};
  List<_PlayerStat> _gPlayers = [];
  List<_GameStat> _gGames = [];
  List<({String player, String display, String region, _GameStat game})>
      _gRecent = [];
  bool _gLoaded = false;
  bool _gFailed = false;
  // The tournament board (PROTOCOL.md 8): ranked records plus
  // the recent results feed, from the server's matches store.
  List<_TPlayer> _tPlayers = [];
  List<_TResult> _tRecent = [];
  bool _tLoaded = false;
  bool _tFailed = false;
  // Friend names for the current player, from the server's friends
  // store. Players rows carry a Friend chip when their name is in
  // here, and OK on a Players row toggles membership.
  Set<String> _friendNames = {};
  String _myName = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    _loadFriends();
    PlayerInfoStore.load().then((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _focusNode.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _listScroll.dispose();
    _focusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _setScope(int scope) {
    if (scope == _scope) return;
    setState(() {
      _scope = scope;
      _selIndex = 0;
    });
    _scrollTop();
    if (scope == 1 && !_gLoaded) _fetchGlobal();
    if (scope == 2 && !_tLoaded) _fetchTournament();
  }

  void _setMode(int mode) {
    setState(() {
      _mode = mode;
      _selIndex = 0;
    });
    _scrollTop();
  }

  void _scrollTop() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (_listScroll.hasClients) _listScroll.jumpTo(0);
    });
  }

  void _scrollToSel() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final ctx = _rowKeys[_selIndex]?.currentContext;
      if (ctx != null) {
        Scrollable.ensureVisible(
          ctx,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
        );
      }
    });
  }

  KeyEventResult _onKey(FocusNode node, KeyEvent event) {
    if (event is KeyUpEvent) {
      _streak = 0;
      _streakKey = null;
      return KeyEventResult.ignored;
    }
    if (event is! KeyDownEvent && event is! KeyRepeatEvent) {
      return KeyEventResult.ignored;
    }
    final key = event.logicalKey;
    // Hold streak bookkeeping: a fresh press starts at zero, each
    // repeat of the same key grows it, a different key resets it.
    if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
      _streak = 0;
      _streakKey = key;
    } else if (_streakKey == key) {
      _streak++;
    } else {
      _streak = 0;
      _streakKey = key;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.escape ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonB ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.browserBack) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 2) {
          if (_selIndex > 0) {
            _selIndex = (_selIndex - _rowStep).clamp(0, _selIndex);
            _scrollToSel();
          } else {
            // The tournament board has no chips zone to land on.
            _zone = _scope == 2 ? 0 : 1;
          }
        } else if (_zone == 1) {
          _zone = 0;
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown) {
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 0) {
          // The tournament board has no filter chips: DOWN
          // from the top bar goes straight to its rows.
          if (_scope == 2) {
            if (_rowCount > 0) {
              _zone = 2;
              _selIndex = 0;
              _scrollToSel();
            }
          } else {
            _zone = 1;
          }
        } else if (_zone == 1) {
          if (_rowCount > 0) {
            _zone = 2;
            _selIndex = 0;
            _scrollToSel();
          }
        } else if (_selIndex < _rowCount - 1) {
          _selIndex = (_selIndex + _rowStep).clamp(0, _rowCount - 1);
          _scrollToSel();
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight) {
      final dir = key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft ? -1 : 1;
      setState(() {
        if (_zone == 0) {
          _barIndex = (_barIndex + dir).clamp(0, 3);
        } else if (_zone == 1) {
          _mode = (_mode + dir + _modes.length) % _modes.length;
          _selIndex = 0;
          _scrollTop();
        } else if (_rowCount > 0) {
          // In the rows, LEFT/RIGHT jump five rows at a time.
          _selIndex = (_selIndex + dir * 5).clamp(0, _rowCount - 1);
          _scrollToSel();
        }
      });
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA) {
      if (_zone == 0) {
        if (_barIndex == 0) {
          Navigator.of(context).pop();
        } else {
          _setScope(_barIndex - 1);
        }
      } else if (_zone == 2 && event is KeyDownEvent) {
        // OK on a Players row adds that player as a friend of the
        // current player, or removes them if they already are one.
        // Only on the fresh press: a held OK must not toggle twice.
        // Your own row does nothing (checked in _toggleFriend).
        final name = _selectedPlayerName();
        if (name != null) _toggleFriend(name);
      }
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    // Handled or not, arrows never fall through to focus traversal:
    // the AppBar back button would take focus on UP and strand input.
    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
  }

  Future<dynamic> _getJson(String path) async {
    final client = HttpClient();
    client.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 6);
    try {
      final req = await client.getUrl(Uri.parse('$kServerBase$path'));
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      final text = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      if (resp.statusCode >= 400) throw Exception('HTTP ${resp.statusCode}');
      return jsonDecode(text);
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  Future<dynamic> _postJson(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body) async {
