    final client = HttpClient();
    client.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 6);
    try {
      final req = await client.postUrl(Uri.parse('$kServerBase$path'));
      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.write(jsonEncode(body));
      final resp = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      final text = await resp.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      if (resp.statusCode >= 400) throw Exception('HTTP ${resp.statusCode}');
      return text.isEmpty ? null : jsonDecode(text);
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  // The current player, resolved the same way the rest of the app
  // resolves it: the current_player pref.
  Future<String> _currentPlayerName() async {
    final p = await Prefs.get('current_player');
    return (p == null || p.isEmpty) ? 'Player 1' : p;
  }

  void _applyFriends(dynamic data) {
    final list = (data is Map ? data['friends'] : null) as List?;
    if (list == null) return;
    final names = <String>{};
    for (final e in list) {
      if (e is Map) {
        final n = (e['name'] ?? '').toString();
        if (n.isNotEmpty) names.add(n);
      }
    }
    _friendNames = names;
  }

  // The friend set comes from the server, never from local play
  // stats: it belongs to the account name, not to this box.
  Future<void> _loadFriends() async {
    try {
      final me = await _currentPlayerName();
      _myName = me;
      final data =
          await _getJson('/friends?player=${Uri.encodeQueryComponent(me)}');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _applyFriends(data));
    } catch (_) {
      // Friends are a bonus: a failed load just shows no chips.
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleFriend(String name) async {
    if (name.isEmpty) return;
    if (_myName.isEmpty) _myName = await _currentPlayerName();
    if (name == _myName) return;
    try {
      final path =
          _friendNames.contains(name) ? '/friends/remove' : '/friends';
      await _postJson(path, {'player': _myName, 'friend': name});
      // Re-read the set so the chips always match the server copy.
      await _loadFriends();
    } catch (_) {
      // Leave the chips as they are on any failure.
    }
  }

  // The player name behind the selected row, Players mode only.
  // Rows in the other modes are games or activity, not people.
  String? _selectedPlayerName() {
    // Tournament rows are match records, not friend toggles.
    if (_scope == 2) return null;
    if (_mode != 0) return null;
    final list = _scope == 1 ? _gPlayers : _players;
    if (_selIndex < 0 || _selIndex >= list.length) return null;
    return list[_selIndex].name;
  }

  Future<void> _fetchGlobal() async {
    try {
      final players = await _getJson('/leaderboard/players') as List;
      final games = await _getJson('/leaderboard/games') as List;
      final recent = await _getJson('/leaderboard/recent') as List;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _gPlayers = players.map((e) {
          final m = e as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return _PlayerStat(
            m['player']?.toString() ?? 'Player',
            const [],
            gamesCountOverride: (m['games'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            secondsOverride: (m['seconds'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            playsOverride: (m['plays'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            display: m['display']?.toString() ?? '',
            region: m['region']?.toString() ?? '',
          );
        }).toList();
        _gGames = games.map((e) {
          final m = e as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return _GameStat(
            m['game']?.toString() ?? '',
            (m['plays'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            (m['seconds'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            0,
          );
        }).toList();
        _gRecent = recent.map((e) {
          final m = e as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return (
            player: m['player']?.toString() ?? 'Player',
            display: m['display']?.toString() ?? '',
            region: m['region']?.toString() ?? '',
            game: _GameStat(
              m['game']?.toString() ?? '',
              (m['plays'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
              (m['seconds'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
              (m['lastPlayed'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            ),
          );
        }).toList();
        _gLoaded = true;
        _gFailed = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _gLoaded = true;
        _gFailed = true;
      });
    }
  }

  // The tournament board (PROTOCOL.md 8): ranked records and
  // the recent results feed from the server's matches store,
  // a different store from the playtime boards above. Fetched
  // lazily on first entry, the same way the global board is.
  Future<void> _fetchTournament() async {
    try {
      final board =
          await _getJson('/matches/leaderboard') as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final feed =
          await _getJson('/matches/recent') as Map<String, dynamic>;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _tPlayers = ((board['players'] as List?) ?? []).map((e) {
          final m = e as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return _TPlayer(
            name: m['name']?.toString() ?? 'Player',
            display: m['display']?.toString() ?? '',
            region: m['region']?.toString() ?? '',
            wins: (m['wins'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            losses: (m['losses'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            matches: (m['matches'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            tournamentsWon: (m['tournamentsWon'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            lastTournament: m['lastTournament']?.toString() ?? '',
            lastGame: m['lastGame']?.toString() ?? '',
            lastTitle: m['lastTitle']?.toString() ?? '',
          );
        }).toList();
        _tRecent = ((feed['recent'] as List?) ?? []).map((e) {
          final m = e as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return _TResult(
            tournament: m['tournament']?.toString() ?? '',
            game: m['game']?.toString() ?? '',
            winner: m['winner']?.toString() ?? 'Player',
            loser: m['loser']?.toString() ?? 'Player',
            at: (m['at'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
          );
        }).toList();
        _tLoaded = true;
        _tFailed = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _tLoaded = true;
        _tFailed = true;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    var players = <_PlayerStat>[];
    try {
      final raw =
          await _channel.invokeMethod<String>('getLeaderboard') ?? '[]';
      final list = jsonDecode(raw) as List<dynamic>;
      for (final entry in list) {
        final map = entry as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final gamesMap =
            (map['games'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? <String, dynamic>{});
        final games = gamesMap.entries.map((e) {
          final g = e.value as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return _GameStat(
            e.key,
            (g['plays'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            (g['seconds'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
            (g['last'] as num? ?? 0).toInt(),
          );
        }).toList();
        players.add(_PlayerStat(map['name']?.toString() ?? 'Player', games));
      }
    } catch (_) {
      players = [];
    }
    players.sort((a, b) => b.totalSeconds.compareTo(a.totalSeconds));
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _players = players;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  List<_GameStat> _aggGames({required bool byPlays}) {
    final byRom = <String, _GameStat>{};
    for (final p in _players) {
      for (final g in p.games) {
        final cur = byRom[g.rom];
        byRom[g.rom] = cur == null
            ? g
            : _GameStat(g.rom, cur.plays + g.plays,
                cur.seconds + g.seconds, cur.last > g.last ? cur.last : g.last);
      }
    }
    final all = byRom.values.toList();
    if (byPlays) {
      all.sort((a, b) => b.plays.compareTo(a.plays));
    } else {
      all.sort((a, b) => b.seconds.compareTo(a.seconds));
    }
    return all.take(10).toList();
  }

  // Display identity for a row. Global rows use the identity the
  // player's own box reported; local rows resolve through this box's
  // player info. The two never mix: a global "David" from another
  // house must not inherit this box's David's initials.
  String _dispName(_PlayerStat p, bool global) {
    if (global) return p.display.isNotEmpty ? p.display : p.name;
    return PlayerInfoStore.displayOf(p.name);
  }

  String _regionOf(_PlayerStat p, bool global) {
    if (global) return p.region;
    return PlayerInfoStore.of(p.name)?.region ?? '';
  }

  Widget _regionTag(String region) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white10,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
      ),
      child: Text(
        region,
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.white70),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Trailing marker on a Players row whose name is in the current
  // player's friend set. Styled like the lobby list's Open chip.
  Widget _friendChip() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF00E676).withOpacity(0.14),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(
          color: const Color(0xFF00E676).withOpacity(0.55),
        ),
      ),
      child: const Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.person, size: 13, color: Color(0xFF00E676)),
          SizedBox(width: 4),
          Text(
            'Friend',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: Color(0xFF00E676),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _playerCard(int rank, _PlayerStat p, {bool global = false}) {
    final fav = p.favorite;
    final region = _regionOf(p, global);
    final medalColor = rank == 1
        ? const Color(0xFFFFD54F)
        : rank == 2
            ? const Color(0xFFB0BEC5)
            : rank == 3
                ? const Color(0xFFBCAAA4)
                : const Color(0xFF424242);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 9),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 17,
            backgroundColor: medalColor,
            child: Text(
              '$rank',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Colors.black87,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          PlayerAvatar(name: p.name, size: 32),
          const SizedBox(width: 11),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        _dispName(p, global),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (region.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 9),
                      _regionTag(region),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                Text(
                  'Time played: ${_fmtDuration(p.totalSeconds)} · '
                  'Games: ${p.gamesCount} · Launches: ${p.totalPlays}',
                  style:
                      const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: Colors.white70),
                ),
                if (_mode == 0 && fav != null)
                  Text(
                    'Favorite: ${fav.name} (${_fmtDuration(fav.seconds)})',
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white54),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (_friendNames.contains(p.name)) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            _friendChip(),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rows = _loading ? const <Widget>[] : _visibleContent();
    _rowCount = rows.length;
    if (_selIndex >= _rowCount) {
      _selIndex = _rowCount == 0 ? 0 : _rowCount - 1;
    }
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Leaderboard'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        // The board switch lives in the top bar now, beside
        // the back button (David, 2026-10-12). UP from anywhere
        // below reaches this row; OK picks Back or a board:
        // Local, Global, or Tournament.
        // A custom leading button (instead of the automatic one) so
        // remote focus on Back is visible.
        leading: Center(
          child: GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: Container(
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: _zone == 0 && _barIndex == 0
                      ? Colors.white
                      : Colors.white24,
                  width: _zone == 0 && _barIndex == 0 ? 2.5 : 1,
                ),
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, size: 21),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          _scopePill('Local', 0),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _scopePill('Global', 1),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          _scopePill('Tournament', 2),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
        ],
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFF2A1152), Color(0xFF140B2E), Color(0xFF0A1A33)],
          ),
        ),
        child: _loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            : Focus(
                focusNode: _focusNode,
                onKeyEvent: _onKey,
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    // The mode chips sort the playtime boards.
                    // The tournament board keeps the server's
                    // own order (titles, then wins), so the
                    // chips hide while it is up.
                    if (_scope != 2)
                      Wrap(
                        spacing: 10,
                        alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          for (var i = 0; i < _modes.length; i++)
                          GestureDetector(
                            onTap: () => _setMode(i),
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 18, vertical: 8),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: _mode == i
                                    ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
                                    : const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: _zone == 1 && _mode == i
                                      ? Colors.white
                                      : (_mode == i
                                          ? Colors.white54
                                          : Colors.white24),
                                  width: _zone == 1 && _mode == i ? 2.5 : 1,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                _modes[i],
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 16.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color:
                                      _mode == i ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    Expanded(child: _contentArea(rows)),
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                      child: Text(
                        'UP for the top bar · DOWN to browse the board · '
                        'LEFT / RIGHT switch boards · BACK returns',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: Colors.white38),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _scopePill(String label, int scope) {
    final active = _scope == scope;
    final focused = _zone == 0 && _barIndex == scope + 1;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _zone = 0;
          _barIndex = scope + 1;
        });
        _setScope(scope);
      },
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          // Rectangular segmented look in the app's card language, no
          // green fill (David, 2026-10-12): the current board is the
          // lighter card with a plain border, remote focus thickens
          // the border to white.
          color: active ? const Color(0xFF2E2E4A) : const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
          border: Border.all(
            color: focused
                ? Colors.white
                : (active ? Colors.white54 : Colors.white24),
            width: focused ? 2.5 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: active ? Colors.white : Colors.white60,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _emptyText() {
    if (_scope == 2) {
      if (!_tLoaded) return 'Loading the tournament board...';
      if (_tFailed) {
        return 'Cannot reach the leaderboard server.\n'
            'Tournament results are kept there.';
      }
      return 'No tournament matches yet.\n'
          'Host a room with a tournament name to start one.';
    }
    if (_scope == 1) {
      if (!_gLoaded) return 'Loading the global board...';
      if (_gFailed) {
        return 'Cannot reach the leaderboard server.\n'
            'Local scores are under the Local switch.';
      }
      return 'No global play time yet.\n'
          'Finished games send their totals here.';
    }
    return 'No play time logged yet.\n'
        'Stats start counting as soon as someone plays.';
  }

  Widget _contentArea(List<Widget> rows) {
    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
          child: Text(
            _emptyText(),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: Colors.grey),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return Center(
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 1060,
        child: ListView(
          controller: _listScroll,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
          children: [
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) _selectable(i, rows[i]),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Wraps one board row with its remote-selection ring and the key
  // the scroller uses to keep the selected row on screen.
  Widget _selectable(int i, Widget child) {
    final sel = _zone == 2 && _selIndex == i;
    return Container(
      key: _rowKeys.putIfAbsent(i, () => GlobalKey()),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
        border: Border.all(
          color: sel ? Colors.white : Colors.transparent,
          width: 2.5,
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _visibleContent() {
    if (_scope == 0) return _modeContent();
    if (_scope == 2) return _tournamentContent();
    switch (_mode) {
      case 1: // Top Games, by time
        final games = [..._gGames]
          ..sort((a, b) => b.seconds.compareTo(a.seconds));
        final top = games.take(10).toList();
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < top.length; i++)
            _gameRow(i + 1, top[i],
                '${_fmtDuration(top[i].seconds)} · ${top[i].plays} plays'),
        ];
      case 2: // Most Played, by launches
        final games = [..._gGames]
          ..sort((a, b) => b.plays.compareTo(a.plays));
        final top = games.take(10).toList();
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < top.length; i++)
            _gameRow(i + 1, top[i],
                '${top[i].plays} plays · ${_fmtDuration(top[i].seconds)}'),
        ];
      case 3: // Last Played across everyone
        return [
          for (final e in _gRecent)
            Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              padding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  PlayerAvatar(name: e.player, size: 30),
                  const SizedBox(width: 11),
                  Text(
                    e.display.isNotEmpty ? e.display : e.player,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  if (e.region.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    _regionTag(e.region),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(width: 13),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      e.game.name,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    _fmtWhen(e.game.last),
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white60),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ];
      default: // Players
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < _gPlayers.length; i++)
            _playerCard(i + 1, _gPlayers[i], global: true),
        ];
    }
  }

  // The tournament board: the ranked rows in the server's
  // order, then the recent results under a header. One list,
  // so the remote browses both the way it browses the other
  // boards.
  List<Widget> _tournamentContent() {
    final rows = <Widget>[
      for (var i = 0; i < _tPlayers.length; i++)
        _tournamentRow(i + 1, _tPlayers[i]),
    ];
    if (_tRecent.isNotEmpty) {
      rows.add(const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 18, bottom: 6, left: 4),
        child: Text(
          'Recent results',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
      ));
      for (final r in _tRecent) {
        rows.add(_tournamentRecentRow(r));
      }
    }
    return rows;
  }

  // One tournament row, in _playerCard's shape: rank medal,
  // avatar, identity with its region tag, the record under it.
  Widget _tournamentRow(int rank, _TPlayer p) {
    final medalColor = rank == 1
        ? const Color(0xFFFFD54F)
        : rank == 2
            ? const Color(0xFFB0BEC5)
            : rank == 3
                ? const Color(0xFFBCAAA4)
                : const Color(0xFF424242);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 9),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 17,
            backgroundColor: medalColor,
            child: Text(
              '$rank',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Colors.black87,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          PlayerAvatar(name: p.name, size: 32),
          const SizedBox(width: 11),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        p.display.isNotEmpty ? p.display : p.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (p.region.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 9),
                      _regionTag(p.region),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                Text(
                  'Record: ${p.wins}-${p.losses} · Matches: ${p.matches} · '
                  'Titles: ${p.tournamentsWon}',
                  style:
                      const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: Colors.white70),
                ),
                if (p.lastTitle.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    'Latest title: ${p.lastTitle}',
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white54),
                  )
                else if (p.lastTournament.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    'Last event: ${p.lastTournament}',
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white54),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // One recent result: who beat who, in which event, at what.
  Widget _tournamentRecentRow(_TResult r) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          PlayerAvatar(name: r.winner, size: 30),
          const SizedBox(width: 11),
          Text(
            '${r.winner} def. ${r.loser}',
            style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 16.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 13),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              '${r.tournament} · ${_GameStat(r.game, 0, 0, 0).name}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5),
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            _fmtWhen(r.at),
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white60),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _modeContent() {
    switch (_mode) {
      case 1: // Top Games, by time
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < _aggGames(byPlays: false).length; i++)
            _gameRow(i + 1, _aggGames(byPlays: false)[i],
                '${_fmtDuration(_aggGames(byPlays: false)[i].seconds)} · ${_aggGames(byPlays: false)[i].plays} plays'),
        ];
      case 2: // Most Played, by launches
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < _aggGames(byPlays: true).length; i++)
            _gameRow(i + 1, _aggGames(byPlays: true)[i],
                '${_aggGames(byPlays: true)[i].plays} plays · ${_fmtDuration(_aggGames(byPlays: true)[i].seconds)}'),
        ];
      case 3: // Last Played, newest first across players
        final entries = <(_PlayerStat, _GameStat)>[
          for (final p in _players)
            if (p.mostRecent != null) (p, p.mostRecent!),
        ]..sort((a, b) => b.$2.last.compareTo(a.$2.last));
        return [
          for (final e in entries)
            Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  PlayerAvatar(name: e.$1.name, size: 30),
                  const SizedBox(width: 11),
                  Text(
                    PlayerInfoStore.displayOf(e.$1.name),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  if ((PlayerInfoStore.of(e.$1.name)?.region ?? '')
                      .isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    _regionTag(PlayerInfoStore.of(e.$1.name)!.region),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(width: 13),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      e.$2.name,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    _fmtWhen(e.$2.last),
                    style:
                        const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.white60),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ];
      default: // Players
        return [
          for (var i = 0; i < _players.length; i++)
            _playerCard(i + 1, _players[i]),
        ];
    }
  }

  Widget _gameRow(int rank, _GameStat g, String right) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFF1B1B28),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white12),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 14,
            backgroundColor: rank == 1
                ? const Color(0xFFFFD54F)
                : const Color(0xFF37474F),
            child: Text(
              '$rank',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: rank == 1 ? Colors.black87 : Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              g.name,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16.5),
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            right,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white70),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TV keyboard: a big on-screen keyboard the remote and gamepad can drive.
// The TV's own pop-up keyboard does not take D-pad focus inside our
// dialogs, so names and search are typed here instead.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Future<String?> showTvKeyboard(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  String initial = '',
}) {
  return showDialog<String>(
    context: context,
    barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.85),
    builder: (_) => TvKeyboardDialog(title: title, initial: initial),
  );
}

class TvKeyboardDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final String title;
  final String initial;
  const TvKeyboardDialog({super.key, required this.title, this.initial = ''});

  @override
  State<TvKeyboardDialog> createState() => _TvKeyboardDialogState();
}

class _TvKeyboardDialogState extends State<TvKeyboardDialog> {
  static const _rows = [
    'ABCDEFGHIJ',
    'KLMNOPQRST',
    'UVWXYZ1234',
    "567890-.'",
  ];
  static const _actions = ['Space', 'Delete', 'Done', 'Cancel'];
  late String _text;
  int _row = 0;
  int _col = 0;
  final FocusNode _focusNode = FocusNode();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _text = widget.initial;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _focusNode.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _focusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _cols => _row < _rows.length ? _rows[_row].length : _actions.length;

  bool _isSelectKey(LogicalKeyboardKey k) =>
      k == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
      k == LogicalKeyboardKey.select ||
      k == LogicalKeyboardKey.space ||
      k == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonA;

  void _press() {
    if (_row < _rows.length) {
      setState(() {
        if (_text.length < 40) _text += _rows[_row][_col];
      });
      return;
    }
    switch (_col) {
      case 0: // Space
        setState(() {
          if (_text.length < 40) _text += ' ';
        });
        break;
      case 1: // Delete
        setState(() {
          if (_text.isNotEmpty) _text = _text.substring(0, _text.length - 1);
        });
        break;
      case 2: // Done
        Navigator.pop(context, _text);
        break;
      case 3: // Cancel
        Navigator.pop(context, null);
        break;
    }
  }

  void _onKey(KeyEvent event) {
    if (event is! KeyDownEvent) return;
    final key = event.logicalKey;
    // A real keyboard can just type.
    final ch = event.character;
    if (ch != null && ch.length == 1 && ch.codeUnitAt(0) >= 32) {
      setState(() {
        if (_text.length < 40) _text += ch;
      });
      return;
    }
    if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.backspace) {
      setState(() {
        if (_text.isNotEmpty) _text = _text.substring(0, _text.length - 1);
      });
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.escape ||
        key == LogicalKeyboardKey.gameButtonB) {
      Navigator.pop(context, null);
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft) {
      setState(() => _col = (_col - 1 + _cols) % _cols);
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight) {
      setState(() => _col = (_col + 1) % _cols);
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp) {
      setState(() {
        _row = (_row - 1 + _rows.length + 1) % (_rows.length + 1);
        if (_col >= _cols) _col = _cols - 1;
      });
    } else if (key == LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown) {
      setState(() {
        _row = (_row + 1) % (_rows.length + 1);
        if (_col >= _cols) _col = _cols - 1;
      });
    } else if (_isSelectKey(key)) {
      _press();
    }
  }

  Widget _cell(String label, bool focused, {bool wide = false}) {
    return AnimatedContainer(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
      width: wide ? 150 : 68,
      height: 58,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
      alignment: Alignment.center,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: focused ? const Color(0xFF00E676) : const Color(0xFF2E2E47),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(
          color: focused ? Colors.white : Colors.white12,
          width: focused ? 3 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: wide ? 19 : 25,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          color: focused ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E1E2E),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
      child: KeyboardListener(
        focusNode: _focusNode,
        onKeyEvent: _onKey,
        child: Container(
          width: 820,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(26),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.title,
                style:
                    const TextStyle(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFF12121E),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  _text.isEmpty ? 'Type a name…' : '$_text▌',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 24,
                    color: _text.isEmpty ? Colors.white38 : Colors.white,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              for (var r = 0; r < _rows.length; r++)
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    for (var c = 0; c < _rows[r].length; c++)
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          setState(() {
                            _row = r;
                            _col = c;
                          });
                          _press();
                        },
                        child: _cell(_rows[r][c], _row == r && _col == c),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  for (var c = 0; c < _actions.length; c++)
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        setState(() {
                          _row = _rows.length;
                          _col = c;
                        });
                        _press();
                      },
                      child: _cell(
                        _actions[c],
                        _row == _rows.length && _col == c,
                        wide: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Player avatars: generated pictures (DiceBear) picked per player, cached
// on the device. Falls back to the colored initial letter.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Avatars {
  static const styleIds = [
    'pixel-art',
    'bottts',
    'adventurer',
    'avataaars',
    'fun-emoji',
    'personas',
  ];
  static const styleNames = [
    'Pixel',
    'Robots',
    'Adventurer',
    'Toons',
    'Fun Faces',
    'People',
  ];
  static Map<String, String> _map = {};
  static bool _loaded = false;

  static Future<void> load() async {
    if (_loaded) return;
    _loaded = true;
    final raw = await Prefs.get('avatars');
    if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        _map = decoded.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toString()));
      } catch (_) {
        _map = {};
      }
    }
  }

  static (String, String)? parse(String name) {
    final k = _map[name];
    if (k == null) return null;
    final i = k.indexOf(':');
    if (i <= 0) return null;
    return (k.substring(0, i), k.substring(i + 1));
  }

  static Future<void> _save() => Prefs.set('avatars', jsonEncode(_map));

  static Future<void> set(String name, String style, String seed) async {
    await load();
    _map[name] = '$style:$seed';
    await _save();
  }

  static Future<void> clear(String name) async {
    await load();
    _map.remove(name);
    await _save();
  }

  static Future<void> rename(String oldName, String newName) async {
    await load();
    final k = _map.remove(oldName);
    if (k != null) {
      _map[newName] = k;
      await _save();
    }
  }

  static File fileFor(String style, String seed) {
    final safe = seed.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_-]'), '_');
    return File('/sdcard/iTaK/avatars/${style}_$safe.png');
  }

  static final Map<String, Future<File?>> _inflight = {};

  static Future<File?> get(String style, String seed) {
    // One download per picture at a time: without this, every
    // rebuild of a picker tile or avatar widget restarts the same
    // download, and the picker fills with spinners that never land
    // (David, 2026-11-03). Callers share the in-flight future; the
    // disk cache check still runs first inside _fetch.
    final key = '$style:$seed';
    return _inflight.putIfAbsent(key, () {
      final f = _fetch(style, seed);
      f.whenComplete(() => _inflight.remove(key));
      return f;
    });
  }

  static Future<File?> _fetch(String style, String seed) async {
    final f = fileFor(style, seed);
    if (f.existsSync()) return f;
    final url =
        'https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/$style/png?seed=${Uri.encodeComponent(seed)}&size=96';
    final bytes = await Artwork._download(url);
    if (bytes == null || bytes.length < 400) return null;
    try {
      await f.parent.create(recursive: true);
      await f.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
      return f;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

class PlayerAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  final String name;
  final double size;
  const PlayerAvatar({super.key, required this.name, required this.size});

  Widget _letter() {
    return CircleAvatar(
      radius: size / 2,
      backgroundColor:
          kPlayerColors[name.hashCode.abs() % kPlayerColors.length],
      child: Text(
        name.isEmpty ? '?' : name[0].toUpperCase(),
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: size * 0.5,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          color: Colors.white,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final parsed = Avatars.parse(name);
    if (parsed == null) return _letter();
    return FutureBuilder<File?>(
      future: Avatars.get(parsed.$1, parsed.$2),
      builder: (ctx, snap) {
        final f = snap.data;
        if (f == null) return _letter();
        return ClipOval(
          child: Image.file(
            f,
            width: size,
            height: size,
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _letter(),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Friend alert banner: slides down from the top of the screen,
/// holds, and slides away on its own (the shell removes the
/// overlay entry at 4 s; the fade out starts a little before so
/// nothing pops). IgnorePointer wraps the whole thing: the banner
/// can never take the remote's focus or eat a key press.
class _FriendAlertBanner extends StatefulWidget {
  final String avatarName;
  final String message;
  const _FriendAlertBanner({required this.avatarName, required this.message});

  @override
  State<_FriendAlertBanner> createState() => _FriendAlertBannerState();
}

class _FriendAlertBannerState extends State<_FriendAlertBanner>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _ctrl;
  Timer? _outTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
    );
    _ctrl.forward();
    _outTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 3650), () {
      if (mounted) _ctrl.reverse();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _outTimer?.cancel();
    _ctrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final curve = CurvedAnimation(parent: _ctrl, curve: Curves.easeOut);
    return Positioned(
      top: 18,
      left: 0,
      right: 0,
      child: IgnorePointer(
        child: FadeTransition(
          opacity: curve,
          child: SlideTransition(
            position: Tween<Offset>(
              begin: const Offset(0, -1.4),
              end: Offset.zero,
            ).animate(curve),
            child: Center(
              child: Material(
                color: Colors.transparent,
                child: Container(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 18, vertical: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFF23233A),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: const Color(0xFF00E676).withOpacity(0.55),
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.45),
                        blurRadius: 18,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 6),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      PlayerAvatar(name: widget.avatarName, size: 42),
                      const SizedBox(width: 14),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          widget.message,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 19,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<void> showAvatarPicker(BuildContext context, String playerName) {
  return showDialog<void>(
    context: context,
    barrierColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.85),
    builder: (_) => _AvatarPickerDialog(playerName: playerName),
  );
}

class _AvatarPickerDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final String playerName;
  const _AvatarPickerDialog({required this.playerName});

  @override
  State<_AvatarPickerDialog> createState() => _AvatarPickerDialogState();
}

class _AvatarPickerDialogState extends State<_AvatarPickerDialog> {
  int _style = 0;
  int _focusIdx = -1;
  // Stable futures per picture: a FutureBuilder handed a fresh
  // future on every rebuild restarts its download each time, which
  // is half of why tiles spun forever (2026-11-03).
  final Map<String, Future<File?>> _tileFutures = {};

  Future<File?> _tileFuture(String style, String seed) =>
      _tileFutures.putIfAbsent('$style:$seed', () => Avatars.get(style, seed));

  List<String> get _seeds => [
        widget.playerName,
        for (var i = 2; i <= 24; i++) '${widget.playerName}-$i',
      ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final style = Avatars.styleIds[_style];
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF262640),
      title: Text('Pick a picture for ${widget.playerName}'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 660,
        height: 540,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                for (var i = 0; i < Avatars.styleIds.length; i++)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(Avatars.styleNames[i]),
                    selected: _style == i,
                    onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _style = i),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: GridView.builder(
                gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                  crossAxisCount: 6,
                  crossAxisSpacing: 10,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 10,
                ),
                itemCount: _seeds.length,
                itemBuilder: (ctx, i) {
                  final seed = _seeds[i];
                  final focused = _focusIdx == i;
                  // Tiles are real focusable buttons on a LIGHT
                  // backing. The old GestureDetector tiles could not
                  // be reached with the TV remote at all (touch
                  // only), and the transparent pictures rendered
                  // straight onto the dark dialog, so dark hair and
                  // dark features vanished (David, 2026-11-03).
                  return Material(
                    color: const Color(0xFFF2F3F7),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    child: InkWell(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      autofocus: i == 0,
                      onFocusChange: (f) {
                        if (f) setState(() => _focusIdx = i);
                      },
                      onTap: () async {
                        await Avatars.set(widget.playerName, style, seed);
                        if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: focused
                                ? const Color(0xFF00E676)
                                : Colors.transparent,
                            width: 3.5,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: ClipRRect(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                          child: FutureBuilder<File?>(
                            future: _tileFuture(style, seed),
                            builder: (ctx, snap) {
                              final f = snap.data;
                              if (f != null) {
                                return Image.file(f, fit: BoxFit.cover);
                              }
                              if (snap.connectionState ==
                                  ConnectionState.done) {
                                // The picture could not be fetched:
                                // show a placeholder, never an
                                // endless spinner.
                                return const Center(
                                  child: Icon(
                                    Icons.person,
                                    size: 40,
                                    color: Color(0xFF5A5A72),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }
                              return const Center(
                                child: SizedBox(
                                  width: 22,
                                  height: 22,
                                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                      strokeWidth: 2),
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () async {
            await Avatars.clear(widget.playerName);
            if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
          },
          child: const Text('Use letter instead'),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancel'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}


==================== FILE: flutter_ui/lib/space_background.dart ====================

// Animated deep-space backdrop for the app shell.
//
// A starfield flies toward the viewer, like looking out a ship
// window. Flight speed breathes on its own in a loop: a slow
// drift where stars are points that twinkle and the galaxies
// show, an ease up to warp where the stars stretch into
// streaks, a hold at warp, an ease back down, then repeat.
// Phase lengths are randomized so the rhythm never feels
// mechanical.
//
// Galaxy sprites are generated once at startup from
// logarithmic spiral point clouds and cached as images; no
// asset files ship with this feature and nothing is
// downloaded. A faint nebula wash sits under everything so
// the scene reads as space at any speed.
//
// Cost discipline: the star list is preallocated and the
// painter allocates nothing per frame (nebula shaders are
// rebuilt only when the size changes). The ticker belongs to
// the widget, so it stops when the shell is covered by
// another route or removed from the tree, and games run in
// a separate Android activity where this widget never
// exists.

import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';

/// The flying-through-space background. Drop it into a Stack
/// as the bottom layer, under a translucent gradient and the
/// content.
class SpaceBackground extends StatefulWidget {
  const SpaceBackground({super.key});

  @override
  State<SpaceBackground> createState() => _SpaceBackgroundState();
}

enum _Phase { drift, accel, warp, decel }

class _Star {
  double x = 0; // view-plane offset at z = 1, about -0.95..0.95
  double y = 0;
  double z = 1; // depth: 1 is far, near 0 is at the viewer
  double twinklePhase = 0;
  double twinkleSpeed = 1;
  int colorIndex = 0;
}

class _Galaxy {
  ui.Image? image;
  double fx = 0; // center as a fraction of the canvas size
  double fy = 0;
  double vx = 0; // fraction of width per second
  double vy = 0;
  double size = 240; // sprite edge, pixels
  double rotation = 0;
  double spin = 0; // radians per second
}

class _Scene {
  final List<_Star> stars = [];
  final List<_Galaxy> galaxies = [];
  double speed = _SpaceBackgroundState._driftSpeed;
  double galaxyAlpha = 1;
  double time = 0;
  double width = 0;
  double height = 0;
  final List<ui.Shader?> nebulaShaders = [null, null, null];
  double nebulaW = -1;
  double nebulaH = -1;
}

class _SpaceBackgroundState extends State<SpaceBackground>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  static const double _driftSpeed = 0.055;
  static const double _warpSpeed = 1.6;
  static const int _starCount = 260;

  static const List<Color> _starColors = [
    Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
    Color(0xFFCFE0FF),
    Color(0xFFFFE3B3),
  ];

  // tint, sprite size, start position (fraction), drift
  // velocity (fraction of width per second), spin
  static const List<(Color, double, double, double, double, double)>
      _galaxySpecs = [
    (Color(0xFFBFD4FF), 300, 0.16, 0.24, 0.0035, 0.010),
    (Color(0xFFFFD9A0), 225, 0.83, 0.17, -0.0026, -0.014),
    (Color(0xFFD3B3FF), 260, 0.68, 0.80, -0.0030, 0.008),
    (Color(0xFFA8E6D8), 200, 0.27, 0.86, 0.0042, -0.011),
    (Color(0xFFBFD4FF), 165, 0.52, 0.44, 0.0022, 0.016),
  ];

  final _Scene _scene = _Scene();
  final math.Random _rnd = math.Random(20261022);
  final ValueNotifier<double> _frame = ValueNotifier<double>(0);
  late final Ticker _ticker;
  Duration? _lastTick;
  _Phase _phase = _Phase.drift;
  double _phaseDur = 7; // first drift is short: warp comes soon
  double _phaseLeft = 7;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (var i = 0; i < _starCount; i++) {
      final s = _Star();
      _respawn(s, randomDepth: true);
      _scene.stars.add(s);
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < _galaxySpecs.length; i++) {
      final spec = _galaxySpecs[i];
      final g = _Galaxy()
        ..size = spec.$2
        ..fx = spec.$3
        ..fy = spec.$4
        ..vx = spec.$5
        ..spin = spec.$6
        ..vy = spec.$5 * 0.35
        ..rotation = _rnd.nextDouble() * math.pi * 2;
      _scene.galaxies.add(g);
      _makeGalaxyImage(spec.$1, 9100 + i * 733).then((img) {
        if (!mounted) {
          img.dispose();
          return;
        }
        g.image = img; // the running ticker repaints within a frame
      });
    }
    _ticker = createTicker(_onTick)..start();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ticker.dispose();
    _frame.dispose();
    for (final g in _scene.galaxies) {
      g.image?.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _respawn(_Star s, {bool randomDepth = false}) {
    s.x = (_rnd.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * 0.95;
    s.y = (_rnd.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * 0.95;
    s.z = randomDepth ? 0.08 + _rnd.nextDouble() * 0.92 : 1.0;
    s.twinklePhase = _rnd.nextDouble() * math.pi * 2;
    s.twinkleSpeed = 0.6 + _rnd.nextDouble() * 1.8;
    final roll = _rnd.nextDouble();
    s.colorIndex = roll < 0.6 ? 0 : (roll < 0.85 ? 1 : 2);
  }

  double _easeInOut(double u) =>
      u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3).toDouble() / 2;

  void _enterPhase(_Phase next) {
    _phase = next;
    switch (next) {
      case _Phase.drift:
        _phaseDur = 8 + _rnd.nextDouble() * 12; // 8..20 s
        break;
      case _Phase.accel:
        _phaseDur = 2.5;
        break;
      case _Phase.warp:
        _phaseDur = 4 + _rnd.nextDouble() * 6; // 4..10 s
        break;
      case _Phase.decel:
        _phaseDur = 3.0;
        break;
    }
    _phaseLeft = _phaseDur;
  }

  void _onTick(Duration elapsed) {
    final last = _lastTick;
    _lastTick = elapsed;
    if (last == null) return;
    var dt = (elapsed - last).inMicroseconds / 1000000.0;
    if (dt <= 0) return;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // a hitch never teleports the field
    _advance(dt);
    _frame.value = elapsed.inMicroseconds / 1000000.0;
  }

  void _advance(double dt) {
    final scene = _scene;
    scene.time += dt;

    _phaseLeft -= dt;
    if (_phaseLeft <= 0) {
      _enterPhase(_Phase.values[(_phase.index + 1) % _Phase.values.length]);
    }
    final u = (1 - _phaseLeft / _phaseDur).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    switch (_phase) {
      case _Phase.drift:
        scene.speed = _driftSpeed;
        break;
      case _Phase.accel:
        scene.speed =
            _driftSpeed + (_warpSpeed - _driftSpeed) * _easeInOut(u);
        break;
      case _Phase.warp:
        scene.speed = _warpSpeed;
        break;
      case _Phase.decel:
        scene.speed =
            _warpSpeed + (_driftSpeed - _warpSpeed) * _easeInOut(u);
        break;
    }

    // Galaxies are the payoff of slowing down: full view at
    // drift, nearly gone at warp, eased between.
    final norm =
        ((scene.speed - _driftSpeed) / (_warpSpeed - _driftSpeed))
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final target = 1 - 0.93 * norm;
    scene.galaxyAlpha +=
        (target - scene.galaxyAlpha) * math.min(1.0, dt * 0.9);

    final dz = scene.speed * dt * 0.5;
    for (final s in scene.stars) {
      s.z -= dz;
      if (s.z <= 0.06) _respawn(s);
    }
    for (final g in scene.galaxies) {
      g.fx += g.vx * dt * (1 + scene.speed * 0.35);
      g.fy += g.vy * dt;
      g.rotation += g.spin * dt;
      // Wrap around with a margin of one sprite width.
      if (scene.width > 0) {
        final m = g.size / scene.width + 0.05;
        if (g.vx > 0 && g.fx > 1 + m) g.fx = -m;
        if (g.vx < 0 && g.fx < -m) g.fx = 1 + m;
      }
      if (g.fy < -0.3) g.fy = 1.3;
      if (g.fy > 1.3) g.fy = -0.3;
    }
  }

  /// One spiral galaxy sprite: a bright soft core and two
  /// logarithmic spiral arms of points, alpha fading outward,
  /// tinted per galaxy. Drawn once, cached as an image.
  Future<ui.Image> _makeGalaxyImage(Color tint, int seed) async {
    const double dim = 256;
    final rnd = math.Random(seed);
    final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();
    final canvas = Canvas(recorder);
    const center = Offset(dim / 2, dim / 2);

    final glow = Paint()
      ..shader = ui.Gradient.radial(center, dim * 0.30, [
        tint.withAlpha(64),
        tint.withAlpha(0),
      ]);
    canvas.drawCircle(center, dim * 0.30, glow);

    final paint = Paint()..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
    const arms = 2;
    const points = 850;
    for (var a = 0; a < arms; a++) {
      final armOffset = a * math.pi;
      for (var i = 0; i < points; i++) {
        final t = math.pow(rnd.nextDouble(), 0.72).toDouble() *
            math.pi *
            2.6;
        final r = 3 * math.exp(0.45 * t);
        if (r > 122) continue;
        final jitter = 1.5 + r * 0.07;
        final px = center.dx +
            r * math.cos(t + armOffset) +
            (rnd.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * jitter;
        final py = center.dy +
            r * math.sin(t + armOffset) * 0.82 +
            (rnd.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * jitter;
        final fade = (1 - r / 128).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        final alpha =
            (fade * 165 * (0.35 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.65)).round();
        if (alpha <= 2) continue;
        paint.color = Color.lerp(tint, Colors.white, rnd.nextDouble() * 0.55)!
            .withAlpha(alpha);
        paint.strokeWidth =
            (1 + rnd.nextDouble() * 2.1) * (1.15 - r / 170);
        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(px, py), paint.strokeWidth / 2, paint);
      }
    }
    final picture = recorder.endRecording();
    final img = await picture.toImage(dim.toInt(), dim.toInt());
    picture.dispose();
    return img;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        _scene.width = constraints.maxWidth;
        _scene.height = constraints.maxHeight;
        return RepaintBoundary(
          child: CustomPaint(
            painter: _SpacePainter(_scene, repaint: _frame),
            size: Size.infinite,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _SpacePainter extends CustomPainter {
  _SpacePainter(this.scene, {required Listenable repaint})
      : super(repaint: repaint);

  final _Scene scene;
  final Paint _fill = Paint();
  final Paint _stroke = Paint()
    ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
  final Paint _imagePaint = Paint()..filterQuality = FilterQuality.medium;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    _paintNebula(canvas, size);
    _paintGalaxies(canvas, size);
    _paintStars(canvas, size);
  }

  void _paintNebula(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (scene.nebulaW != size.width || scene.nebulaH != size.height) {
      scene.nebulaW = size.width;
      scene.nebulaH = size.height;
      final w = size.width;
      final h = size.height;
      scene.nebulaShaders[0] = ui.Gradient.radial(
        Offset(w * 0.16, h * 0.20),
        w * 0.55,
        const [Color(0x2E5E35B1), Color(0x005E35B1)],
      );
      scene.nebulaShaders[1] = ui.Gradient.radial(
        Offset(w * 0.86, h * 0.78),
        w * 0.50,
        const [Color(0x241565C0), Color(0x001565C0)],
      );
      scene.nebulaShaders[2] = ui.Gradient.radial(
        Offset(w * 0.50, h * 0.95),
        w * 0.46,
        const [Color(0x1A7B1FA2), Color(0x007B1FA2)],
      );
    }
    final rect = Offset.zero & size;
    for (final shader in scene.nebulaShaders) {
      if (shader == null) continue;
      _fill.shader = shader;
      canvas.drawRect(rect, _fill);
    }
    _fill.shader = null;
  }

  void _paintGalaxies(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final alpha = scene.galaxyAlpha.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    if (alpha < 0.01) return;
    _imagePaint.colorFilter = ColorFilter.mode(
      Color.fromRGBO(255, 255, 255, alpha),
      BlendMode.modulate,
    );
    for (final g in scene.galaxies) {
      final img = g.image;
      if (img == null) continue;
      canvas.save();
      canvas.translate(g.fx * size.width, g.fy * size.height);
      canvas.rotate(g.rotation);
      canvas.drawImageRect(
        img,
        Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, img.width.toDouble(), img.height.toDouble()),
        Rect.fromCenter(
            center: Offset.zero, width: g.size, height: g.size),
        _imagePaint,
      );
      canvas.restore();
    }
  }

  void _paintStars(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final cx = size.width / 2;
    final cy = size.height / 2;
    final scaleR = (size.height / 1080).clamp(0.7, 1.4);
    final speed = scene.speed;
    // Matches the per-frame z travel in _advance: streaks run
    // from where the star was last frame to where it is now.
    final dz = speed * 0.016 * 0.5;
    final warp = speed > 0.4;
    for (final s in scene.stars) {
      final sx = cx + (s.x / s.z) * cx;
      final sy = cy + (s.y / s.z) * cy;
      if (sx < -48 || sx > size.width + 48 || sy < -48 || sy > size.height + 48) {
        continue;
      }
      final twinkle =
          0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(scene.time * s.twinkleSpeed + s.twinklePhase);
      final bright = (1.18 - s.z).clamp(0.22, 1.0) * twinkle;
      final color = _SpaceBackgroundState._starColors[s.colorIndex]
          .withAlpha((bright * 255).round().clamp(0, 255));
      final radius = ((1.1 - s.z) * 1.9 + 0.35) * scaleR;
      if (warp) {
        final pz = s.z + dz;
        final px = cx + (s.x / pz) * cx;
        final py = cy + (s.y / pz) * cy;
        _stroke.color = color;
        _stroke.strokeWidth = radius * 1.15;
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(px, py), Offset(sx, sy), _stroke);
      } else {
        _fill.color = color;
        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(sx, sy), radius, _fill);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_SpacePainter oldDelegate) =>
      !identical(scene, oldDelegate.scene);
}

# TODO: Move the rest of this into files in ephemeral. See
# https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/57146.

# Serves the same purpose as list(TRANSFORM ... PREPEND ...),
# which isn't available in 3.10.
function(list_prepend LIST_NAME PREFIX)
    set(NEW_LIST "")
    foreach(element ${${LIST_NAME}})
        list(APPEND NEW_LIST "${PREFIX}${element}")
    endforeach(element)
    set(${LIST_NAME} "${NEW_LIST}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

==================== FILE: flutter_ui/linux/my_application.cc ====================

#include "my_application.h"

#include <flutter_linux/flutter_linux.h>
#ifdef GDK_WINDOWING_X11
#include <gdk/gdkx.h>
#endif

#include "flutter/generated_plugin_registrant.h"

struct _MyApplication {
  GtkApplication parent_instance;
  char** dart_entrypoint_arguments;
};

G_DEFINE_TYPE(MyApplication, my_application, GTK_TYPE_APPLICATION)

// Implements GApplication::activate.
static void my_application_activate(GApplication* application) {
  MyApplication* self = MY_APPLICATION(application);
  GtkWindow* window =
      GTK_WINDOW(gtk_application_window_new(GTK_APPLICATION(application)));

  // Use a header bar when running in GNOME as this is the common style used
  // by applications and is the setup most users will be using (e.g. Ubuntu
  // desktop).
  // If running on X and not using GNOME then just use a traditional title bar
  // in case the window manager does more exotic layout, e.g. tiling.
  // If running on Wayland assume the header bar will work (may need changing
  // if future cases occur).
  gboolean use_header_bar = TRUE;
#ifdef GDK_WINDOWING_X11
  GdkScreen* screen = gtk_window_get_screen(window);
  if (GDK_IS_X11_SCREEN(screen)) {
    const gchar* wm_name = gdk_x11_screen_get_window_manager_name(screen);
    if (g_strcmp0(wm_name, "GNOME Shell") != 0) {
      use_header_bar = FALSE;
    }
  }
#endif
  if (use_header_bar) {
    GtkHeaderBar* header_bar = GTK_HEADER_BAR(gtk_header_bar_new());
    gtk_widget_show(GTK_WIDGET(header_bar));
    gtk_header_bar_set_title(header_bar, "itak_gaming");
    gtk_header_bar_set_show_close_button(header_bar, TRUE);
    gtk_window_set_titlebar(window, GTK_WIDGET(header_bar));
  } else {
    gtk_window_set_title(window, "itak_gaming");
  }

  gtk_window_set_default_size(window, 1280, 720);
  gtk_widget_show(GTK_WIDGET(window));

  g_autoptr(FlDartProject) project = fl_dart_project_new();
  fl_dart_project_set_dart_entrypoint_arguments(project, self->dart_entrypoint_arguments);

  FlView* view = fl_view_new(project);
  gtk_widget_show(GTK_WIDGET(view));
  gtk_container_add(GTK_CONTAINER(window), GTK_WIDGET(view));

  fl_register_plugins(FL_PLUGIN_REGISTRY(view));

  gtk_widget_grab_focus(GTK_WIDGET(view));
}

// Implements GApplication::local_command_line.
static gboolean my_application_local_command_line(GApplication* application, gchar*** arguments, int* exit_status) {
  MyApplication* self = MY_APPLICATION(application);
  // Strip out the first argument as it is the binary name.
  self->dart_entrypoint_arguments = g_strdupv(*arguments + 1);

  g_autoptr(GError) error = nullptr;
  if (!g_application_register(application, nullptr, &error)) {
     g_warning("Failed to register: %s", error->message);
     *exit_status = 1;
     return TRUE;
  }

  g_application_activate(application);
  *exit_status = 0;

  return TRUE;
}

// Implements GApplication::startup.
static void my_application_startup(GApplication* application) {
  //MyApplication* self = MY_APPLICATION(object);

  // Perform any actions required at application startup.

  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(my_application_parent_class)->startup(application);
}

// Implements GApplication::shutdown.
static void my_application_shutdown(GApplication* application) {
  //MyApplication* self = MY_APPLICATION(object);

  // Perform any actions required at application shutdown.

  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(my_application_parent_class)->shutdown(application);
}

// Implements GObject::dispose.
static void my_application_dispose(GObject* object) {
  MyApplication* self = MY_APPLICATION(object);
  g_clear_pointer(&self->dart_entrypoint_arguments, g_strfreev);
  G_OBJECT_CLASS(my_application_parent_class)->dispose(object);
}

static void my_application_class_init(MyApplicationClass* klass) {
  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(klass)->activate = my_application_activate;
  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(klass)->local_command_line = my_application_local_command_line;
  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(klass)->startup = my_application_startup;
  G_APPLICATION_CLASS(klass)->shutdown = my_application_shutdown;
  G_OBJECT_CLASS(klass)->dispose = my_application_dispose;
}

static void my_application_init(MyApplication* self) {}

MyApplication* my_application_new() {
  return MY_APPLICATION(g_object_new(my_application_get_type(),
                                     "application-id", APPLICATION_ID,
                                     "flags", G_APPLICATION_NON_UNIQUE,
                                     nullptr));
}

==================== FILE: flutter_ui/macos/Runner/MainFlutterWindow.swift ====================

import Cocoa
import FlutterMacOS

class MainFlutterWindow: NSWindow {
  override func awakeFromNib() {
    let flutterViewController = FlutterViewController()
    let windowFrame = self.frame
    self.contentViewController = flutterViewController
    self.setFrame(windowFrame, display: true)

    RegisterGeneratedPlugins(registry: flutterViewController)

    super.awakeFromNib()
  }
}

==================== FILE: flutter_ui/test/settings_screen_test.dart ====================

// Settings screen D-pad tests (2026-11-04 focus + popup rework).
//
// Test 1 is the regression test for the shipped bug: on 1.105 the
// rows were not focus nodes at all, so an UP press moved the manual
// highlight once and then framework traversal threw real focus to
// the AppBar back button, after which the remote was dead until a
// RIGHT press rescued it. Here the rows ARE focus nodes, so focus
// itself must walk the whole list in both directions.
//
// Tests 2-4 cover the popup rework: activating a row opens its
// popup with a default choice focused, and closing the popup
// returns focus to the row that opened it.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:itak_gaming/main.dart';

String? focusLabel() => FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.debugLabel;

Future<void> key(WidgetTester tester, LogicalKeyboardKey k) async {
  await tester.sendKeyEvent(k);
  // Let the 180 ms ensure-visible scroll animation finish so the
  // next traversal step sees settled geometry.
  await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 220));
}

/// Text of the currently focused TextButton, if focus is on one.
String? focusedButtonText(WidgetTester tester) {
  final ctx = FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.context;
  if (ctx == null) return null;
  final btn = ctx.findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<TextButton>();
  if (btn == null) return null;
  final child = btn.child;
  return child is Text ? child.data : null;
}

Future<void> openSettings(WidgetTester tester) async {
  tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1920, 1080);
  tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 1.0;
  addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
  await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
    home: Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('shell'))),
  ));
  tester
      .state<NavigatorState>(find.byType(Navigator))
      .push(MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()));
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
}

void main() {
  testWidgets('D-pad walks the whole settings list and back',
      (tester) async {
    await openSettings(tester);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-0');

    for (var i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
      await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown);
      expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-$i', reason: 'after $i DOWNs');
    }
    // Bottom of the list: DOWN stays on the Back row.
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-12');

    // The shipped bug: this UP fled to the AppBar back button.
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-11');
    for (var i = 10; i >= 0; i--) {
      await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp);
      expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-$i', reason: 'walking back up');
    }

    // UP from the top row reaches the header back button on
    // purpose, and DOWN from it returns to row 0.
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp);
    final pf = FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus;
    expect(pf, isNotNull);
    expect(focusLabel(), isNot(startsWith('settings-row')));
    expect(pf!.context!.findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<BackButton>(),
        isNotNull);
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-0');
  });

  testWidgets('Toggle row opens its popup, applies, refocuses the row',
      (tester) async {
    await openSettings(tester);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-0');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Swap A and B buttons'), findsWidgets);
    expect(find.text('Now: Off'), findsOneWidget);
    // Default focus sits on the current value's button.
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'Off');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight);
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'On');
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsNothing);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-0');

    // Reopening proves the pick was applied: it now reads On, and
    // the default focus moved to the On button.
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Now: On'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'On');
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsNothing);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-0');
  });

  testWidgets('Sound test popup: buttons walkable, Close refocuses row',
      (tester) async {
    await openSettings(tester);
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown);
    }
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-4');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Sound test'), findsWidgets);
    // Scope to the dialog: 'Send debug report now' is also row 10's
    // label in the list behind the popup.
    final inDialog = find.descendant(
        of: find.byType(AlertDialog), matching: find.byType(TextButton));
    expect(
        find.descendant(
            of: find.byType(AlertDialog),
            matching: find.text('Measure sound delay')),
        findsOneWidget);
    expect(
        find.descendant(
            of: find.byType(AlertDialog),
            matching: find.text('Send debug report now')),
        findsOneWidget);
    expect(inDialog, findsNWidgets(3));
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'Measure sound delay');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight);
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'Send debug report now');
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight);
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'Close');
    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsNothing);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-4');
  });

  testWidgets('Logs popup opens with Close focused and refocuses row',
      (tester) async {
    await openSettings(tester);
    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown);
    }
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-6');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Logs'), findsWidgets);
    expect(focusedButtonText(tester), 'Close');

    await key(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter);
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsNothing);
    expect(focusLabel(), 'settings-row-6');
  });
}

# Compilation settings that should be applied to most targets.
#
# Be cautious about adding new options here, as plugins use this function by
# default. In most cases, you should add new options to specific targets instead
# of modifying this function.
function(APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS TARGET)
  target_compile_features(${TARGET} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /W4 /WX /wd"4100")
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /EHsc)
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0")
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:_DEBUG>")

  "${WRAPPER_ROOT}/include"
